article.articleHeadline: 13 casos de sarampo são registrados este ano em SP e acendem alerta para necessidade de vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 13 measles cases have been recorded this year in São Paulo, raising the alarm about the need for vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo, Brazil: 13 cases recorded this year in the state, with 11 in the capital, prompting vaccination actions. Health authorities launched an immunization drive at the Santa Cruz metro station, with plans to expand to additional sites. Measles is a highly contagious viral disease causing high fever and skin rashes and can lead to serious complications, especially in infants and the immunocompromised. Last year Brazil confirmed 38 measles cases nationwide. The new locally reported cases include babies up to one year and adults aged 20–50. Officials urge residents to check and update their vaccination records. The vaccine is freely available at all primary health units and is considered safe and effective. The Ministry of Health recommends: infants 6–11 months receive a zero-dose; people 5–29 years should have two doses; adults 30–59 years should have at least one dose.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で今年13件の麻疹症例が確認、ワクチン接種の必要性に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹症例数が限定的で重篤例の報告もないが、ヒト-ヒト感染力が高く継続的な監視が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 症例数13件と小規模で、ブラジル保健当局が予防接種キャンペーンを実施中。重症例や死亡の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Perú donará 3,000 ampollas de medicamento para tratar la leishmaniasis en Costa Rica tras gestiones del Ministerio de Salud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peru to donate 3,000 ampoules of medication to treat Leishmaniasis in Costa Rica following the Ministry of Health's actions.
article.articleSummary: Peru donates 3,000 ampoules of meglumine antimoniate to Costa Rica to treat leishmaniasis amid a national shortage. The Peruvian government confirmed the donation as part of international cooperation steered by the Costa Rican Ministry of Health to secure essential medicines. Costa Rica’s health authorities cite the donation as a key step to maintain treatment for diagnosed patients; regional partners Brazil, Peru, and Guatemala are being contacted to diversify supply while availability is resolved. Leishmaniasis, a vector-borne zoonosis caused by Leishmania parasites and transmitted by female sandflies (Lutzomyia), remains a public health concern in rural and forested areas. As of June 17, 2026, Costa Rica reported 369 cases (204 men, 165 women). Preventive measures include environmental cleanliness, waste management, window/door screens, repellents, protective clothing, and veterinary controls. The CCSS will review technical documentation, ensure regulatory compliance, and coordinate import/logistics before distribution to centers; authorities will sustain international cooperation to prevent shortages.

triage.headline_ja: ペルー、保健省の働きかけによりコスタリカへリーシュマニア症治療薬3,000アンプルを寄贈
triage.triage_reason: コスタリカにおける医薬品不足への国際協力の話であり、対象国（Peru, Guatemala, Costa Rica）はいずれも監視対象国リストに含まれず、Brazilも主題ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコスタリカにおけるリーシュマニア症治療薬の不足とペルー・ブラジル・グアテマラとの国際協力であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。Brazilは供給元候補として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Số ca tử vong ở châu Phi tăng lên hơn 1.000 người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Death toll in Africa rises to more than 1,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa expands across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of July 20, DRC records 2,473 confirmed Ebola cases and 999 deaths; 737 patients are in isolation or hospital, with 482 recoveries. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Total Ebola deaths in the two affected countries reach 1,001. At the AU Extraordinary Assembly’s 25th session in Accra on July 21, Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warned the outbreak could become one of the worst on record if not rapidly controlled, urging stronger political commitment and increased resources. Outbreak funding has surged from an estimated $518 million in June to about $1.4 billion. Humanitarian conditions in the DRC are worsening, with over 1.15 million internally displaced, complicating response and heightening transmission risk amid gaps in contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:アフリカでの死者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を中心に確認症例2,473例・死亡999例に達し、ウガンダにも拡大。アフリカCDCが史上最悪級になり得ると警告し、国際的資金・支援が急増しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ガーナ(アクラ)はAU臨時総会の開催地として言及されているのみで、疾病発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Zika Virus Testing Market Forecast to Reach USD 359.44 Million by 2031 Driven by Expanding Disease Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Zika virus testing market forecast: Global market valued at USD 256.03 million in 2026, projected to reach USD 359.44 million by 2031, CAGR 7.03%. Growth is driven by expanding mosquito-borne disease surveillance, broader vector monitoring, and emphasis on early diagnosis by public health agencies and healthcare providers in regions vulnerable to Zika. Rising international travel and expanding mosquito habitats further boost demand. Key players include Abbott, DiaSorin (Luminex), Roche, Quest Diagnostics, and Siemens. Segments span test types (molecular, serologic, PRNT); samples (blood/serum, urine, saliva); end-users (hospitals/clinics, diagnostic laboratories, home care, research institutes); and geographies (North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, South America, Middle East and Africa). Trends include multiplex testing platforms, improved assay accuracy, and enhanced domestic manufacturing for supply stability, reflecting ongoing investments in surveillance and diagnostic preparedness for global mosquito-borne disease monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ジカウイルス検査市場、疾病監視の拡大に牽引され2031年までに3億5,944万米ドルに達すると予測
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はジカウイルス検査の市場調査レポートであり、具体的な感染症発生や公衆衛生上の事象を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 市場調査レポート記事であり、特定地域での実際の感染症発生報告ではないため、発生地域（中国）は主題と無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en Congo y Uganda supera las 1000 muertes, informa la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo and Uganda surpasses 1,000 deaths, WHO reports.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports more than 1,000 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of July 22, 2026, with 2,473 confirmed cases since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Ituri and North Kivu provinces continue to bear the bulk of infections, though the outbreak has reached other northeastern provinces. Uganda stopped reporting Ebola cases amid the Congo outbreak, having recorded 20 cases and 2 deaths; no new Ugandan cases have been reported since July 21, and the region remains under intensive epidemiological surveillance. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the outbreak is spreading faster than any Congo outbreak in the past, and acknowledges the response is ahead of current controls. WHO notes encouraging progress on two potential treatments for the Bundibugyo strain—a vaccine trial and a post-exposure prophylaxis that could be given after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行、死者1000人超とWHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ死者数が1000人を超え、WHO事務局長が過去最速の拡大速度と発言するなど深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大の複数基準に該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは対応がコントロールに追いついていないと認めており、国際支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Lebih 1,000 kematian wabak Ebola direkodkan di DRC, Uganda: WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,000 deaths from the Ebola outbreak recorded in the DRC and Uganda: WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak declared in May is affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with over 1,000 deaths reported. WHO data show 2,473 confirmed cases in the DRC, including 999 deaths, and 20 cases in Uganda, including 2 deaths. Most transmission remains in the conflict-affected Ituri region of northeastern DRC, where precarious living conditions impede case finding; contact tracing demands substantial resources amid poverty and insecurity. Some fatalities occurred with families burying their dead without protective measures, accelerating spread (one death can generate up to 17 secondary cases). Uganda’s cases are largely Congolese cross-border arrivals; three weeks have elapsed without new Ugandan cases. There is no approved vaccine or Bundibugyo virus treatment yet, though WHO notes progress toward vaccine and post-exposure prophylaxis trials in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: DRCとウガンダで発生中のエボラ出血熱、死者1,000人超え：WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,473症例・999死亡、ウガンダに越境拡大しており、致死率が高く国際的拡大リスクとワクチン未承認という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、紛争地域での症例探知困難など、感染拡大リスクが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ébola Supera las Mil Muertes: "Se Expande Más Rápido que Cualquier Brote Previo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic Surpasses a Thousand Deaths: "It Is Spreading Faster Than Any Previous Outbreak."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has surpassed 1,000 deaths, with 2,473 confirmed cases in the DRC and 999 deaths; Uganda reports 20 infections and 2 deaths. Declared May 15, this seventeenth Ebola outbreak since the virus’s discovery is centered mainly in Ituri province in northeastern DRC, with cases in four other provinces. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids. The WHO notes the outbreak is spreading faster than any previous one. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant has no vaccine or approved treatment. In DRC, experimental therapies are under evaluation: MBP134 antibody cocktail plus remdesivir, with vaccine trials also underway. Uganda reports most cases involve Congolese cross-border travelers, with no new cases in three weeks. Symptoms appear up to 21 days after infection, starting with fever and pains, then hemorrhagic fever, with about 50% mortality in the hemorrhagic stage.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、死者1,000人を超える:「過去のどの流行よりも速いスピードで拡大している」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行が死者1,000人を超え、WHOが過去最速の拡大速度と指摘しており、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の観点からIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス変異株であり、致死率も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Deaths Top 1,000 in Congo as Response Trails Fastest-Spreading Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, confirmed Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 1,000, with Africa's top public health official warning the outbreak could become one of the worst on record unless transmission is rapidly brought under control. The death toll has doubled in just over two weeks, signaling a fast-spreading outbreak and ongoing containment challenges. The report centers on confirmed fatalities within the context of the evolving public health response, underlining the gravity of the trajectory in the DRC and the urgent need to curb transmission to avert further loss of life. The situation has drawn heightened international attention as authorities work to accelerate measures to halt transmission and manage the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者数が1,000人を超える、対応が追いつかず史上最速の拡大を見せる感染爆発
triage.triage_reason: エボラ死者数が急増し2週間で倍増するなど公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心の高さからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 死者数が2週間で倍増し1,000人を超えるという急速な拡大が報告されており、封じ込めの遅れが強調されている。アフリカ地域全体の公衆衛生当局トップが史上最悪級となる可能性を警告している点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Three British Airways suffer food poisoning at same time - 30,000 ft in air
article.articleSummary: Three British Airways pilots suffered food poisoning simultaneously during a flight to Heathrow after a stopover in India. The first pilot became incapacitated at 30,000 ft and required oxygen; the other two continued operating but developed worsening symptoms. Breakfast in a Hyderabad hotel lounge, coupled with bottled water from an external supplier, is noted as the potential exposure. Upon landing, one pilot needed a 12-hour operation in hospital; passenger safety was described as uncompromised. All three pilots filed Air Safety Reports and were asked to provide samples to help doctors identify the illness source. British Airways is reviewing hotel arrangements used during the layover. The incident underscores in-flight medical emergencies linked to suspected foodborne illness and the difficulty of pinpointing the contamination source when multiple crew members are affected.

triage.headline_ja: 英国航空のパイロット3名、飛行中に同時に食中毒を発症 - 高度3万フィート
triage.triage_reason: 個別の食中毒事例であり、公衆衛生上の広範な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。パイロット3名という限定的な集団感染で、公衆の関心も低い。
triage.notes: インド・ハイデラバードのホテルでの食事が原因と疑われる個別の食中毒事例。感染症のアウトブレイクではなく、単発の食品衛生問題として扱うべき事案。対象国リストのインドが発生地域に含まれるが、これは公衆衛生上の疾病流行ではなく個人の食中毒事例のためピックアップ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات "إيبولا" في إفريقيا تتجاوز ألف حالة والإصابات ترتفع إلى 2493
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Africa exceed 1,000, with infections rising to 2,493.
article.articleSummary: Ebola deaths in Africa exceed 1,000, with infections rising to 2,493. As of July 20, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 2,473 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections, including 999 deaths, while Uganda registered 20 cases and 2 deaths. The combined total stands at 2,493 confirmed infections and 1,001 deaths across the two countries. The outbreak was first declared in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15 and has since spread to four additional provinces. Health authorities report 737 patients still under treatment or in isolation and 482 recoveries. Reported from Kinshasa on July 23 by WAM, these figures indicate ongoing transmission since the outbreak’s start, underscoring the need for continued containment and surveillance.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,473例・999人死亡、ウガンダにも拡大し国境を越えた人-人感染が継続しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダも感染確認国だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率が高く(約40%)、複数州への拡大も見られるため継続的な監視・支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 济宁高风险!山东发布最新健康提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jining at High Risk! Shandong Issues Latest Health Tips.
article.articleSummary: Jining is highlighted as high risk as Shandong’s late June 2026 mosquito-density forecast shows central Shandong (鲁中) and southern Shandong (鲁南) mainly at level 5 (high risk) for July; other areas are level 4 (high–moderate risk). The white-striped mosquito, Aedes albopictus, enters the annual high-activity peak, raising concerns for dengue fever and chikungunya; Culex tritaeniorhynchus remains a vector for Japanese encephalitis, and Anopheles sinensis for malaria. The forecast combines data from 16 city monitoring stations, historical weather, and forecasts. Prevention emphasizes source reduction and personal protection: wear light-colored long sleeves and pants, apply DEET or Picaridin repellents, and avoid dawn/dusk outdoors—especially for infants, pregnant women, the elderly, and those with underlying diseases. Check and eliminate standing water daily in high-risk areas (every 3 days elsewhere); use screens and nets; seek medical care if fever, headache, joint pain, or rash and provide travel history. Source: Shandong CDC.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le ministre congolais de la Santé à Kampala pour coordonner la riposte avec l'Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the Congolese health minister in Kampala to coordinate the response with Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Congolese Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba arrived in Kampala to strengthen cross-border cooperation with Uganda against Ebola, focusing on border-area surveillance, prevention, and urgent-response coordination. The Bundibugyo strain, originating in Ituri, has crossed into Uganda with about twenty cases and two deaths. As of mid-July, Uganda is approaching the end of its outbreak, with no new confirmed cases since June 21 and a 42-day countdown begun July 16 to end-of-outbreak declaration; Congo's outbreak continues, with over 2,260 cases and nearly 900 deaths. The two countries seek to prevent re-importation and leverage Ugandan response experience for Congo's response. African CDC urges early detection, transparent information sharing, and regional coordination; WHO cautions that border closures hinder control and stigmatization.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国保健大臣、ウガンダとの対応調整のためカンパラを訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで2,260例・約900人の死者を記録し、既にウガンダへ国境を越えて拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国境を越えた感染拡大が実際に発生している点はリスク評価上重要。WHOは国境封鎖が対策の妨げになると警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Breaking News Live Updates: Over 1,000 died in the Ebola outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: Over 1,000 people have died in the Ebola outbreak in Congo, with ongoing transmission noted as of 2026-07-23. In the same dated report, Taiwan’s Ministry of National Defence recorded heightened Chinese military activity around its territory: 21 PLA aircraft sorties, 6 PLAN vessels and 2 official ships operating around Taiwan up to 06:00 UTC+8; 20 of the 21 sorties crossed the median line into Taiwan’s northern and southwestern ADIZ, with ROC Armed Forces monitoring and responding. The Ebola note confirms Congo as affected; the Taiwan item highlights tense cross-strait security dynamics on the same date. No laboratory confirmation, infection source, or case details are provided beyond these figures.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱による死者数が1,000人を超え、継続的な感染拡大が示唆されているため、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響とWPRO基準複数該当によりフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾・中国間の軍事的緊張についても言及しているが、これはエボラとは無関係な別事象であり、疾患発生国としてはコンゴのみが該当する。ラボ確認や感染源等の詳細情報は記事にないため、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 热射病、传染病、心脑血管疾病如何防？省卫健委专家答疑解惑
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to prevent heat stroke, infectious diseases, and cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases? Experts from the Provincial Health Commission answer questions and dispel doubts.
article.articleSummary: Fujian Province, China, held a summer disease prevention briefing focusing on heat‑stroke rescue, infectious-disease control, and cardiovascular/cerebrovascular care for children, older adults, and chronic patients. Six experts from Fujian CDC and major local hospitals outlined three high‑risk summer infections: enteric diseases (norovirus gastroenteritis, bacterial dysentery, Salmonella enteritis, cholera) transmitted mainly via contaminated water or undercooked foods; vector‑borne diseases (dengue, chikungunya) spread by mosquitoes (and ticks in outdoor settings); and respiratory infections (influenza, COVID‑19) with rising trends. Prevention guidance emphasizes four areas: diet, environment, protection, and habits—drinking boiled water, fully cooked foods, clean utensils, avoiding raw water, washing produce, reheating leftovers; eliminating standing water and pest breeding sites; ventilating air‑conditioned spaces; wearing protective clothing, using repellents, avoiding crowded enclosed spaces, and regular handwashing. For children, five risks include heat stroke and drowning, with explicit drowning precautions; for elderly with cardiovascular disease, advocate gradual activity, a low‑salt/low‑fat/high‑fiber diet, regular monitoring, and prudent AC use.

triage.headline_ja: 熱中症、感染症、心脳血管疾患をどう予防する？省衛生健康委員会専門家が疑問に答える
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、夏季の一般的な健康啓発・予防広報記事であり、異常な公衆衛生事象を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は福建省の夏季疾病予防に関する専門家Q&A形式の啓発記事であり、具体的なアウトブレイクや症例数の急増などの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Anjing Liar Mulai Resahkan Warga Pelaihari Tanahlaut, Lansia Perempuan Jadi Korban Gigitan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stray dogs disturb residents of Pelaihari, Tanah Laut Regency; an elderly woman was bitten.
article.articleSummary: Stray dogs roaming Pelaihari, Tanah Laut Regency, Kalimantan Selatan, have residents anxious after an elderly woman was bitten. The attack occurred July 14, 2026, around 18:00 WITA in Almanar, Angsau, Pelaihari, when a dog suddenly charged a pedestrian returning from a waste disposal site. The victim sustained a single bite on the right calf above the ankle. She was taken to the Emergency Department of RSUD Hadji Boejasin Pelaihari and received three rabies vaccine injections; she was discharged in healthy condition after evaluation. The incident raises rabies concerns as stray dogs are increasingly seen near homes and the TPS. Residents express fear of further attacks if dogs are not controlled. No laboratory confirmation of rabies is reported.

triage.headline_ja: 野良犬がプレイハリの住民を脅かす、タナラウト郡で高齢女性が咬傷被害に

triage.notes: 被害者は狂犬病ワクチン接種済みで健康状態良好のまま退院。ラボによる狂犬病確定診断はなし。野良犬の増加が地域住民の懸念事項となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ngành chuyên môn Hà Tĩnh khuyến cáo tăng cường phòng, chống dịch sau khi xuất hiện ổ dịch H5N1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hà Tĩnh authorities urge enhanced disease prevention and control after the emergence of an H5N1 outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ha Tinh authorities have activated enhanced avian influenza prevention after an H5N1 outbreak emerged in Cam Duệ Commune, Ha Tinh Province, on July 13. The outbreak affected 228 poultry across five households, triggering mandatory culling. Control measures include quarantine and culling of infected/high‑risk birds, continuous disinfection of sheds and entry points, ongoing sampling, vaccination boosters, and intensified surveillance of neighboring flocks. Movement of poultry and products from the infected area is being restricted, with emphasis on reporting and biosafety compliance. The risk of further spread remains high given concurrent outbreaks in Nghe An, Thanh Hoa, Ninh Binh, Phu Tho, Dien Bien, and Cao Bang. Round 1/2026 vaccination coverage is low; some households have not reported outbreaks. Public guidance urges using poultry with origin, avoiding sick birds and raw poultry products, and ensuring thorough cooking. Additional boosters for unvaccinated or newly introduced flocks are planned, alongside market and farm monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: H5N1感染発生後、ハティン省の専門機関が防疫強化を勧告
triage.triage_reason: 家禽におけるH5N1発生であり、現時点でヒトへの感染は報告されていないが、ベトナム複数省で同時多発しておりワクチン接種率も低いため、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽（鳥）のH5N1発生に関するものでヒト感染事例の記載はない。影響カテゴリも'animals'のみ。ただし複数省（ゲアン、タインホア、ニンビン、フート、ディエンビエン、カオバン）で同時発生しており、ワクチン接種率低下や報告不備も指摘されているため、ヒトへのスピルオーバーリスクを含め継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha reports first Covid case from Ganjam
article.articleSummary: First Covid-19 case in Odisha this year; on Wednesday, 22 July 2026, a 54-year-old woman from Purushottampur, Ganjam district, tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 and is receiving treatment at MKCG Medical College and Hospital in Berhampur. Hospital superintendent Prof Sudeepa Dash said the patient's condition is stable and the virus is mutant and harmless. The district administration has intensified surveillance and preparedness; all government hospitals and community health centres have been directed to strengthen monitoring for possible increases in infections. Covid-19 testing is now mandatory for patients with severe acute respiratory infections (SARI) and influenza-like illness (ILI); at MKCG MCH, 5% of patients with fever, cough, and cold are tested as part of routine surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州、ガンジャム県で今年初のCovid症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 単発の軽症例で病原体も無害と説明されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低く、社会的関心も限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: 患者は安定しており、病院関係者はウイルスは変異株だが無害と説明。地元当局はSARI/ILI患者への検査強化など監視体制を強化しているが、これは通常のサーベイランス強化であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo sees early signs of Ebola stabilization
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak in eastern provinces shows early stabilization, with case notifications plateauing and a slight downward trend as of July 20. The epicenter is Bunia, Ituri province, part of a five-province outbreak declared May 15, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Government figures: 2,473 confirmed cases, 999 deaths, 482 recoveries, and 737 patients in isolation or hospital care. Response capacity includes 23 Ebola treatment centers, 19 operational laboratories, and nearly 800 beds across affected regions. Despite progress, community resistance, insecurity, and geographic spread remain challenges. Authorities stress the importance of early detection, public trust in health facilities, and adherence to preventive measures to break transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の早期安定化の兆候
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定2,473例、死亡999例）であり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航貿易制限リスク）を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 5州にまたがる大規模アウトブレイクで死亡率が高く（999/2473）、地域拡大・住民抵抗・治安不安など管理上の課題が継続している。安定化の兆しはあるが依然警戒レベルは高い。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला के कहर से कांगो त्रस्त, वायरस के नए वैरिएंट ने मचाई तबाही, 2 महीने में ही 1 हजार से अधिक की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo plagued by Ebola outbreak as a new virus variant wreaks havoc, more than 1,000 deaths in just two months.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is confronting an Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo variant, the fastest-spreading on record. As of 23 July 2026, the country reports 1,031 confirmed deaths and 2,473 new cases, with about 737 patients in isolation or hospital. The variant was declared on 15 May and currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. The World Health Organization warns the true toll may be 2–4 times higher due to inaccessibility and ongoing conflict. Ebola spreads via contact with infected bodily fluids, causing severe illness and often death. The outbreak centers in Ituri province and four other provinces, with roughly 80% of new cases outside known hotspots. Burial teams face resistance, and attacks on health centers and responders have hindered response, leaving frontline workers unpaid and sometimes on strike. The situation marks a faster spread than the 2013–2016 Ebola outbreak, which had about 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ危機深刻化、新変異ウイルスが猛威、2カ月で1000人以上死亡
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速拡散とされるブンディブギョ変異株による大規模アウトブレイクで、死者1000人超・症例2473件、ワクチン未承認、紛争による対応困難という複合的な深刻事態のためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の死者・患者数が報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性を警告しており、埋葬チームや医療従事者への攻撃・ストライキも対応を阻害している。2013-2016年の大流行を上回る速度で拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim Epidemiológico das Arboviroses: Município registra seis casos prováveis de dengue na 28ª Semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiological Bulletin of Arboviral Diseases: The municipality reports six probable dengue cases in Week 28
article.articleSummary: Week 28 (12–18 July 2026) in Vitória da Conquista shows dengue activity largely under investigation: seven suspected dengue cases were reported, one discarded, and six unresolved; no lab or clinical confirmations and no hospitalizations for dengue, chikungunya, or Zika in that week. The six probable dengue cases are primarily urban: Centro (2), Candeias (1), Patagônia (1), Urbis 5 (1), São João da Vitória (1). January–July 2026 totals: 826 dengue notifications, 23 confirmed, 633 probable. Chikungunya: 64 notifications, 1 confirmed, 58 probable. Zika: 1 notification and 1 confirmed. No arboviral deaths to date. Data from Sinan Online and subject to change as investigations progress; routine Aedes aegypti control measures remain active by municipal health teams.

triage.headline_ja: アルボウイルス感染症疫学速報:自治体が第28週にデング熱の疑い例6件を報告
triage.triage_reason: 地域の定例疫学速報であり、死亡例なし・入院なし・確定例も少数で、通常の監視活動の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ヴィトリア・ダ・コンキスタ市の定例デング熱等アルボウイルス疫学速報。死亡例・入院例なし、通常の蚊媒介対策が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Bullous cutaneous larva migrans: an atypical presentation and review of literature - Parasitology Research
article.articleSummary: Bullous cutaneous larva migrans (CLM), an atypical presentation of a common tropical dermatosis, was diagnosed in a previously healthy 34-year-old man after barefoot mud exposure on a hike in Thailand. Initially treated with antibiotics for presumed bacterial infection, nine days after onset he developed multiple tense bullae with surrounding erythema on the right foot. Review of a prior photograph revealing a serpiginous track, together with exposure history, supported bullous CLM. A single oral dose of ivermectin produced rapid clinical improvement with no recurrence. The case emphasizes the broad spectrum of CLM presentations and highlights the diagnostic value of prior clinical photographs, detailed exposure history, and re-evaluation of non-resolving symptoms to avoid delayed diagnosis and unnecessary antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 水疱型皮膚幼虫移行症：非定型症例の呈示と文献レビュー - Parasitology Research
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や集団感染の兆候はなく、通常のヒト-ヒト感染もしない寄生虫症の稀な臨床像に関する学術報告のため。
triage.notes: 単一の臨床症例報告であり、感染症危機管理上の公衆衛生シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: ডেঙ্গি মোকাবিলায় এবার ভারতে এল ভ্যাকসিন,'কিউ ডেঙ্গা'-কে বাণিজ্যিকভাবে বিক্রির অনুমোদন
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dengue vaccine has arrived in India to combat dengue; approval to commercially sell 'Q Dengue'.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, India’s Drug Controller General has granted commercial approval for the dengue vaccine Q Dengue, developed by Japan’s Takita Biopharmaceuticals. The vaccine will be administered to children aged 4–7 years and reportedly requires no prior dengue infection screening. Manufacturer claims Q Dengue protects against all four dengue virus serotypes. It has already been approved in 43 countries, including Switzerland, Indonesia, and Malaysia, with clinical trials involving over 28,000 participants across at least eight countries. This marks the first dengue vaccine to be commercially available in India.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策としてインドにワクチン登場、『キューデンガ』の商業販売が承認
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチンの商業承認に関するニュースであり、感染症の異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の発生報告ではなく、ワクチンの商業承認に関する情報提供記事。日本・スイス・インドネシア・マレーシアは既承認国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Deaths Surpass 1,000 in Congo as Virus Outpaces Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 1,000, as the outbreak outpaces the response. Africa's top public health official warned the epidemic could become one of the worst on record unless transmission is rapidly brought under control. The National Institute of Public Health reported 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths as of Thursday, with fatalities doubling in just over two weeks from 506 on July 4. The outbreak has spread beyond its Ituri epicenter into two new provinces, signaling greater geographic reach. Public health authorities emphasize urgent, intensified containment measures to stop further transmission and avert a larger public health disaster.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者数が1,000人を超える、ウイルスが対応を上回るペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し死者数が急増、複数州に拡大しており公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く、感染者数・死者数が急増（2週間で死者数倍増）。Ituri州から新たな2州へ拡大しており、アフリカCDCも最悪クラスの流行になる恐れを警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh sởi đang gia tăng: Những điều cha mẹ cần biết để bảo vệ trẻ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles are on the rise: What parents need to know to protect their children
article.articleSummary: Measles cases are rising in Vietnam. Measles is an acute viral respiratory illness that can cause serious complications if not detected and managed. Early symptoms mimic fever and rash: high fever 38.5–40°C, cough, runny nose, Koplik spots; after 3–4 days a rash appears behind the ears and spreads to the face, neck, trunk, and limbs, with fever often easing as the rash reaches the legs. Complications include pneumonia (the most common and leading cause of death in children with measles), encephalitis/meningitis, prolonged diarrhea with dehydration, and eye ulcers that can cause blindness, especially in malnourished children with low vitamin A. Home care emphasizes isolation, rest, fever relief with paracetamol (avoid aspirin), gentle cleansing, and vitamin A per medical guidance; seek hospital for persistent fever, rapid breathing, poor intake, or severe diarrhea. Vaccination per Expanded Immunization Program: first dose at 9 months and second at 18 months; catch-up vaccines encouraged.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹(はしか)が増加中：子どもを守るために親が知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで麻疹症例が増加しているとの記述があるが、具体的な症例数や地域的広がり、重症度データが示されておらず、内容は主に保護者向けの一般的な健康教育情報である。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の症状・合併症・家庭でのケア・予防接種スケジュールに関する一般的な啓発情報であり、具体的な発生規模や地域データは含まれていない。続報で症例数や地域的拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 危险就在厨房！男子徒手处理生肉染"布病"颈椎被啃出大洞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Danger in the kitchen! A man who handles raw meat with bare hands contracted brucellosis, and his cervical vertebrae were gnawed into a large hole.
article.articleSummary: A 53-year-old man with two months of low-grade fever and bone pain was diagnosed with brucellosis (Brucella infection). Imaging confirmed erosion of the seventh cervical vertebra, indicating spinal infection threatening the spinal cord. Investigation linked the illness to kitchen exposure: he buys raw beef, handles it without gloves, and uses cutting boards and knives without proper sanitation. His family keeps pigs and dogs, with pigs recognized as Brucella hosts. Brucellosis is prevalent in Northwest pastoral regions; cattle and sheep are the primary sources, while pigs can also host the bacteria. Transmission likely occurred through hand wounds during contact with raw meat or animals. The infection tends to affect the spine and joints, with cervical involvement being rare and more dangerous due to potential spinal cord compression. Symptoms include prolonged fever and bone pain; weakness or paralysis can occur if an abscess forms. Advice: avoid handling raw meat with hand injuries; wear gloves, wash hands thoroughly, and keep raw and cooked meat separate.

triage.headline_ja: 厨房に潜む危険！生肉を素手で扱った男性が「ブルセラ症」に感染、頸椎に大きな穴が開く
triage.triage_reason: 個人の生肉取り扱いによる散発的なブルセラ症症例であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や集団感染の兆候はない。中国では風土病的に発生している既知の感染症であり、健康啓発目的の記事と考えられる。
triage.notes: 1例の散発症例に関する健康啓発記事であり、動物由来感染症の家庭内・職業曝露によるもの。集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC urges action amid rapid Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) is spreading at an unprecedented pace amid insecurity and mass displacement. As of July 23, 2026, 2,473 cases and 999 deaths have been reported across five provinces (case fatality rate 40%). More than 1,000 total deaths since May. Of the known cases, 737 are in isolation or hospitalization; 482 recovered; 700+ patients remain under follow-up. Surveillance and response are intensifying: over 80% of epidemiological alerts investigated within 24 hours; 81% of contacts traced. Treatment facilities remain open. Internal displacement exceeds 1.15 million in affected areas, complicating control efforts; insecurity has hampered response, with an Africa CDC staffer injured. A joint Africa CDC-WHO continental response plan targets about $1.4 billion; African pledges exceed $110 million, with a remaining funding gap of about $12 million for therapeutics and vaccines. Emphasis on health security, regional cooperation, and self-reliance.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラの急速な拡大を受けて対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が5州に拡大し、致死率40%、死者999人・症例2473件と深刻。治安悪化・大規模避難民により制御が困難で、国際的な資金支援計画（14億ドル規模）が発動されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率40%、5州にまたがる大規模流行で、治安不安・150万人超の国内避難民が対応を困難にしている。Africa CDCとWHOによる共同大陸対応計画（約14億ドル）が進行中で、資金ギャップ（約1200万ドル）も存在する。国際的な支援ニーズが高く、続報の監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲本轮埃博拉疫情死亡病例破千
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Africa's current Ebola outbreak surpasses 1,000.
article.articleSummary: As of July 20, 2026, the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has surpassed 1,000 deaths. DRC reported 2,473 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 999 deaths; Uganda reported 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, giving a combined total of 1,001 deaths. About 737 patients remain in isolation or hospital care, with 482 recoveries. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called the outbreak the third-largest on record, noting accelerated spread over the past month. Uganda’s last patient was discharged on July 16, triggering a 42-day observation period to determine whether transmission has ceased. The outbreak began in Ituri Province, DRC, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and was designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの現在のエボラ出血熱流行、死者数が1000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC指定済みの大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで死者1000人超、複数国にまたがり国際的拡大リスクが明確なためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダも罹患国として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOにより既にPHEICが宣言されている。

article.articleHeadline: Over 1,000 people killed as Congo battles Ebola outbreak: Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: DR Congo endures the fastest Ebola outbreak on record caused by Bundibugyo virus, with 2,473 confirmed cases and 1,031 deaths reported by Africa CDC as of the latest update, and 737 patients in isolation or hospitalised. The outbreak was declared May 15 and centers in Ituri province, spreading to four other provinces. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo virus. WHO estimates the true scale may be 2–4 times higher than official figures. More than 60% of fatalities occur in the community before care, and about 80% of new cases arise outside known transmission chains, indicating rapid, hard-to-trace spread. Response challenges include community resistance to safe burials, strikes by health workers, attacks on burial teams and health facilities, and delays in patient transfer and test results. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids such as vomit, blood, or semen.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行、死者1,000人超:アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行で死者1,000人超、ワクチン・治療法なし、複数州へ拡大しており国際的リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行で、80%の新規症例が既知の感染経路外で発生しており、封じ込めが困難な状況。WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon Risk: Leptospirosis पावसाळ्यात 'लेप्टो'चा इशारा; वेळेत उपचारच ठरतील जीवदान...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon Risk: Leptospirosis—Warning During the Rainy Season; Timely Treatment Will Be Life-Saving.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis poses a major monsoon risk in Pune and Mumbai, India, with contaminated water and mud spreading Leptospira bacteria from rat urine. Despite attention to dengue and malaria, this neglected infection can damage kidneys, liver, and heart, and cause jaundice. Incubation is about a week before symptoms appear: headache, eye irritation and redness, vomiting, and malaise; if untreated, organ failure can follow. In Mumbai, outbreaks are described as large, with urinary changes (urine may become bluish or yellow) and loss of appetite among prominent signs. Preventive measures include avoiding walking through sewage or floodwater, wearing boots for sanitation workers, and washing feet promptly after returning home. If symptoms develop, seek immediate medical care; ELISA testing helps assess severity and confirm diagnosis. Early treatment is life-saving during the monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンのリスク：レプトスピラ症—雨季の警告；早期治療が命を救う
triage.triage_reason: 毎年恒例の季節性疾患（モンスーン期のレプトスピラ症）に関する啓発・注意喚起記事であり、異常な増加や新規性は示されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年モンスーン期に見られる季節性のレプトスピラ症に関する予防・啓発記事。具体的な症例数や異常な増加を示すデータはなく、通常の季節性疾患対策の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 아프리카서 에볼라 확산...콩고 사망자 1천명 육박
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading in Africa... Death toll in DR Congo nears 1,000.
article.articleSummary: In Africa, Ebola is spreading rapidly, with the death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda surpassing 1,000. WHO reports more than 1,000 Ebola deaths across these countries. In the DRC, authorities as of June 20 reported 2,473 confirmed cases and 999 deaths, with 737 patients in isolation. The outbreak is the fastest on record: after onset was confirmed on May 15, it surpassed 1,000 deaths in roughly two months, compared with eight months to reach 10,000 deaths in the 2013 outbreak. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo virus (Bundibugyo ebolavirus); there is no approved vaccine or widely effective therapy. Transmission remains highly efficient through bodily fluids such as vomit, blood, and semen, and infection can be fatal in severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ拡大…コンゴの死者数1000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC・ウガンダで急速に拡大し死者1000人に迫る過去最速の流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチン・治療法がない点、過去最速のペースで拡大している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 沉寂14年的病毒突然苏醒，两个月杀了828人_腾讯新闻
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virus that had been dormant for 14 years suddenly awakens, killing 828 people in two months.
article.articleSummary: A Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, began May 2026. By July 15, WHO reported 2,124 confirmed cases and 828 deaths (case fatality around 39%), making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record and after 2014–2016 West Africa and 2018–2020 KiVU. Origin traced to a February 4 funeral in Montboulu town in Ituri; unsafe burials and community transmission fueled spread. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected body fluids; incubation 2–21 days. Healthcare workers infected: 112, with 35 deaths; treatment centers overwhelmed and some facilities attacked or underpaid, triggering strikes. No licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo; existing Zaire-targeted vaccines offer little protection. Candidates advancing: IAVI's rVSV-BDBV, Oxford's ChAdOx1 BDBV (BD-Ebov) in Phase I in the UK, and Moderna mRNA candidate. WHO advises against routine Ervebo use; antiviral trials MBP134, maftivimab, remdesivir, obeldesivir underway. Prevention relies on surveillance, diagnostics, contact tracing, isolation, safe burials, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: 14年間沈黙していたウイルスが突然目覚め、2か月で828人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行は確定例2,124人・死亡828人（致死率約39%）に達し、史上3番目の規模かつ有効なワクチンが存在しないため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaとUKが含まれるが、記事本文はDRCイトゥリ州での発生のみを扱っており、UKはワクチン治験地として言及されているに過ぎないため除外した。既存のZaire型ワクチン（Ervebo）はBundibugyo型に有効性が低く、承認済みワクチンが存在しない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola toll tops 1,000 as response struggles to keep pace
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 1,000, with 2,536 cases and 1,033 deaths reported by the National Institute of Public Health Thursday. The outbreak, declared in eastern Congo on May 15 and centered in Ituri, has spread into two provinces beyond epicentre. If transmission is not rapidly halted, Africa’s outbreak could become one of the worst on record, officials warned. The rare Ebola virus here has no approved vaccine or treatment, and fragile health systems amid conflict and displacement hinder case identification, isolation, and contact tracing. 14,000 contacts are under follow-up, but only 77% are monitored. About half of 34 confirmed deaths on Wednesday occurred in the community rather than treatment centres. Response teams are expanding treatment capacity, referral systems, and safe burial teams. UN warns the outbreak could cost over $1 billion and push about 1 million more people into poverty, with regional spillovers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が1,000人を超え、対応が追いつかない状況
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者数が1,000人を超え、複数州に拡大し封じ込めが困難な状況で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、紛争・避難民の影響で医療体制が脆弱。UNは10億ドル超の経済損失と地域への波及を警告しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 高温多雨蚊虫伺机出没！疾控专家支招
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hot and rainy weather brings mosquitoes and other insects out of hiding—public health experts offer tips.
article.articleSummary: Beijing enters peak mosquito season in July–August due to hot, humid, and rainy conditions (25–30°C), accelerating mosquito breeding. Mosquitoes remain vectors for dengue fever and chikungunya; Beijing’s Center for Disease Control and Prevention urges proactive, science-based protection to prevent bites and outbreaks. Core measures: drain and seal standing water sources and breeding sites in indoor spaces (air conditioner pans, water dispensers, flower pots, drains, and gutters), repair screens, and use bed nets for infants; indoors, electric mosquito swatters and safe use of mosquito coils are advised with proper ventilation. Outdoors, wear light-colored, loose clothing; apply approved repellents (including DEET and other common formulations) before outdoor activities and reapply after sweating or washing; avoid high-risk areas at dawn and dusk (grass, water edges, low-lying wet areas). The guidance emphasizes that a single standing-water site can sustain mosquitoes. Source: Beijing CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 高温多雨で蚊などの害虫が活発化！疾病予防管理の専門家がアドバイス
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生報告ではなく、北京市疾病予防管理センターによる夏季の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）予防に関する一般的な注意喚起・啓発記事であるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症発生や症例報告を伝えるものではなく、季節性の蚊対策に関する予防啓発情報のため、トリアージ対象イベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 1,000 maut akibat wabak Ebola di Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,000 deaths due to Ebola outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) on May 15 continues with 2,473 cases and 999 confirmed deaths in the DRC, while Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths as of July 23, 2026. The 17th DRC outbreak is centered in the Ituri region in the northeast and remains difficult to control amid ongoing armed conflict. MSF in Bunia notes that contact tracing requires substantial resources, and burial practices by families without protective measures can accelerate transmission, with one death potentially triggering many additional infections. Cases have also been detected in four other DRC provinces. Uganda’s cases are mainly cross-border Congolese; three weeks with no new cases there. WHO's Tedros warned the outbreak is growing faster in June than any previous Ebola outbreak. For Bundibugyo, no vaccine or treatment is approved yet, though field trials include two potential therapies, one vaccine, and one post-exposure prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行により1,000人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダも患者発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHO事務局長も過去最速の拡大速度と警告しており、国際的関心が高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Hai ca sốt rét ác tính nguy kịch được cứu sống
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two cases of severe malaria in critical condition were saved.
article.articleSummary: Two severe malaria cases, including cerebral malaria, were saved at Bach Mai Hospital in Hanoi, Vietnam. On July 22, 2026, a 51-year-old Vietnamese patient and a 38-year-old Chinese patient were discharged after days of intensive care for very severe malaria with multi‑organ dysfunction, including coma, liver injury, acute kidney injury, pneumonia, anemia, and thrombocytopenia. The 38-year-old required intubation, mechanical ventilation, and continuous renal replacement therapy. A major challenge was the extremely limited supply of intravenous artesunate, the specific antimalarial treatment; only enough for the first patient remained. Coordinated efforts among the hospital, Vietnam's Ministry of Health, WHO, and partners secured an artesunate import from Cambodia, enabling parasite clearance and limiting organ damage, allowing recovery. WHO staff commended the hospital's multi‑disciplinary response; all cases were imported, underscoring ongoing vigilance for malaria brought from abroad.

triage.headline_ja: 重篤な熱帯熱マラリア2例、一命を取り留める
triage.triage_reason: 重症マラリア（脳マラリア含む）の輸入症例が救命されたという単発の症例報告であり、地域内伝播や公衆衛生上の広範な影響は確認されていないが、抗マラリア薬（アルテスネート）の供給不足という医療体制上の課題が浮上しており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 2例とも輸入症例（海外由来）であり、ベトナム国内での媒介蚊による伝播拡大を示す情報はない。カンボジアからのアルテスネート緊急輸入という国際協力事例が特徴的。SFTSウイルスへの言及は本記事内容とは無関係と思われる（疾患名リストに含まれるが記事本文はマラリアのみ扱う）。

article.articleHeadline: 暑假腸病毒疫情緩升！今年6例重症1死　5歲以下出現重症警訊快就醫 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer vacation enterovirus outbreak on the rise! This year, six severe cases and one death; children under five showing warning signs of severe illness—seek medical care promptly.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports six severe enterovirus infections this year, including one death. Virologic findings: four EV-D68; Coxsackie A4 and A16, one each. In the past four weeks Coxsackie A6 has dominated; week 28 ED visits were 7,534 (July 12–18), similar to the prior week. With daycare centers operating in summer, transmission risk remains high; authorities urge routine disinfection with 500 ppm chlorine bleach, plus strict hand hygiene and cough etiquette. Children under five are at high risk for severe illness; warning signs include drowsiness, confusion, weakness, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing, or tachycardia—seek care at a hospital promptly. Regional notes: Vietnam and China report rising enterovirus activity; Vietnam is heavily affected by EV71, while China reports Coxsackie A16 predominance in HFMD.

triage.headline_ja: 夏休みに腸病毒（エンテロウイルス）流行が緩やかに増加！今年は重症6例・死亡1例、5歳未満の重症警告サインに注意し早期受診を
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で腸病毒重症例6件・死亡1件が報告され、5歳未満の重症化リスクが強調されている。加えてベトナム・中国でも流行拡大が報告されており、地域的な感染拡大と社会的関心（公衆衛生当局の注意喚起）が認められるため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。台湾が主要な発生地だが、記事中でベトナム（EV71優勢）と中国（コクサッキーA16優勢のHFMD）の流行拡大も具体的に言及されているため両国を含めた。季節性の腸病毒流行としては例年見られるパターンだが、重症例・死亡例の発生と地域拡大の言及から経過観察以上の注視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: TN detects 48,469 TB cases in first half of 2026; intensifies elimination efforts
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu, India, detected 48,469 tuberculosis cases in January–June 2026 under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP); all patients diagnosed were enrolled for treatment. This follows 93,203 cases in 2025. Health Minister K.G. Arunraj chaired district TB reviews in Chennai, urging intensified case detection, surveillance, early diagnosis, and strong community participation to advance TB elimination. Diagnostic focus includes chest X-rays and molecular tests to identify infections early, enabling prompt treatment and reducing transmission. Preventive treatment for close contacts of TB patients and comprehensive care for critically ill patients were highlighted to improve outcomes. In 2025, 2,390 village panchayats were certified TB-free, illustrating public-health impact of sustained interventions. Officials were urged to boost coordination among government departments, private providers, NGOs, and the public to accelerate elimination of tuberculosis in Tamil Nadu.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州、2026年上半期に48,469件の結核症例を検出、撲滅対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 定期的な結核サーベイランス活動の報告であり、既知の疾患・既存の対策プログラム内での通常業務であるため、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地方流行病であり、国家プログラム(NTEP)下での定期活動報告。突発的なアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Insecurity continues to impact Ebola outbreak response in DR Congo: UN
article.articleSummary: Bundle of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: Bundibugyo ebolavirus; North Kivu, Ituri, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo provinces; Beni territory in North Kivu affected. As of July 20, 2,473 confirmed Ebola cases reported nationwide in DRC. Attacks in Beni July 13–19 killed at least 30 and injured about 12, driving displacement and restricting humanitarian access. Six humanitarian organisations, including Ebola-response partners, suspended movements in Beni due to security concerns. The UN and partners continue scaling up surveillance, laboratory testing, treatment, and community engagement; calls for protection of civilians and safe, unhindered humanitarian access. Transmission aided by population movements, insecurity, artisanal mining, and cross-border exchanges with Uganda and South Sudan. Outbreak declared May 15; ongoing across five provinces, with laboratory confirmation and ongoing response measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:治安不安がエボラ流行対応に影響を与え続ける（国連）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,473例の確定エボラ症例が報告される中、治安悪化により人道支援・対応活動が阻害されており、ウガンダ・南スーダンとの越境移動による国際的拡大リスクも存在するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは越境感染リスクの文脈で言及されているが、実際の症例発生地はDRC国内の5州（北キブ、イトゥリ、南キブ、オートウエレ、ツォポ）に限定されているため、対象国としてはDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: 暑假腸病毒疫情緩升！今年6例重症1死　5歲以下出現重症警訊快就醫 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus outbreak during the summer vacation on the rise! This year, 6 severe cases and 1 death. Children under 5 show warning signs of severe illness—seek medical care promptly | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports rising enterovirus activity this summer, with 6 severe enterovirus infections and 1 death confirmed this year as of 2026-07-23. Severe cases include 4 infections due to enterovirus D68, plus Coxsackie A4 and Coxsackie A16 (one each). In the past four weeks Coxsackie A6 has been the most common circulating type locally. Week 28 (July 12–18) ED visits reached 7,534, similar to 7,442 the prior week, indicating ongoing transmission. Children under 5 remain the high-risk group; warning signs include lethargy, altered consciousness, reduced activity, limb weakness or seizures, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing, or tachycardia—urgent hospital care is advised. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene, cough etiquette, and environmental disinfection with 500 ppm chlorine bleach in homes and childcare settings. Neighboring outbreaks are noted in Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City and southern provinces; EV71, ~55,000 cases, 10 deaths) and China (HFMD with Coxsackie A16; ~630,000 cases, 119 severe, 1 death), plus Japan, Thailand, Singapore, and Korea.

triage.headline_ja: 夏休みの腸病毒（エンテロウイルス）流行が緩やかに上昇！今年は重症6例・死亡1例、5歳以下で重症化の警告サインに注意し早期受診を
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で腸病毒（EV-D68等）重症例・死亡例が発生し、隣接するベトナム（EV71、約55,000例・10名死亡）や中国（HFMD、約63万例・119重症・1死亡）でも同時期に大規模な流行が確認されており、地域的な流行拡大と重症化リスクの観点からWPRO基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 台湾（Bluedot対象国外）が主要な発生地だが、記事本文でベトナム（ホーチミン市中心にEV71、約55,000例・10名死亡）と中国（HFMD、約63万例・119重症・1死亡）の具体的な流行データが明記されているため両国をverified_locationsに含めた。日本・タイ・シンガポール・韓国は文中で具体的データなく言及のみのため除外。季節性の腸病毒流行だが、複数国での死亡例・大規模症例数が報告されており経過観察・地域リスク評価の対象として妥当。

article.articleHeadline: ระวัง!! มีเพศสัมพันธ์ต่างชาติ ชายไทยวัย 37 ติด 'ฝีดาษวานร' หลังสัมพันธ์ผู้ติดเชื้อ HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning!! Had sex with a foreigner: 37-year-old Thai man contracted monkeypox after sex with an HIV-positive person.
article.articleSummary: 37-year-old Thai man contracted mpox (monkeypox) after sex abroad with an HIV-positive foreign partner. On 16 July 2026, he presented with fever, rigors, and malaise for 3 days, followed by disseminated vesiculopustular lesions on the face, trunk, limbs, genitals, and perianal area; no eye or oral lesions. Physical exam showed bilateral inguinal lymphadenopathy. PCR testing of lesion fluid and skin confirmed mpox, Clade 1b. Management included oral Tecovirimat twice daily for 14 days; the patient tolerated it well and lesions diminished. Given high-risk exposure and solitary residence, strict home isolation was advised for 3 weeks until crusts resolved and new epidermis covered the prior lesions to prevent transmission. Case highlights travel-associated exposure and molecular confirmation of mpox in Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: 警告!! 外国人との性交渉:37歳のタイ人男性がHIV陽性者との性交渉後にサル痘(Mpox)に感染
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内でMpox Clade 1b(より重症度が高いとされる系統)の輸入症例が確認され、国際的な伝播経路(渡航関連の性的接触)が明示されているため、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大の2項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 本症例はClade 1bの輸入例であり、HIV陽性者との性的接触による感染経路が確認されている。タイ国内での二次感染の有無や公衆衛生対応の詳細は記事に記載がなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lâm Đồng tăng cường phòng, chống bệnh tay chân miệng và sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lam Dong strengthens prevention and control of hand, foot and mouth disease and dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Lam Dong province in Vietnam reports 2,285 dengue fever cases this year as of July 23, 2026, up 9.7% from the same period in 2025, including 57 severe cases and 1 death. Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) has 3,076 cases, up 1,622 from 2025, with 2 fatalities. The health sector warns that ongoing heavy rainfall favors mosquito breeding, elevating transmission risk, while HFMD remains circulating in multiple localities with potential spread in kindergartens and communities. The provincial Department of Health has directed agencies and local authorities to implement synchronized, aggressive measures: enhanced epidemiological surveillance, early detection and rapid containment of outbreaks; environmental sanitation and larval control; ensure adequate staffing, medicines, and supplies; and public awareness campaigns. Citizens are urged to seek medical care promptly upon symptom onset to reduce severe outcomes and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ラムドン省、手足口病とデング熱の予防・対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム地方省での季節性デング熱・手足口病の症例増加報告だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限に直結する情報はなく、地方レベルの通常対応の域にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱・手足口病ともに前年より症例数増加し死亡例も報告されているが、これは季節性の毎年繰り返される感染症であり、省当局が通常の対策強化を指示している段階。国レベルでの深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態や国際的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ο Έμπολα θερίζει στο Κονγκό - Η Ιτούρι στο επίκεντρο της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Congo - Ituri at the center of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, Ebola is ravaging the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Ituri province at the epicenter of the Bundibugyo strain outbreak. The World Health Organization reports that Ituri remains the focal point of transmission, with the death toll nearing 1,000. A July 22, 2026 photo shows staff at the Ebola treatment center at Bunia General Hospital in Ituri transporting a coffin, underscoring the severity of the crisis. The report notes that the Bundibugyo variant is driving the outbreak in Ituri, Congo, highlighting the ongoing public health emergency in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを席巻 - イトゥリが流行の中心地
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が拡大し、死者数が1000人近くに達しているとの報告があり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOが報告するコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行で、死者数が約1000人に達しているとの重大な情報。詳細な感染者数や国際対応の状況については続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: अफ्रीकी देश कांगो में इबोला का कहर.... अब तक 1,031 लोगों की हो चुकी है मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola wreaks havoc in the African country Congo... so far 1,031 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Congo has caused 1,031 confirmed deaths and 2,473 reported cases, with at least 737 patients in isolation or hospitalized as of Monday. Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Casey warns vaccines, therapeutics, and funds are insufficient. WHO cautions the true scale may be 2–4 times higher than official figures, with 80% of new cases occurring outside known transmission chains, indicating rapid, hard-to-trace spread. The outbreak began on 15 May and is described as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. Ebola transmits through body fluids such as blood, vomit, sweat, or semen, and there is no established cure; vaccines, antiviral drugs, and adequate funding are currently lacking, contributing to high mortality risk.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ諸国コンゴでエボラが猛威...これまでに1,031人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ流行が史上最速のスピードで拡大し死者1,031人・症例2,473件に達しており、伝播経路不明の症例が8割を占めるなど国際的拡大リスクが高く、ワクチン・治療薬・資金不足も報告されているためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、伝播チェーン不明の新規症例が80%を占めることから追跡困難な急速拡大が懸念される。Africa CDCはワクチン・治療薬・資金の不足を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: GHIT Fund Invests Approx. JPY 140 Million in a Portable Rapid Diagnostic System for Ebola Disease in a Joint Project Between Osaka Metropolitan University, K.K. DNAFORM, and INRB
article.articleSummary: GHIT Fund invested JPY 140 million (about USD 862,000) to develop a portable rapid diagnostic system for Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus, in a joint project between Osaka Metropolitan University, K.K. DNAFORM, and the National Institute for Biomedical Research (INRB) of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the DRC and Uganda led WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16–17, 2026, creating urgent need for near-patient testing to support isolation and contact tracing in resource-limited settings. The project uses DNAFORM’s GenPad portable isothermal nucleic acid amplification platform to develop a point-of-care test, requiring no large instruments, with prototype development and performance validation for Bundibugyo virus detection and plans for future clinical evaluation in the DRC. This aligns with the 100-Day Mission to deploy medical countermeasures within 100 days of threat identification, following a GHIT landscape assessment and EOIs initiated May 22, 2026. GenPad cartridges can be developed, manufactured, and shipped within 40 days of an outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: GHIT Fund、大阪公立大学・株式会社DNAFORM・コンゴ民主共和国国立生物医学研究所（INRB）の共同プロジェクトにエボラ病診断用ポータブル迅速診断システム開発のため約1億4000万円を投資
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ病アウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ、2026年5月にWHOがPHEIC宣言済み）に関連する診断技術開発ニュースであり、既に国際的に重大とされている進行中のアウトブレイクへの対応策であるためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事自体はDRC・ウガンダで発生中のブンディブギョウイルス由来エボラ病アウトブレイク（2026年5月WHO PHEIC宣言）に対する診断技術開発の投資ニュース。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。日本（大阪）は研究開発拠点であり発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon Health Alert: बारिश में बार-बार हो रहा है वायरल इंफेक्शन? डॉक्टर से जानिए इसके कारण, इलाज और बचाव के जरूरी उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon Health Alert: Is a viral infection recurring during the monsoon? Learn from a doctor about its causes, treatment, and essential precautions.
article.articleSummary: During the Indian monsoon, humidity, rainfall, and temperature swings promote viral spread. In Pune, Dr. Raman Gaikwad of Sahyadri Hospital attributes rising viral infections to waterlogging, dirty water, contaminated food, and expanding mosquito breeding, with immunity temporarily weakened by seasonal changes. Common monsoon viral illnesses include the common cold, influenza, viral fever, dengue, and chikungunya. Symptoms typically present as abrupt fever with sore throat, cough, nasal congestion or runny nose, headache, body and joint pains, fatigue; dengue and chikungunya can bring rashes, and nausea or diarrhea may occur. Most viral infections are self-limiting; management centers on rest and hydration, with lifestyle and diet adjustments. Antibiotics are ineffective against viruses. Preventive measures include frequent handwashing, boiled or filtered water, clean food, avoiding contact with the sick, mosquito protection (repellent, long sleeves), and eliminating standing water. Seek care if fever persists >2–3 days, breathing trouble, persistent vomiting, rash, low platelets, or dehydration.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン健康アラート：雨季に繰り返すウイルス感染症？医師が語る原因・治療・予防策
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な増加を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性ウイルス感染症（インフルエンザ、デング熱、チクングニア熱等）に関する一般的な健康啓発・予防情報であり、具体的な症例数増加や集団発生の報告ではない。医師によるインタビュー形式の健康情報記事。

article.articleHeadline: Outbreak traced to moringa leaf powder declared over
article.articleSummary: 131 people in 38 states infected with Salmonella linked to moringa leaf powder imported from India; illnesses began Aug 22, 2025, through Jun 14, 2026. As of Jul 22, 2026, 36 hospitalizations and no deaths reported. Traced to moringa leaf powder sold under brands including Live it Up Super Greens, Why Not Natural capsules, and TNVitamins capsules; products have long shelf lives and were recalled. Of 84 ill individuals interviewed, 74 reported consuming moringa-containing products: 63 Live it Up Super Greens, 5 Why Not Natural capsules, 1 both products, 5 TNVitamins capsules. Laboratory work found 12 finished product/ingredient samples positive for Salmonella, with 11 samples containing outbreak strains by whole-genome sequencing. FDA has increased screening of imported moringa powder from India. The CDC/FDA-led investigation is closed and the outbreak declared over; consumers should discard recalled products.

triage.headline_ja: モリンガ葉粉末に関連したアウトブレイクは終息したと発表
triage.triage_reason: 米国で発生したサルモネラ集団感染（モリンガ葉粉末由来）で、CDC/FDAにより既に終息宣言されており、対象国での新規発生事案でもないため見送りとする。

article.articleHeadline: Why The Fastest-growing Ebola Outbreak In History Is Becoming More Challenging
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo’s Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing in history, with 1,031 deaths confirmed as of July 23, 2026. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province (about 90% of cases) but has spread to five provinces, including Kisangani. It is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare type for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Unpaid health-worker strikes, rebel threats, and misinformation that the virus is not real are hampering containment in a region with fragile infrastructure. Most new infections arise from unknown transmission chains, and the outbreak’s origin remains unclear. U.S. CDC modeling suggests a worst-case trajectory could approach the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed over 11,000 people. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces or materials.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ流行はなぜますます困難になっているのか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ東部で史上最速のペースで拡大し1,031人が死亡、承認された治療法・ワクチンがない稀な株であり、複数州への拡大と不明な感染経路が続いているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが対象国リストに無いため除外。記事の主題はコンゴ東部（イトゥリ州中心、キサンガニ含む5州）でのエボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: Three Pilots Of A British Airways Flight From Hyderabad, India Suffer Severe Food Poisoning
article.articleSummary: Three British Airways pilots on a Hyderabad–London Heathrow flight developed severe food poisoning after a layover in Hyderabad, where they reportedly consumed meals at the crew hotel and bottled water from an external supplier. In flight, all three fell ill; one required oxygen and later underwent a twelve‑hour emergency surgery after arriving in London, while the other two continued to operate the flight to Heathrow despite worsening symptoms. British Airways said it is reviewing crew accommodations and that Air Safety Reports were filed, with doctors to pinpoint the source and samples requested. The article attributes the illness to food consumed at the Hyderabad location and to bottled water; investigations are ongoing to confirm the infection source. No fatalities were reported. Published 2026-07-23.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード発ブリティッシュ・エアウェイズ便のパイロット3名が重度の食中毒を発症

triage.notes: 航空会社乗員個人の食中毒事例であり、感染症のアウトブレイクではない可能性が高い。原因物質・病原体は未特定で、ハイデラバードのホテル食事またはボトル水が疑われている。英国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Paparan hantavirus ditemukan pada peternak satwa liar di Vietnam: Alarm bagi negara lain di Asia Tenggara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus exposure detected among wildlife breeders in Vietnam: a warning to other Southeast Asian countries.
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, a 2025 study of 210 wildlife breeders in Lao Cai and Dong Nai provinces found 8.7% with hantavirus antibodies, indicating prior exposure, and 1.9% with active infections around August 2023–March 2024. Higher risk was among breeders focusing solely on wildlife farming, suggesting poor biosecurity and prolonged contact with animals and contaminated enclosures. The study could not identify the virus type or rodent hosts; only ELISA antibody testing was used, and RT-PCR with sequencing is needed for definitive characterization. Transmission is typically via inhalation of aerosols containing urine, feces, or saliva from infected rodents, with dirty farm environments elevating risk. The Andes hantavirus, capable of human-to-human transmission, caused 13 infections and 3 deaths on the MV Hondius cruise ship in May, underscoring regional vigilance. The findings urge strengthened biosecurity and a One Health approach across Southeast Asia, including Indonesia, to prevent spillover.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの野生動物繁殖業者にハンタウイルス曝露を確認：東南アジア諸国への警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの野生動物繁殖業者を対象とした研究で抗体陽性率8.7%、活動性感染1.9%が判明したが、これは過去(2023-2024年)のデータに基づく研究報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない。ウイルス種や宿主も未特定で、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠もないため、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム・ラオカイ省及びドンナイ省での野生動物繁殖業者を対象とした学術研究の紹介であり、実際の疾病発生・アウトブレイクではない。インドネシアは地域的な警鐘の対象として言及されているのみで、同国内での感染確認事例はサマリー中に記載がないため verified_locations から除外した。クルーズ船でのアンデスハンタウイルス感染例は別の事例（発生地域も対象国外）であり、本研究とは区別して扱った。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Pelajar Terpapar HIV di Sidoarjo Capai 522 Orang, Dinkes Buka Suara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral HIV-Exposed Students in Sidoarjo Reach 522 People, Health Office Speaks Out
article.articleSummary: In Sidoarjo Regency, East Java, Indonesia, health officials refute a social-media claim that 522 HIV/AIDS-exposed students exist. Cumulative data from 2001-2026 show 60 HIV cases among 11-17-year-olds, with 7 deaths, leaving 53 alive. Among 0-10-year-olds, 117 cases, 35 deaths, and 50 lost to follow-up; 32 children are currently on antiretroviral therapy (ARV). Most infections in young children arise from mother-to-child transmission during pregnancy, birth, or breastfeeding. Delta Crisis Center (DCC) says its data differ due to scope; as of 21 July 2026, DCC has assisted 5,107 people with HIV/AIDS, within its network; DCC’s cumulative count across health facilities is about 7,182 cases in Sidoarjo. Education/occupation data are only captured at enrollment; updated metrics include age, ARV regimen, and clinic. Most clients are aged 26-42; school-age cases largely perinatal, while students show behavioral risk, underscoring need for education, stigma reduction, and ongoing access to education.

triage.headline_ja: シドアルジョでHIV感染学生が522人に達したとSNSで拡散、保健局が見解を発表
triage.triage_reason: SNS上の誤情報を保健当局が訂正する内容であり、累積統計データの説明に留まるため、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はSNSで拡散された誤情報（学生522人がHIV感染）に対する保健局の訂正報道であり、HIVは既知の流行性疾患で新規性・異常性は低い。地域の慢性的なHIV/AIDS統計データの整理・訂正が主内容。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya receives 4.5 tonnes of medical supplies from India to boost Ebola preparedness
article.articleSummary: Kenya received the first tranche of 4.5 tonnes of medical supplies from India to boost Ebola preparedness. Donated PPE kits, sample transportation kits, infrared thermometers, face shields, heavy-duty boots and other infection prevention materials were handed over by the Indian High Commissioner to Health Secretary Aden Duale; a second consignment is expected in the coming days. The donation follows India’s broader support to Africa to bolster Ebola prevention and response via Africa CDC. Kenya has activated a nationwide Ebola preparedness plan (June 2026) involving surveillance, laboratory testing, border screening, case management, and emergency response coordination, anchored by the National Incident Management System with a 4-W matrix to track actions. Surveillance has been intensified, with health facility and community-based surveillance, updated Ebola case definitions, and Rapid Response Teams on 24-hour standby; counties are to operationalize isolation facilities and quarantine centers for rapid response to suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ対策強化のためインドから4.5トンの医療物資を受領
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はケニアにおけるエボラ「準備」支援に関する内容であり、実際の感染事例発生を報じるものではない。対象国（インド）はエボラ発生国ではなく支援国として登場するのみ。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアの準備態勢強化とインドからの支援に関するものであり、対象国リストにケニアは含まれない。インドは支援提供国であり感染発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: तमिलनाडु में 2026 के पहले छह महीनों में मिले 48,469 टीबी मरीज, टीबीमुक्त राज्य बनाने की मुहिम तेज | TN detects 48,469 TB cases in first half of 2026, intensifies elimination efforts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tamil Nadu detects 48,469 TB cases in the first six months of 2026, intensifies the campaign to make the state TB-free.
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu identified 48,469 tuberculosis (TB) patients in the first six months of 2026, with all patients started on treatment and under ongoing surveillance under the state’s TB Control Programme. Health Minister K. G. Arunraj said the figures were disclosed after a National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) review meeting in Chennai on 23 July 2026. The government aims to make Tamil Nadu TB-free by strengthening surveillance, expediting early detection, and boosting community participation. In 2025, 93,203 TB cases were identified; January–June 2026 added 48,469 new cases. Active case-finding will be intensified in high-risk rural and urban wards; close contacts will receive preventive therapy to interrupt transmission; severely ill patients will receive enhanced, comprehensive care. In 2025, 2,390 Gram Panchayats were declared TB-free, reflecting sustained public health efforts and calls for multi-sector collaboration across government, private hospitals, NGOs, and the public.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州、2026年前半に48,469件のTB患者を確認、結核撲滅対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: TBはインドの風土病であり、通常のサーベイランス・撲滅プログラムの一環としての報告であって、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths in eastern DRC's Grand Nord Kivu region far higher than elsewhere
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC's Grand Nord Kivu region accelerates: as of July 20, 2026, 2,473 cases and 999 deaths confirmed by the Ministry of Health. North Kivu’s case fatality is 56%, rising to 68% in Beni/Grand Nord Kivu, vs. 39.9% in Ituri. Fourth straight week with >300 new cases marks the fastest-growing outbreak, comparable to West Africa’s 2013–2016 epidemic; there are no licensed vaccines for the Bundibugyo strain. Overcrowded Ebola treatment centres and isolation wards operate at 128% capacity amid ongoing conflict, weak surveillance, and funding shortfalls, with many deaths occurring in communities rather than facilities. Unsafe burials and funeral contacts drive transmission. The IRC warns that trust and access alone are insufficient without scaled-up funding, and is supporting IPC, surveillance, community engagement, and frontline health workers, while maintaining a reduced footprint in Beni.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部の北キブ「グラン・ノール」地域におけるエボラ死者数、他地域より突出して多い
triage.triage_reason: 致死率が高く、症例数・死者数が急増し続けており、Bundibugyo株にはワクチンがないなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高い大規模流行であるため。
triage.notes: 2013-2016年の西アフリカ流行に匹敵する規模とされ、Bundibugyo株にはライセンス取得済みワクチンがないため、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Men gan tăng sau 5 ngày sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elevated liver enzymes after five days of dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam — A 35-year-old woman, Hân, with dengue fever progressed to severe dengue with plasma leakage and risk of shock. At Tam Anh General Hospital, platelets fell to 26,000/mm³ and AST rose 25-fold. She had hypokalemia and pericholecystic effusion with minimal ascites, signs of severe dengue. The physician noted that high‑dose antipyretics likely caused liver injury. After intensive care, platelets rose to 74,000/mm³, liver enzymes declined, fever resolved, and she was discharged. The dangerous window is days 4–6 around defervescence, with rapid platelet drop and shock risk. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti, breeding in small water-filled containers around homes. Preventive measures include eliminating breeding sites, avoiding bites, and dengue vaccination when eligible. Seek care for persistent high fever, especially in the rainy season or areas with cases.

article.articleHeadline: Perluas 68 Lokasi Prioritas, Dinkes Kota Madiun Sasar Skrining Warga yang Miliki Kontak Erat Pasien TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expand to 68 priority locations, Madiun City Health Office targets screening residents who have had close contact with TB patients.
article.articleSummary: Expansion to 68 priority locations, Madiun City Health Office targets screening residents who had close contact with TB patients. The Integrated Area TB Contact Investigation (Sibatik Ulos) uses interviews, health checks, Mantoux testing, and portable X-ray to identify suspected TB; those with positive findings are referred to hospitals for treatment. Individuals without symptoms but at high risk receive TB Preventive Therapy (TPT). The screening involves Dinkes PPKB Kota Madiun, RS Paru Manguharjo, RSUD Kota Madiun, Puskesmas Ngegong, and Kelurahan Patihan, and now includes schools and correctional facilities among the 68 locations. By July 2026, Kota Madiun records 543 TB cases in total, with 171 residents. TB is curable with six months of medication, and patients should adhere to treatment. The expansion seeks earlier detection to halt transmission.

article.articleSummary: TB in Tamil Nadu: In Jan–Jun 2026, 48,469 tuberculosis patients were identified and immediately started on treatment under the state TB control program, with ongoing surveillance. Health Minister K. G. Arunraj announced this after a National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) review in Chennai on July 23, 2026, stating the goal of a TB-free Tamil Nadu. The administration plans stronger surveillance, emphasis on early detection, and greater public participation. In 2025 the state identified 93,203 TB patients; Jan–Jun 2026 added 48,469 new cases. Active screening campaigns will be intensified in high-risk rural villages and urban wards, and contacts of TB patients will receive preventive therapy to break transmission. For severely ill patients, improved comprehensive care is being mandated. Tamil Nadu reported 2,390 gram panchayats TB-free in 2025, reflecting sustained community-based efforts and cross-sector coordination with private sector and NGOs.

article.articleHeadline: All three pilots on British Airways' Hyderabad-London flight fall ill with food poisoning mid-air - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: Three British Airways pilots on the Hyderabad-to-London flight fell ill with suspected food poisoning mid-air. The 10.5-hour Boeing 777 encountered an incapacitated first officer at about 30,000 ft, who was given oxygen; the other two pilots continued operating and landed safely at London Heathrow. The incapacitated pilot’s condition worsened after landing, requiring a 12-hour operation. The airline said flight safety was never compromised and an urgent investigation is underway. The three pilots had shared breakfast and drinks at the crew hotel in Hyderabad and reportedly drank bottled water from an external company; the cause is undetermined. All three filed Air Safety Reports and provided medical samples to help identify the source. BALPA raised hygiene concerns about the Hyderabad hotel; BA is reviewing crew accommodation in the city.

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में हिंसा के बीच इबोला से जंग पर संकट, संयुक्त राष्ट्र ने जताई चिंता
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Crisis in the fight against Ebola amid violence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; the United Nations has expressed concern.
article.articleSummary: A concise, self-contained summary of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of July 20, 2026. Ebola (Ebola virus disease) has been confirmed in 2,473 cases across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo provinces. In North Kivu’s Beni area, 13–19 July attacks killed about 30 civilians and injured more than a dozen, triggering displacement and hindering relief delivery. The UN and partners continue surveillance, laboratory testing, treatment, and community engagement, though security concerns have led at least six humanitarian organizations to pause movements in affected areas. The outbreak, declared May 15, has spread to five provinces due to population movement, insecurity, mining activity, and cross-border movement with Uganda and South Sudan. The UN urges protection of civilians and safe, unimpeded humanitarian access.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での暴力の中、エボラとの闘いに危機――国連が懸念を表明
