article.articleHeadline: Количество смертей от лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго перевалило за 1 тысячу - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 1,000 - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,536 confirmed or suspected cases, with 1,034 lab-confirmed deaths (case fatality 40.7%), as of July 22. Hospitals and isolation centers hold 738 patients with suspected Ebola, while 506 have recovered. Response is hampered by vaccine shortages and funding gaps, according to Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya. WHO estimates the true scale could be 2–4 times official counts; about 80% of cases occur outside identified transmission chains, and under 9% of contacts are under surveillance. More than 60% of deaths occur outside health facilities and before seeking care. The outbreak began in May in eastern DRC and Uganda, with the epicenter in Ituri province. Ebola is a highly contagious viral hemorrhagic fever; the largest prior outbreak (2013–2016) in West Africa infected over 28,000 and caused about 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ出血熱による死者数が1000人を超える - Vesti.ruニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確定・疑い症例2,536件、死者1,034人（致死率40.7%）に達し、ワクチン不足・資金不足・接触者追跡の不備によりヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが高い深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（特にイトゥリ州）のエボラ流行を主題としている。ウガンダやアンゴラへの言及もあるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOは実際の規模が公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性があると推計しており、80%の症例が既知の感染経路外で発生、接触者の9%未満しか監視下にないなど、監視・封じ込め体制の不備が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 2536 حالة والوفيات تتجاوز الألف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 2,536, with deaths exceeding 1,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,536 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,033 deaths. Government data show 50 new infections on Monday in eastern Ituri and North Kivu, among the regions hardest hit. The Public Health Institute says authorities are sustaining surveillance and response measures to contain transmission as new cases continue to be recorded. The update confirms a protracted outbreak centered in eastern DRC, with ongoing transmission despite public health efforts. The briefing provides no additional laboratory detail beyond the case and death counts, and does not note specific infection sources or cross-border movements.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が2,536人に増加、死者数は1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが継続しており、症例数・死亡者数ともに深刻で、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率は約40%と高く、東部イトゥリ州・北キブ州を中心に継続的な感染拡大が見られる。国境を越えた感染拡大の有無については記事中に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Médicos ecoam ministério e veem risco aumentado de dengue com El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors echo the ministry and see an increased risk of dengue with El Niño.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, Brazilian health authorities warn that El Niño could raise dengue transmission via warmer temperatures and altered rainfall, boosting Aedes aegypti proliferation. The climate shift may create water-storage conditions that favor mosquito breeding across regions, with some areas experiencing heavy rains and others drought. Fiocruz’s InfoDengue projects about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027 in Brazil, though estimates may change with new meteorological and epidemiological data. The Ministry of Health calls for intensified surveillance and vector-control measures, including immediate interruption of transmission at first identified cases, reorganized vector-control teams, and adoption of federal-recommended technologies. It also urges public participation to remove breeding sites at home and prompt medical evaluation for dengue or chikungunya symptoms. Experts note El Niño accelerates mosquito development and virus incubation, but regional differences mean tailored, intersectoral approaches are needed.

triage.headline_ja: 医師らが保健省の見解に同調、エルニーニョによるデング熱リスク増大を懸念
triage.triage_reason: 現時点では将来予測・注意喚起の段階であり実際の症例急増は未確認だが、デング熱の流行しやすさや季節性拡大の懸念があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は予測・予防的注意喚起が主体であり、実際の症例数増加や重症度に関するデータは含まれていない。2027年の推定症例数（170万件）は将来予測であり、確定情報ではない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 3 British Airways pilots fall ill after food poisoning during Hyderabad stopover
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, three British Airways pilots developed food poisoning after a stopover in Hyderabad on flight BA276 to London Heathrow. The cockpit crew stayed overnight in Hyderabad; all three fell ill after breakfast before departure. One first officer collapsed at about 30,000 feet and required oxygen; the others continued the flight, which landed safely. After landing, their condition worsened. BA launched an internal investigation, reviewing the Hyderabad hotel and whether pre-departure food or another source caused the illness. Biological samples have been collected, and all three pilots filed Air Safety Reports. BALPA has raised hygiene concerns about the Hyderabad hotel, which is under review as investigators seek the exact cause. BA says safety and wellbeing of employees is the top priority and flight safety was never compromised.

triage.headline_ja: 英国航空(BA276便)の操縦士3名、ハイデラバード立ち寄り後に食中毒を発症
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒による個別的な健康被害であり、人-人感染や広域拡大の兆候はないが、ホテルの衛生状態に関する懸念があり原因究明中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 原因はホテルの朝食による食中毒が疑われており、感染症としての人-人伝播のリスクは低い。BAとBALPAが調査中であり、続報でホテルの衛生状態や他の宿泊客への影響有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تعلن ارتفاع الوفيات بإيبولا إلى 1033 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports Ebola death toll rising to 1,033.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rose to 2,536 with 1,033 deaths, according to government data released late yesterday. The Public Health Institute reported 50 new cases detected on Monday in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu. The update confirms ongoing transmission in the region, with the cumulative totals based on laboratory-confirmed cases and fatalities. The report provides no details on vaccination status, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. It underscores the sustained severity of the outbreak in eastern DRC, where Ituri and North Kivu continue to be active foci. Further updates are expected as surveillance and laboratory confirmation continue in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ死者数1,033人に上昇と発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行で死亡者数が1,033人に達し、感染者数も2,536人と深刻化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中のエボラ流行のアップデート記事。ワクチン接種状況や感染源、輸入/輸出症例に関する情報は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تعلن ارتفاع الإصابات المؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا إلى 2536 منها 1033 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo announces that confirmed Ebola virus cases have risen to 2,536, of which 1,033 have died.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 2,536 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with 1,033 deaths, according to government data released late Wednesday. The Public Health Institute said 50 new cases were recorded on Monday in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu. The update underscores persistent transmission in eastern DRC, where Ebola outbreaks have repeatedly emerged. The report provides no details on infection sources, laboratory confirmation methods, or imported/exported cases. The new cases in Ituri and North Kivu indicate ongoing local spread, reinforcing the need for continued surveillance and rapid outbreak response in Congo's eastern border regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルスの確定感染者数が2,536人に増加、うち1,033人が死亡と発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（致死率約40%）が継続しており、複数州での地域拡大と高い重症度からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 感染源、検査方法、輸入/輸出症例に関する詳細は記事に記載なし。イトゥリ州・北キブ州での継続的な地域内伝播が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế ký kết dự án viện trợ 15 triệu Euro, ứng dụng AI và công nghệ số dự báo dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health signs €15 million aid project, applying AI and digital technologies to forecast disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam signs a €15 million non-repayable aid agreement with Germany’s KfW to apply digital technologies and artificial intelligence for forecasting disease outbreaks. The project, 'Application of Digital Technologies in Disease Prevention and Control,' aims to modernize the preventive health system, strengthen surveillance and early warning, and enable AI-driven analysis, modeling, and forecasting of outbreaks. Implemented through December 30, 2030, it will integrate data systems and improve data sharing from central to local levels. The ceremony was attended by Deputy Minister Le Duc Luan, German ambassador Helga Barth, and KfW’s Daniel Plankermann. The initiative follows calls to upgrade digital capacities after COVID-19. It also notes AI can open new avenues for preventing non-communicable diseases by improving early detection and reducing mortality.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、1,500万ユーロの援助プロジェクトに調印、AIとデジタル技術を活用し疾病予測を実施
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生や流行に関する情報ではなく、AI・デジタル技術導入による疾病予測体制強化のための国際援助協定締結に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19後のデジタル保健インフラ強化に関する国際協力の話であり、疾病発生シグナルではない。ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue: Thay đổi khó lường, lan rộng phức tạp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever: Unpredictable changes, widespread and complex transmission.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Vietnam is showing unpredictable, evolving transmission. The disease has appeared nationwide with rapidly rising case numbers and some severe presentations. In the first five months of 2026, Vietnam recorded more than 50,000 dengue cases, including 5 deaths. The report is a joint educational effort by Takeda Vietnam Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and the Vietnamese Association of Preventive Medicine, presenting medical information objectively and without commercial endorsement. The material aims to educate and raise public awareness and does not replace clinical diagnosis or medical advice; individuals should consult their physician for guidance. The publication underscores a shift from traditional patterns toward widespread, complex transmission, signaling the need for ongoing public health attention and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：予測困難な変化、複雑に拡大する感染状況
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで症例数増加と死亡例が報告されているが、デング熱は同国の季節性流行病であり、本記事は製薬企業と予防医学会による啓発目的の教育コンテンツであるため、IHR基準は該当せず社会的関心度も不明であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はTakeda Vietnam社とベトナム予防医学会による共同啓発資料であり、商業的宣伝を伴わない医療情報提供を目的としているため、緊急性の高い一次情報としての性質は低い。今後の症例数推移とベトナム保健当局の公式発表を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dödssiffran stiger - 1 000 döda i Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll rises - 1,000 dead from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Kongo Kinshasa has reached 1,031 fatalities and roughly 2,500 cases as of 23 July 2026, according to Africa CDC president Jean Kaseya. Described as the fastest Ebola outbreak in history, it emerged in mid-May in Kongo Kinshasa. There is no licensed vaccine or effective treatment for the Bundibugyo variant driving this outbreak, one of six Ebola strains with four capable of infecting humans. The mortality rate varies by healthcare capacity: about 30–50% in settings with adequate intensive care, and 50–90% in weaker health systems, per WHO estimates cited in the article. The death toll continues to climb daily, reflecting the rapid spread and lack of medical countermeasures, contrasting with previous large outbreaks in West Africa in 2014, which took longer to reach 1,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 死者数増加 - エボラで1,000人死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速とされるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生し、死者数1,000人超・症例約2,500人に達しており、ワクチン・治療法が確立していないBundibugyo株による深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（Kinshasa）のみを主題としているため除外。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による過去最速の拡大が報告されており、国際的な支援（Africa CDC言及）が既に関与している点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: बदलते मौसम में तबीयत हो रही खराब, कहीं कोविड-19 तो नहीं? डॉक्टर ने बताए नए लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health is worsening in the changing weather; could it be COVID-19? The doctor has described the new symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon season increases illness risk with dengue, malaria, and chikungunya spreading as humidity rises; meanwhile, COVID-19 cases are surfacing in Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, and Bihar, prompting advisories in several states. Dr. Rishi Yadav notes that new COVID-19 variants bring shifted symptoms: severe throat pain, persistent cough, fever (mild to high), nasal congestion, muscle aches, and extreme fatigue, with some patients experiencing nausea or diarrhea. Distinguishing COVID-19 from viral infections is challenging since both can cause fever, sore throat, cough, runny nose, body pains, headaches, and fatigue; red flags include prolonged fever, breathing difficulty, altered taste or smell, or rapidly worsening weakness. Although many cases are milder than earlier waves, symptoms can linger. Testing is advised if fever persists, there has been contact with an infected person, or respiratory symptoms worsen. Practical guidance emphasizes rest, hydration, balanced nutrition, and limiting crowded exposure, with prompt medical advice for severe or persistent symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 変わりやすい気候で体調不良に、それはCOVID-19かもしれない？医師が新しい症状について解説
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の健康アドバイス記事であり、COVID-19や媒介感染症の異常な流行や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す具体的データがないため。
triage.notes: 記事は一般向けの健康アドバイス記事であり、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の証拠は示されていない。COVID-19新変異株の症状に関する医師のコメントが中心。

article.articleHeadline: 危险的非洲大蜗牛正在全国扩张 威胁生态与健康
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous African giant snails are expanding nationwide, threatening ecosystems and human health
article.articleSummary: African giant snail (Achatina fulica) is expanding nationwide in southern China, threatening ecosystems and human health. Originating from East Africa, it is a large, nocturnal invasive species with shell lengths of 7–8 cm, feeding on fruits, vegetables, waste, and even cement and feces. It has spread across Guangdong, Fujian, Guangxi, and Yunnan, and was added to China’s Key Management Invasive Species List in 2022 after earlier IUCN listing as one of the world’s 100 most threatening invasive species. The snail can transmit Angiostrongylus cantonensis (rat lungworm), causing meningitis/encephalitis in humans. In 2026, a 1-year-old in Shenzhen was treated for Angiostrongylus cantonensis after snail contact; in 2022, a 10-year-old boy in Zhongshan developed encephalitis after playing with the snail. Control efforts include multi-agency eradication campaigns; Fujian issued summer snail-elimination guidelines in 2025 and local prevention calls in 2026; some residents salt-spray snails to dehydrate and kill them.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なアフリカマイマイが全国で拡大中 生態系と健康を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: アフリカマイマイの分布拡大に伴い広東・福建・広西・雲南で散発的な広東住血線虫症（好酸球性髄膜脳炎）症例が報告されているが、既知の感染経路によるものであり、ヒト-ヒト感染や急激な症例増加は確認されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: アフリカマイマイ（Achatina fulica）は2022年より中国の重点管理外来種リストに指定され、広東・福建・広西・雲南で拡大が続いている。広東住血線虫（Angiostrongylus cantonensis）を媒介し、2026年に深センで1歳児、2022年に中山市で10歳男児が接触後に脳炎を発症した事例が報告されている。既知の疾病であり急性アウトブレイクの兆候はないが、生態系拡大に伴う症例増加の可能性があるため経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Mas di 1.000 morto kousá pa Ébola na RDC - èxtra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,000 dead from Ebola in the DRC - Extra
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has killed more than 1,000 people, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). The DRC reports 2,473 confirmed Ebola cases and 999 deaths; Uganda has 20 cases with 2 deaths. The eleventh Ebola outbreak in the DRC was declared around May 15, with infections concentrated in Ituri province in the northeast. Some deaths left families without protective measures, accelerating transmission. The report relies on WHO figures and provides no details on the infection source or on any exported or imported cases. Ongoing transmission in Ituri underscores the continued need for public health measures to contain the virus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより1,000人以上死亡 - Extra
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によりDRCで999人、ウガンダで2人の死亡が確認されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも感染確認地域だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC(Ituri州)が主要な発生地。第11次エボラ流行として2026年5月15日頃に宣言された。

article.articleHeadline: New Covid variants BA.2.86, RF.5: Symptoms, risks and precautions
article.articleSummary: Amid an uptick in cases in Andhra Pradesh, India, the Omicron subvariants BA.2.86 (Pirola) and RF.5 are under watch. BA.2.86 is heavily mutated; RF.5 is a recombinant variant. Both belong to the Omicron family and spread mainly through respiratory droplets and close contact. There is no strong evidence that either variant causes more severe illness than earlier Omicron strains, but they pose higher risk for older adults, pregnant women, and people with chronic illnesses or weakened immune systems due to partial immune escape. Common symptoms mirror recent Covid-19 variants: fever, sore throat, cough, nasal congestion, fatigue, headache, and body aches; hoarseness or mild GI symptoms may occur. Testing remains important, especially for high-risk individuals. Severe signs—breathlessness, chest pain, confusion, or low oxygen—require urgent care. Precautions: stay home if unwell, practice hand hygiene, mask in crowded indoor spaces for vulnerable individuals, and keep vaccination up to date.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ変異株BA.2.86、RF.5：症状、リスク、予防策
triage.triage_reason: インドのアンドラプラデシュ州で症例増加とオミクロン系統変異株(BA.2.86、RF.5)への注視が報告されているが、重症度上昇の明確な証拠はなく、一般向け解説記事の性格が強い。
triage.notes: 既知のオミクロン系統変異株に関する一般向け医療情報記事であり、重症度増加や医療逼迫の証拠は示されていない。症例増加の規模・地域拡大状況は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ribuan Warga Pekalongan Mulai Disasar Skrining TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands of Pekalongan Residents Targeted for TB Screening.
article.articleSummary: Pekalongan, Indonesia launches Active Case Finding (ACF) for tuberculosis (TB), screening 1,350 residents who had close contact with TB patients through September 2026. In the city, 140 TB patients are currently undergoing treatment. Health workers, with assistance from Mentari Sehat Indonesia cadres, will actively visit neighborhoods around diagnosed cases to screen family members and other close contacts for undetected infection. The program began in July 2026 and runs through September 2026. Symptoms triggering screening include a cough lasting more than two weeks, night-time fever, and loss of appetite. Transmission is influenced by environmental factors such as poor sanitation and unfinished treatment. TB treatment lasts at least six months, and can extend to one to two years depending on severity. The initiative targets all age groups to broaden early detection and control spread.

triage.headline_ja: ペカロンガン住民数千人を対象にTBCスクリーニング開始
triage.triage_reason: 結核の積極的症例発見(ACF)という通常の公衆衛生プログラムの報道であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は流行性感染症としての緊急性は低く、通常の地域保健活動の一環。インドネシアが発生地域として挙げられているが、これは通常のTB対策プログラムであり、シグナルとしての特異性はない。

article.articleHeadline: India donates medical supplies to boost Kenya's Ebola preparedness efforts
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-23, India delivered the first tranche (4.5 tonnes) of Ebola preparedness supplies to Kenya, as Congo reports over 1,000 Ebola deaths and Uganda/DRC outbreaks keep the region on alert. The shipment of 279 packages—PPE kits, sample transport kits, infrared thermometers, face shields, heavy-duty boots, and infection prevention materials—will bolster Kenya’s national emergency stockpile and frontline capacity to detect, contain, and respond to Ebola. Health CS Aden Duale received the items at JKIA, highlighting a whole-of-government approach: enhanced entry-point surveillance, laboratory capacity, rapid response teams, incident management, and public awareness. A second tranche is expected soon. The donation complements prior Indian assistance to Africa CDC (~45 tonnes) and Kenya’s COVID-19 vaccine support under Vaccine Maitri, underscoring enduring India–Kenya health-security cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: インド、ケニアのエボラ対策強化のため医療物資を寄贈
triage.triage_reason: 記事はケニアへの支援物資寄贈がテーマだが、DRCで1,000人超のエボラ死者が報告され地域全体が警戒態勢にあると明記されており、IHR基準（深刻性・国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドからケニアへの医療物資支援だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの継続中のエボラ流行（死者1,000人超）が言及されており、既知の公衆衛生危機として継続監視が必要。ウガンダも対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo says more than 1,000 die of Ebola, confirmed cases rise to 2,536
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 2,536 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,033 deaths, according to the latest government data. The public health institute said 50 new cases were detected on Monday in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu, signaling ongoing transmission in the region. The update underscores that the Ebola outbreak remains active in eastern DRC with a sustained burden of disease reflected in these counts. The government released the figures late on Wednesday, detailing the evolving outbreak trajectory and continued transmission within Ituri and North Kivu. It is part of ongoing Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラで1,000人以上死亡と発表、確定症例数は2,536人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で継続的に感染拡大しており、死亡者1,000人超・確定症例2,536人という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州・北キブ州で継続的な新規症例発生が報告されており、致死率は約40%と高い。既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報告であり、既にフルRRAの対象となっている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Save the Children, morti in Repubblica Democratica del Congo oltre 180 bambini nell'epidemia, migliaia necessitano di supporto per la salute mentale - politicamentecorretto.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Save the Children, deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, over 180 children have died in the outbreak, thousands in need of mental health support
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province. As of 23 July 2026, the Ministry of Health confirms about 476 child cases and at least 189 child deaths, representing over 20% of confirmed fatalities. Save the Children reports thousands of children require mental health support; more than 4,000 children in Ituri are receiving psychosocial services via 18 child-friendly spaces established by Save the Children. The outbreak, declared on May 15, continues to affect schooling, with many children unlikely to return to class in September. Ituri is the outbreak epicenter; interventions include enhanced hygiene and distancing protocols. Many affected children have witnessed illness or death and have been separated from caregivers due to disease, displacement or death. Save the Children urges increased international funding for child protection and mental health services; the organization has operated in the DRC since 1994, coordinating with local partners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:セーブ・ザ・チルドレン、コンゴ民主共和国で流行中に子ども180人超が死亡、数千人がメンタルヘルス支援を必要としている

article.articleHeadline: تفشي فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو يسجل أرقاماً قياسية وسط غياب اللقاحات وتحديات أمنية معقدة - جنوبية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo sets record numbers amid vaccine shortages and complex security challenges - Southern
article.articleSummary: DRC’s Ebola outbreak, the fastest-growing on record, has 2,473 confirmed cases and 999 deaths, with Ituri Province alone accounting for over 90% of cases. Eastern provinces North Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshop?o, and South Kivu show ongoing transmission. The outbreak, the 17th in the DRC, began May 15 and is driven by Bundibugyo virus. There are no licensed vaccines or targeted therapies for this strain; patient care is supportive and patients are isolated. WHO has begun enrolling patients in urgent trials and added a rapid diagnostic test specific to this strain to the emergency use list. Security challenges, militia violence, and widespread displacement hinder surveillance and access, while cross-border movement with Uganda has led to imported cases there. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行、ワクチン不足と複雑な治安上の課題の中で記録的な数を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の記録的規模の流行で、WHOがPHEICを宣言、ワクチン・治療薬不足、ウガンダへの越境事例も発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: 黑龙江发布夏季传染病预防科普 四类疾病需重点防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Heilongjiang Province Launches Summer Infectious Disease Prevention Public Education; Four Types of Diseases Require Priority Prevention and Control.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-23, Heilongjiang Province launched a Summer Priority Infectious Disease Prevention and Public Health Education briefing in Harbin. Deputy director Zhang Bixin of the provincial CDC said the 1st 28 weeks of 2026 show a stable overall infectious-disease picture, with a 7.79% year-on-year decline in Category B cases and no large outbreaks. As summer peaks, enteric and vector-borne diseases rise, alongside zoonoses and heat-related risks. Key concerns: enteric infections (Norovirus and bacterial infectious diarrhea) from contaminated food/water; hand-foot-mouth disease mainly in children under five, with fever and rashes; tick-borne diseases such as forest encephalitis due to high tick activity in woods; and brucellosis from livestock work or consuming undercooked beef/lamb and raw milk. Respiratory infections remain sporadic, with low-level activity of influenza, SARS-CoV-2, human metapneumovirus, and rhinovirus. Preventive guidance emphasizes food safety, thorough cooking, handwashing, avoiding crowded indoor venues for children, outdoor insect protection, and prompt care with travel/history disclosure.

triage.headline_ja: 黒竜江省、夏季感染症予防に関する公衆衛生教育を発表 重点的に予防・管理すべき4種類の疾病
triage.triage_reason: 感染症全体の発生状況は前年比減少で大規模流行なしとされ、内容は季節性疾患に関する一般的な予防啓発情報であり、シグナルとしての異常性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は黒竜江省CDCによる夏季の一般的な感染症予防啓発発表であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。前年比でカテゴリB感染症は7.79%減少し、大規模流行なしと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: UK Responds To Potential Ebola Exposure With Emergency Medical Transfer
article.articleSummary: UK evacuates a humanitarian worker from the Democratic Republic of the Congo after potential Ebola exposure during outbreak response; the individual was transferred by a dedicated chartered flight and placed in isolation at a London hospital for monitoring. UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) says there are no confirmed Ebola cases in the UK and the public risk remains low. The worker, currently asymptomatic, will be observed during the 2–21 day Ebola incubation period. Imported Ebola cases are extremely rare in the UK, and NHS facilities are equipped to safely manage suspected infections with robust infection-control procedures. The evacuation follows an ongoing Ebola outbreak in parts of the DRC and Uganda; in May the World Health Organization designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, fatigue, headaches, vomiting and diarrhoea, with severe cases potentially leading to organ failure.

article.articleHeadline: Two more persons test positive for COVID in Odisha
article.articleSummary: Three COVID-19 cases have been reported in Odisha’s Ganjam district by July 23, 2026, with two new infections pushing the state total to three. All cases are in Ganjam. The two newly diagnosed patients are under home isolation and in stable condition, while a female patient admitted to MKCG Medical College Hospital in Berhampur also remains stable despite diabetes, hypertension, and heart disease. Health officials Rabindranath Mishra, Director of Public Health, and Santosh Mishra, Special Secretary, said the illness shows influenza-like symptoms and that the virus has weakened, urging the public not to panic. Mishra inspected the Berhampur hospital to assess the situation. The article does not specify infection sources or laboratory confirmation details.

article.articleHeadline: 布魯氏菌病｜上海漢低燒兩個月頸椎被細菌「啃出洞」　源頭來自廚房 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brucellosis | A Shanghai man with a two-month low-grade fever had holes gnawed into his cervical spine by bacteria; source traced to the kitchen | am730
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis diagnosed in a Shanghai man after two months of afternoon low-grade fever and bone pain; targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) confirmed Brucella infection with a high bacterial load (99.57%). Imaging showed a hole in the seventh cervical vertebra (C7) from vertebral osteomyelitis. Infection traced to the kitchen: he routinely bought raw beef and used the same cutting board for raw and cooked foods; the home also housed pigs and dogs, Brucella reservoirs. He had no pastoral-area exposure. Brucellosis, common in cattle and sheep of Northwest pastoral regions, can invade the spine and joints; cervical involvement is rare but carries high risk of neurological compromise. After antibiotics, fever resolved and condition improved, but about a three-month course with periodic blood tests and cervical imaging is needed. Preventive measures: separate cutting boards and utensils, wear gloves with wounds when handling raw meat, cook beef and pork thoroughly, and avoid unpasteurized dairy.

triage.headline_ja: ブルセラ症｜上海の男性、2か月間の微熱で頸椎に細菌が穴を開ける　感染源は自宅の台所
triage.triage_reason: 台所での個人的な汚染食材（生肉）からの単発症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や集団発生の兆候はない。公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 個別症例報告であり、家庭内での生肉・まな板の共用や家畜（豚・犬）飼育による曝露が原因。牧畜地域への渡航歴なし。ヒト-ヒト感染しないブルセラ症の性質上、公衆衛生上の広域拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: HIV di Bengkalis Meningkat, Capai 35 Kasus Hingga Pertengahan Tahun: Waspadai Pergaulan Kelompok LSL
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV in Bengkalis on the Rise, Reaching 35 Cases by Mid-Year: Beware the LSL Group's Social Circles.
article.articleSummary: By mid-2026, HIV cases in Bengkalis Regency, Indonesia rose to 35 new infections, per the Bengkalis Health Office on July 23, 2026. New detections were reported across facilities: RSUD Mandau (15), RSUD Bengkalis (9), Puskesmas Duri (4), Puskesmas Batu Panjang Rupat (2), Puskesmas Bengkalis (2), and Puskesmas Sungai Pakning, Puskesmas Tengayun, and RS Thursina Duri (1 each). Cumulative people living with HIV (ODHIV) on antiretroviral therapy total 307, with a male predominance. Cases are largely linked to unsafe sexual behavior, especially men who have sex with men (MSM, locally LSL), followed by sex workers. Irawadi, head of the Disease Prevention and Control Division (P2P), urged broad community vigilance and education, targeting youth and involving schools, campuses, and religious leaders to deter exploitation by this group, noting the MSM-related phenomenon often involves novices rather than established MSM.

triage.headline_ja: ブンカリスでHIV増加、年半ばまでに35例確認:LSLグループの交友関係に注意

triage.notes: 地方保健当局によるルーティンの疾病監視報告。HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、IHR通報対象やEBSシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Nagpur reports first H1N1 death of 2026 as swine flu cases surge in July - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: Nagpur reports its first Influenza A (H1N1) death of 2026 as swine flu cases surge in July. Since January, 25 laboratory-confirmed H1N1 cases have been recorded, with 15 infections in July and 13 within Nagpur Municipal Corporation (NMC) limits, signaling a July-driven spike. One death is directly attributed to H1N1; a second fatality was linked to existing comorbidities and not H1N1-related. In response, the NMC has ordered districts to strengthen ILI and SARI surveillance, institute daily reporting of all confirmed H1N1 cases, and require private hospitals to report suspected and confirmed infections. Hospitals must adhere to government treatment and infection-control protocols, ensure essential medicines and facilities, and conduct public awareness campaigns and medical audits of every H1N1-related death. Officials emphasize H1N1 is treatable with early diagnosis; watch for symptoms as outlined in guidance.

triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして毎年インドで発生しており、今回はナグプール市（マハーラーシュトラ州）における局地的な症例増加と死亡1例の報告。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、地方自治体による監視強化措置が取られている点は経過観察の対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Привезла с собой шесть паразитов: россиянка заразилась опасной лихорадкой денге после укуса комара во Вьетнаме :: Новости - RuFox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: She brought six parasites with her: a Russian woman contracted dangerous dengue fever after a mosquito bite in Vietnam :: News - RuFox
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Vietnam shows a surge, with more than 50,000 cases in the first five months of 2026, a 2.5-fold rise, signaling increasingly unpredictable outbreaks. A Russian traveler contracted dengue after a mosquito bite during an Asia tour in Vietnam; symptoms began two days later, including fever up to 40°C and severe body aches. After returning to Russia, she called an ambulance; clinicians diagnosed dengue and provided treatment and monitoring, and she was discharged after about a week with no ongoing health threat. In early July, another Russian woman, 35-year-old Valentina from Krasnodar, was hospitalized in Danang with dengue. The report highlights imported dengue cases in Russia amid rising Vietnam infections, underscoring travel-associated risk and the need for vigilance among travelers and healthcare providers.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll exceeds 1,000 in DR Congo as cases continue to rise
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, a case fatality rate of 40.7%, with the death toll exceeding 1,000 as of 23 July 2026. Since declaration on May 15, the virus has spread to five provinces, with Ituri remaining the epicenter. Some 738 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 506 have recovered. Health authorities say the response remains fully deployed across affected provinces, with reinforced surveillance, diagnostics, and case management capacities. The UN migration agency warns that the movement of Ebola victims' bodies across Congo for burial is increasing the risk of further transmission. Prime Minister Judith Suminwa is expected to visit affected areas to bolster the response and assess on-the-ground realities. Officials say it is too early to assert that the peak has been reached.

article.articleHeadline: ഡി.ആർ. കോംഗോയിലെയും യുഗാണ്ടയിലെയും എബോള വ്യാപനം; മരണം ആയിരം കടന്നുവെന്ന് ലോകാരോഗ്യസംഘടന
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda; death toll has crossed 1,000, says WHO
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has surpassed 1,000 deaths, according to WHO as of Wednesday. DR Congo reports 2,473 cases and 999 deaths; Uganda has just over 20 cases and more than 2 deaths. Most Ugandan cases are border-crossing Congolese; Uganda has had no new cases in three weeks. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of six Ebola species. This is the largest outbreak in the region since 1976; last August Congo reported 34 deaths; 2018–2020 waves killed about 2,300 in the region, and 2014–2016 West Africa exceeded 28,600. Transmission occurs through blood and bodily fluids; animals such as monkeys, apes, bushpigs, and pigs can harbor the virus. Incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle and throat pain, sometimes vomiting; severe cases bleed and cause liver/kidney failure, with death in 5–7 days. Prevention: proper meat cooking, isolation, avoiding contact, and prompt supportive care; NSAIDs and malnutrition or liver disease worsen outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴとウガンダでエボラ流行拡大、死者1,000人超えとWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: 死者1,000人超・国境を越えた複数国での感染拡大が確認され、1976年以来最大規模の流行とされており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus ditemukan pada peternak satwa liar di Vietnam: Alarm bagi Asia Tenggara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Found in Wildlife Breeders in Vietnam: A Warning for Southeast Asia
article.articleSummary: Antibodies against hantavirus were found in wildlife breeders in Vietnam, indicating prior exposure. In a study of 210 breeders from Lao Cai and Dong Nai, hantavirus antibodies were detected in 8.7%, with 1.9% suspected infections between August 2023 and March 2024. Those focusing solely on wildlife farming faced higher risk, likely due to poor biosecurity and prolonged contact with cages. Transmission can occur by inhaling aerosols from urine, feces, or saliva of infected rodents, with dirty environments increasing risk. The findings echo Southeast Asia concerns, including Indonesia (23 positives, 3 deaths among 250 suspects). They note the May Andes hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius cruise ship, highlighting spillover risk. Labs used ELISA; RT-PCR/sequencing are needed to identify the specific virus and rodent hosts. Strengthened biosecurity and a One Health, cross-disciplinary approach are urged for prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの野生動物飼育者からハンタウイルス抗体が検出：東南アジアへの警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの野生動物飼育者を対象とした血清疫学調査で抗体保有が確認されたが、現時点で急性の集団発生や重症患者の急増は報告されておらず、研究知見の域を出ないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はベトナム（ラオカイ省、ドンナイ省）における野生動物飼育者を対象とした血清疫学調査結果の報告であり、急性アウトブレイクの発生を示すものではない。インドネシアの過去の症例データ（23陽性、3死亡）も参照的に言及されているため対象国として含めた。RT-PCR等によるウイルス種の特定やげっ歯類宿主の同定が今後必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: United against polio: Zimbabwe strengthens regional immunity through synchronized vaccination
article.articleSummary: Zimbabwe completed three synchronized nOPV2 polio vaccination rounds (20–23 Apr, 2–5 Jun, 7–10 Jul 2026) across 27 high-risk districts in nine provinces to prevent re-establishment of circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2). Following a cVDPV2 outbreak in Oct 2023, no cVDPV2 has been detected since Jun 2024. The campaign, targeting children under five, delivered nearly three million doses (936,618; 997,941; 1,025,806) with over 6,000 personnel and nine national surge consultants, emphasizing door-to-door delivery, venue-based services, and intensified surveillance. Independent monitoring and Lot Quality Assurance Surveys reported high coverage. The regional synchronized effort includes Mozambique, Malawi, Zambia, Namibia, and Botswana to counter cross-border importation risks, strengthen acute flaccid paralysis and environmental surveillance, and support routine immunization to sustain population immunity against polio in Southern Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオに対抗して団結：ジンバブエが同期ワクチン接種で地域の免疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: cVDPV2再興防止のための予防的・同期的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの順調な実施報告であり、2024年6月以降新規症例は検出されていないが、地域的な越境リスクへの継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はジンバブエ主導の地域協調ワクチン接種活動の成功報告。対象国リストにはZambiaのみ含まれ、同期接種参加国として言及されているため含めた。ジンバブエ・モザンビーク・マラウイ・ナミビア・ボツワナは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Had dengue once? Here's why you can get it again and be more careful
article.articleSummary: Dengue infection can recur; immunity is serotype-specific. In India, four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) circulate, so a person can be reinfected with a different serotype. A second infection may carry a higher risk of severe disease due to antibody-dependent enhancement, though many patients recover with supportive care. The critical phase typically begins as fever subsides between day 3 and day 7, with plasma leakage, bleeding, and possible shock. Early dengue symptoms include high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, body aches, nausea and rash; warning signs needing urgent care include persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, bleeding, breathing difficulty, confusion, reduced urine output. Platelet count is not the sole measure of severity; clinicians assess hydration, blood pressure, hematocrit, and evidence of plasma leakage. Prevention by mosquito bite avoidance and eliminating standing water remains essential, since prior dengue does not guarantee protection.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に一度かかったことがある?再感染する理由と注意点
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の再感染メカニズムに関する一般的な医療解説記事であり、特定の集団感染や異常な流行を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の再感染リスクと臨床経過に関する啓発・解説記事であり、インドにおける具体的なアウトブレイクや症例数増加の報告ではないため、対象国としても計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: 初期症状像感冒，杭州有人中招！医生提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early symptoms resemble a cold; someone in Hangzhou has contracted it. Doctors warn.
article.articleSummary: Hangzhou, China—A 23-year-old man developed acute Hepatitis A with liver dysfunction after repeatedly eating roadside late-night foods, including barbecue, fried chicken, and ice-containing drinks. He tested positive for Hepatitis A virus IgM antibodies and is recovering after targeted treatment. Hepatitis A spreads via the fecal-oral route through contaminated food or water; high-risk sources include coastal street foods and raw or undercooked seafood. The incubation period is 15–50 days; initial symptoms mimic cold or gastroenteritis (fever, malaise, anorexia), followed by jaundice, dark urine, and pale stools. The article highlights three risky dining behaviors: raw or half-cooked seafood; unlicensed street vendors selling cold foods and drinks; and cross-contamination from shared utensils at home. Five prevention steps are advised: Hepatitis A vaccination; fully cook all seafood; keep raw and cooked foods separate; thorough hand hygiene; and choose licensed, established eateries while avoiding unverified street stalls.

triage.headline_ja: 初期症状は風邪に似ている、杭州で感染者が出た！医師が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 個別の一例症例に関する啓発記事であり、集団発生や異常な流行拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 個人の食習慣（生食・屋台の氷入り飲料等）に起因するA型肝炎の一例報告であり、公衆衛生上の啓発記事。集団感染や地域的流行の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Wirus rozprzestrzenia się szybciej niż kiedykolwiek. Tysiąc ofiar epidemii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The virus is spreading faster than ever. A thousand victims of the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed 1,031 lives since the epidemic began on May 15, 2026, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. The Bundibugyo virus strain underpins this outbreak, for which there is no licensed vaccine or proven treatment. WHO warns true infections may be 2-4 times higher than official figures. Funding remains critically short: WHO Africa crisis chief Marie Roseline Belizaire says $115 million is needed, with only $49 million raised to date. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids, and 80% of new cases occur outside known transmission chains, signaling rapid, untracked spread. Factors hampering response include ongoing conflict, scarce resources, and distrust of health workers.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスがこれまで以上に速く拡大。感染症の犠牲者は千人に達する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が史上最速の拡大速度を記録し、死者1,031人、資金不足、追跡不能な感染拡大（新規症例の80%が既知の感染経路外）という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立のブンディブギョ株による史上最速のエボラ流行。WHOは実際の感染者数が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を警告。資金不足（必要額1.15億ドルに対し調達済みは4,900万ドル）と紛争、保健従事者への不信感が対応を阻害している。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mask up if you have a heart condition: IMA expert, as Andhra Pradesh COVID-19 cases reach 32
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Andhra Pradesh rises to 32 cases as of July 22, 2026, with six new infections—three each in East Godavari and Visakhapatnam (Vizag). One death reported; three more test positive. The Omicron-derived RF.5 sub-lineage identified in five samples from YSR Kadapa district via NIV Pune sequencing; RF.5 is a derivative of Omicron, with symptoms mirroring other Omicron sub-variants: sore throat, cough, fever, headache, runny or blocked nose, fatigue, and body aches. Sub-variants may not cause more severe disease in healthy individuals but can stress those with heart conditions; masks advised for people with comorbidities in crowded places. Health Secretary held a virtual preparedness review, calling for testing kits, medicines, dedicated COVID beds, PPE and emergency supplies. Authorities urge those with even mild symptoms to visit government hospitals; no need for panic; cyclical pattern of cases is expected to rise and fall in coming months.

triage.headline_ja: 心臓疾患のある人はマスクを着用すべき:IMA専門家、アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州のCOVID-19症例が32件に達する
triage.triage_reason: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でのCOVID-19症例増加は季節的な増減パターンとして予想内とされ、症状も軽度。ただしOmicron派生株RF.5の検出があり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Nipahは疾患名リストに含まれるが記事サマリーには言及なし。BluedotのAPIタグ付けの誤りと思われる。記事は主にCOVID-19（Omicron派生株RF.5）の地域的増加に関する定例報告であり、重篤性や異常性は明示的に否定されている（「パニックの必要なし」「季節的な増減パターン」）。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يحصد 1033 وفاة في الكونغو والإصابات تتجاوز 2500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims 1,033 lives in Congo, as cases exceed 2,500.
article.articleSummary: 2,536 confirmed Ebola infections and 1,033 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of July 23, 2026. The National Institute of Public Health reported 50 new cases on Monday in Ituri and North Kivu in the east, where the outbreak was announced on May 15. Ituri’s security crisis since late 2025 has displaced over 100,000 people; the province is a mining region with high population movement, potentially accelerating spread. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are currently no licensed vaccines or specific treatments. WHO has begun clinical trials of two therapies and granted emergency use authorization for a diagnostic test targeting this strain; a first trial is assessing the safety of the ChAdOx1 vaccine developed by Oxford University. WHO warns the virus remains ahead, with containment hampered by insecurity, humanitarian crisis, mobility, cross-border risks, and the crucial role of burial ceremonies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで死者1033人、感染者2500人超に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が2500人超の感染、1000人超の死亡に至り、ワクチン未承認かつ治安悪化・人口移動により拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: イツリ州（Ituri）はDRC国内のADM1地域であり、対象国リストにはDRCとして集約。治安危機による人口移動・国境を越えるリスク・埋葬儀礼の関与など、拡大リスクが極めて高い状況。ワクチン・治療薬未承認で、WHOが臨床試験を開始している段階。

article.articleHeadline: Moringa, è di nuovo allerta Salmonella negli integratori
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moringa: Salmonella warning again in dietary supplements
article.articleSummary: Salmonella contamination linked to moringa-based dietary supplements prompted the Italian Ministry of Health to issue warnings after a U.S. outbreak. From August 2025 to June 2026 (over ten months), 131 Salmonella infections (serotypes Typhimurium, Newport, and Richmond) were reported across 38 states, tied to moringa leaf powder imported from India. Although the outbreak is considered closed, the U.S. FDA has recalled six moringa-containing products from three companies: Total Nutrition Inc (brands TNVitamins and Doctor’s Pride), Why Not Natural, and Superfoods Inc (Live It Up). Recalled items include 1,200 mg moringa capsules and 10,000 mg “Green Superfood” blends, with multiple lots and expiries between 2027 and 2028. These supplements are mainly sold online (Amazon, eBay). Consumers are advised not to consume them. Earlier Italian alerts involved Rosabella moringa powder and Erbavoglio Production recalls.

triage.headline_ja: モリンガ：サプリメントでサルモネラ警告が再び
triage.triage_reason: 米国で既に終息したサルモネラアウトブレイク（モリンガ由来サプリメント）に関する食品リコール情報であり、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクいずれも低い。
triage.notes: 感染事例は米国38州で発生し、既に終息済み（closed outbreak）。原料のモリンガ葉粉末はインド産だが、インド国内での感染発生は記載なし。イタリアも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Revue de presse Afrique - À la Une: l'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse les 1000 morts en RDC et en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa Press Review - Top Story: the Ebola outbreak has surpassed 1,000 deaths in the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda totals 1,001 confirmed deaths per the latest WHO briefing: 999 in the DRC and 2 in Uganda. Uganda reports no current cases but remains under a one‑month waiting period without new infections to be declared Ebola-free. In the DRC, the Ituri region remains the epicentre, where the Bundibugyo strain drives the 17th outbreak; no vaccine or proven treatment exists for this strain. Two clinical trials are advancing: Partner targets already infected patients with an experimental antiviral to reduce complications and deaths; Ebopep administers interventions to high‑risk contacts to prevent disease development. Civil society in Ituri, centered in Bunia, unveiled a three‑month awareness plan, aided by outbreak-response teams, while community engagement remains a key challenge. Advocates warn that Western funding cuts erode essential tools (testing, transport, handwashing stations, protective stocks) and urge renewed financial support to prevent a localized outbreak from becoming regional.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ・プレスレビュー - トップニュース：エボラ出血熱の流行がDRCとウガンダで死者1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行が死者1,001人に達し、有効なワクチン・治療法がない中で地域拡大の懸念があり、国際的な資金支援の必要性も指摘されているため。

article.articleHeadline: 2536 إصابة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2,536 Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,536 confirmed Ebola virus disease infections, including 1,033 deaths. Ebola is described as a highly deadly virus with an average fatality around 50%, and most outbreaks have occurred in sub-Saharan Africa, underpinning the naming of some variants after places. The outbreak has also been reported in Uganda in 2026, prompting international health authorities to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The United Nations Development Programme warns of substantial economic impacts, noting Africa could face significant losses exceeding its capacity. The article highlights the ongoing outbreak, the confirmed case and death toll, and the broader health and economic implications for the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染2,536例
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%のエボラ出血熱がDRCで2,536例・死亡1,033例に達し、ウガンダへの拡大とPHEIC宣言が報告されており、IHR基準に複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模流行とウガンダへの拡大、PHEIC宣言、経済的影響（UNDP）に言及。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控发布蚊子藏身地图！防蚊指南→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC Releases Map of Where Mosquitoes Hide! Mosquito Prevention Guide →.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-23, China CDC released a 'Mosquito Hide Map' showing Aedes albopictus breeding sites linked to dengue and chikungunya risk. Guangdong shows elevated vector activity; northern regions with summer conditions accelerate breeding. Mosquito habitats include indoor water containers (potted plants, mop buckets, discarded cups) and outdoor sites (ponds, tree holes, leaf litter, shelters, drainage ditches). Prevention centers on removing standing water: overturn unused bottles, refresh plant water weekly, and empty containers; resting sites include shrubs, shade, vacant houses, clutter—avoid lingering when passing. Blood type is not a factor; mosquitoes are guided by CO2, skin odors, and metabolism; infants and pregnant women or those who sweat are more attractive. Repellents: DEET for ages 2 months+, up to 10% for children, higher concentrations for adults; Picaridin for 6 months+; plant oils less durable; lemon eucalyptus not for under 2. Apply lightly to children; use nets for under 2 months. Source CCTV News.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理センターが蚊の隠れ場所マップを発表！蚊対策ガイド→
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生報告ではなく、中国CDCによる蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）の予防啓発・注意喚起の一般情報記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染症発生事例や患者数を報告するものではなく、季節的な蚊媒介感染症予防のための一般的な公衆衛生啓発コンテンツである。広東省で蚊の活動が活発との記述はあるが、実際の症例報告は含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se šíří rekordně rychle, Kongo hlásí přes tisíc obětí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads at a record pace, Congo reports over a thousand deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading at a record pace in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the country reporting over 1,000 deaths. The current outbreak—the 17th in the DRC—is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment, unlike the Zaire lineage that powered most previous outbreaks in the country. MSF warns that many patients arrive at health facilities in critical condition, with Mongbwalu seeing daily fatal outcomes and health systems overwhelmed by shortages of resources. Ebola transmits through contact with an infected person or contaminated materials and presents with fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and bleeding. No vaccine or specific therapy exists for Bundibugyo at this time; the article emphasizes ongoing, severe impact in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が記録的な速さで拡大、コンゴで1000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1000人以上の死者を出すエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の記録的速さの流行であり、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・特異的治療法が存在せず、DRC第17次流行として深刻化。MSFが医療体制の逼迫を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: 'We Will All Die From Ebola Here': Virus Stalks Crowded Camps in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, DRC, where camps housing about 1.3 million displaced face explosive transmission. In Kigonze camp, 20,000 residents with only a handful of water stations; Tsere camp in Rwampara (near Bunia) with 6,400+ sharing a single water tank; latrines overflow since 2023; water and sanitation infrastructure decimated by aid cuts. As of this week: Congo's health ministry reports 2,423 confirmed Ebola cases and 967 confirmed deaths; WHO cautions real numbers may be 2-4 times higher. In the last 24 hours four deaths; 19 deaths in the camp that month; at Kigonze, 55 deaths Apr-Jun, with at least four confirmed Ebola. 80% of new cases detected outside known contact lists. Renewed fighting displaced 361,000 since December, total displaced 1.3 million in Ituri. A new clinic near Tsere; humanitarian response deemed essential by health officials.

triage.headline_ja: 「ここではエボラで皆死ぬだろう」：コンゴの過密キャンプでウイルスが忍び寄る
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州の避難民キャンプで確認症例2,423件・死亡967件と大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、80%の新規症例が既知の接触者リスト外で発見されるなど制御不能な拡大の兆候があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にアフガニスタン・ルワンダが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCイトゥリ州（キゴンゼ・ツェレ・ブニア近郊）のキャンプでの流行のみを主題としているため、これらは除外した。水・衛生インフラの崩壊と援助資金削減が感染拡大を助長している点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 棋局正酣，一"粪"飞来......高热不退背后，竟藏着这种致命小虫！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The chess game is in full swing when a "feces" fly flies in... Behind the persistent high fever lies this deadly little parasite!
article.articleSummary: Guangdong Province, Zhuhai Hospital, China, reported a laboratory-confirmed scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) case after a park incident where the patient was struck by bird droppings while playing chess. He developed a high fever up to 41°C with chills; platelet count dropped to 50. Initial diagnosis of pneumonia changed after clinicians linked the illness to park exposure and mite exposure. Scrub typhus is transmitted by trombiculid mite larvae from rodents to humans. Incubation is 4–21 days (avg 9–12). Key signs include an eschar at concealed moist sites (armpits, groin, waist, perineum), lymphadenopathy, and a rash 3–6 days after fever onset. Without treatment, multi-organ injury and death (30–70% mortality) can occur; early appropriate antibiotics typically reduce fever within 24–48 hours. Prevention: protective clothing, avoid grass, and report outdoor exposure to clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: 将棋対局中に「糞」が飛来……高熱が続く背後には、この致命的な小さな虫が潜んでいた！
triage.triage_reason: 個別の散発的なツツガムシ病症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常な集団発生や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病は風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。今回は公園でのダニ曝露による単発症例で、医学解説記事の性格が強い。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Πάνω από 1.000 νεκροί από την επιδημία Έμπολα - Εντείνονται οι φόβοι για περαιτέρω εξάπλωση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Over 1,000 dead from the Ebola outbreak - fears of further spread intensify.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has resulted in 1,031 deaths and 2,473 cases, according to Africa CDC and the DRC Health Ministry. As of the latest update, roughly 737 patients are in isolation or in hospital. Declared on May 15, the outbreak is centered in Ituri province in eastern DRC, with cases reported in four additional provinces. It is among the fastest-growing and deadliest Ebola events on record, with mortality exceeding that seen in the West Africa 2013–2016 outbreak (over 11,000 deaths, 28,000 cases). Challenges include armed conflict, distrust toward health teams and safe-burial practices, attacks on healthcare facilities, and funding gaps. The WHO warns the true scale may be two to four times higher due to inaccessibility. Fewer than 9% of contacts are monitored, and over 60% of deaths occur in communities before patients receive care.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:エボラ流行で死者1,000人超-さらなる拡大への懸念強まる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRコンゴで急速に拡大し死者1,000人超・症例2,473件と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大懸念とWHOへの通知相当のIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOは実際の規模が報告の2〜4倍の可能性を指摘しており、武力紛争・医療施設への攻撃・接触者追跡率の低さなど管理困難な要因が多数存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Switzerland boosts support for fight against epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and wider region
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending a new Ebola epidemic that began in May, with Ituri Province as the epicenter and North Kivu also affected. The outbreak has 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, worsened by armed conflict and displacement. Switzerland increases support with an extra CHF 1.6 million to the WHO, bringing total Swiss assistance to CHF 4.6 million since the crisis began; funding facilitates emergency medical teams, response coordination, and the Africa CDC-WHO continental preparedness plan. WHO has doubled laboratory capacity to 400 tests per day, running across 10 laboratories with a capacity of over 2,000 tests daily. Clinical trials for Bundibugyo Ebola treatments are underway internationally. The SDC plans to provide a Swiss Humanitarian Aid Unit expert for six months. The risk of cross-border spread to South Sudan is noted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：スイスがコンゴ民主共和国および周辺地域における流行対策への支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認2,536例・死亡1,033例に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、武力紛争による対応困難化と国境を越えた拡大リスク（南スーダン）が指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: スイスと南スーダンは発生地域として挙げられているが、記事の主題である感染発生国はDRCのみ。南スーダンは越境拡大リスクとして言及されているに留まり、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: la Suisse renforce son soutien à la lutte contre l'épidémie en République démocratique du Congo et dans la région
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Switzerland strengthens its support for the fight against the epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and in the region.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues since May 2026, with 2,536 cases and 1,033 deaths reported by the national public health institute. The Ituri province remains the epicenter, followed by North Kivu, as conflict and population displacement hinder containment and raise cross-border risk to neighboring South Sudan. Switzerland provides an additional 1.6 million Swiss francs to the WHO, bringing total Swiss support to 4.6 million francs since the crisis began. Funds strengthen coordination of emergency medical teams and the Africa CDC–WHO continental preparedness and response plan. WHO has expanded laboratory testing from 200 to 400 per day, now operating 10 laboratories with capacity over 2,000 tests daily. Trials evaluating potential treatments for Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus are under international coordination. Switzerland will deploy a six-month expert from the Swiss Humanitarian Aid Corps to assist response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：スイスがコンゴ民主共和国および周辺地域における流行対策への支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,536例・死亡1,033例に達するエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続中で、国境を越えた拡大リスクや国際支援の必要性が明確であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 南スーダンへの越境リスクが言及されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。スイスは支援国であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta mundial por nueva cifra de muertos que deja peligroso virus; brote no se detiene
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global alert over new death toll from a deadly virus; outbreak shows no signs of stopping.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed 1,033 lives since the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, with continued spread across eastern provinces. Authorities report ongoing transmission in multiple eastern districts, a region where conflict and population movement complicate control efforts. In response, the government, backed by international partners, has intensified contact tracing, expanded diagnostic capacity, and deployed medical teams to the hardest-hit areas, alongside vaccination campaigns targeting people at risk of exposure. Public information programs aim for early symptom recognition and reduced transmission. Ebola is a viral disease transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals or animals. Key symptoms include high fever, severe weakness, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and, in some cases, internal and external bleeding. The World Health Organization stresses rapid response, isolation, and thorough contact tracing to halt spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数の新たな発表で世界的警戒感高まる；アウトブレイクは収束せず
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によりDRC東部で1,033人の死者が発生し、紛争地域での感染拡大継続と国際支援介入があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 1,033人の死者数、東部での紛争と人口移動により対策が困難という記載あり。国際的なワクチン接種キャンペーンと医療チーム派遣が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Die Schweiz verstärkt ihre Unterstützung zur Bekämpfung der Ebola-Epidemie in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo und der Region
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Switzerland steps up its support to combat the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the region.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo faces a renewed Ebola epidemic since May 2026, with 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths reported by the National Institute of Public Health. The outbreak concentrates in the eastern Ituri province and North Kivu, with conflict and displacement impeding containment. Cross-border spread to South Sudan is a concern given fragile health systems and extensive cross-border trade. The Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation (DEZA) has allotted an additional 1.6 million Swiss francs, bringing Switzerland's total support to 4.6 million francs since the crisis began. WHO has expanded testing from 200 to 400 tests per day, deploying 10 laboratories across affected provinces with capacity above 2,000 daily. Clinical trials for Bundibugyo Ebola variant therapies are underway, in which Switzerland participates. DEZA will second a WHO expert for six months to assist crisis management.

triage.headline_ja: スイスはコンゴ民主共和国とその地域におけるエボラ流行対策への支援を強化する
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2026年5月以降エボラ（Bundibugyo株）の流行が継続し、確認症例2,536例・死亡1,033例と深刻。紛争による対応の困難さや南スーダンへの越境拡大懸念もあり、国際支援が拡大している。
triage.notes: スイスと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。致死率は約40%と高く、Bundibugyo型エボラの臨床試験も進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Cases Spike Across Pune as On-and-Off Rains Fuel Mosquito Breeding
article.articleSummary: Dengue infections surge in Pune in July 2026 as stop-start monsoon showers create stagnant water ideal for Aedes mosquitoes. The Pune Municipal Corporation reports 540 suspected dengue cases and 22 lab-confirmed infections in the first three weeks of July, up from 175 suspected and 12 confirmed in June. Warje-Karvenagar is the hardest-hit area, with Nagar Road-Wadgaonsheri, Kothrud, and Aundh-Baner following closely, prompting intensified vector-control measures. Intermittent rainfall leaves water in open containers, potholes, and puddles, sustaining breeding sites. Both adults and children present with dengue-like fever, body aches, and fatigue; some require hospitalization for high fever, dehydration, or thrombocytopenia. Treatment remains supportive—fluids, rest, paracetamol—with antibiotics ineffective and no antiviral. Accurate diagnosis is essential due to overlap with other febrile illnesses. Warning signs include repeated vomiting, severe abdominal pain, breathing trouble, or sudden blood pressure drops; prevention and early detection are key.

triage.headline_ja: プネー各地でデング熱急増、断続的な雨が蚊の発生を助長
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン時期に例年見られる季節性のデング熱増加であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、地域の通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: SFTSウイルスは疾患名リストに含まれるが記事本文には言及がなく、実質的にはプネー市におけるデング熱の季節的増加に関する報道。地元自治体（Pune Municipal Corporation）によるベクター対策の強化が報告されているのみで、外部支援の必要性や重大な異常性は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: عدد الوفيات بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية يصل إلى 1033
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,033.
article.articleSummary: 2,536 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 1,033 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 23, 2026. The latest government data show 50 new infections were detected last Monday in Ituri and North Kivu in the eastern DRC. Over the past 50 years, Ebola outbreaks in Africa have killed more than 15,000 people. The World Health Organization announced clinical trials for two treatments against the latest rare strain and granted emergency use authorization for a new molecular diagnostic test to detect it. Last week, WHO also launched the first safety evaluation of the ChAdOx1 vaccine, led by the University of Oxford. Tierno Baldeh, the WHO Ebola outbreak response lead in the DRC, warned at a Geneva press conference that the outbreak remains ahead of response efforts and that authorities are trying to catch up with its evolution.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルスによる死者数が1,033人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（2,536例、死者1,033人）が継続し、新規感染も発生、WHOが対応強化中であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: WHOがジュネーブで会見し、対応が流行の進行に追いついていないと警告。新規治療薬・診断薬・ワクチンの緊急使用も進行中で、国際的な支援ニーズが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera los 2.500 casos mientras las autoridades detectan una estabilización de la epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 2,500 cases as authorities detect signs of stabilization of the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,536 lab-confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths as of July 21, 2026, with a 40.7% case fatality rate. After weeks of intense response, authorities report early signs of stabilization in new case notifications. The response covers Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo, with Ituri still the epicenter and Bunia the provincial capital. The health system now operates 23 Ebola Treatment Centers, 19 diagnostic laboratories, and about 800 beds. 738 patients remain isolated or hospitalized; 506 have recovered. Contacts monitored reach 77.2%. Nine patients were discharged from Bunia’s CME Ebola Treatment Center, bringing regional survivors to 85. Ongoing challenges include population reticence and insecurity, underscoring the need for continued surveillance, rapid referral, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、2,500例を突破、当局は安定化の兆候を検出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2,500例超・死亡率40.7%と大規模流行が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクの観点からIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報告。安定化の兆候はあるが、死亡率が高く、複数州にまたがり、接触者追跡率も77.2%と完全ではないため、引き続き監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DRC's Ebola outbreak kills more than 1,000, with children hit hardest
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak declared in May in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has killed more than 1,030 people and reached 2,536 confirmed cases in the DRC, with 1,001 deaths there and two deaths in Uganda, per WHO. About 90% of cases are in Ituri province, where 189 children have died and 476 have been infected; thousands more face trauma from loss and displacement. Fifty new cases were detected on Monday in Ituri and North Kivu as the outbreak accelerates. Transmission occurs via close contact and infected bodily fluids, with some burials taking place without protective measures. Bunia, Ituri’s capital, illustrates tracing challenges amid poverty and violence. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment, though trials for two potential therapies, a vaccine, and post-exposure prophylaxis are underway. Uganda notes three weeks with no new cases; most cross-border cases are Congolese.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者1,000人超え、子どもが最も深刻な被害
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者1,000人超、症例2,500人超）が継続・拡大しており、ワクチン・治療法未承認の株であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも死亡例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株であり、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが継続している点に注意。
