article.articleHeadline: Takeda's QDENGA Becomes India's First Approved Dengue Vaccine
article.articleSummary: India grants marketing authorization to QDENGA, Takeda's recombinant live attenuated tetravalent dengue vaccine, marking the country's first dengue vaccine approval. The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) approved the vaccine, imported by Takeda Biopharmaceuticals India Pvt. Ltd., for individuals aged 4–60 years in a two-dose regimen (0.5 mL per dose, spaced three months apart). Unlike some vaccines, QDENGA requires no prior dengue infection screening. Approval followed comprehensive evaluation under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act and Rules. QDENGA is developed using recombinant DNA technology and targets all four dengue serotypes. The vaccine has global data: Phase III in India showing safety, immunogenicity, efficacy; program across over eight countries (Brazil, Thailand, Sri Lanka, India). It is prequalified by WHO, approved in 42 countries with over 24 million doses distributed; post-marketing surveillance reports no significant safety concerns. This supports NVBDCP efforts in vector control, surveillance, and case management.

triage.headline_ja: 武田薬品のQDENGA、インド初の承認済みデング熱ワクチンに
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチンの承認に関する規制・製品ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な流行を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン承認のニュースであり、デング熱の発生・流行状況を報告するものではない。タイ、ブラジル、スリランカは臨床試験実施国として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: चंदौली में खुरपका-मुंहपका बीमारी से बचाव के लिए 5 सितंबर तक टीकाकरण अभियान, जानें
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination campaign in Chandauli to prevent foot-and-mouth disease through September 5; learn more.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) poses a risk to livestock in Chandauli district as the monsoon season begins. FMD attacks cattle and buffaloes' mouths and hooves, causing ulcers, lesions, and lameness, and can reduce milk yield and raise abortion risk in pregnant animals. Under the National Animal Disease Control Programme, a free vaccination campaign runs in Chandauli through September 5, vaccinating about 300,000 cattle and buffaloes. Three teams will go door-to-door in the district, including Niyamatabad block, to ensure coverage. The drive is expected to last about 45 days. If a farmer misses vaccination, they can call the toll-free helpline 1962 or contact the officer in charge at 9451871257. The campaign aims to prevent illness, maintain milk production, and shield farmers from economic losses by ensuring no animal is left unvaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: チャンダウリで口蹄疫予防のため9月5日までワクチン接種キャンペーン実施
triage.triage_reason: これは家畜向けの定期的な予防ワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内記事であり、実際の口蹄疫アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 家畜（牛・水牛）の口蹄疫予防のための国家動物疾病対策プログラムに基づく定期的なワクチン接種活動の告知記事。動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染症イベントではないため対象国リストへの該当なし（家畜のみが影響を受ける疾患）。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू का हाई अलर्ट: 18 इलाके हॉटस्पॉट घोषित, PMCH में जापानी वैक्सीन से टीकाकरण की तैयारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue on high alert: 18 areas declared hotspots, preparations for vaccination with the Japanese vaccine at PMCH.
article.articleSummary: Patna, India faces a dengue alert as 18 city areas are declared hotspots. With the monsoon, authorities anticipate a case surge by August's second week. Patna Medical College Hospital (PMCH) will host a dedicated dengue vaccination center for residents aged 4–60, using a Japanese vaccine. Each person receives a 0.5 mL primary dose, followed by a booster after an interval; full protection requires completing both doses. In hotspot wards, three daily fogging cycles and regular anti-larva spraying will target mosquitoes. Hotspots include Market Committee, Patliputra, Kankarbagh, Gardani Nagar, Rajiv Nagar, Shastrinagar, PMCH vicinity, Chamari Chak (Danapur), Fulwari Sharif, Indrapuri, Kumhrar, Jakkampur, Bhagwat Nagar, Bhikanpahadi, Alamganj, Bankipur, Mainpura, Mahendru, and Transport Nagar. Rapid-response teams will survey homes after new cases and intensify awareness via e-rickshaws and autos to prevent water stagnation.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に高度警戒:18地区がホットスポットに指定、PMCHで日本製ワクチンによる接種準備
triage.triage_reason: インド・パトナで季節性デング熱の流行対策(ホットスポット指定、ワクチン接種準備)が報じられているが、例年の季節的対応であり異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は乏しい。
triage.notes: モンスーン時期の季節性デング熱対策報道。症例数や重症度の具体的データは記事に含まれず、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 1.000 muertes registradas por brote de ébola en la RDC y Uganda, según OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,000 deaths recorded from Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has caused over 1,000 deaths. DRC reports 2,473 confirmed cases and 999 deaths; Uganda records 20 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri province (northeastern DRC), remains concentrated there with spillover into four other provinces. Uganda notes most cases involve Congolese cross-border travelers and reports three weeks with no new infections. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the outbreak has expanded faster in the last month than any prior Ebola event. Thierno Balde of the WHO said the outbreak is still ahead of responders. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, though progress includes two potential treatments, a vaccine, and post-exposure prophylaxis trials on the ground.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行、WHOによると死者1,000人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死者1,000人超、国境を越えた感染拡大、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなくWHOも対応が追いついていないと警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事の主題国だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOトップが過去最速の拡大と警告しており、致死率も非常に高い(約40%)。

article.articleHeadline: Viaggi all'estero, cresce il rischio di chikungunya e dengue: disponibili i vaccini anche in Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Traveling abroad, the risk of Chikungunya and Dengue is rising; vaccines are also available in Italy.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya and dengue infections are rising travel risks, with vaccines now available in Italy. Chikungunya vaccine (recombinant virus-like particles) has been available since Oct 2025 for those 12 and older, in a single 14-plus day pre-departure dose; no adjustment needed for older adults. Dengue vaccine is a live attenuated tetravalent given in two doses three months apart for travelers aged 4 and up, with no pre-travel serology required. Both diseases are transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; protection relies on repellents, long sleeves, nets, and daytime insecticides, especially at dawn and dusk. Chikungunya circulates in over 110 countries; transmission confirmed in more than 50. Dengue is endemic across Africa, Southeast Asia, India, the Middle East, the Americas, Australia and parts of the Pacific. Italy has had autochthonous chikungunya in Veneto and Emilia Romagna last year; dengue in Lodi (2023) and Fano (2024). SIMVIM urges pre-travel vaccination and awareness; Andrea Rossanese advocates knowledge.

triage.headline_ja: 海外渡航、チキングニアとデング熱のリスクが増加：イタリアでもワクチンが利用可能に
triage.triage_reason: 旅行者向けワクチン接種啓発に関する一般的な情報提供記事であり、特定の対象国における新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアにおける渡航者向けワクチン接種の一般啓発情報であり、インドはデング熱の流行地域として言及されているのみで、具体的なアウトブレイクの主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Schweiz stockt Ebola-Hilfe für den Kongo auf
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Switzerland increases Ebola aid for the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, Switzerland has intensified the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), providing 1.6 million francs to the WHO, bringing total aid to 4.6 million CHF. The Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation (Deza) will strengthen coordination of medical emergency teams and fund a plan to contain the disease in neighboring countries, including South Sudan. With partner support, WHO has raised testing in affected areas from 200 to 400 tests per day; ten laboratories across the provinces now offer over 2,000 tests daily. Deza will supply a six-month expert from the Swiss Humanitarian Aid Corps to the WHO, and Switzerland is participating in clinical trials for potential Ebola therapies. The outbreak, first reported in May 2026, has 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu amid armed conflict.

triage.headline_ja: スイス、コンゴ(民)へのエボラ支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例2,536件・死亡1,033件に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、近隣国（南スーダン）への拡大懸念や国際支援の拡充が報じられているため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 南スーダンへの拡大防止計画が言及されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。スイスは支援国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: У россиянки достали из ноги восемь личинок после отдыха на пляже Вьетнама
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eight larvae removed from a Russian woman's leg after vacation on a beach in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Eight larvae were surgically removed from a Russian tourist’s heel and knee after a vacation at Bai Sao Beach on Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam. The patient noticed painful nodules and sought care upon returning to Moscow; surgeons opened the lesions and extracted eight larvae. She underwent about 10–11 days of dressings and could only resume walking on the heel after roughly a month. The patient suspects sand fleas may have deposited the larvae under the skin or introduced infection. The report also notes a separate dengue fever case in Vietnam in another Russian traveler, who developed high fever and body aches after mosquito bites. The incidents highlight travel-associated infections linked to Vietnam, per Baza.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人女性、ベトナムのビーチで休暇後に足から幼虫8匹を摘出
triage.triage_reason: 個別の旅行者症例（幼虫感染および散発的なデング熱1例）であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は個人旅行者の症例報告であり、デング熱はベトナムにおける散発的な感染事例として言及されているのみで、アウトブレイクの兆候はない。ロシア・モスクワは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia di Ebola in Congo causa più di 1000 morti, quali sono i rischi per l'Europa e per l'Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo has caused more than 1,000 deaths; what are the risks for Europe and Italy?
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 999 deaths, with two more in neighboring Uganda, for a total just over 1,000 fatalities and more than 2,000 cases. Uganda reports no new cases for at least a week and awaits international confirmation to declare the outbreak over; the DRC continues to face worsening transmission. The hardest-hit areas are in north‑east Congo near the Uganda border, about 1,700 kilometers from Kinshasa, traversed by dense rainforest and limited roads, with the Kivu region also affected amid the M23 rebel control. Europe has seen imported cases, notably in France; authorities say sustained spread in Europe is very unlikely. Ebola transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids and cadavers, not airborne, and European surveillance remains vigilant, including in Italy.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行で1000人以上死亡、ヨーロッパとイタリアへのリスクは？
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1000人以上の死亡者を伴う大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダや欧州への越境事例も発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、フランス、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主たる発生地域として明確に特定される。M23反乱軍による治安不安定も対応の障壁となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 사망자 1000명 육박...세계보건당국 진단기술 확보 비상
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola death toll nears 1,000... WHO secures diagnostic technology.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo nears 1,000 deaths two months after declaration, with 2,473 confirmed cases and a 40.4% case fatality rate as of July 20, 2026. The flare-up is centered in Ituri Province and is reportedly spreading faster than the 2014 West Africa epidemic, though that prior event recorded about 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths overall. The current strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, whose regional CFR is generally 30–50%; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Uganda also declared Ebola that day but reports comparatively stable transmission, with last patient cured on July 16 and 20 cases, 2 deaths to date. Diagnostic capacity on the ground is limited, relying on specialized labs and causing delays. The Light Foundation is funding Ebola diagnostic R&D—focusing on point-of-care and rapid tests, up to 500 million won per project for up to nine months, with an August 18 deadline, to enhance field deployment and international collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ死者数、1000人に迫る…世界保健当局、診断技術確保に緊急対応
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラアウトブレイクで、致死率40%超、感染拡大速度が過去の西アフリカ流行を上回るとされ、複数国（DRC・ウガンダ）に及ぶ深刻な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEICを既に宣言済み。ウガンダも同日にエボラ発生を宣言したが、対象国リストに含まれないため（Uganda・Angolaは対象国リスト外）verified_locationsから除外。DRCが記事の主題国。

article.articleHeadline: No One Knows When It Will End": A Doctor on the Ebola Emergency
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a public-health emergency of international concern May 17 for Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. More than 2,400 people have tested positive and over 990 have died, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The outbreak center remains hot and spreading, driven by conflict, funding cuts, and an exodus of health-care workers. Early Ebola can resemble malaria and typhoid, but illness can progress to hemorrhagic fever with severe fluid losses, shock, multi-organ failure, and mortality often above 50%. On July 19, Abdou Sebushishe of Goma described care at Bunia General Hospital and the Ebola Treatment Center, where non-Ebola patients cannot cross into the center, and a PPE workflow with a buddy system and supervisor checks is used. The outbreak may have started in February; 1,000 cases were confirmed within 40 days. The risk to the U.S. remains low, but neighboring countries face threat.

triage.headline_ja: 「いつ終わるのか誰にも分からない」：エボラ緊急事態に対応する医師の証言
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行（症例2400人超、死亡990人超）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行（史上3番目の規模）。紛争・資金不足・医療従事者流出により制御困難。ウガンダも影響地域として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国への直接リスクは低いとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Virus del Nilo Occidentale si diffonde in Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile virus spreads in Europe.
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus transmission is active across Europe in 2026. In Greece, EODY reports 21 autochthonous cases through July 22, with 20 showing CNS involvement (encephalitis, meningitis, acute flaccid paralysis) and one mild; 13 hospitalizations. One additional travel-associated case is under investigation. Across Europe by July 15, 2026, 33 locally acquired cases were recorded in five countries: Italy (20 cases across 16 regions; most in Novara, then Cremona and Verona), North Macedonia (2 in Skopje and Vardar), Romania (2 in Argeș and Suceava), and Spain (2 in Alicante and Seville). In Greece, most infections were in Attica, with several municipalities affected; outside Attica, cases occurred in Larissa and Palamas. High-risk areas include Peania, Rafina-Pikermi, Amarousio, Iraklio Attikis, Filothei-Psychiko. The ECDC issues weekly summer updates; authorities emphasize mosquito protection as transmission is influenced by weather and bird migration and appears established in Greece since 2010.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルスがヨーロッパで拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準について公衆衛生への深刻な影響（CNS関与20例、13入院）と国際的拡大（5か国で33例）の2つが該当するため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はギリシャ・イタリア・北マケドニア・ルーマニア・スペインでの西ナイルウイルス流行を主題としており、対象国リストに該当する国（フィリピン等）は発生地域として誤って付与されているのみで、記事本文には一切言及がないため verified_locations には含めない。西ナイルウイルスは毎年夏季に流行する季節性感染症であり、ギリシャでは2010年以降定着しているため「異常/予想外」には該当しないと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: India sends 4.5 tonnes of medical aid to Kenya to boost Ebola preparedness - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: India delivered a first 4.5-tonne tranche of medical aid to Kenya at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi to bolster Ebola preparedness amid the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. Indian High Commissioner Adarsh Swaika handed over the supplies to Kenya's Health Secretary Aden Duale; a second tranche is to follow. The 279-package shipment includes PPE kits, sample transport kits, infrared thermometers, face shields, and other infection‑prevention materials, supporting surveillance, safe sample collection/transport, and frontline protection. This follows more than 45 tonnes of assistance to Africa CDC in May–June to enhance Ebola readiness. Cooperation also extends to medical equipment grants, such as a Bhabhatron radiotherapy machine for Kenyatta National Hospital and diagnostic gear for the Kenya Navy Hospital in Mombasa. Around 10,000 Kenyans travel to India annually for treatment; Indian pharma accounts for over half of Kenya’s market.

triage.headline_ja: インドがケニアへエボラ対策支援として医療物資4.5トンを送付
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドからケニアへの医療支援物資提供という外交・物流ニュースであり、新規感染例や流行拡大を示す情報は含まれていない。DRCのエボラ流行は既知の継続事案であり、本記事自体が新たなシグナルとはならない。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はインドによるケニアへの人道支援物資提供であり、ケニア国内での新規エボラ症例は報告されていない。背景としてDRCでの流行が言及されているため、DRCを発生国として記録するが、本記事自体は新規シグナルというより既存流行への対応・準備支援に関する報道。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak kills over 1,000 in DR Congo, Uganda - WHO - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has killed more than 1,000 people, with 2,473 confirmed cases across both countries. The DRC reports 2,453 infections and 999 deaths; Uganda has 20 cases and two fatalities. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, centered in Ituri province in the northeast, with spread to four additional provinces amid insecurity hindering response. Most Ugandan cases involve Congolese nationals who crossed the border; no new infections have been reported there in three weeks. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Two experimental treatments, a vaccine candidate and post-exposure preventive therapy, are in clinical trials with encouraging early progress. WHO Director-General warned the outbreak expanded rapidly over the past month; response remains ahead of containment as of 2026-07-23.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、DRコンゴとウガンダで死者1,000人超 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によりDRコンゴとウガンダで1,000人以上の死者、2,473例の確定例が発生し、国境を越えた拡大と治安悪化による対応困難があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの第17次エボラ流行で、Bundibugyo株による発生。承認済みワクチン・治療薬はなく、治験中の候補薬に期待。治安悪化が対応を妨げている。

article.articleHeadline: கொங்கோ நாட்டில் எபோலா வைரஸ் தொற்றால் உயிரிழந்தவர்களின் எண்ணிக்கை ஆயிரத்தை கடந்தது
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola virus infection in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed one thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,000 deaths. Since it was officially declared on May 15, 2026, investigators confirm 2,536 cases and 1,033 deaths, a case fatality rate of 40.7%. The five-province spread centers on Ituri province. Currently 738 patients are in hospital isolation and in intensive care, while 506 have recovered. Health authorities have intensified testing, patient management, and surveillance across all affected provinces. The UN refugee agency warns that transporting Ebola-affected bodies for funerals to different regions raises transmission risks. Prime Minister Judit Suminva will visit the affected areas to assess the situation on the ground and reinforce response measures. Officials caution that the outbreak has not yet peaked and containment efforts must be further escalated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルス感染症の死者数が1000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者1000人超・致死率40.7%、5州に拡大しピークに達していないため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 首相の現地視察やUNHCRの警告など社会的・政治的関心も高く、アウトブレイクは未だピークに達していないとされ、今後の拡大に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha reports two new COVID-19 cases, total infections rise to three
article.articleSummary: Odisha reports two new COVID-19 cases, raising total infections to three, all in Ganjam district. The two new patients are in home isolation and stable; the third patient, a woman treated at MKCG Medical College Hospital in Berhampur, is also stable but has diabetes, hypertension and heart-related issues. Officials describe the illness as influenza‑like and say the virus has become weak; health authorities urged residents not to panic. Rabindranath Mishra, Director of Public Health, and Santosh Mishra, Special Secretary of the Health and Family Welfare Department, visited the Berhampur hospital to assess the situation. The article does not provide infection sources or travel linkage.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州で新たに2件のCOVID-19感染確認、累計感染者数3人に
triage.triage_reason: 感染者数は3人のみで全員安定しており、当局も「弱毒化したインフルエンザ様疾患」と説明しパニックを否定しているため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19はすでに広く流行している既知の疾患であり、少数の軽症例報告に過ぎない。地方保健当局が視察を行った程度で、国際的な懸念事項には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Le nombre de décès liés au virus Ebola dépasse les 1000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The number of Ebola virus-related deaths has surpassed 1,000.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: confirmed cases reach 2,536 with 1,033 deaths (case fatality rate 40.7%). Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the epidemic has shown persistent community transmission, with deaths surpassing 1,000. Five provinces are affected: Haut-Uele, Ituri (epicenter for Bundibugyo strain), Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo. Current status lists 738 patients in isolation or hospitalized and 506 recovered. The Ituri province remains the outbreak's epicenter; despite occasional slight declines in new infections in some areas, officials say it is too early to declare the peak over. The UN migration agency warned last week that transporting victims' remains across Congo for burial could fuel spread. Government response is ongoing, with top officials visiting Kisangani, Bunia, Mungwalu, and Rwampara to bolster surveillance, case management, and prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラウイルスによる死者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例2,536人、死者1,033人（致死率40.7%）に達する大規模エボラ流行が5州にわたり継続中で、コミュニティ内伝播や遺体移動によるさらなる拡大リスクがあり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwanda（Kigali Province）が含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内5州（Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo）のみが言及されており、Rwandaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: AP Reports Rise In Covid Cases, No Infections In Telangana
article.articleSummary: AP reports rise in Covid-19: Andhra Pradesh has recorded over 60 cases in the past 15 days, with four Covid-positive deaths and advisories issued after these fatalities. Government hospitals have stepped up testing and set up dedicated wards. In Telangana, Hyderabad officials say no confirmed Covid cases have been detected; a suspected Covid-related death in Tarnaka prompted concerns, but Hyderabad District Medical Officer Dr. Putla Srinivas noted no confirmed Covid deaths and no cases detected in Hyderabad. Testing kits are available at Gandhi Hospital and Osmania General Hospital, with symptomatic patients tested as needed. Dr. Raja Rao of Osmania Medical College linked the new infections in AP and Kerala to an Omicron subvariant, though current circulation is not considered highly severe. Authorities advise elderly and chronically ill individuals to stay cautious and seek medical advice if symptoms appear; most hospital visits concern monsoon-related cold, cough, and fever.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデシュ州でコロナ感染者増加、テランガナ州では感染確認なし
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な感染者増加であり、致死性も高くなく既知のOmicron亜系統によるもので、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地元メディアによる日常的なCOVID-19感染状況の報告であり、既知のOmicron系統による軽症例が中心。テランガナ州では確定症例なしとされている。

article.articleHeadline: El Puerto de Barcelona crece en tráfico pese al caos ferroviario, la peste porcina y la geopolítica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Port of Barcelona sees growth in cargo traffic despite rail chaos, swine fever and geopolitics.
article.articleSummary: Port of Barcelona cargo throughput grew 3.5% in January–June 2026 to 35.87 million tonnes, despite geostrategic uncertainty, African Swine Fever (ASF) affecting the meat industry, and rail disruptions. Container traffic climbed 4.3% to 1.93 million TEU, with imports up 6.7%. About 386,000 vehicles moved (+6.5%), while vehicle imports rose 36%, with roughly half from China and 45% electric or hybrid. Exports of salts and potash from Iberpotash mines in Bages rose 4.8% on the metre-gauge network operated by FGC. Rubí tunnel closure cut international rail traffic by over 46%; Gelida accident reduced Iberian traffic by about 18%. Cruise movements reached 2.44 million, including 1.0 million cruise passengers (up 3.4%). Investments include 98 million for new road junctions and 111.5 million for liquid-bulk berths, signaling resilience and ongoing port expansion.

triage.headline_ja: バルセロナ港、鉄道混乱・豚熱・地政学的不安にもかかわらず貨物取扱量増加
triage.triage_reason: 記事は港湾物流・経済動向が主題であり、アフリカ豚熱(ASF)は肉産業への影響として言及される程度で、公衆衛生上の直接的懸念や新規発生情報は含まれない（ASFはヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生上の意義も低い）。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はバルセロナ港の物流統計であり、ASFはスペイン国内の背景要因として簡潔に触れられているのみ。対象国リストにスペインは含まれず、また本記事はヒト感染症事案ではないためトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: IDAF reforça alerta contra a raiva bovina após confirmação de caso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IDAF reinforces alert against bovine rabies after confirmation of a case.
article.articleSummary: Bovine rabies case confirmed in Tarauacá’s rural zone, Acre, prompting alert by the Acre Institute of Agricultural and Forest Defense (IDAF). Rabies is a viral zoonosis affecting all mammals, with near-100% fatality after clinical signs appear. In cattle, primary transmission is from hematophagous bats (Desmodus rotundus) or contact with infected saliva. Early diagnosis is emphasized to curb spread. Clinical signs in bovines include isolation from the herd, difficulty walking and tremors, excessive salivation and inability to swallow, behavioral changes, and neurological disturbances. Producers should notify IDAF for sample collection and testing; notification does not incur penalties, even if animals are unvaccinated, enabling sanitary barriers and vaccination blocks in neighboring properties. Annual vaccination remains the most effective protection, starting at three months with periodic boosters. Humans at risk should seek immediate medical evaluation after bites or scratches; avoid handling sick animals without PPE. IDAF operates temporarily from Cageacre, Copacabana, during renovations.

triage.headline_ja: IDAFがウシ狂犬病症例確認を受けて警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: アクレ州における牛の狂犬病単発症例で、中南米では吸血コウモリ由来の牛狂犬病は既知かつ地域的に一般的な事象であり、人への感染拡大や国際的リスクは報告されていない。
triage.notes: 地域の農業機関（IDAF）による通常の家畜衛生対応であり、人への感染例やヒト-ヒト感染の報告はない。コロンビアの地名も発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題はブラジル・アクレ州の牛狂犬病であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 138 Kasus DBD di Kota Tasikmalaya, Didominasi Anak-anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 138 Dengue Fever Cases in Tasikmalaya City, Predominantly Among Children
article.articleSummary: 138 dengue fever cases in Tasikmalaya City, West Java, Indonesia, from January through July 2026, predominantly among children. Age distribution: 0–5 years 31; 6–12 years 30; 13–18 years 22; 19–30 years 19; 31–50 years 25; 50+ years 11. Cases span 10 districts. Aedes aegypti is the vector; several patients require intensive care. Officials attribute the rise to weather and low public awareness of environmental hygiene, particularly during the dry season. Public health measures include PSN (mosquito larva source elimination) and G1R1J (one house, one jumantik) to curb larval habitats in water containers and drains. The health secretary warns of possible further increases and urges massive environmental cleaning to reduce transmission this year.

triage.headline_ja: タシクマラヤ市でデング熱138例、子どもが多数
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアの地方都市における季節的な流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例増加傾向と重症例の存在から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで毎年季節的に発生する風土病であり、本記事は地方都市（タシクマラヤ）レベルでの症例報告。一部重症例あり集中治療を要するが、国全体・国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。当局は既にPSN・G1R1Jなどの対策を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: OIM Alerta Que Transporte de Cadáveres Agrava Risco de Propagação na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: IOM warns that the transport of corpses increases the risk of transmission in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola transmission risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is rising as families move corpses between districts, according to IOM. The Bundibugyo variant leaves bodies highly infectious after death. As of July 14, DRC and Uganda reported over 2,000 cases and about 700 deaths, with two-thirds of fatalities occurring outside health facilities, hindering safe burials. IOM intercepted 105 corpses in transit at checkpoints, with samples collected for investigation and burial teams ensuring safe, dignified rites. One transport contributed to new infection foci in Tshopo province, where the outbreak rose about 70% in two weeks, averaging over 40 new cases daily. Community resistance and occasional attacks hinder containment. WHO reports roughly 80% of confirmed case contacts are under monitoring, while about 20% remain unlocated due to insecurity. No corpses have been moved to other countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：IOMがDRCにおける遺体搬送が感染拡大リスクを増大させていると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCとウガンダで2,000例以上・約700人の死者を伴うエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が拡大しており、遺体搬送による新規感染巣の形成やコミュニティの抵抗が制御を妨げているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも感染地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Tshopo州はDRC国内の地域のためDRCに統合。

article.articleHeadline: About 30 students fall ill after dinner at MJPRS in Mancherial
article.articleSummary: About 30 students of the government-run Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Residential School (Girls) in Bellampalli, Mancherial district, fell ill after dinner on Wednesday night, reporting vomiting and stomach pain. They were admitted to hospital, discharged by midnight, but symptoms recurred Thursday morning, and they were rushed to a hospital again and are undergoing treatment. Officials ordered an inquiry and will test food samples in a laboratory to determine the cause, with the incident attributed to possible food poisoning from stale food served around 9 pm. Parents urged steps for hygienic meals and preventive measures to avoid recurrence. The case highlights school-food safety concerns; no laboratory-confirmed diagnosis is reported yet as results are awaited.

triage.headline_ja: マンチェリアルのMJPRSで夕食後に生徒約30人が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒疑いの局所的な集団発症であり、感染症としての異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 食中毒（stale food）が原因と推定され、感染症イベントではない可能性が高い。ラボ結果待ちのため続報要だが現時点でトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Nagpur News: इस बार नागपुरवासियों को इन्फ्लुएंजा ए (एच1एन1) कर सकता है परेशान | This time, Influenza A (H1N1) may trouble the people of Nagpur.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nagpur News: This time, Influenza A (H1N1) may trouble the people of Nagpur.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1N1) – swine flu – is prompting caution in Nagpur, India. The Nagpur Municipal Corporation (NMC) health department urges vigilance as 13 new cases were confirmed in July, with the total lab-confirmed cases in 2026 so far reaching about 25 since January. A swine flu containment plan has been initiated after two years. Hospitals under NMC and private facilities have been asked to report cases for monitoring. Public health advice emphasizes avoiding crowded places and wearing masks, especially for the elderly, pregnant women, young children, and individuals with diabetes or other serious illnesses. Symptom awareness is urged: cold, cough, fever, sore throat, and nausea; if present, avoid self-treatment and seek care at the nearest NMC hospital where doctors will supervise treatment. Lead: Dr. Govardhan Navkhare, Infectious Disease Officer, NMC. Historical data (2022–2025): 2022 – 371 cases, 21 deaths; 2023 – 79/10; 2024 – 122/24; 2025 – 46/1.

triage.headline_ja: ナグプールニュース: 今回はインフルエンザA(H1N1)がナグプール市民を悩ませる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1流行であり、当局が対応計画を開始しているが、2026年の症例数（25例）は過去のピーク（2022年371例）と比べて少なく、現時点で異常な拡大や重篤性の急増は確認されていない。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドで毎年季節的に発生する既知の感染症であり、ナグプール市保健当局（NMC）が封じ込め計画を再開し、監視体制を強化している。過去のデータ（2022年371例・21死亡、2023年79例・10死亡等）と比較すると2026年の症例数は現時点で少なく、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態とは言えないが、季節の進行に伴う症例増加の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل 2536 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا منها 1033 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo records 2,536 confirmed Ebola virus cases, including 1,033 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: confirmed cases reach 2,536 with 1,033 deaths. Government data released late Wednesday report 63 new infections on Tuesday in Ituri, North Kivu, and Haut-Uele provinces in the eastern region. Neighboring Uganda records 2 deaths and 20 cases, after authorities previously indicated no active infections as of July 20 per WHO. Over the past 50 years, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa. The World Health Organization announced clinical trials for two treatments targeting the latest rare strain and granted emergency use authorization for a molecular diagnostic test. Last week, the first safety trial for the ChAdOx1 vaccine, led by Oxford University, began. WHO Ebola response lead Tierno Baldeh warned the outbreak remains ahead of response efforts and that teams are still trying to catch up.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラウイルス確認症例2,536例、うち死者1,033人を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行(致死率約40%)が継続し、隣国ウガンダにも越境拡大、WHOが治療薬・ワクチン治験を実施するなど国際的対応が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例・死亡が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOが希少株に対する治療薬治験・診断薬の緊急使用許可を実施し、Oxford大学主導のChAdOx1ワクチン安全性試験も開始しており、国際的対応の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: اختبار سريع جديد للكشف عن إيبولا يحصل على ترخيص طارئ في الولايات المتحدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New rapid test for Ebola detection receives emergency authorization in the United States.
article.articleSummary: FDA grants Emergency Use Authorization for OraQuick Ebola 2.0 rapid test to bolster diagnostics during a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with spillover into Uganda. The test uses whole blood from living patients and oral fluids from recently deceased suspected cases, and detects antigens from four Orthoebolavirus species — Bundibugyo, Zaire, Sudan, and Taï Forest — but cannot identify the specific strain from a positive result. Results appear in about 30 minutes on a test strip without laboratory equipment or power, enabling use in resource-limited settings. The outbreak remains active in the DRC; WHO reports 2,124 confirmed cases and 828 deaths as of July 15, while Uganda reports no new cases since June 21, with a 42-day monitoring period. Developed with BARDA; OraQuick 2.0 has higher sensitivity and more automated manufacturing than the prior version. The 2019 OraQuick Ebola rapid antigen test was the first U.S.–marketed.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、新しいエボラ出血熱迅速検査キットに緊急使用許可（EUA）を付与
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のブンディブギョ・エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定2,124例、死亡828例）がウガンダへ越境しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: 米国とウガンダは発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ（226074）と米国は含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイクとその診断技術に関するもの。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon infections: Experts call for early laboratory testing to improve diagnosis and treatment
article.articleSummary: Monsoon infections in India include dengue, malaria, chikungunya, typhoid, hepatitis A and E, leptospirosis, influenza and acute gastrointestinal infections, with early laboratory testing essential for accurate diagnosis and timely treatment. At a Mahajan Imaging & Labs webinar, experts stressed diagnostics help distinguish diseases with overlapping symptoms (fever, body aches, cough, diarrhoea) and prevent complications. Testing volumes reflect seasonal rise: 490, 475 and 404 tests May–Jul 2025; 937 in August and 1,128 in September; 597 in October and 413 in November. In 2026, January–June testing totalled 2,107. The Indian Council of Medical Research identifies dengue, malaria, typhoid, leptospirosis, chikungunya and influenza among AUFI priority causes requiring timely lab work. Persistent fever beyond two days or alarming signs warrant evaluation; early pathology, microbiology and molecular diagnostics enable faster, more accurate identification, guide treatment, curb unnecessary antibiotics and strengthen surveillance; emphasis on hygiene and mosquito control.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン感染症：専門家が診断・治療改善のための早期検査室検査を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 毎年恒例のモンスーン季節性感染症に関する啓発・検査推奨記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性感染症（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア熱等）の診断・検査の重要性を啓発する一般的な医療情報であり、具体的な発生や異常な増加を報告するものではないため、対象国verified_locationsも空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Raebareli Launches Massive FMD Vaccination Drive for Cattle | Raebareli News: गौवंशों के लिए बृहद टीकाकरण अभियान शुरू, खुरपका-मुंहपका रोग से बचाव पर विशेष जोर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Raebareli Launches Massive FMD Vaccination Drive for Cattle | Raebareli News: A Large Vaccination Campaign for Cattle Launched, with Special Emphasis on Protection Against Foot-and-Mouth Disease.
article.articleSummary: Raebareli district in Uttar Pradesh launched a large-scale Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) vaccination drive to protect cattle. The Department of Animal Husbandry has formed 54 teams that are visiting villages and cow sheds to vaccinate eligible cattle, excluding pregnant cows. The teams include a veterinarian, an animal husbandry extension officer, and other trained staff, with a goal of timely, blanket immunization across the district. Beyond vaccination, farmers are being educated on animal health, sanitation, and disease prevention. District Veterinary Officer Dr. Kuldeep Kumar Dwivedi emphasized FMD as an infectious disease that not only harms animal health but also reduces milk production; vaccination is the most effective preventive measure. The department seeks 100% vaccination of all eligible cattle to prevent future outbreaks and safeguard livelihoods and dairy productivity.

triage.headline_ja: ラエバレリでウシ向け口蹄疫(FMD)大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーン開始
triage.triage_reason: 動物の口蹄疫予防のための通常のワクチン接種活動を伝える記事であり、ヒトへの健康影響や異常な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物衛生分野の予防的ワクチン接種活動の報道であり、ヒトの感染症危機管理の対象としての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Mehr als 1.000 Ebola-Tote in Demokratischer Republik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,000 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak with more than 1,000 deaths. The National Institute of Public Health records 1,033 Ebola deaths and 2,533 confirmed infections, with 506 recoveries. The outbreak, detected in mid-May, has accelerated, especially among health workers due to shortages of protective equipment. Prime Minister Judith Suminwa visited affected regions. The World Health Organization declared an international health emergency shortly after the outbreak began. There is no vaccine or specific therapy for this Bundibugyo strain. Most infections are in Ituri Province; Uganda reported a few initial cases, including two deaths, with no new cases since June 21. Transmission occurs from animals (monkeys and fruit bats) to humans and between people via bodily fluids, including handling of the dead; early symptoms resemble flu and can progress to bleeding, cramps, and breathing difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者1,000人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大）し、WHOが国際保健緊急事態を宣言済みであることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも初期に数例（死亡2名含む）報告されたが6月21日以降新規症例なしのため、現時点での主要発生国はDRCのみと判断。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株であり、医療従事者間の感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع عدد الإصابات بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, government data released on Wednesday evening show. The latest report from the Institute of Public Health records 63 new infections on Tuesday in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu, and a third eastern locality transliterated as Ot Oili. The update confirms ongoing transmission in eastern DRC. The report provides counts of confirmed cases and deaths, with no further detail on recoveries or laboratory confirmation methods. The continuation of new cases underscores the persistent risk in the outbreak area and the need for sustained public health surveillance and response in the affected regions."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例数・死亡者数が高水準で継続的に増加しており、複数州にまたがる持続的なヒト-ヒト感染が示唆されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率は約40.7%（1033/2536）と高く、複数の東部州（イトゥリ、北キブ、および第三の地域）で新規感染が確認されている。継続的なサーベイランスと対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : 2.536 cas confirmés d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: 2,536 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,536 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,033 deaths as of 23 July 2026. Announced from Kinshasa and cited by Reuters, the figures reflect an ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak within the country. Transmission is by direct contact with the blood, secretions, organs, and other bodily fluids of infected individuals, and by contact with surfaces and materials contaminated by these fluids. The notice provides no regional breakdowns or timelines beyond the cumulative totals, and does not detail infection sources or recent case-by-case developments in specific areas. Overall, the counts represent laboratory-confirmed cases officially reported by authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ確定症例2,536件
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定2,536例、死亡1,033例）が継続しており、致死率も高く国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は約40.7%と高く、感染源や地域別内訳、時系列情報は不明。継続的な症例増加の推移を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 2,536 حالة وتسجيل 1,033 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 2,536 cases and 1,033 deaths recorded
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has intensified, with 2,536 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths reported as of 23 July 2026. Government data indicate 63 new eastern infections in Ituri and North Kivu (and another area), signaling ongoing transmission in eastern DRC. Uganda registered 20 cases and 2 deaths linked to cross-border spread. International response includes the World Health Organization launching two therapeutic trials for the latest rare strain and approving the first emergency-use molecular diagnostic test; Oxford University has begun the first safety trial of the ChAdOx1 Ebola vaccine. WHO warns the outbreak remains advancing and requires intensified public health measures to curb spread. All figures are lab-confirmed, reflecting a persistently active outbreak and broad international involvement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が2,536人に増加、死者1,033人を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模拡大し、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例発生も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。国際的な治療薬・ワクチン開発も進行中で、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 19 Girls Hospitalised After Diarrhoea Outbreak at Mayurbhanj KGBV Hostel
article.articleSummary: Diarrhoea outbreak at Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV) hostel in Sargada, Bijatola block, Mayurbhanj district, Odisha, left 19 girl students hospitalised after more than 30 developed symptoms on Wednesday. The infections prompted an emergency response with a special Health Department team from Bijatola delivering primary treatment, health check-ups, and ongoing monitoring at the hostel. Nineteen students were shifted to Rairangpur Sub-divisional Hospital in two SUVs; all are reported in stable condition, with the medical team continuing treatment at the hostel for remaining students. The exact cause is not yet confirmed; contaminated food or drinking water is suspected. District administration and health department have strengthened arrangements for safe food and potable drinking water and are maintaining surveillance to contain the spread while officials review the situation at the school.

triage.headline_ja: マユールバンジのKGBV寮で下痢アウトブレイク発生、19人の女子生徒が入院
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設内での下痢集団発生であり、原因は未確定（食中毒または水系感染が疑われる）。重症例は報告されておらず国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 学生寮内での集団下痢症例であり、全員安定した状態。原因物質・病原体は特定されておらず、汚染された食品または飲料水が疑われている。地域の保健当局が対応中で、外部支援の必要性は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus do Nilo Ocidental: 21 casos na Grécia, infeção espalha-se na Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile virus: 21 cases in Greece, infection spreading across Europe.
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus transmission is active across Europe. In Greece, 21 autochthonous cases as of 22 July 2026; 20 CNS involvement (encephalitis, meningitis or acute flaccid paralysis) and 1 mild; no deaths; 13 hospitalised; 14 new autochthonous cases in the last week; plus one travel-associated case with exposure abroad, not in EODY’s analysis. Across Europe by 15 July 2026, 33 locally transmitted cases in five countries: Italy 20 cases across 16 regions (notably Novara 3; Cremona and Verona 2 each; others including Milan, Florence, Naples, Padua, Modena, Ferrara); North Macedonia 2 (Skopje, Vardar); Romania 2 (Argeș, Suceava); Spain 2 (Alicante, Seville). In Greece, Attica accounts for the majority; other Greek cases in Larissa and Palamas; high-risk zones include Peania, Rafina-Pikermi, Amarousiou, Iraklio Attica and Filothei-Psychiko. Protection against mosquitoes is advised; ECDC/EODY provide weekly summer updates; transmission is influenced by weather, vectors, and wild birds.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルス：ギリシャで21症例、感染はヨーロッパ全域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 西ナイルウイルスの感染拡大はギリシャ・イタリア・北マケドニア・ルーマニア・スペインで発生しており、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）はいずれも実際の発生地域に含まれない。
triage.notes: 本記事はヨーロッパ（ギリシャ、イタリア、北マケドニア、ルーマニア、スペイン）における西ナイルウイルスの季節的流行に関するものであり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生ではない。発生地域リストにフィリピンが含まれるが、記事本文・サマリーには一切言及がなくBluedotの誤付与と判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: IISc Scientist Decode Virus Hijack Mechanism
article.articleSummary: Encephalomyocarditis virus (EMCV) hijacks the host cell’s protein-making machinery via a structured Internal Ribosomal Entry Site (IRES) to seize ribosomes. In Bengaluru, India, IISc researchers show EMCV’s IRES binds directly to the 40S ribosomal subunit and initiator tRNA, redirecting translation from cellular to viral proteins and blocking normal host protein production. Using cryo-electron microscopy, the team captured the moment the viral IRES forms a complex with the ribosome, after isolating the viral translation complex from rabbit reticulocyte extracts with a specially designed bait protein. The study, published in eLife, identifies a potential drug target and notes that related viruses (including poliovirus) may be susceptible to IRES-blocking strategies. This work provides a detailed picture of how EMCV initiates replication and offers a foundation for future antiviral development.

triage.headline_ja: IISc科学者、ウイルスの乗っ取りメカニズムを解明
triage.triage_reason: これは基礎研究に関する科学記事であり、実際の疾病発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はEMCV（脳心筋炎ウイルス）のIRESによるリボソーム乗っ取り機構の分子生物学研究に関するものであり、ポリオウイルスは将来の創薬標的の可能性として言及されているのみ。実際の感染症発生事例ではないため、疾患名『Poliomyelitis』はミスラベルと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha Records Three COVID‑19 Cases, All Stable: Public Health Director
article.articleSummary: Three people tested positive for COVID-19 in Odisha, according to Public Health Director Dr Rabindranath Mishra. All cases are stable: two are in quarantine and one is undergoing hospital treatment; none are described as severe. The situation is under control with no cause for alarm. Surveillance and testing continue across districts, and precautionary measures remain in place. Odisha’s healthcare system is prepared to handle any potential rise in cases. The statement provides no information on symptoms, infection source, or laboratory confirmation beyond the positive results, and the update is current as of 23 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州でCOVID-19感染者3人を確認、いずれも安定 : 公衆衛生局長
triage.triage_reason: 軽症3例のみで公衆衛生局長も「制御下にあり懸念なし」と説明しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、少数の安定症例報告のみでシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola deaths top 1,000 as violence and shortages hamper medics
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 1,000 deaths, with 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 fatalities reported by the public health institute as of 2026-07-23. The 17th DRC Ebola outbreak, declared in mid-May, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which carries a case fatality rate up to 40% and has no approved vaccine. A small number of experimental vaccines and treatments are under review, and officials are assessing whether existing Ebola drugs could help. Insecurity across eastern Congo, with armed groups, attacks on clinics and widespread shortages, hampers response; burial restrictions fuel anger and conspiracy theories. Transmission is by direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people, living or dead, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and bleeding. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, reporting about 20 confirmed cases; Uganda last patient discharged July 16, triggering a 42-day countdown to virus-free status.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が1,000人を超える、暴力と物資不足が医療従事者を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者1,000人超、国境を越えてウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、越境伝播の事実として国際拡大リスクの評価に反映した。ワクチン未承認・致死率最大40%・治安悪化による対応困難など、複数の重大リスク要因が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola | Eristyksissä elävä avustustyöntekijä kertoo: Tauti leviää nopeammin kuin apu ehtii perille
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola | A relief worker living in isolation says: The disease is spreading faster than aid can reach.
article.articleSummary: Theresa Berthold, MSF, is in Kinshasa under a 21-day self-monitoring period after coordinating MSF Ebola work in Benin town, about 200 km from the outbreak center in Beni, DRC. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing its fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic, with about 2,500 confirmed infections and around 1,000 deaths; current case fatality is estimated at 25–40%. In Benin, MSF reports roughly 30 cases and 23 deaths, with mortality above 50% suggesting late treatment. The Bundibugyo strain has no cure or vaccine. Early symptoms resemble malaria or typhoid and incubation is 2–21 days. Kinshasa requires surveillance for travelers leaving outbreak areas; monitoring includes twice-daily fever checks and isolation rules, though outdoor activity is allowed. Stigma, distrust, and burial customs hinder response, and access challenges persist amid security incidents near Benin.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ | 隔離生活を送る援助従事者が語る：疾病は援助が届くよりも速く拡大している
triage.triage_reason: DRCで最も急速に拡大しているエボラ流行とされ、約2500人の感染者・約1000人の死亡、致死率25-40%（一部地域では50%超）と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事中の『Benin town』は、DRC北東部の流行中心地『Beni』の誤記・誤訳と考えられる。Bluedotが付与した『Republic of Benin（西アフリカ）』は誤分類の可能性が高く、記事の主題はDRC国内（Kinshasa・Beni周辺）のエボラ流行であるため、検証地域はDRCのみとした。国際的拡大や渡航制限については記事内に明確な記載がなく不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo: Mehr als 1.000 Tote bei Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 1,000 dead in Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,000 deaths, with 1,033 fatalities among 2,536 laboratory-confirmed infections, and about 740 patients isolated or under clinical care. Since mid-May, the outbreak has spread rapidly, becoming the fastest-growing Ebola event on record and stressing an already fragile public-health infrastructure. The Bundibugyo variant is of particular concern, with no licensed vaccine and no established therapy. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warned that deaths stem not only from the virus but from shortages of medicines and funding, and a global crisis-response pattern that often acts only after headlines rise. The piece highlights the escalating crisis and the urgent need for effective countermeasures and sustained international support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行で死者1,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 死者1,000人超・過去最速拡大とされるエボラ流行で、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株が原因であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、感染拡大速度が過去最速と報告されている点が特に重大。Africa CDCも資金・医薬品不足を警告しており、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Nagpur reports first H1N1 death of 2026 as swine flu cases rise in July
article.articleSummary: Nagpur reports its first confirmed death from Influenza A (H1N1) in 2026 as July cases rise. By July, 15 H1N1 infections have been recorded, accounting for over 60% of the year’s total in Nagpur. Since January, Nagpur has 25 confirmed H1N1 cases, with 13 of July’s 15 detections within Nagpur Municipal Corporation (NMC) limits. An H1N1 Death Audit Committee found one death due to H1N1; a second death linked to comorbidities. Authorities have strengthened surveillance across the Nagpur division, directing hospitals to monitor ILI and SARI, test promptly, and raise awareness. H1N1 is a viral respiratory illness usually treatable with early diagnosis but can be severe in older adults, pregnant women, children under five, and people with diabetes, heart disease, kidney disease, lung disease, or weakened immunity. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body aches, fatigue; seek care promptly for high-risk individuals. Daily monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: ナグプールで2026年最初のH1N1死亡例、7月の豚インフルエンザ症例増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1のローカルな増加と死亡例1件が報告されているが、異常な広がりや国際的リスクは認められず、監視強化による経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ナグプール（マハーラーシュトラ州）における季節性H1N1インフルエンザの増加。地元当局はILI/SARIの監視強化と死亡例の原因調査（併存疾患関連含む）を実施中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。続報（症例数・死亡数の推移）を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Deaths in Ebola Outbreak Eclipse 1,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to claim lives, with 1,033 confirmed deaths among 2,536 cases in Congo as of July 23, 2026; 506 have recovered and 738 are in isolation or treatment, while Uganda has two deaths. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved vaccines or therapeutics. Health authorities report surveillance, case management, and contact tracing, but only about 77% of contacts have been tracked (below the 90% target set by WHO). Calls for more funding and resources have intensified; WHO estimates over $400 million in additional funds are needed. Modeling suggests the Congo outbreak could grow to the scale of past West Africa outbreaks without rapid, large-scale interventions. Key measures include rapid case finding, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、確認された死者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,000人超の死者を伴う大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダにも拡大、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がない稀少株であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・アンゴラも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダでは死者2名確認との記述あり、国際的拡大の一例として言及。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll hits over 1,000 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-23, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has 2,536 confirmed infections and 1,033 deaths, a case fatality rate of 40.7%. The outbreak, declared May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo virus, with Ituri Province as the epicenter and five provinces affected: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. About 738 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 506 have recovered. The UN warns that burial practices involving transporting bodies across communities heighten transmission risk. The health ministry says the response is fully deployed, with reinforced surveillance, diagnostics, and case management capacities. While some provinces show a slight downward trend in new infections, authorities say it is too early to declare the peak reached. Prime Minister Judith Suminwa planned visits to Kisangani, Bunia, Mungwalu, and Rwampara to bolster coordination, prevention, and care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数1,000人超え
triage.triage_reason: 致死率40.7%の大規模エボラ流行が5州に拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ルワンダは発生地域として言及されているが、記事本文では感染確認の記述がなく主題はDRCのみのため除外。ブンディブギョウイルス株による流行で、5州（Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo）に拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: More than 1,000 people killed in Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo virus with no approved vaccines or treatments has killed more than 1,000 people and infected 2,473 cases, with 737 in isolation or hospital as of Monday, according to the DRC health ministry. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention confirms 1,031 deaths. Declared May 15, the outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola episode in history, reaching 1,000 deaths in nearly ten weeks, far faster than the eight months of the 2013–2016 epidemic (over 11,000 deaths from 28,000 cases). Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. Epicenter in Ituri province; some communities difficult to reach due to rebel fighting. Officials say about 80% of new cases arise outside known transmission chains; community resistance and unsafe burials hinder response, sometimes requiring security escorts. UK resident hospitalized after exposure; vaccine trials in the UK are planned.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行でコンゴ民主共和国での死者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 承認済みワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ流行で死者1,000人超・症例2,473例、史上最速の拡大速度であり、伝播経路不明な症例が8割を占めるなど重大な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 英国での曝露後入院例が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRC(イトゥリ州)での流行であり、対象国リストに英国は含まれないため除外。史上最速の拡大速度、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、紛争地域でのアクセス困難、伝播経路不明の症例が8割を占めるなど、フルRRAが必要な重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Dinas Peternakan Simeulue vaksinasi ternak cegah penyakit menular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Simeulue Department of Animal Husbandry Vaccinates Livestock to Prevent Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Free vaccination of livestock conducted by Simeulue Regency's Department of Plantations, Livestock, and Animal Health to prevent infectious diseases, especially Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), in Simeulue, an island regency in Aceh Province. Head Syuhelmi states vaccines are provided gratis and that vaccination sites are paired with livestock censuses to ensure accurate population data. The current herd totals 30,775 head: 28,000 water buffalo and 2,774 cattle, with Teupah Tengah and other districts serving as livestock hubs. Farmers such as Hamzah express gratitude, noting the program boosts herd immunity and reduces disease transmission risk. The initiative reflects proactive local government biosecurity measures to protect animal health and agricultural livelihoods on the island regency.

triage.headline_ja: シムル県畜産局、感染症予防のため家畜にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の発生報告ではなく、予防的な家畜ワクチン接種プログラムに関する内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のFMD発生事例ではなく、予防的ワクチン接種と家畜センサスに関する地方行政の取り組みを報じたものである。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情死亡破千　罕見病毒無疫苗又遭暴力阻礙 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese Ebola outbreak death toll surpasses 1,000; rare virus has no vaccine and is once again hampered by violence - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, has reached 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, with a case fatality rate around 40%. There is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain; only a few experimental therapies are under review. This marks DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, and officials say transmission began weeks before mid-May. The response is severely hampered by ongoing armed conflict and dire supply shortages in the eastern region, with healthcare workers facing restricted access and clinics attacked amid public frustration and misinformation. In neighboring Uganda, 20 confirmed cases have been reported, with no new cases since June 22; the last patient was discharged on July 16, and Uganda has entered a 42-day period without new infections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ疫病、死者数1000人突破　珍しいウイルスにワクチンなく暴力にも阻まれる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行で致死率約40%、ワクチン・治療法未承認、武力紛争により対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例は既に終息（42日間新規感染なし）と報告されているため、主題はDRCの流行継続。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемиолог объяснил, что при какой температуре живут переносчики Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An epidemiologist explained the temperature at which Ebola carriers live.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains endemic to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and nearby African countries. The report attributes transmission to bats, described as feeding exclusively on bananas and mangoes and living at around 30°C. Human infection occurs only through very close contact, not via airborne spread. The current outbreak in the DRC is characterized as the largest in the country’s history by the rate of initial spread, with fatalities exceeding 1,000. The disease is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and the article notes there are no approved vaccines or treatments yet. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor reported no cases in Russia and no risk of importation. A WHO official highlighted the outbreak’s scale, while an epidemiologist emphasized that Ebola does not pose a global threat.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学者が、エボラウイルスの媒介動物が生息する温度について説明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模とされるエボラ流行が継続しており、死者数が1000人を超え深刻な公衆衛生上の影響とWHOによる注目が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの疫学解説記事だが、DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（史上最大の初期拡大速度、死者1000人超、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス、ワクチン・治療薬未承認）に言及しており、公衆衛生上の重大性が高い。ロシア国内感染リスクはないと報告されているため、国際的拡大の直接的証拠はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）本輪伊波拉疫情已致近千人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed nearly a thousand people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has killed at least 999 people among 2,473 confirmed cases, with figures released July 22 for data up to July 19. Declared May 15 by the Africa CDC, the ongoing outbreak currently has no approved vaccine or therapy. The rapid death toll and case count make this the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. By comparison, the 2013–2016 West Africa epidemic reported at least 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths, taking about eight months to reach 1,000 fatalities. Ebola is rare but highly contagious and can spread through vomit, blood, and other body fluids, causing severe and often fatal illness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（金）で今回のエボラ出血熱の流行、死者ほぼ1000人に達す
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死者数が近千人に達し、史上最速の拡大速度とされ、承認済みワクチン・治療法がないため国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文では言及がなく主題はDRCのみのため除外。Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS : L'épidémie d'Ebola franchit la barre des 1 000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak surpasses 1,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has surpassed 1,000 deaths, per WHO on July 20, 2026: 1,001 deaths (999 in DRC, 2 in Uganda). DRC reports 2,473 confirmed cases since mid-May; Uganda has 20 confirmed cases. Uganda has had no active cases for a week, but must remain case-free for another month to be declared virus-free. The Ituri province in NE DRC accounts for about 90% of cases and over 83% of deaths; security conflicts hinder surveillance and contact tracing. MSF notes unsafe burials fueling spread, with sometimes one death triggering multiple transmission chains. Bunia residents have increased precautions, including hand sanitizers. Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or treatment; July trials of two experimental therapies began, and WHO authorized emergency use of a molecular diagnostic test and launched a ChAdOx1 vaccine trial with Oxford. The virus also circulates in North Kivu and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ流行が死者1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで死者1,000人を超えるエボラ流行が継続しており、国境を越えた伝播、治療薬・ワクチン未承認、治安上の理由で監視・接触者追跡が困難など、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Ituri州が症例・死亡の大部分を占め、治安問題により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Why health officials do not have a good handle on the current Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled: as of just over two months into the outbreak, nearly 1,000 deaths and more than 2,400 cases. No approved vaccine exists. Contact tracing is labor-intensive and currently under strain; more than 80% of new cases occur outside known contacts, suggesting transmission chains outside health officials' view in a region with transient workers and ongoing conflict. Two-thirds of deaths occur outside the health system, with patients turning to traditional healers or delaying care. WHO is training 21,000 community workers to improve tracing and response. New clinical trials for treatments and post-exposure prophylaxis are beginning, but access remains limited to trial participants. Building trust and improving care are seen as essential to encouraging care-seeking and containment.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ保健当局は現在のエボラ流行を制御できていないのか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者約1000人、症例2400例超）が制御不能な状態にあり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチンなし、接触追跡の80%以上が既知接触者外で発生しており、紛争地域での人口移動も相まって国際的拡大リスクが高い。WHOが2万1000人の地域保健従事者を訓練中だが制御は依然困難。

article.articleHeadline: Diarrhoea outbreak at Kasturba Balika Vidyalaya in Odisha's Mayurbhanj: Over 30 students affected, 19 hospitalised
article.articleSummary: Diarrhoea outbreak at Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV) hostel in Sargada, Bijatala block, Mayurbhanj district, Odisha, has affected over 30 girl students, with 19 admitted to Rairangpur Sub-divisional Hospital. Symptoms emerged on Thursday, July 22, 2026, prompting a rapid health response. The 19 patients are reported stable under hospital care, while the remainder are under observation. Officials suspect contamination of hostel water or food as the transmission source. District and block administrations, along with the health department, have implemented enhanced food and drinking-water safety measures and intensified hygiene and sanitation at the hostel. A medical team conducted on-site checks; 19 students were transported to hospital via two vehicles. Investigations will identify the exact cause and prevent recurrence. No laboratory confirmation details were disclosed, and as of July 23, 2026, officials emphasize the goal of full recovery and safeguarding others.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州マユールバンジのカストゥルバ・バリカ・ヴィディヤラヤで下痢の集団発生：30人以上の生徒が発症、19人入院
triage.triage_reason: インド・オディシャ州の女子寄宿舎で下痢症の集団発生が確認されたが、患者は安定しており死亡例もなく、地元当局が対応中。国際的拡大の兆候はないが、汚染源が未特定で続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 汚染源（水または食品）は未特定であり、実験室確認結果も未公表。寄宿舎という閉鎖環境での二次感染リスクがあるため、続報を注視することが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ratusan Kasus TBC Ditemukan di Kabupaten Lumajang selama 2026, Hampir di Semua Kecamatan Ada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of tuberculosis cases detected in Lumajang Regency during 2026, in nearly all districts
article.articleSummary: In 2026, Lumajang Regency, East Java, reported 971 tuberculosis (TB) cases, detected across nearly all districts. The figures come from the Lumajang Health Department’s Disease Prevention and Control, Population Control and Family Planning (Dinkes P2KB), covering January to June 2025. The spread is attributed to low public knowledge about TB and stigma that leads to delayed diagnosis and social ostracism. Clinically, presumptive TB patients exhibit a prolonged cough lasting more than two weeks, fever, reduced appetite, and weight loss. Local health workers conduct sputum screening; a rapid sputum test is used to confirm TB if positive. When cases are identified, teams screen close contacts to limit transmission, prioritizing those who shared a household or were in close proximity to the symptomatic patient.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、ルマジャン県で結核患者数百人を検出、ほぼ全地区で発生
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアで地方流行状態にある疾患であり、通常の症例報告・サーベイランス活動の一環であるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアの風土病であり、本記事は地方自治体の定期的な症例報告に基づくもの。地域住民の認知不足やスティグマによる診断の遅れが指摘されているが、新規かつ異常な公衆衛生事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Boa Esperança mobiliza estudantes em projeto de prevenção à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boa Esperança mobilizes students in a dengue prevention project.
article.articleSummary: Public schools in Boa Esperança launched the Nossa Escola Contra a Dengue project, featuring an essay contest to boost awareness and prevention of dengue transmitted by mosquitoes. The initiative used reading and writing to deepen children’s knowledge about precautions against dengue and to reflect on residents' responsibility in prevention. Students act as information multipliers, sharing insights with parents and other family members to bring prevention guidance into homes. Beyond health education, the contest fostered reading, writing, critical thinking, and civic awareness linked to a problem affecting daily life. The best essays received awards, and families were encouraged to participate in activities and apply the discussed preventive measures at home.

triage.headline_ja: ボア・エスペランサが学生を動員したデング熱予防プロジェクトを実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防啓発を目的とした学校での教育活動に関する記事であり、実際の感染事例や公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定地域（Boa Esperança）における学校主導のデング熱予防啓発活動を報じたものであり、実際の症例数や流行状況についての情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: BRICS Health Ministers meet in India, focus on health systems, pandemic
article.articleSummary: 16th BRICS Health Ministers' Meeting concluded in Chandigarh, India, under the 2026 BRICS Chairship, with member countries reaffirming commitments to strengthening health systems, pandemic preparedness, digital health and Universal Health Coverage. Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda highlighted India's reforms and digital infrastructure, and outlined priorities: strengthening the BRICS TB Research Network, enhancing cooperation among Medical Products Regulatory Authorities, and improving preparedness for future health emergencies; establishment of the Sub-Working Group on the BRICS Integrated Early Warning System for Mass Infectious Diseases. The meeting released the BRICS Compendium on Digital Health Architecture, showcased the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission and E-Sanjeevani, and launched the BRICS Mission for Healthy Lifestyle (2026–2029). It endorsed Mental Wellness networks led by NIMHANS and operational frameworks for social determinants of health and national public health institutes. The Declaration commits to UHC, pandemic prevention, digital health and vaccine access. Delegations visited FSSAI, NHA and AYUSH pavilions.

triage.headline_ja: BRICS保健大臣会合がインドで開催、保健システムとパンデミック対応に焦点
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、BRICS保健大臣会合という政策・外交イベントであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にTuberculosisとあるが、記事はBRICS保健大臣会合の一般的な政策会議であり、結核の具体的な発生・流行に関する情報ではない。会議内で結核研究ネットワーク強化に言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : les intervenants dans la riposte contre Ebola appelés officiellement à s'identifier - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Stakeholders in the Ebola response officially called on to identify themselves - ACP
article.articleSummary: July 23, 2026 – In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Tshopo province (Kisangani), all stakeholders involved in the Ebola response are urged to officially identify themselves with the provincial Health Ministry and its sectoral divisions before any field intervention. The directive targets cooperation agencies, NGOs and humanitarian actors supporting provincial health authorities to ensure a coordinated, effective response to the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak. The measure covers all humanitarian actors serving vulnerable populations in the province, including war-displaced people from the East and internal IDPs affected by the Mbole-Lengola conflict. Tshopo is the fifth province affected by the outbreak, after Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Ituri, the latter identified as the epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: ツショパ州:エボラ対応の関係者に公式登録が義務付けられる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがツショパ州(5番目の州)にも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 本記事は第17次エボラアウトブレイクの拡大（ツショパ州が5番目の被害州）に伴う対応関係者の登録義務化を報じる行政的内容だが、既存の重大アウトブレイクの継続・拡大を示す重要な続報であるためPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Former Telangana DPH urges stronger Covid-19 surveillance amid rise in Andhra Pradesh cases
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, former Telangana Director of Public Health Dr G. Srinivasa Rao urges stronger Covid-19 surveillance as Andhra Pradesh records rising cases. He notes Covid-19 positives and deaths in Telangana and criticizes the state for not issuing regular, transparent health bulletins. Rao calls for expanded testing with Rapid Antigen Tests and RT-PCR at Government Hospitals and Primary Health Centres, and for all positive samples to undergo genomic sequencing at designated national laboratories with public disclosure of results. He frames Andhra Pradesh’s Omicron-driven surge as a wake-up call to bolster fever surveillance, contact tracing and overall disease monitoring in Telangana. Beyond Covid-19, monsoon trends show rising dengue, malaria, chikungunya and other water-borne diseases. He urges vigilance for pregnant women, seniors, and chronically ill, and suggests masking in crowded or symptomatic settings and prompt hospital evaluation for fever or cough.}{

triage.headline_ja: 前テランガナ州公衆衛生局長、アンドラプラデシュ州での症例増加を受けCOVID-19監視強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン季節性の感染症増加とCOVID-19（オミクロン系統）症例増加への懸念表明だが、具体的な症例数・死亡数などの定量データが乏しく、既知の病原体による季節性変動の域を出ないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家の意見・提言記事であり、具体的な症例数や死亡者数の統計データが本文中に明記されていない。デング・マラリア・チクングニアはモンスーン期の季節性増加として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: У гражданки России извлекли восемь личинок из ноги после отдыха во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eight larvae were removed from the leg of a Russian woman after a vacation in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Eight larvae were removed from the heel and knee of a Russian woman after a vacation on Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam (Bai Sao Beach). The patient, Christina, developed painful lesions, and after returning to Moscow, clinicians opened the lesions and extracted eight larvae. She suspected bites from sand fleas or infection introduction as the source. Post-procedure, she required about ten to eleven days of wound dressings; a month later she could again step on the injured heel. The report highlights Vietnam as a popular tourist destination but warns of tropical infection risks, advising repellents, closed footwear, and antiseptics to reduce insect bites and infections. It also notes a separate case of a Russian tourist in Vietnam contracting dengue fever from mosquitoes, presenting with high fever and body aches.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム旅行後、ロシア人女性の脚から8匹の幼虫が摘出される
triage.triage_reason: 個別のロシア人旅行者1名における虫刺され由来の幼虫症とデング熱の症例報告であり、公衆衛生上のアウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は個人旅行者の症例（幼虫症・デング熱）を報じる一般向け旅行注意喚起記事であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての重要性は低い。モスクワ・ロシアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Switzerland increases Ebola aid for the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (east, Ituri and North Kivu provinces) re-emerged in May 2026, with 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths reported as of July 23, 2026. Switzerland escalates support, providing CHF1.6 million to WHO, bringing total Swiss aid since the crisis began to CHF4.6 million. The extra funding via the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation strengthens coordinating medical emergency teams and funds containment plans in neighboring countries such as South Sudan. With partner support, WHO expanded testing capacity from 200 to 400 tests per day; the network now comprises ten laboratories with total capacity over 2,000 tests daily across affected provinces. The SDC will place an expert from the Swiss Humanitarian Aid Unit with WHO for six months. Switzerland is also participating in clinical trials for potential Ebola treatments. Ongoing conflict in the region hampers containment.

triage.headline_ja: スイス、コンゴ民主共和国へのエボラ支援を増額
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例2,536例・死亡1,033例という大規模なエボラ再流行が継続しており、致死率が高く、国際的な支援・対応が拡大しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事本文には南スーダンへの波及防止策への言及があるが、南スーダン自体での症例発生は明記されていないため対象国リストには含めず。またスイス・スーダン(Republic of the Sudan)は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Why health officials do not have a good handle on the current Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Health officials do not have a good handle on the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where there is no approved vaccine. Just over two months in, nearly 1,000 deaths and more than 2,400 illnesses; daily case counts show no slowing. More than 80% of new cases occur outside known contacts, signaling wider transmission and stretched contact tracing. The outbreak's center involves a region with transient workers and ongoing conflict, hindering case-finding; WHO is training 21,000 community workers. Many deaths occur outside the health system (about two-thirds) as people seek traditional healers, stay home, or avoid treatment centers amid stigma and mistrust. Promising developments include clinical trials for treatments and a drug to protect exposed people from getting sick, but access remains limited to trials. Building trust and better care are needed to reduce transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya e dengue, come proteggersi durante i viaggi nelle aree a rischio - Sanità
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya and dengue: how to protect yourself while traveling to high-risk areas - Health
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya and dengue pose travel health risks as both are transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. Chikungunya is active in more than 110 countries, with transmission confirmed in over 50 in the last five years; dengue circulates across Africa, Southeast Asia, India, the Middle East, Central and Latin America, Australia and many Pacific regions. Italy has reported local foci: chikungunya in Veneto and Emilia Romagna last year; dengue autochthonous in Lodi (2023) and Fano (2024). Personal protection remains the primary defense: apply repellents to skin and clothing, wear long-sleeved light-colored garments, sleep under bed nets, and use insecticides during the day, since Aedes bites mainly at dawn and dusk. Vaccines: since Oct 2025 Italy offers chikungunya vaccine for age 12+, a single dose at least 14 days before departure. A tetravalent dengue vaccine is for age 4+, two doses 3 months apart with no serology required.
