article.articleHeadline: All 3 British Airways Pilots Were Hit By Food Poisoning Midflight -- But Kept Flying To London Anyway
article.articleSummary: Three British Airways pilots on flight BA 276 from Hyderabad to London Heathrow fell ill with food poisoning during the 10.5-hour journey; all three had shared a hotel breakfast in Hyderabad prior to departure. About 30,000 feet into the flight, one first officer became incapacitated and was given oxygen; the captain and the other first officer remained symptomatic but continued to operate to London. Upon landing, their conditions reportedly worsened. All three submitted Air Safety Reports and provided biological samples to help doctors determine the cause, though no confirmed pathogen is reported in the article. There were unverified claims of a lengthy surgery for one pilot. Union sources cited dozens of hygiene complaints about an unnamed Hyderabad hotel; BA described it as isolated sickness, with crews moved to alternative Hyderabad accommodation. The incident raises questions about crew safety and decision-making when illness strikes multiple cockpit crew.

triage.headline_ja: ブリティッシュ・エアウェイズのパイロット3名全員が機内で食中毒に――それでもロンドンへ飛行継続
triage.triage_reason: ハイデラバードのホテル朝食後にコックピット乗員3名全員が食中毒症状を呈した事例だが、病原体は未特定で、公衆への持続的曝露や人-人感染の証拠もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 食中毒の原因病原体は未確認であり、ホテルの衛生状態への苦情が複数報告されている点は懸念材料だが、感染症としての拡大や公衆衛生上の広範な影響は現時点で確認されていない。続報（原因判明、他の宿泊客への影響有無）を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: Aantal ebola-doden in Congo over de duizend, Amerikaanse hulpverleners in quarantaine in Kenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of Ebola deaths in the Congo exceeds a thousand, American aid workers in quarantine in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 1,000 deaths, with 1,033 fatalities and 2,536 laboratory-confirmed cases, up from 930/2,344 three days earlier; the outbreak remains within Congo, while foreign responders face quarantine abroad. Seven American aid workers who treated Ebola patients in Ituri are in a 21-day quarantine at Kenya's Laikipia Air Force Base, after Kenyans protested the facility—three people were killed in June—though Kenyan authorities approved the site. Health Minister Aden Duale was admonished for contempt of court over the project. The U.S. State Department confirmed the Americans' relocation and Kenyan permission; Samaritan’s Purse said the aircraft bore 'Helping in Jesus’ name.' President William Ruto cited consent given to host the center; Uganda reported no new cases outside Congo, while Ituri bears most deaths and care is ongoing without vaccine or registered treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が1000人を超え、米国人援助隊員がケニアで隔離
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が死者1000人を超え、症例数も増加を続けており、国際的な援助隊員の隔離措置や近隣国への波及リスクも生じているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 米国・ケニア・ウガンダは対応・隔離措置に関連する国であるが、記事の主題であるエボラ発生自体はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）内で継続しているため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。ワクチンや承認された治療法がない状況が続いており、経過を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Why This Ebola Outbreak Poses an Unusual Threat
article.articleSummary: Mounting toll in the latest Ebola outbreak is highlighted in this edition of Next Africa. The newsletter frames Ebola as a major health story, noting the ongoing transmission and rising toll, though the excerpt provides no detailed case counts or locations. In a separate item, the issue points to a world-beating rally in Zambia's sovereign bonds, underscoring striking financial market activity in the region. The dual focus reflects the publication's broader aim to track Africa's current trajectory by pairing public health developments with economic movements. Published on 2026-07-23, the edition consolidates updates on the Ebola outbreak while also signaling notable capital market dynamics in Zambia. No additional specifics are provided in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: なぜこのエボラ出血熱の流行は異常な脅威をもたらすのか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は本質的に重篤な感染症であり、見出しで「異常な脅威」と明記されている点、及び継続的な感染拡大と死亡者数の増加が報じられている点からIHR基準を2つ満たすと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ出血熱の具体的な発生国・地域や症例数が明示されておらず、Zambiaへの言及は同ニュースレター内の別項目（同国のソブリン債の好調）に関するものであり、エボラ出血熱の発生地とは無関係と判断した。そのためverified_locationsは空とした。続報で具体的な発生地域・症例数の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mainpuri News: पशुओं को खुरपका से बचाने को किया टीकाकरण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainpuri News: Vaccination carried out to protect animals against foot-and-mouth disease
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccination drive underway in Mainpuri district, Uttar Pradesh, India. Under the Department of Animal Husbandry, veterinary officers are conducting a special campaign to shield livestock from FMD. On July 22, the drive expanded to villages including Nagla Raghi, Gopalpur, Akbarpur, Oncha, Kakrara, and Kosma, with Dr. Jitendra Singh, the veterinary officer, supervising vaccinations. By July 23, about 3,000 animals have been immunized. FMD is a highly contagious disease that adversely affects livestock health and milk production. The campaign's aim is to strengthen herd immunity in rural communities and prevent potential spread. The article reports vaccination activity across several settlements in Mainpuri but does not mention confirmed outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: マインプリニュース：口蹄疫から家畜を守るためのワクチン接種実施
triage.triage_reason: 動物の口蹄疫予防ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する記事であり、確認された発生や人への影響の報告はなく、ヒトの公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物疾病(FMD)の予防的ワクチン接種活動の報告であり、感染発生ではない。影響カテゴリも'animals'のみで人への感染報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉持續籠罩民主剛果　染疫死亡數破千人大關
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to ravage the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the death toll from Ebola infections surpasses 1,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have killed more than 1,000 people, with 1,033 deaths among 2,536 confirmed cases reported by the public health institute as of July 23, 2026. The northeast DRC is the outbreak epicenter, caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, which can have a case fatality rate up to 40%. The outbreak began in mid-May, though experts say transmission likely started weeks earlier. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola to date. Health workers are battling the outbreak under severe pressure from armed violence, attacks on medical facilities, and widespread shortages of supplies, hindering containment and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国を襲い続け、死者数が1,000人の大台を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死者が1,000人を超え致死率も高く、ワクチン未承認かつ武力紛争により対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はワクチン未承認、致死率最大40%とされ、武力紛争下での対応困難が続いている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉持續籠罩民主剛果 染疫死亡數破千人大關
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to plague the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the death toll from infection surpasses 1,000.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,000 deaths. Official data indicate 2,536 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,033 fatalities. The outbreak was declared in mid-May, though experts say transmission began weeks earlier. It is caused by the Bundibugyo virus lineage, with a case fatality rate up to 40%. There is currently no approved vaccine. The northeast region of the DRC remains the epicenter, where health workers are contending with armed violence, attacks on health facilities, and widespread shortages of medical supplies. Ongoing transmission and the insecure operating environment complicate containment and patient care, highlighting the severe public health and security challenges facing responders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が続く民主コンゴ、感染死者数が1000人の大台を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2,500例超・死者1,000人超に達し、致死率も高くワクチンも未承認、武力紛争による対応困難という深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であり、国際的拡大リスクも否定できないためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの発生を主題としており、Bundibugyo（地名）はDRC国内の地域名として言及されている可能性が高い。Ugandaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及がないため除外。武力紛争下での医療従事者への攻撃や医療物資不足が対応を複雑化させている点は特に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Zoonoses de Piracicaba registra terceiro morcego com resultado positivo para raiva em 2026 - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piracicaba's Zoonoses Reports Third Bat Positive for Rabies in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Piracicaba records its third bat positive for rabies in 2026, a Nyctinomops laticaudatus (insectivorous) found in the central region near São Dimas. The first 2026 positive bat was in São Dimas and the second near São Jorge; no canine or feline rabies cases have been reported so far, and 2025 saw seven positive bats across Santa Teresinha, Vila Prudente (two), Centro, Nova América, Água Branca and Jardim Monumento. Rabies is a fatal viral disease affecting mammals, including humans; bats are rabies reservoirs. Authorities urge not to touch or handle exposed bats; isolate live or dead bats with a container until CCZ collects them. Emphasize annual rabies vaccination for dogs and cats, available free at the CCZ (Rua Dionísio Dal Picolo, 21, Jupiá). Hotline 156; CCZ (19) 3427-3008. CCZ hours: Mon-Fri 7-16, Sat-Sun/Holidays 7-12.

triage.headline_ja: ピラシカーバの動物人畜共通感染症対策部門、2026年3例目の狂犬病陽性コウモリを報告
triage.triage_reason: コウモリでの狂犬病陽性事例は当該地域で例年報告される既知の状況であり、犬猫や人への感染例もなく、公衆衛生上の異常性・重大性は認められない。
triage.notes: コウモリの狂犬病はブラジルで地方病的に存在しており、当局は日常的な注意喚起・ワクチン接種推奨を行っているのみで、ヒトや家畜への感染拡大は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: BRICS Health Ministers back TB research, disease surveillance, mental health cooperation
article.articleSummary: BRICS Health Ministers adopted a joint declaration to expand collaboration on tuberculosis research, disease surveillance, digital health, mental health and access to medicines during the 16th BRICS Health Ministers’ Meeting in Chandigarh, with New Delhi serving as press location. India’s 2026 chairship led to emphasis on strengthening the BRICS TB Research Network, noting BRICS countries account for nearly half of global TB burden and focusing on diagnostics, medicines and vaccines. The package also establishes a Sub-Working Group for the BRICS Integrated Early Warning System for Prevention and Response to Mass Infectious Diseases to improve surveillance and outbreak coordination. A BRICS Network of Centres of Excellence on Mental Wellness is created, led by NIMHANS (India) as coordinating centre, plus a BRICS Training Hub Network for workforce training and knowledge exchange. Additional steps include regulatory cooperation, a Network of National Public Health Institutes, and interoperable digital health, vaccine R&D, nuclear medicine and traditional medicine initiatives.

triage.headline_ja: BRICS保健大臣、結核研究・疾病サーベイランス・メンタルヘルス協力を支持
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、BRICS保健大臣会合における政策的・協力枠組みに関する外交的発表であるため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の具体的な発生・流行に関する報告ではなく、BRICS諸国間の保健協力枠組み（サーベイランス体制強化、研究ネットワーク等）に関する政策発表である。感染症イベントとしてのシグナルではないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Floods increase diarrhoea risk as doctors urge parents to seek early treatment
article.articleSummary: Floods in Accra and flood-affected communities heighten diarrhoeal risk among children. Diarrhoeal diseases remain a leading cause of dehydration-related death in low-resource settings, worsened when floods damage water infrastructure and sewage contaminates drinking water. Dr Ernestina Schandorf of Korle Bu Teaching Hospital warns dehydration can progress rapidly; urgent medical assessment is advised for four or more stools in 24 hours, sunken eyes, dry lips, reduced urination, or marked weakness. Begin oral rehydration immediately with ORS, clean water, coconut water, or rice water en route to a health facility. Cholera differs from ordinary diarrhoea by rice-water stools and requires immediate treatment. Avoid routine antibiotics and herbal remedies; continue feeding as tolerated. The Pediatric Society of Ghana and NADMO have started free health screenings for flood-affected children in Accra, expanding to Weija, Adenta, and Ashaiman, including consultations, immunisations, NHIS registration, clothing, food, and psychological support.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水により下痢のリスクが増加、医師が早期受診を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の下痢性疾患一般への注意喚起記事であり、具体的なコレラ症例数やアウトブレイクの確認情報がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコレラの具体的な症例報告ではなく、洪水後の水系感染症リスクに関する一般的な医療啓発と、NADMO・小児科学会による無料健診プログラムの案内が主体。実際のコレラ確定症例数や発生規模の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Tshopo : la Première ministre est arrivée à Kisangani pour renforcer la lutte contre l'épidémie Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Tshopo: The Prime Minister has arrived in Kisangani to bolster the fight against the Ebola epidemic | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease resurgence prompts a high-level mission as the Prime Minister arrives in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, DRC, on July 23, 2026, to bolster the response. The delegation—accompanied by representatives from the United States, the United Nations system, and major partners—seeks to reaffirm government leadership and strengthen coordination with technical and financial allies amid the eastern outbreak that has claimed over 1,000 lives. After Kisangani, the team will visit Bunia, Mungwalu, and Rwampara in Ituri Province, the main epicenter, before proceeding to North Kivu. The mission aims to consolidate prevention, surveillance, and case management, evaluate on-ground realities, and accelerate actions to protect affected populations. The visit underscores continued international support and a unified strategy against Ebola in the DRC’s eastern regions.

article.articleHeadline: Probably Nothing . . . But It feels a Bit Like Deja Flu
article.articleSummary: Yonhap News reports a July 23, 2026 alert about a shortage of Chinese duck and goose feathers in Japan used for badminton shuttlecocks, tied to stagnant Chinese demand and avian influenza-related issues. The article notes rising disease-control costs and tighter poultry-farm management driven by infection concerns, contributing to the feather shortage and a shift to synthetic shuttlecocks. It frames the signal against a backdrop of China’s reported but opaque poultry-health picture: the FAO avian-flu activity map since Oct 1, 2025 shows almost no HPAI H5N1 in Mainland China, while China continues to contend with multiple avian viruses including LPAI H9N2, H3Nx, H6Nx, and H10Nx. The piece regards the shortage as a weak signal worth monitoring given past episodes where vague reports preceded outbreaks. It cites China MOA vaccine-policy updates from last November and closes with a cautious 'probably nothing' assessment.

article.articleHeadline: Supera los mil muertos el brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 1,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists, with 1,033 deaths among 2,536 confirmed cases (through July 21), a case-fatality rate of 40.7%. Of confirmed cases, 738 patients remain in isolation or hospitalization, and 506 have recovered; the contact-tracing rate is 77.2%. Five provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The INSP describes the epidemic as in a phase of ongoing transmission with high virus circulation, while noting that contact-tracing results are still insufficient and surveillance must be reinforced. Data fluctuations should be interpreted with caution due to reporting delays and ongoing data consolidation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの5州で継続的に伝播しており、致死率40.7%、死者1,000人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクや対応能力の懸念もあるためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡率77.2%だが不十分と指摘されており、サーベイランス強化の必要性が明記されている。継続的な症例増加のモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Por qué aumentan los casos de fiebre amarilla en Latinoamérica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why yellow fever cases are increasing in Latin America.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever cases are rising in Latin America, with infections detected in mountainous and subtropical areas near major cities. The Pan American Health Organization issued a regional health alert. Brazil tops the tally with 111 confirmed cases and 44 deaths, followed by Colombia with 74 cases and 31 deaths; Peru, Ecuador, and Bolivia report dozens. The disease is viral and transmitted by mosquitoes in tropical South America; common symptoms include high fever, headache, chills, muscle pains, nausea, and vomiting, with jaundice appearing in advanced disease. Argentina will offer free yellow fever vaccination in endemic zones—including Misiones, Corrientes, Formosa, and parts of Salta, Jujuy, and Chaco—and recommends vaccination for travelers to areas of viral circulation. Contraindications include infants under 6 months, pregnancy, immunosuppression, and some older adults; medical consultation advised.

triage.headline_ja: なぜラテンアメリカで黄熱病の症例が増加しているのか
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルを含む複数国で黄熱病症例・死亡が急増し、PAHOが地域保健アラートを発出しており、IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル、コロンビア、ペルー、エクアドル、ボリビア、アルゼンチンなど複数のラテンアメリカ諸国における黄熱病症例増加を報告しているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。ブラジルは111症例・44死亡で最多報告国であり、主題の中心となっている。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola s'étend à un rythme incontrôlable prévient MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading at an uncontrollable pace, MSF warns.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly, MSF and humanitarian groups warn. Africa CDC reports more than 1,000 deaths as of July 22, while the Congolese Health Ministry lists 2,473 confirmed cases and 999 deaths since the start. About 90% of infections are in Ituri province, with the virus now in five provinces including Tshopo (Kisangani), raising fears of wider spread. Insecurity, with fighting between the army and M23 rebels and ADF fighters, plus a health worker strike over unpaid salaries, hampers response and displaces civilians, accelerating transmission. Patients often arrive at treatment centers in advanced illness, diminishing survival. Experts estimate first cases date back to February. CDC modelling warns worst-case could mirror West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll (>11,000). WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May 2026. The outbreak is caused by Ebola Bundibugyo virus, for which no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists yet.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が制御不能な速度で拡大、MSFが警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みで死者数1,000人超、複数州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月にPHEICを宣言済み。エボラ・ブンディブギョ株による流行で、承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点、治安悪化（M23・ADFとの戦闘）や医療従事者ストライキが対応を阻害している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: شمار قربانیان شیوع ابولا در کنگو از 1000 نفر گذشت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in Congo surpassed 1,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, specifically Ituri province in eastern DRC, has surpassed 1,000 deaths. The latest report shows 2,536 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, with 738 patients in isolation or hospital care. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine, and the case-fatality rate is 40.7%. The outbreak began May 15 after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths in Ituri. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17 due to international concern. Ebola is a hemorrhagic fever first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan and Yambuku, DRC, named after the Ebola River. Historical West Africa outbreaks (2014–2017) affected Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone with ~30,000 cases and >11,000 deaths.

article.articleHeadline: A multiuniversity survey on knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding zoonotic diseases among veterinary students in Vietnam
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-23, a cross-sectional survey (Jan–Nov 2021) of 446 undergraduate veterinary science students across ten Vietnamese universities found only 9.6% with good knowledge of zoonotic diseases (ZD), 83.9% with positive attitudes, and 26.5% with good practices. Better knowledge was associated with higher prevalence of positive attitudes (PR 1.13, 95% CI 1.02–1.27), while positive attitudes strongly correlated with good practices (PR 4.66, 95% CI 2.14–10.17). Senior students (years 3–5) were more likely to have good knowledge than juniors (PR 2.29, 95% CI 1.15–4.57), but less likely to report good practices (PR 0.59, 95% CI 0.41–0.84). Students in the Central Highlands had lower prevalence of both good knowledge and positive attitudes than those in the North-Central region (knowledge PR 0.42, 95% CI 0.18–0.95; attitudes PR 0.76, 95% CI 0.66–0.87). The study suggests strengthening theoretical training, competency-based instruction, and standardized infection prevention and control protocols to improve ZD preparedness and support Vietnam’s One Health strategy.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの獣医学生を対象とした人獣共通感染症に関する知識・態度・実践に関する多大学調査
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はベトナムの獣医学生を対象とした知識・態度・実践に関する調査研究であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 実際の疾患発生事例ではなく学術調査（KAP調査）であり、コクシジオイデス症の実発生とは無関係。疾患名はBluedot APIの誤分類の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Fumacê de moto: Nova Iguaçu reforça combate à dengue com 'motofog' em áreas de difícil acesso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Motorcycle fogging: Nova Iguaçu reinforces the fight against dengue with 'motofog' in hard-to-reach areas.
article.articleSummary: Nova Iguaçu, Brazil expands Aedes aegypti control using motofog, a motorcycle-mounted insecticide sprayer, to reach hard-to-access areas such as alleys, cul-de-sacs, river margins, and the Municipal Cemetery. On July 15, the motofog deployment complemented ongoing house visits and breeding-site elimination, with inspectors checking drains, cisterns, and other containers to kill eggs and larvae before adulthood. Health officials, including Secretary Luiz Carlos Nobre Cavalcanti, emphasize persistent, shared responsibility and advise residents to spend about ten minutes weekly checking their yards for standing water. Marcos Euclides, coordinator of Environmental Surveillance, notes the motorcycle’s coverage in difficult terrains and claims approximately 100% efficacy. The effort targets Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, reinforcing ongoing public-health measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: バイクによる薫煙:ノヴァ・イグアスー市、アクセス困難な地域で「モトフォグ」を使いデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊媒介感染症対策（防除活動）に関する定例的な報道であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による日常的な蚊媒介感染症予防活動の紹介記事であり、症例数や流行状況についての具体的データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola-Todesfälle in Afrika übersteigen 1.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola deaths in Africa exceed 1,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola deaths in Africa exceed 1,000, with the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda affected. World Health Organization data as of July 21, 2026 show 999 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo and two in Uganda, bringing the global death toll to at least 1,001. Worldwide confirmed Ebola cases total 2,494. The WHO had declared on May 17 that this outbreak constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and warned the risk of cross-border spread to other countries is high, indicating potential regional spread. These figures underscore the ongoing public health challenge from Ebola in Africa today globally.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: アフリカでのエボラ死者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの進行中エボラ流行で、死者1,000人超・症例2,494件、国境を越えた拡大リスクも高いとされておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOはPHEICを既に宣言済みであり、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Malang gandeng lintas sektor tingkatkan kesiapsiagaan zoonosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malang Regency Government teams up across sectors to strengthen zoonosis preparedness.
article.articleSummary: Malang Regency, East Java, Indonesia, strengthens zoonosis preparedness through cross-sector collaboration to prevent animal-to-human diseases such as avian influenza, rabies, and anthrax. The Health Department, Portal Kesehatan Masyarakat, and the Risk Communication and Community Engagement Working Group held a Zoonosis Prevention Education Workshop at Puskesmas Tumpang to bolster risk communication, surveillance, and coordination before emergencies. Surveillance data (SKDR) from 2023 to 22 July 2026 show no human avian influenza or anthrax cases; leptospirosis rose from three in 2023 to four by 22 July 2026, while rabies-related bites (GPHR) rose from 24 to 127. Veterinary authorities highlight transmission via bites from dogs, cats, and monkeys; annual vaccination of pets reduces rabies risk. Avian influenza risk calls for avoiding contact with sick/dead poultry; anthrax risk from infected livestock or carcasses; avoid slaughter or consumption of ill animals. Officials stress cross-sector collaboration as the foundation for outbreak prevention and response.

triage.headline_ja: マラン県政府、人獣共通感染症への備えを強化するため他部門と連携
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例急増や異常事態ではなく、予防的な啓発・準備活動に関する内容であり、緊急のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は人獣共通感染症（鳥インフルエンザ、狂犬病、炭疽）への予防的な準備活動を報じたもの。人での鳥インフルエンザ・炭疽の症例はなし。狂犬病咬傷とレプトスピラ症はやや増加しているが、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態としての記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 1000 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,000 deaths, with 1,031 lab-confirmed fatalities among 2,473 reported cases and at least 737 patients remaining in isolation or hospital care. The outbreak began on May 15 and is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no approved vaccines or proven treatments. Transmission occurs through direct contact with vomit, blood, semen of an infected person, and contaminated surfaces or objects. The pace of spread is faster than any previous outbreak; during 2013–2016, the death toll reached 1,000 after about eight months, whereas current figures reached that milestone in roughly ten weeks. The World Health Organization has cautioned that real case numbers could be two to four times higher than official statistics, with modeling suggesting infections may be undercounted, and shortages of vaccines, therapeutics, and funding contributing to the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の死者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大し、死者1,000人超・過去最速のペースで進行しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の感染者数が公式統計の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、ワクチン・治療薬・資金の不足も報告されている。過去最速のペースで死者数が増加している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Passes 1,000 Ebola Deaths as Outbreak Becomes Fastest-Spreading on Record
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu has reached 2,473 cases and 1,031 deaths as of July 23, 2026, making it the fastest-spreading on record. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern in May, with Director-General Tedros noting the outbreak may have begun as early as January; the crisis is compounded by violence, displacement, and community resistance to aid. The case fatality rate is about 40% (initially 999 deaths among 2,473 cases, later updated to over 1,000), and there is no widely available treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo. More than 80% of new cases have not been linked through contact tracing, hindering containment. Authorities urge rapid mobilization of resources, strengthened ground response, and local engagement to overcome distrust and prevent further fatalities, amid ongoing security challenges and misinformation in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数1,000人を突破 ― 過去最速の拡大ペースの流行に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行であり、致死率約40%、ワクチン・治療薬未整備、接触追跡不能な症例が8割超と国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明確なためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOにより既にPHEIC宣言済みであり、フルRRAでの継続的モニタリングが必須。治安悪化・コミュニティの不信感が対応を阻害している点にも注意。

article.articleHeadline: Над 1000 души са загинали при епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 1,000 people have died in the Ebola epidemic in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused more than 1,033 deaths among 2,536 confirmed cases as of 23 July 2026, a case fatality rate of about 40.7%. The five provinces affected are Upper Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Chopo, with Ituri remaining the epicenter of transmission of the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. About 738 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 506 have recovered. Transmission continues despite expanded response, with strengthened surveillance, diagnostics, and treatment. It is too early to declare the outbreak over. Prime Minister Judith Sumina is slated to visit Kisangani in Chopo, then Bunia, Mungvalu, and Rwampara in Ituri to reinforce government leadership, coordination, and prevention, surveillance, and medical care. Last week the IOM warned that transporting bodies for burial across districts raises the risk of further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で1000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約40.7%、5州にまたがる大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、国際的拡大リスクとIHR基準複数該当のため。
triage.notes: 首相が現地視察を予定するなど政府の関与が高く、IOMが遺体搬送によるさらなる拡散リスクを警告している。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo : KIMAFEST dénonce l'insalubrité qui expose les habitants à des maladies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: KIMAFEST denounces the unsanitary conditions that expose residents to diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 23 July 2026, Kipaji na Mazingira Festival (KIMAFEST) in Butembo, North Kivu, denounces reckless waste accumulation and urban authorities' inaction, calling for immediate city sanitation and a transparent waste-management plan. The city, a commercial hub, is described as crowded with refuse; streets become dumps, drains clogged, and sanitation deficits pose mounting health risks. KIMAFEST condemns perceived silence by authorities, noting they readily collect taxes yet fail to guarantee a clean, healthy living environment amid the ongoing regional Ebola threat. The group stresses sanitation as a fundamental right and urges an immediate, citywide cleanup plus a permanent, transparent waste-management program with clear accounting for sanitation funds. It also appeals for governance that prioritizes citizens. Residents are urged to stop normalizing filth and to cooperate with services to improve cleanliness.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ:KIMAFESTが住民を病気にさらす不衛生な環境を非難
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラそのものの発生報告ではなく、都市の衛生環境悪化に対する市民団体の批判であり、具体的な症例や感染拡大の情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの具体的な発生状況ではなく、衛生環境改善を求める市民団体の声明。エボラへの言及は「地域的な脅威が継続している」という文脈のみで、新規症例等の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mahasiswa KKN USK Edukasi Kaum Ibu Bandar Dua Tentang Pencegahan dan Penanggulangan TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USK KKN students educate the women of Bandar Dua about TB prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: TB prevention education was conducted by Universitas Syiah Kuala (USK) KKN Reguler Period XXIX, Group 85, at Posyandu in Gampong Drien Bungong, Bandar Dua, Pidie Jaya, on 11 July 2026. The session targeted women at the Posyandu to raise knowledge and awareness of tuberculosis, its symptoms, transmission, and prevention, with emphasis on early detection and treatment adherence. Balqis Izzatunnisaa’ from the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine delivered the material in simple language, including the One Health concept that human, animal, and environmental health are interconnected. The program, supported by Kepala Gampong Drien Bungong Tgk. Jauhari, S.E., aims to reduce TB spread and promote healthier communities by improving health literacy and encouraging medical checkups if TB symptoms occur; it also notes that cattle can be affected by different strains of tuberculosis, underscoring the role of animal health in public health.

triage.headline_ja: USK KKN学生がバンダル・ドゥアの女性たちにTB予防・対策について教育
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は大学生による地域住民向けの結核予防啓発活動の報告であり、実際の感染拡大や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 地域啓発活動に関する記事であり、具体的な発生・流行データを含まないため対象国としてのイベントとは見なさない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, chikungunya: Ministério da Saúde alerta sobre possível aumento de infecções no país devido ao El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue, Chikungunya: Ministry of Health warns of a possible increase in infections in the country due to El Niño.
article.articleSummary: El Niño is expected to raise arbovirus infections in Brazil, including dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and Oropouche fever. InfoDengue/Fiocruz projects about 1.7 million new dengue cases in 2027. Warmer temperatures and higher rainfall in some regions, and drought in others, may boost water storage and create breeding sites for mosquitoes and ticks. The Ministry of Health urges states and municipalities to intensify surveillance and interrupt transmission at the first identified cases, reorganize the work of Endemic Disease Control Agents, and adopt the vector-control technologies recommended by the ministry. Public cooperation is essential; individuals should follow preventive measures. The advisory highlights ongoing risk in Brazil in the second half of 2026 and into 2027, driven by climate-related changes and potential concurrent arboviral outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、チクングニア熱：保健省がエルニーニョによる国内感染増加の可能性について警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱等のアルボウイルス感染症増加の「予測・警告」段階であり、現時点で具体的な異常発生や重篤な公衆衛生上の緊急事態は確認されないが、今後の感染拡大リスクがあるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は将来予測（2026年後半〜2027年）に基づく保健省の注意喚起であり、実際の異常な症例急増や重症化データは示されていない。InfoDengue/Fiocruzによる2027年の推定新規デング熱症例数(170万件)は将来予測値。

article.articleHeadline: Health surveillance stepped up after 16 juveniles at Bokaro observation fall ill
article.articleSummary: Around 16 of 43 juveniles at Bokaro's Observation Home-cum-Place of Safety reported flu-like symptoms in the past 48 hours, prompting intensified health surveillance. Of the residents, 16 were admitted; 15 recovered and were discharged after medical fitness, while one remains under observation as a precaution. Two more adolescents are being monitored at a medical camp inside the facility, staffed by a paediatrician and a general physician. Preventive medicines are being administered to all adolescents to reduce infection risk. Deputy Commissioner Ajay Nath Jha inspected the facility, directing uninterrupted healthcare services and urging improvements in cleanliness and sanitation; the food safety officer will inspect premises under prescribed safety protocols. A preliminary medical assessment attributes the illness to seasonal weather changes; no evidence of other causes. The administration and health department maintain continuous surveillance, and the situation remains under control.

triage.headline_ja: ボカロの少年観護施設で16人が体調不良、健康監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 少年観護施設内の限定的なインフルエンザ様症状の集団発生で、季節性の変化によるものと評価され、重症例や死亡もなく状況は制御下にあるため。
triage.notes: 施設内の限定的な発生で、地方行政による通常の対応（監視強化・衛生改善）が行われている。国際的懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: MSF says health workers in DR Congo are struggling to prevent Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, the fastest-growing on record, has killed over 1,000 people in roughly two months since the WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. As of 22 July, more than 1,000 deaths are reported by Africa CDC; Ituri province accounts for nearly 90% of cases, with Ebola confirmed in five eastern provinces. Twenty cases, including two deaths, have been recorded in neighbouring Uganda. MSF warns the response is not enough and could worsen without rapid scale-up; inaccessible provinces hinder contact tracing and late arrivals case-fatalities are high. MSF has more than 1,400 staff on the ground operating treatment centres and providing supplies, but a strike by Bunia health workers over unpaid salaries has aggravated gaps. The Bundibugyo strain underpins the outbreak, with no specific treatments or vaccines available; transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, and mortality remains high.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ拡大防止に医療従事者が苦慮していると発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した過去最速拡大のエボラ流行で死者1,000人超、隣国ウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準を複数満たす明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例（死亡2例）確認されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはPHEICを宣言済みで、既にフルRRA相当の対応が進行中と推測される。

article.articleHeadline: IISc researchers decode how a virus hijacks host protein machinery
article.articleSummary: Encephalomyocarditis virus (EMCV), a rodent-borne animal virus causing heart and brain inflammation, reproductive problems, and neurological disorders in mammals, hijacks the host's protein-synthesis machinery via its Internal Ribosomal Entry Site (IRES). Researchers at IISc Bengaluru used cryo-EM to show EMCV IRES directly engages the host 40S ribosomal subunit and initiator tRNA, triggering viral translation while host translation is suppressed. A pulldown strategy isolated the EMCV IRES pre-initiation complex from rabbit reticulocyte lysate, revealing the intact assembly with initiation factors including eIF2. Findings, published in eLife, highlight a mechanism distinct from other viruses and suggest that targeting IRES could yield therapeutics against EMCV and related viruses such as poliovirus. (As of 2026-07-23).

triage.headline_ja: IISc研究者、ウイルスが宿主のタンパク質合成機構を乗っ取る仕組みを解明
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、EMCVウイルスの分子機構に関する基礎研究論文の紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究機関（IISc Bengaluru）による基礎科学研究の成果報告であり、実際の感染症発生・流行事例ではないため対象国の発生地域には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Spotlight on the Ebola Outbreak | United Nations
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola, a rare Ebola virus strain lacking a vaccine or specific treatment, is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Cases have been reported in a number of locations, elevating the urgency of the response. The outbreak unfolds amid humanitarian crisis, remote and densely populated areas, insecurity, and high population and trade movements. The United Nations system is rapidly scaling up life-saving support with partners to contain transmission and protect communities. Guidance on transmission, at-risk groups, and steps to halt transmission and the outbreak is being disseminated. The article notes considerations for imported or exported cases and emphasizes stopping the chain of transmission as the central goal.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に焦点を当てて | 国連
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン・特効治療のない稀なブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる流行がPHEICとしてWHOにより宣言されており、複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めていない。PHEIC宣言済みであり緊急のフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, chikungunya: Ministério da Saúde alerta sobre possível aumento de infecções no país devido
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue, Chikungunya: Ministry of Health warns of possible increase in infections in the country due to
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces an anticipated rise in arboviruses as El Niño intensifies in the second half of 2026. Projections by InfoDengue/Fiocruz estimate around 1.7 million new dengue cases in the coming year. The Health Ministry warns that higher temperatures and increased rainfall in some regions, along with drought in others, can boost water storage and create mosquito and tick breeding sites. In response, states and municipalities are urged to intensify transmission surveillance and control, implement transmission-blocking measures at the first identified cases, reorganize Vector Control Agents activities, and adopt the agency-recommended vector-control technologies. Public participation is essential: eliminate domestic breeding sites, monitor for arbovirus symptoms (dengue, zika, chikungunya, and Oropouche fever), and seek healthcare promptly at symptom onset.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・チクングニア熱：保健省がエルニーニョによる感染増加の可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル保健省がエルニーニョに伴う季節性のデング・チクングニア等アルボウイルス感染症の増加を予測し注意喚起した内容であり、現時点で異常な流行拡大は確認されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性の予測警告であり、El Niñoに伴う恒例のアルボウイルス増加対策の呼びかけ。実際の症例急増や異常な流行パターンの報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 3 British Airways Pilots Fall Ill Mid-Air on Hyderabad-London Flight due to suspected food poisoning
article.articleSummary: Three British Airways pilots on a Hyderabad–London flight fell ill mid-air from suspected food poisoning, prompting an onboard medical emergency at 30,000 ft. The Boeing 777 diverted to Heathrow and landed safely; one pilot required oxygen and was hospitalized, while the other two were assessed after landing. No fatalities reported. The incident occurred about 10.5 hours into the flight over Europe. British Airways has launched an internal investigation and filed an air safety report; medical samples have been collected for testing. Preliminary findings link the illness to food and bottled water consumed during a Hyderabad hotel layover the night before departure. The airline is reviewing catering arrangements with external suppliers, and aviation authorities in the UK and India have been notified and are monitoring the investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 英国航空のパイロット3名、ハイデラバード発ロンドン行き便内で体調不良、食中毒疑い
triage.triage_reason: 単一便における食中毒疑いの個別事例であり、公衆衛生上の広範な影響やヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は認められない。
triage.notes: ハイデラバードのホテル滞在中に摂取した食品・水が原因と推定される個別の食中毒事例。ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念はなく、航空会社内部調査で対応可能な事象。

article.articleHeadline: Sena entra em lista de cidades com mais SRAG no Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sena enters the list of cities with the most SRAG in Acre.
article.articleSummary: Sena Madureira is among Acre's municipalities with the highest Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) notifications in 2026, reporting 62 cases from epidemiological weeks 1–27, per SESacre Boletim Epidemiológico No. 23/2026. Acre totals 1,929 SRAG cases in this period, the highest in three years, up from 1,639 (2024) and 1,425 (2025). Other top cities are Rio Branco (811), Cruzeiro do Sul (290), Marechal Thaumaturgo (156), Mâncio Lima (100), Senador Guiomard (65), and Tarauacá (54). Children 0–9 and adults over 60 remain most vulnerable, driving hospitalizations. Identified pathogens include Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), rhinovirus, Influenza A, Influenza A (H1N1)pdm09, SARS-CoV-2, adenovirus, and metapneumovirus. Health authorities urge vaccination, regular hand hygiene, and seeking medical care for persistent symptoms, especially in children and the elderly, to prevent clinical worsening.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州で最もSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）症例数が多い自治体リストにセナ・マドゥレイラが追加
triage.triage_reason: 既知の季節性呼吸器病原体（RSV、インフルエンザ、ライノウイルス等）による定例の疫学速報であり、地域保健当局が管理下で対応しているため、国際的懸念やシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: ブラジル・アクレ州の地方保健局（SESacre）による定例疫学速報（第23号）。病原体は既知のもの（RSV、ライノウイルス、インフルエンザA/H1N1pdm09、SARS-CoV-2、アデノウイルス、メタニューモウイルス）で、過去3年間で最多の症例数だが季節性の範囲内と考えられる。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Bulandsehar News: किशोर में मलेरिया की पुष्टि, विभाग ने कराया छिड़काव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bulandsehar News: Malaria confirmed in a teenager, the department carried out spraying.
article.articleSummary: Malaria confirmed in a teenager in Bulandshahr district, India. Bajheda village in the Ahar region reports nine total malaria cases as seasonal rains and flooding drive mosquito proliferation. A 16-year-old named Rakesh Kumar developed high fever on July 16; local treatment failed to resolve fever, prompting blood testing at Lal Path Lab that confirmed malaria. Health authorities initiated treatment for the patient and launched anti-larval spraying in the village, with screening of nearby households for fever cases. Chief Medical Officer Dr. Sunil Kumar Dohre said teams are dispatched wherever malaria cases are found and are conducting anti-larval spraying to curb mosquito breeding. The initiative operates under the Vector-Borne Disease Control Campaign, focusing on community awareness and preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブランドシャール・ニュース：10代の少年にマラリア感染確認、当局が消毒作業を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における季節性マラリアの散発例（9件）であり、地域の対策(殺幼虫剤散布・監視)が既に機能しており、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方紙報道による季節性マラリアの散発例。地域保健当局が既に対応(殺幼虫剤散布、家庭訪問調査)しており、ベクター媒介疾患対策キャンペーンの一環として管理されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 1 000 morts, l'épidémie s'accélère
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 1,000 deaths, the outbreak is accelerating.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 1,000 deaths, with Africa CDC reporting 1,031 confirmed fatalities. The Congo Ministry of Health lists 2,473 cases, with 737 patients currently hospitalized or in isolation. Declared on May 15, the outbreak is unfolding faster than any previous Ebola event, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists yet. Health authorities are alarmed that nearly 80% of new cases occur outside known transmission chains, indicating rapid spread beyond contact tracing. The epicenter is Ituri Province, with cases in four other provinces as screening and isolation intensify. Oxford University has launched the first human trial of a Bundibugyo vaccine, a Phase I study in 50 healthy adults (18–55) to assess safety and immune response. U.S. researchers caution the worst case could mirror West Africa 2013–2016, with over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱:死者1,000人超、流行が加速
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速ペースのエボラ流行が発生し、死者1,000人超、症例の8割が既知の感染経路外で発生するなど制御困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州中心、他4州に拡大）のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: OMS lanzó alerta por la rápida propagación del brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO issued an alert over the rapid spread of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO issued an alert as the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is rapidly spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with cases recorded between May 15 and July 19 totaling 2,473 across DRC and Uganda. Official figures report 999 deaths in DRC and two in Uganda, though Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya later cited 1,031 confirmed deaths. The outbreak shows the fastest propagation to date for Ebola, with about 80% of new infections from transmission chains without identified sources. Contact tracing covers about 82% of contacts; WHO notes 90–95% transmission control is needed. There are no vaccines or specific treatments available; resources for patient care and outbreak response are limited. The disease is spreading to five of 26 provinces, primarily Ituri near Uganda and South Sudan, with safety concerns prompting healthcare workers to abandon some zones and wage delays. International support urged for funding, technical and logistical assistance.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大に対し警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: WHOが警告を発出するほどの急速な感染拡大、多数の死者、国境を越えた伝播、伝播経路不明の症例が8割を占めるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際支援も明示的に要請されているため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大を主題としている。ウガンダおよびスーダンへの言及もあるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・特異的治療法がない点、接触追跡率が82%にとどまる点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Meghaladta az ezret az ebola-járvány halálos áldozatainak a száma a Kongói DK-ban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak has surpassed one thousand in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,000 deaths, with 1,031 fatalities among 2,473 confirmed infections and at least 737 patients in isolation or under hospital care. Authorities warn the Bundibugyo virus outbreak is the deadliest Ebola episode on record, exceeding the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak, which had about 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths. A lack of vaccine, medicines, and funding is cited as driving fatalities. Oxford University’s Vaccine Group began the world’s first human trial of a Bundibugyo virus vaccine about a week ago. The outbreak remains ongoing in the DRC, with no licensed vaccine or approved therapy available yet.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行の死者数が1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ型)の大規模流行で死者1,031人・感染者2,473人に達し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストになく、記事本文でも言及がないため除外。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる史上最悪規模の流行とされ、ワクチン治験が開始されたばかりで承認済み治療法は未確立。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique: Ebola - L'agence sanitaire de l'UA appelle les États-Unis à lever ses restrictions de voyage visant l'Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Ebola - The African Union's health agency calls on the United States to lift its travel restrictions targeting Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC): Africa CDC urges the United States to lift travel restrictions targeting Uganda, noting no new Uganda cases since June 21 and last patient discharged July 16; 836 contacts followed have ended, with Kampala reporting no current cases. The United States renewed the entry suspension on July 13 for 30 days. Africa CDC favors targeted measures—departure/arrival screening, health questionnaires, and rapid follow-up for symptomatic travelers—over a blanket ban. Uganda maintains enhanced surveillance, especially at its border with the DRC, where the outbreak remains active. The outbreak is not yet declared over; Uganda must wait 42 days to announce end. WHO tallies as of July 20: 1,001 deaths in DRC and Uganda, with 2,473 confirmed cases in the DRC since mid-May. Ebola transmits via contact with body fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; historically deadly outbreak in the DRC (2018–2020).

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：エボラ出血熱－アフリカ連合保健機関、米国に対しウガンダを対象とした渡航制限の解除を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（死者1,001人、DRCで確定症例2,473例）であり、米国が渡航制限を発動するなど国際的な対応が進行中のため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダの国境地域における進行中のエボラアウトブレイクを扱っているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないためDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。米国による渡航制限措置とAfrica CDCの対応要請が中心的話題。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : L'épidémie d'Ebola s'étend à un rythme incontrôlable prévient MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: MSF warns that the Ebola outbreak is spreading at an uncontrollable pace.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding. Africa CDC reports more than 1,000 deaths as of 22 July, while Health Ministry lists 2,473 confirmed cases and 999 deaths since the start. 90% of infections are in Ituri province, with the virus in five provinces, including Tshopo. Humanitarian actors warn security issues and displacement hinder the response, as contact tracing and surveillance falter where health teams are unpaid or unreachable amid clashes involving M23 rebels and ADF fighters. MSF stresses that all six pillars of outbreak response must be operational. Many patients arrive late at treatment centers, unconscious and dying soon after admission. CDC modeling warns the worst-case could exceed 11,000 deaths; WHO declared a PHEIC in May 2026. The outbreak is caused by Ebola Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; early cases may trace back to February, with tests targeting another strain.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行が制御不能なペースで拡大していると国境なき医師団(MSF)が警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行で、死者999〜1000人超、5州に拡大し治安・避難民問題で対応が困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月にPHEICを宣言済み。原因はエボラ・ブンディブギョウイルスで承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし。CDCモデリングでは最悪シナリオで死者11,000人超と予測。治安悪化(M23、ADF)が対応の障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Туристка рассказала, как из ее ноги вынимали личинки после отдыха во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A tourist recounted how larvae were removed from her leg after a vacation in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Kristina, a tourist and blogger, returned from four months in Vietnam with larvae of sand fleas embedded in her heel and knee. She felt inflammation before returning to Russia; once home, the pain worsened and she consulted a surgeon who opened the leg under local anesthesia. Postoperative care included antibiotics and dressings for about 1.5 weeks, with full recovery in roughly one month. The incident occurred in April, but she shared the experience now to warn other travelers. The report notes that Rospotrebnadzor had warned that tropical regions carry a risk of melioidosis, a dangerous tropical infection, underscoring travel-related infectious disease risks.

triage.headline_ja: 観光客がベトナム旅行後に足から幼虫を取り出した経験を語る
triage.triage_reason: 個人の砂ノミ幼虫寄生の体験談であり、メリオイドーシスは注意喚起として言及されているのみで実際の感染事例ではないため、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は砂ノミ(sand flea)幼虫の皮膚寄生に関する個人体験談。メリオイドーシスは記事末尾でRospotrebnadzorの一般的な渡航警告として言及されているだけで、実際の感染事例ではない。疾患名ラベル(Melioidosis)は誤りの可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Aru: un appui logistique sollicité dans une zone de santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Aru: Logistical support sought in a health zone - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Aru, Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 13 confirmed cases and 3 deaths since July 18, 2026 in the Adja health zone of Aru territory. On July 23, 2026, hospital medical director Dr. Ernest Lunghuli requested logistical support to strengthen the response and break the transmission chain, citing the lack of a vehicle to evacuate patients and insufficient resources to contain the outbreak. He warned that lives across Aru depend on prompt action. On the ground, no response teams have been dispatched to Adja; the response relies on the Aru General Hospital ambulance, not available continuously. Contact and suspected cases are often left unattended, posing ongoing transmission risk. The zone remains the epicentre in Aru due to rapidly increasing contacts and deaths, despite awareness campaigns by health zones and community leaders.

triage.headline_ja: アルにおけるエボラ出血熱：保健地区でロジスティクス支援が要請される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州アル準州でエボラ出血熱の確認症例13例・死亡3例が発生し、対応体制の不備（患者搬送車両不足、接触者・疑い例への対応漏れ）により感染連鎖継続のリスクが指摘されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域データにはチャド（Guera Region、Republic of Chad）が含まれているが、記事本文はDRCイトゥリ州アル準州アジャ保健地区でのエボラ発生のみを扱っており、チャドは無関係と判断し除外した。地理座標の不一致（Adja地点がチャド領域の座標で登録）はデータ品質の問題と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : plus de 1 000 morts enregistrés depuis le début de l'épidémie d'Ebola - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: More than 1,000 deaths recorded since the start of the Ebola outbreak - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to progress, with deaths surpassing 1,000 as of July 23, 2026. The outbreak was declared on May 15. The epidemiological report tallies 2,535 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, yielding a global case fatality rate of 40.7%. Healthcare authorities report 738 people currently in isolation and 506 recovered. The contact-tracing effort has a follow-up rate of 77.2%. The disease remains active in 42 health zones across five provinces: North Kivu, South Kivu, Ituri, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele, where response teams continue surveillance, patient care, and contact investigations to curb transmission. The data reflect ongoing transmission and substantial mortality, underscoring the need for sustained public health measures in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行開始以来の死者数が1,000人を超える - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの5州42保健地域に拡大し、死者1,000人超・致死率40.7%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模エボラ流行の継続報道。5州42保健地域に拡大し、致死率40.7%と高い。国際的な支援・監視の継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: InfoGripe: cai número de hospitalizações por VSR e por influenza A e B em grande parte do país | Portal Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: InfoGripe: RSV and influenza A and B hospitalizations fall in much of the country | Fiocruz Portal
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin (Week 28, July 12–18, 2026) reports declines in severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) in much of Brazil, driven by fewer RSV and influenza A/B hospitalizations. Five states—Acre, Maranhão, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina—remain at risk or high risk with rising long-term trends; 16 others are at alert/risk without sustained growth. RSV activity rises in the South and Maranhão; influenza A remains a concern in Acre, Minas Gerais, Paraná and Roraima, while influenza B increases in the Central-Southern states but stabilizes in Ceará, Goiás, Maranhão, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná and São Paulo. Three capitals (João Pessoa, Rio Branco, São Luís) show SARI activity at alert/risk with rising trends; 14 capitals are at alert/risk without growth. Mortality is higher in those 65+, mainly due to influenza A; RSV drives incidence in children under 2. Vaccination against influenza, COVID-19 and RSV is advised, with RSV vaccination for pregnant women; continue masking in health settings.

triage.headline_ja: InfoGripe：ブラジルの大部分でRSVおよびインフルエンザA・B型による入院が減少
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV・インフルエンザ）の定期サーベイランス報告であり、多くの地域で入院数は減少傾向。異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない通常のモニタリング情報。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス（InfoGripe）の定期報告。一部州（Acre, Maranhão, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina）で警戒レベルの上昇傾向はあるが、全国的には減少傾向であり通常のモニタリング範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Muertes por brote de ébola en República del Congo superan las 1,000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola outbreak in the Republic of the Congo surpasses 1,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, has surpassed 1,000 deaths. The INSP warns contact tracing remains insufficient and calls for stronger surveillance. Declared May 15 in Ituri, the epidemic remains in continuous transmission with high virus circulation, with data delays requiring cautious interpretation. Uganda recently discharged its last hospitalized patient a week before 23 July 2026; the country reported 20 confirmed cases, including 15 imported from the DRC, with two deaths, and began a 42-day countdown without new cases to end the outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% case-fatality rate; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO cites high regional risk but low global risk. This is the third-worst Ebola outbreak on record and the 17th in the DRC. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクによる死者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によりコンゴ民主共和国で死者1,000人超、史上3番目に深刻なアウトブレイクとなり、ウガンダへの越境感染も発生している。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染例（20例確認、うち15例はDRCからの輸入例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOは地域リスクを高、世界リスクを低と評価。ブンディブギョ株、CFR 30-50%、ワクチン・特異的治療法なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths hit 1,000 as Congo ravaged by world's fastest-growing outbreak of killer disease - AOL
article.articleSummary: Ebola is the fastest-growing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 2,437 cases and 1,031 deaths confirmed as of July 23, 2026. Ituri province is the epicenter of the crisis, part of the 17th DRC Ebola outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo virus—the strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. More than 60% of deaths occur in the community before care, and only about 9% of contacts are being monitored, signaling weak containment. The World Health Organization warns the true scale may be two to four times higher than official figures due to inaccessible areas amid fighting and attacks on health workers. First-week July fatalities exceed 100 per CDC modeling. Challenges include delays in testing (often >4 days), poor coordination, and community resistance to burial teams. A possible imported case triggered London hospital isolation after a DR Congo trip; authorities urge intensified response at a Ghana health summit.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱による死者1,000人に到達 ― コンゴを襲う史上最速拡大の致死性感染症アウトブレイク
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが進行中で、死者1,000人超・ワクチン未承認株・封じ込め不全に加え、ロンドンへの輸入疑い例も発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: ガーナは対策強化を訴える保健サミット開催地であり、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。英国（ロンドン）の輸入疑い例は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola :Suminwa à Kisangani pour intensifier la riposte dans l'espace Grande Orientale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Suminwa in Kisangani to intensify the response in the Greater Orientale region.
article.articleSummary: On 23 July 2026, at 12:32 p.m., the Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Judith Suminwa Tuluka, arrived at Bangoka International Airport in Kisangani to lead a field visit focused on the Ebola situation in the Greater Orientale region. Welcomed by provincial authorities, she heads a delegation including diplomatic representatives, UN agencies, and technical-financial partners. The mission will extend to Bunia, Mungwalu, and Rwampara in Ituri province, the epicentre of an Ebola resurgence. The aims are to assess the effectiveness of surveillance, strengthen operational coordination, and provide direct support to frontline medical teams deployed in the response. The government reaffirms its commitment to protecting populations and, under its leadership, to a rapid, coordinated, and effective Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：スミンワ首相、グランド・オリエンタル地域での対応強化のためキサンガニを訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州での再燃(resurgence)が示唆されており、首相自らが現地入りし対応強化を図っていることから、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ再燃への対応を主題としている。発生地域にRwandaが含まれているが、記事本文では言及されていないため除外した。感染者数・死亡者数など具体的な疫学データは記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控发布7月第3周急性呼吸道传染病监测情况
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC releases surveillance data on acute respiratory infectious diseases for the third week of July.
article.articleSummary: China CDC’s weekly national sentinel surveillance for acute respiratory infections (July 13–19, 2026) shows SARS-CoV-2 positivity rising, overall at a mid-epidemic level with southern provinces markedly higher than northern ones. Among outpatient/ED samples, the three most detected pathogens are SARS-CoV-2, influenza virus, and enteroviruses; among hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections, SARS-CoV-2, rhinovirus, and influenza virus prevail. No unknown pathogens or emergent diseases detected; influenza activity remains generally low, with type B predominating and the 5–14-year age group showing the highest positivity. Rhinovirus positivity declines, especially in those under 14; parainfluenza declines with highest rates in 0–4-year-olds; enteroviruses and human parechovirus show reductions but with higher rates in children; human parechovirus fluctuates. Public guidance emphasizes masking in healthcare and crowded settings, hand hygiene, ventilation, vaccination for at‑risk groups, and timely care when fever or respiratory symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理センター、7月第3週の急性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス状況を発表
triage.triage_reason: 定例の週次サーベイランス報告であり、未知の病原体や新興感染症は検出されず、季節性の呼吸器感染症動向の範囲内である。
triage.notes: SARS-CoV-2、インフルエンザ、パレコウイルスなど既知病原体の定例監視データであり、新規性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola deaths top 1,000
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has resulted in more than 1,000 deaths (2,536 cases reported since declaration on 15 May). It is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, with transmission spreading faster than health officials can track and no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo. A Merck vaccine licensed to target the Zaire virus could offer some cross-protection against Bundibugyo, per a New England Journal of Medicine paper, but Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are still months from clinical trials. The World Health Organization has expressed lukewarm support for testing the Zaire-targeting vaccine in Congo, highlighting the ongoing, unresolved need for effective countermeasures amid rising mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでBundibugyoウイルスによるエボラ死者が1000人超、史上最速の感染拡大かつワクチン・治療薬未承認という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo種による史上最速の流行拡大であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El Puerto de Barcelona eleva un 3,5% el tráfico pese a la peste porcina y las tensiones geopolíticas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Port of Barcelona posts a 3.5% increase in traffic despite swine fever and geopolitical tensions.
article.articleSummary: Port of Barcelona reported 35.87 million tonnes of throughput in H1, up 3.5% year-on-year, despite geopolitical tensions and African swine fever (ASF) affecting pork trade. Hinterland movements fell 1% as import containers declined—alfalfa (-55%) amid Hormuz strait disruption and late harvest; pork exports to the United States dropped 12% on tariffs. Still, total container traffic rose 4.3% to 1.93 million TEUs, with exports up 6.8% to 380,000 TEUs. Some 55% of imports come from China, aided by the Ebro Free Zone factory boosting Chinese car imports by 35%. Solid bulks rose 1.94 million tonnes; liquids 8.52 million; vehicles 386,000; Ro-Ro 224,000 units. Passenger movements reached 2.4 million (+4.1%), origin/destination traffic at 58%, while rail fell 13.3% due to Gelida and Rubí tunnel closures.

triage.headline_ja: バルセロナ港、豚熱と地政学的緊張にもかかわらず取扱量3.5%増
triage.triage_reason: 記事はバルセロナ港の貿易統計に関する経済記事であり、アフリカ豚熱は貿易への影響要因として言及されているのみで、疾病発生自体の詳細や公衆衛生上の懸念は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン・バルセロナ港の物流・貿易統計に関する経済ニュースであり、ASFの発生地や症例に関する情報は含まれていない。中国は輸入元国として言及されているのみで、ASF発生国としての言及ではないため対象国リストに該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Se elevan a más de mil los muertos por ébola en la República Democrática del Congo y Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola rises to more than a thousand in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to devastate the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths since May, in Ituri, North Kivu and Upper Uele. Uganda has discharged its last patient and aims to declare interruption of transmission. Despite surveillance, the outbreak has expanded; the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern three months ago as spread accelerated. The Bundibugyo strain drives this outbreak; no approved vaccine or treatment exists for it, and vaccines effective against the Zaire strain (e.g., Ervebo) are not applicable. Two American doctors infected while aiding in DRC were evacuated to Germany; Uganda reports imported cases from Congo. Fourteen Americans returning from Congo via Canada were quarantined in New York with no symptoms. Trials are underway: Oxford/ Serum Institute, IAVI, Moderna (mRNA) with CEPI funding, Public Health Vaccines; Gavi, UNICEF, WHO support production.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでエボラ死者数が1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラアウトブレイクであり、死者1000人超・国際的な症例輸出（米国・ドイツへの搬送）も発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。米国・ドイツは輸入症例の搬送先であり発生国ではないため除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行で、既にPHEIC宣言済みの重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو.. ومخاوف من انتشار العدوى عبر المتوفين - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Ebola cases in Congo, and concerns about the spread of infection through the deceased.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows a sharp rise in infections with 2,536 cases and 1,033 deaths reported to date. Transmission remains largely driven by traditional funeral practices involving contact with the deceased, prompting health authorities and the International Organization for Migration to stress safe burial procedures and community awareness to curb spread. The current outbreak, developing within two months, is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history and among the fastest-spreading. Ebola, a highly lethal filovirus, typically causes fever, bleeding, and severe illness; case fatality varies by strain and care quality. The article highlights that viral presence in body fluids after death sustains transmission, underscoring funeral-related risks and the need for vigilant response within the DRC and potential cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染例が急増…遺体を介した感染拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行が急拡大し、史上3番目の規模かつ最速級の拡大速度であり、致死率も高く国際的拡大の懸念があるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 2,536例・1,033死亡と報告されており、致死率約40%。埋葬慣習が主要な感染経路とされ、国際移住機関(IOM)が関与。越境拡大の可能性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Епідемія Еболи не вщухає: смертельний вірус забрав життя понад тисячі людей
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is not subsiding: the deadly virus has claimed the lives of more than a thousand people.
article.articleSummary: 2,536 Ebola cases and 1,033 deaths were officially reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of July 22, 2026, with the outbreak centered in eastern regions since mid-May and spreading amid local violence and attacks on clinics. The rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain carries about 40% mortality; transmission occurs via direct contact with body fluids, causing severe internal and external bleeding. Healthcare workers face extreme danger and shortages of basic medicines, while community hostility toward burial restrictions amplifies challenges. There are no approved vaccines or proven treatments for this strain; ongoing evaluation of a small number of experimental therapies shows efficacy only in animal studies. Uganda reports a stabilizing outbreak with 20 cases and a last discharge on July 16, followed by a 42-day countdown. An imported case was confirmed in France in a doctor who treated Congo patients, underscoring international spread risks per WHO guidance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行は収まらず：致死性ウイルスが千人以上の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率約40%のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)により1,000人超が死亡、フランスへの輸入症例も確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダでは症例数が安定化し終息に向かっているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。フランスの輸入症例も対象国リスト外のため除外。ワクチン・治療法が未承認である点が公衆衛生上の深刻さを増している。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC franchit la barre des 1.000 décès d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC crosses the 1,000 Ebola deaths threshold - ACP
article.articleSummary: By 23 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 1,000 Ebola virus disease (EVD) deaths since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. The Ministry of Health reports 2,535 confirmed cases, 1,033 deaths, 738 people in isolation, and 506 recoveries, with a case fatality rate of 40.7% and a contact-tracing rate of 77.2%. The outbreak spans 42 health zones across five provinces: North Kivu, South Kivu, Ituri, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele. Ituri remains the main transmission hub, containing 88.6% of cumulative cases and 73% of new infections in the day. North Kivu shows the highest fatality rate at 58.7%. Despite ongoing contact follow-up, the national tracing rate of 77.2% is still considered insufficient to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数1,000人の大台を突破 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、死者1,000人超・致死率40.7%・5州42保健区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡率77.2%は依然として感染連鎖遮断に不十分とされ、Ituri州が主要な感染拡大地点。北キブ州の致死率は58.7%と最も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Man at Kozhikode MCH diagnosed with amoebic fever
article.articleSummary: One confirmed case of amoebic meningoencephalitis reported in Kozhikode district, Kerala, involving a 48-year-old man from Koyilandy. The patient is currently under treatment at Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode. He was admitted on July 10 with fever and other symptoms, and laboratory confirmation of amoebic meningoencephalitis was made on July 22. Containment measures have been instituted in his native Koyilandy area to curb potential spread. As of July 23, 2026, authorities have not released details on the patient's clinical outcome, and no additional imported or exported cases have been noted in the report. This appears to be the only case reported so far.

triage.headline_ja: コーリコード医科大学病院（ケララ州）でアメーバ性発熱と診断された男性
triage.triage_reason: アメーバ性髄膜脳炎の単発症例であり重症度は高いが、ヒト-ヒト感染性はなく現時点で拡大の兆候はないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: アメーバ性髄膜脳炎（Naegleria fowleri感染症の可能性）は水系感染で致死率が高い疾患。ケララ州では過去にも散発的に報告例あり。単一症例で地域封じ込め措置が取られており、現時点で他症例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Emergenza sanitaria in Congo: l'epidemia di ebola ha causato più di 1000 vittime - Latina News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health emergency in Congo: the Ebola epidemic has caused more than 1,000 deaths - Latina News
article.articleSummary: As of July 22, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in central Africa has caused 1,001 deaths across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, according to WHO figures. In the DRC, where the outbreak was declared in mid-May, authorities report 2,473 cases and 999 deaths. In Uganda, 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths have been recorded, with officials noting no new infections for several days; if this trend holds for another month, Uganda could be officially declared virus-free. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warned at a health conference in Ghana that this is the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic of all time, stressing severe strains on health systems and shortages of vaccines, medicines, and funds. He called on the international community to provide aid and financing to curb spread and save thousands of lives.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ保健緊急事態：エボラ流行で1,000人以上が死亡 - Latina News
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにまたがるエボラ流行で1,000人以上が死亡し、Africa CDCが「史上最速の流行」と警告するなど深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大が認められるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダも罹患国だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ガーナはAfrica CDC所長が講演した会議開催地に過ぎず、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。
