article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo: surto de Ébola mata mais de 1 000 pessoas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola outbreak kills more than 1,000 people.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 1,031 and infected 2,473, with about 737 in isolation or hospital care. Declared on May 15, the surge is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus—the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record—against which no licensed vaccines or treatments exist. The outbreak is spreading beyond the Ituri epicenter to four additional provinces, with roughly 80% of new cases arising outside known transmission chains, signaling rapid, hard-to-trace spread. The Oxford University Vaccine Group has launched the first human Phase I trial of a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine in Oxford, assessing safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55. Health authorities and experts warn the crisis could reach scales seen in the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, underscoring an urgent need for vaccines, funding, and expanded response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱の流行で1,000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 死亡者1,000人超・感染者2,473人規模のエボラ流行で、ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる史上最速拡大とされ、既知の感染経路外での新規感染が約80%を占めるなど国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 英国オックスフォードは臨床試験実施地であり発生地域ではないため除外。DRC国内でイトゥリ州から4州へ拡大中、既知感染経路外での新規感染が約80%と流行制御の困難さを示唆。ワクチン・治療薬未承認で2014-2016年西アフリカ流行規模への懸念が専門家から示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в ДР Конго стала рекордной по быстроте роста смертности за всю историю
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC set a record for the fastest increase in mortality in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 2,500 cases and 1,031 deaths, with 737 in isolation or hospital and over 460 recoveries; Uganda has reported cases. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no approved vaccines or treatments. While not the largest by case numbers, it shows the fastest mortality rise, with 1,000 deaths reached in about two months, far quicker than the eight months in 2013–2016 West Africa. The UN cautions that true scale could be 2–4 times higher due to inaccessible areas in Ituri Province and transmission chains not traced in 80% of new cases. Fight is hindered by insurgent violence and community resistance; burial teams are sometimes militarized, and health workers have gone on strike since May 15. U.S. aid: $13 million emergency assistance to DRC and Uganda; $250 million to strengthen health systems.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上最速の致死率上昇を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率が史上最速で上昇するエボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダへの拡大や治療薬・ワクチン未承認の株であること、国際支援が投入されている点からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例報告があるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。米国・アンゴラは発生地域として記載されているが記事主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Over 8k TB cases detected in statewide screening drive
article.articleSummary: TB detected 8,537 patients in Bihar during a statewide screening drive from July 2–19, 2026. Over 95.32 lakh people were screened, with 95,32,242 individuals registered on the Nikshay portal. To improve diagnostic accuracy, authorities conducted 3,14,764 digital X-rays among vulnerable groups and performed 58,255 NAATs. Health Minister Nishant Kumar pledged TB elimination through not only identification but timely treatment, nutritional support and comprehensive care until recovery. To curb transmission, 19,123 household contacts of active TB patients were enrolled in TB Preventive Treatment (TPT). Welfare measures included 9,679 food baskets and direct financial assistance to 43,398 beneficiaries under the Nikshay Poshan Yojana via DBT. Citizens with a persistent cough of more than two weeks, prolonged fever, unexplained weight loss or night sweats are urged to visit government facilities for free testing and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 州全体のスクリーニング活動で8千人以上の結核症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する通常の州レベルのスクリーニング活動・対策の報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 定期的な結核対策プログラム（Nikshayポータル、TPT、栄養支援等）の実施報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola death toll hits 1033, confirmed cases exceed 2,500
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-23, the DRC Ebola outbreak in Ituri's epicenter reports 1,033 deaths and 2,536 confirmed cases; 506 recovered, 738 in isolation. No new affected health zones; 47 across five provinces, with 46 under active transmission. The Bundibugyo virus, declared May 15 in Ituri, drives sustained transmission. Treatment capacity is strained in North Kivu (182 in isolation vs 141 beds). While case notifications plateau in some areas, officials caution it is too early to declare a peak given reporting delays and data consolidation. Transmission is fueled by population movements, insecurity, artisanal mining, and cross-border exchanges with Uganda and South Sudan. In Beni territory, July 13-19 attacks killed at least 30 and injured around 12, displacing civilians and restricting humanitarian access; six aid organisations have suspended movements to several localities in Beni.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数1,033人に到達、確認症例数2,500人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者1,033人、確認症例2,536人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国境を越えた拡大リスク・治安悪化による人道アクセス制限も確認されるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは越境交流の文脈で言及されているが、感染症の発生地としては明記されていないため対象国リストから除外。DRC(Ituri, North Kivu)が主発生地。治安悪化による人道アクセス制限が拡大リスクを増大させている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo supera los 1.000 muertos confirmados por brote de ébola - Hondudiario
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 1,000 confirmed deaths from an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 1,033 deaths from 2,536 confirmed cases (through July 21), CFR 40.7%. About 738 patients remain in isolation or hospital, with 506 recovered; contact tracing stands at 77.2%. Five provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. INSP warns follow-up of contacts remains insufficient, urging stronger surveillance amid ongoing transmission and reporting delays. Declared May 15 in Ituri, the outbreak has also reached Uganda, where the last patient was discharged after 42 days without new cases; Uganda had 20 confirmed cases, including 15 imported from the DRC and 2 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists; WHO notes high risk in sub-Saharan Africa but low global risk. This is the third-worst Ebola epidemic and seventeenth for the DRC, behind the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak and the 2018-2020 DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクによる死者数が確認1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率40.7%、死者1,000人超という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、複数州・国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ウガンダ側は既に42日間新規症例なしで収束済み。ワクチン・特異的治療法がないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による第17回目のDRC国内流行であり、WHOはサブサハラアフリカで高リスク、世界的には低リスクと評価。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Ministério da Saúde alerta sobre possível aumento de infecções com El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Ministry of Health warns of a possible increase in infections due to El Niño.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Health Ministry warns that El Niño's arrival in the second half of 2026 could boost arboviral infections, including dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and Oropouche fever. Projections by InfoDengue/Fiocruz put dengue cases at about 1.7 million in the next year. Warmer temperatures and more rainfall, plus drought in other areas, may drive households to store water and create vector breeding sites for mosquitoes and ticks. The ministry urges states and municipalities to intensify surveillance and control, implement transmission-blocking measures at the first detected cases, reorganize the Endemic Combat Agents' activities, and adopt the vector-control technologies endorsed by the ministry. Public participation is essential: eliminate potential residential breeding sites, monitor for arbovirus symptoms, and seek health care promptly on onset of symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：保健省がエルニーニョによる感染増加の可能性について警告
triage.triage_reason: エルニーニョ現象によるアルボウイルス感染症（デング熱等）増加の「予測・警告」段階の記事であり、実際の異常な増加や重症例の報告はまだない。今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル保健省による季節性気候要因（エルニーニョ）を踏まえた予防的警告であり、既存の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱・オロポーチ熱）のサーベイランス強化を呼びかける内容。既に発生している異常事態の報告ではないため、フルRRAへの移行は現時点では不要と判断。今後の実際の症例数増加報告があればPICKUPへ格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: डीआरसी में इबोला महामारी का प्रकोप जारी, संक्रमण के 2,500 से अधिक मामले सामने आए
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak continues in the DRC; more than 2,500 cases reported.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues, driven by Bundibugyo virus with Bunia in Ituri Province as the epicenter. As of 23 July 2026, total infections reach 2,536 and deaths 1,033, with 506 recoveries and 738 in isolation. Affected health zones total 47 across five provinces, with 46 still reporting transmission. The response indicates ongoing widespread transmission, though some areas show stabilization, peak timing remains uncertain. North Kivu Province faces health-system strain, housing 182 isolated patients against a 141-bed capacity. Ongoing cross-border movement with Uganda and South Sudan, insecurity, and small-scale mining are key transmission drivers. Separately, violence in the Beni area (13–19 July) caused at least 30 deaths and displacement, hindering humanitarian access as six aid organizations paused operations.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ流行が継続、感染者数2,500人以上に

triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境移動リスクが指摘されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。北キブ州では病床数141に対し隔離患者182人と医療体制が逼迫し、ベニ地区での治安悪化により人道支援団体6団体が活動を一時停止するなど、対応能力に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: डीआरसी में इबोला महामारी का प्रकोप जारी, संक्रमण के 2,500 से अधिक मामले सामने आए | Bunia: Ebola outbreak in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak continues in the DRC, more than 2,500 cases have been reported | Bunia: Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak persists, with 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, as of July 23, 2026. Cumulative recoveries are 506; 738 patients remain in isolation. No new health zones report infections, leaving 47 affected areas across five provinces, with transmission in 46 zones. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus and was declared in eastern Ituri’s Bunia on May 15. North Kivu province faces healthcare strain, with 141-bed capacity but 182 patients in isolation. Some areas show stable or slightly declining new cases, but officials caution it is premature to declare a peak, noting reporting delays may affect counts. Cross-border movement with Uganda and South Sudan and security issues in the Beni area hinder response, with several humanitarian organizations halting movement.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic continues in the DRC; more than 2,500 cases reported.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists as of 23 July 2026, with 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths; 506 recoveries and 738 patients in isolation. Affected areas total 47 across five provinces, with 46 still transmitting. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, began in Ituri province’s Bunia and was declared on 15 May. North Kivu bears a high isolation burden (182 patients in care for 141-bed capacity). Authorities caution that transmission remains ongoing, though recent fluctuations may reflect reporting delays. Key drivers include sustained population movement, insecurity, artisanal mining, and cross-border movement with Uganda and South Sudan. In Beni, 13–19 July attacks killed at least 30 people and disrupted humanitarian access, with six aid organizations halting movement due to security concerns.

article.articleHeadline: 'This is a Fire' - Congo Ebola Outbreak Fastest Spreading in History
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's eastern Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus and declared May 15, is the fastest-spreading on record, with more than 1,000 deaths. Bunia—the outbreak epicenter—saw mourners bury a six‑month‑old girl at an orphanage. WHO officials warn the outbreak remains ahead of containment as transmission accelerates; 80% of new cases have emerged outside known transmission chains. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccines or treatments, contributing to high mortality as Ebola damages the gut lining and liver, triggering severe diarrhea, vomiting and extreme dehydration of more than two gallons of fluid loss per day. True infection numbers could be two to four times the official tallies; funding gaps and ongoing regional conflict compound the challenge. Samaritan's Purse operates Ebola Treatment Centers in Bunia and another Congo location, admitting over 300 patients with more than 200 discharged.

triage.headline_ja: 「これは火事だ」— コンゴのエボラ流行、史上最速のスピードで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が史上最速の拡大を見せ、死者1000人超、ワクチン・治療薬がなく致死率が高いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOはコンテインメントが追いついていないと警告。80%の新規症例が既知の感染経路外で発生しており、地域紛争と資金不足が対応を困難にしている。承認されたワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョウイルス株であることが重症度・致死率を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola mata mais de 1.000 na RDC; violência e escassez de suprimentos prejudicam médicos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills more than 1,000 in the DRC; violence and shortages of supplies hinder doctors.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) totals 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths as of 2026-07-23, marking the country’s 17th outbreak. The strain’s fatality can reach 40%, and there is no approved vaccine. Declared mid-May, the outbreak is being fought amid security challenges in eastern DRC, including armed groups, attacks on clinics, and chronic supply shortages. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected living or deceased individuals; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. Experimental vaccines and therapies are under evaluation, with limited supporting data primarily from animals. The outbreak has reached Uganda, which has 20 confirmed cases; no new Uganda cases since June 22, and Uganda began a 42-day countdown after the last patient was discharged on July 16 to be declared virus-free.

triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、越境拡大の事実はリスク評価上重要。武装勢力による攻撃や物資不足など対応能力の低下も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果、烏干達伊波拉疫情逾1000人死亡 專家這麼說
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreaks in the Congo and Uganda have killed more than 1,000 people, experts say.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda have killed more than 1,000 people. As of July 22, 2026, the Congo Public Health Institute reports 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, with about 738 patients in isolation or hospital care. The outbreak, first recorded May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Ituri Province accounts for roughly 90% of cases; other provinces and Uganda are also affected. Transmission is via direct contact with infected bodily fluids, not airborne. The World Health Organization says the global risk is low and no sustained spread beyond the affected areas, though imported cases may occur and be contained. Control is hampered by distrust, rumors about treatment centers, fear of isolation, and resistance to safe burial practices, delaying testing and care.

article.articleHeadline: New treatment plant, pipeline planned at Kakkanad apartment complex after E coli contamination sparks protests
article.articleSummary: New measures in Kochi after detection of E coli in drinking water at Kent Mahal apartment complex, Brahmapuram, Kakkanad. Authorities will install a new state-of-the-art sewage treatment plant inside the Kent Mahal complex and lay a dedicated pipeline to the Kozhichira Bund-Manakkathodu stretch to discharge treated water. Cost of the STP to be shared by builder and residents' association. Coordinating agencies include Kochi corporation, Kerala State Electricity Board, Kerala Water Authority, and Public Works Department. A dedicated sampling point will be established near the corporation’s STP; a private laboratory engaged by Vadavucode-Puthencruz grama panchayat will collect daily water samples, and treated water will be released into the bund only after confirming absence of E coli. Suchitwa Mission and Kerala State Pollution Control Board to inspect wells/borewells for contamination sources. Residents’ association will bear laboratory expenses. Protest representatives will withdraw once sewage discharge stops; decisions to be communicated to the High Court.

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τους 1.000 οι νεκροί - Οι εντάσεις και οι ελλείψεις δυσκολεύουν τον έλεγχο της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: Death toll surpassed 1,000 — Tensions and shortages hinder the control of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, a relatively rare variant with a fatality rate up to about 40%. The epidemic has surpassed 1,000 deaths (1,033) and 2,536 confirmed cases, with 63 new cases and 34 deaths reported in the daily bulletin. This is the 17th Ebola surge in DRC, with transmission concentrated in the eastern region amid persistent violence, attacks on health facilities, and severe supply shortages. Community resistance to restrictive measures and misinformation hinder containment, including opposition to burial practices. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; experimental vaccines and therapies are under evaluation, and researchers are assessing whether existing Ebola drugs could offer protection, though data remain limited. In neighboring Uganda, authorities report 20 total cases, no new infections since June 22, and a 42-day surveillance period after a July 16 discharge to determine elimination.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,034 deaths in 24 hours: The Ebola hell intensifies in the DRC, the mortality rate soars to 40%.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending a resurgent Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak, centered in Ituri Province in the east. The Ministry of Communication and Media reports 1,034 deaths linked to 2,536 confirmed cases, with 35 fatalities and 63 new cases in the last 24 hours, yielding a case fatality rate of 40.7%. The outbreak began May 15 and has also affected North Kivu and South Kivu provinces; cases have been reported in neighboring Uganda. About 506 patients have recovered, while more than 738 suspected cases remain in isolation; contact tracing stands at 77.2%. There is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, and health authorities warn of unprecedented spread speed. International aid, including a 45-ton shipment from India to Africa CDC in Nairobi (279 PPE kits and surveillance materials), is being mobilized.

article.articleHeadline: By the Numbers: This year's Ebola outbreak has spread faster than the worst on record
article.articleSummary: Bundibugjo/Bundibugyo virus–driven Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, declared May 15, has reached 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths as of Tuesday, with a case fatality rate around 40%. This is the fastest Ebola outbreak on record, having reached 1,000 deaths in just over two months, versus eight months in the 2014-2016 West Africa crisis (which had >28,000 cases and >11,000 deaths). Bundibugyo virus is a rare variant with no approved vaccines or treatments; Ebola virus remains the deadliest overall. The current outbreak is largely confined to Congo’s five eastern provinces near the Uganda border, with Uganda reporting a few cross-border cases. Officials warn the peak may still be ahead as patient zero is unconfirmed and many new cases arise outside monitored contacts. In 2014-2016, spread extended to Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone and some cases in the US/Europe; CFR then about 66%.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death Toll Exceeds 1,000 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed 999 deaths (DRC health ministry) and 1,031 deaths (Africa CDC), and infected 2,473 confirmed cases as of July 23, 2026, with about 737 patients still in isolation or hospital treatment. Declared May 15 in Ituri, it remains concentrated there but has spread to other provinces and crossed into Uganda; two Ugandan deaths have been linked, and France reported a health worker infected in Congo who later recovered. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments, unlike the Zaire strain. An Oxford University vaccine candidate entered a phase I trial. Front-line teams have faced strikes over unpaid wages, and Bunia airport closure disrupted response funding. WHO reports over 100 healthcare workers infected; US travel restrictions on DRC/Uganda/South Sudan travelers persist. Uganda discharged its last patient on July 16, initiating a 42-day clock per WHO guidelines.

article.articleHeadline: Serum Institute Partners with Gates MRI to Make TB Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Serum Institute of India will manufacture the experimental tuberculosis vaccine M72/AS01E under an agreement with Gates Medical Research Institute. The vaccine candidate has been in development for two decades and is currently in a late-stage clinical trial. If approved, it would be the first new TB shot in more than 100 years. Serum Institute plans to invest more than $100 million to scale up manufacturing capacity and prepare for future vaccine supply. Under the deal, Gates MRI will transfer the technology and know-how needed to manufacture the vaccine antigen and enable large-scale production, permitting Serum Institute to produce the antigen at scale. The collaboration highlights Gates MRI’s technology transfer to accelerate TB vaccination efforts pending regulatory approval.

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai civic body signs three-year MoU with Mission Rabies India to strengthen rabies control
article.articleSummary: Rabies control: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) and Worldwide Veterinary Service-HOPE/Mission Rabies India signed a three-year MoU covering 2026–2028 to bolster rabies control in Mumbai. Mission Rabies India will conduct mass anti-rabies vaccination of stray dogs, strengthen rabies surveillance, and run public awareness and education campaigns, plus initiatives to promote preventive measures against the disease. BMC will provide free anti-rabies vaccination services for stray dogs across Mumbai. The agreement, signed at the BMC headquarters, aims to make Mumbai rabies-free through coordinated vaccination, surveillance, and community outreach. Additional Municipal Commissioner Prajakta Verma-Lavangare stated the collaboration will run through 2028. No rabies case counts are cited in the article.

article.articleHeadline: BMC Partners With Mission Rabies India To Vaccinate Stray Dogs, Aims To Make Mumbai Rabies-Free By 2030
article.articleSummary: Mumbai’s Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) signed a three-year MoU with Worldwide Veterinary Services-HOPE/Mission Rabies India to provide free mass anti-rabies vaccination for stray dogs across Mumbai from 2026 to 2028, as part of a drive to make the city rabies-free by 2030 under India’s National Action Plan for Dog-Mediated Rabies Elimination (NAPRE). The collaboration includes rabies surveillance and public awareness campaigns to reduce human exposure to the fatal disease. The initiative follows Union Health Ministry and Department of Fisheries and Animal Husbandry targets and Supreme Court directions to vaccinate stray dogs per the Animal Welfare Board of India’s SOPs. Officials at the signing included Prajakta Verma-Lavangare and Municipal Commissioner Ashwini Bhide, with Dr. Kalimpasha Pathan and Dr. Balaji Chandrasekhar participating.

CDC notes Ebola viruses can be fatal up to 90% without treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 数字で見る:今年のエボラ流行は史上最悪のケースよりも速いペースで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ流行は、致死率約40%、2ヶ月余りで1,000人死亡という過去最速のペースで拡大しており、承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、ピークはまだ先の可能性がある重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事項である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUnited States、Sierra Leone、Liberia、Uganda、Guineaが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較文脈で言及されているのみで、今回の流行の主題ではないため除外した。今回の流行はDRC東部5州に限定されている（ただしウガンダ国境付近）。ワクチン・治療法が未承認のブンディブギョウ変異株であることが特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: У ДРК ў выніку ўспышкі ліхаманкі Эбола памерлі больш за тысячу чалавек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, more than a thousand people died as a result of an Ebola fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has killed more than 1,031 people, with 2,473 cases reported in the DRC and about 737 patients in isolation or receiving care. The World Health Organization considers this the third-largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history. The flare-up began May 15 in eastern DRC and Uganda, with Ituri province in the DRC as the main transmission hub. Ongoing challenges include shortages of vaccines, medicines, and funding for response efforts. Oxford University has begun the first-ever clinical trials of a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of the viruses behind the current outbreak, late last week.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱の流行により1000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行であり、死者1000人以上・症例2473件、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOはこれをDRC史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行と位置付けており、ワクチン・医薬品・資金の不足が課題として挙げられている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll passes 1,000 as outbreak shows no signs of slowing
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, Ebola in north‑eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province, has surpassed 1,000 deaths with 1,033 fatalities among 2,536 confirmed cases. About 738 patients remain in isolation or hospitalised as daily deaths rise to roughly 30–40, highlighting a fast-spreading outbreak that may outpace containment. The strain is Bundibugjo Ebola, for which there is no vaccine, and initial detection was hampered by a lack of testing kits, allowing weeks of undetected spread. The response by the DRC government, World Health Organization, and aid groups faces challenges from conflict‑driven weak surveillance, a highly mobile, densely populated urban setting, and local distrust toward outsiders and health workers. Ongoing funding shortfalls, including cuts by the U.S. administration and some donors, risk limiting future control efforts and outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数が1,000人を突破、流行に収束の兆しなし
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ワクチンなしのブンディブギョ株）が2,500人以上の感染者・1,000人超の死者を出し、拡大が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチンが存在しないブンディブギョ株であること、都市部での高い人口密度・住民の不信感・資金不足が拡大リスクを増大させている点に注意。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Região Sul concentra maior número de casos de raiva animal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Southern Region accounts for the largest number of animal rabies cases.
article.articleSummary: Southern Region (Região Sul) of Santa Catarina accounts for the largest number of animal rabies cases in the state, triggering a health alert for authorities and the public. Rabies is a viral zoonosis affecting mammals and can be transmitted to humans through bites or contact with infected saliva. The report emphasizes preventive actions, including vaccination of dogs and cats and taking precautions when in contact with wildlife or suspected animals. The regional concentration underscores ongoing transmission risk in the southern part of the state, highlighting the need for vigilance by residents and pet owners. No specific case counts are provided, but the emphasis on vaccination and preventive contact measures signals a continued public health concern regarding animal rabies in this area.

triage.headline_ja: 南部地域、動物狂犬病の症例数が州内最多
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州で動物狂犬病の集中発生が報告されているが、具体的な症例数やヒトへの感染事例は不明であり、地域的な風土病的性格が強いため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 動物間での狂犬病流行が主体で、ヒト症例の具体的報告はなし。地域の風土病的性格が強く、国際的拡大リスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Le bilan de l'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse les 1.000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak surpasses 1,000.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has climbed to 1,001 deaths, according to the World Health Organization. In the DRC, the epicenter, the tally reports 999 deaths and 2,473 confirmed cases as of July 20, 2026. In Uganda, authorities report 2 deaths among 20 confirmed cases, and say there are no active patients remaining. The DRC notes 47 affected health zones across five provinces, with no new zones added. The outbreak, declared on May 15, 2026, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. These figures reflect ongoing transmission in the region, with Uganda’s cluster significantly smaller than the dynamics in the DRC. The report does not provide further details on infection sources or import/export cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、死者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにまたがるエボラ出血熱の流行で死者が1,000人を超え、47の保健区域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOが集計・報告している大規模流行であり、既にフルRRA相当の対応が進んでいる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-virus verspreidt zich snel in Congo, duizend mensen overleden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus spreading rapidly in Congo, a thousand people have died.
article.articleSummary: On 23 July 2026, Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 1,000 deaths, including children. Health experts report many cases where the infection source is unknown, complicating containment and allowing transmission to outpace aid efforts. The outbreak has reached neighboring Uganda, where people are also sick and have died. The article notes that the likelihood of Ebola spreading to Europe is very small, but authorities fear continued spread within Africa if not quickly halted. The report underscores the lack of clarity on transmission chains and the escalating mortality toll as responders struggle to trace infections and implement control measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴで急速に拡大、1000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで1000人以上の死者を出し、感染源不明の症例が多発、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事内で言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染源不明の症例が多く、伝播チェーンの追跡が困難な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: В ДРК в результате вспышки лихорадки Эбола умерло больше тысячи человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, more than a thousand people died as a result of an Ebola fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: 2,473 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 1,031 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with about 737 patients in isolation or under treatment, according to the health ministry and Africa CDC. The outbreak began May 15 in eastern DRC and Uganda, with Ituri Province as the main transmission hotspot. The WHO regards this as the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Vaccination efforts are hampered by shortages of vaccines, medicines, and funding. Oxford University has initiated the first-in-the-world clinical trials of a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of the virus species responsible for this outbreak, signaling a major development in response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行により1000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(2473症例、1031死亡)で、WHOが史上3番目の規模と評価するなど深刻な公衆衛生インパクトと国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれるが、対象国リストに存在しないため除外。ワクチン・医薬品・資金不足により対応が困難な状況で、国際支援が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Salgın büyüyor, dünya izliyor: Kongo'da ebola bilançosu ağırlaşıyor! Ölü sayısı bini, vaka sayısı 2 bini aşmış durumda...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The outbreak is growing, the world is watching: In Congo, the Ebola toll is worsening! The death toll has reached one thousand, the number of cases has surpassed two thousand...
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Ituri Province, began May 15, driven by the Bundibugyo variant with no approved vaccine or therapy. Latest official data show 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, with 738 patients under treatment or isolation. Initial reports included 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths; authorities warn the fatality rate for this variant is about 40.7%. The World Health Organization declared an International Public Health Emergency on May 17. Ebola, a hemorrhagic fever virus first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC, is named after the Ebola River. Context includes Africa’s recurring burden: the 2013–2017 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) caused roughly 30,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths, underscoring the need for urgent international response.

triage.headline_ja: 感染拡大、世界が注視:コンゴでエボラの被害が深刻化!死者数は千人、感染者数は2千人を超えた…
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)が大規模流行しWHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。致死率約40.7%、死者1,033人・感染者2,536人と深刻な被害が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはSudan/Sierra Leone/Angola/Liberia/Burundi/Guineaなど多数含まれるが、これらは歴史的背景・過去の流行事例として言及されているのみで、現行の流行地域はDRC(イトゥリ州)のみ。WHOは既にPHEICを宣言済みであり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Two Rajasthan girls die of Chandipura virus
article.articleSummary: Two Rajasthan girls died in Gujarat after testing positive for Chandipura virus. A 6-year-old girl from Dungarpur district's Ratanpura village died while undergoing treatment at Civil Hospital in Himmatnagar, and a 2-year-old girl from Sirohi district died during treatment in Banaskantha district. Rajasthan health authorities report three suspected or confirmed Chandipura virus cases to date, including these fatalities. Surveillance has been intensified in Dungarpur, Sirohi and Udaipur; screening of 75 houses in Ratanpura found no suspected cases so far, and confirmatory test results for the 6-year-old are awaited. Rapid response teams are checking children for fever, vomiting, seizures and altered consciousness—symptoms consistent with acute encephalitis-like illness. Prevention measures, including fogging, involve animal husbandry officials. Chandipura virus is transmitted by infected sandflies and can cause severe illness in children.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州の少女2人がチャンディプラウイルスで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 小児における脳炎様疾患（チャンディプラウイルス）による複数死亡例が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と稀少・予期しない病原体という点でIHR基準を2つ満たすため。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介の脳炎ウイルスで、インドでは過去にも小児の集団発生・死亡例が報告されている。現時点では地域限定的だが、サーベイランス強化中であり続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв вспышки Эболы в ДР Конго превысило тысячу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed one thousand.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s eastern Ituri province, the Ebola outbreak has 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, with 738 people in isolation or under treatment. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccines or therapies exist, and the case fatality rate is 40.7%. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Initial reports noted 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths in Ituri. Ebola, a hemorrhagic fever, was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River at Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC. The 2013–2017 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) infected about 30,000 people with over 11,000 deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Diagnostic validity of ELISA-IgM, DPP® rapid test, and MAT for leptospirosis diagnosis in Brazilian reference laboratories: a latent class analysis
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis diagnosis in Brazil assessed via latent class analysis of ELISA-IgM, DPP Leptospirosis rapid test, and MAT using 430 samples from reference laboratories across four Brazilian states. In a two-stage approach, 215 samples formed the infected/not infected latent classes, guiding accuracy estimates for the remaining 215. ELISA-IgM achieved 100% sensitivity but only 48.62% specificity. MAT showed high specificity at 97.25% with 69.81% sensitivity. The DPP rapid test offered balanced performance with 82.08% sensitivity and 90.83% specificity. Findings support combining tests to optimize leptospirosis detection, highlight rapid testing's role in settings with limited laboratory infrastructure, and underscore the need to improve current assay accuracy.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル参照検査室におけるレプトスピラ症診断のためのELISA-IgM、DPP®迅速検査、MATの診断妥当性：潜在クラス分析
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断検査法の精度評価に関する研究報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を扱うものではない。
triage.notes: この記事は診断法の精度検証に関する学術研究であり、疾病発生や流行状況を報告するものではないため、地域は特定の発生事例と関連付けられない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo-Ebola : la riposte contre Ebola n'est pas piétinée, affirme la Première ministre Judith Suminwa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo-Ebola: the Ebola response is not being trampled on, says Prime Minister Judith Suminwa - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo, on July 23, 2026, Prime Minister Judith Suminwa stated that the Ebola response in Tshopo province’s 17th outbreak is advancing normally. Five imported Ebola cases have been recorded in Tshopo, with response teams having traced nearly all contacts currently under surveillance. The Prime Minister credited collaboration between national health authorities, the provincial health division, and technical partners for the progress, highlighting rapid contact identification as a key indicator of the surveillance system’s effectiveness. While vigilance remains essential, she praised frontline health workers deployed in Kisangani for their efforts to limit transmission and bolster community trust in interventions. The statement underscores ongoing efforts to contain the outbreak in northeastern DRC and the importance of maintaining robust case finding and contact tracing to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ・エボラ：エボラ対応は停滞していない、とスミンワ首相が表明 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の第17次アウトブレイクであり、致死率の高い感染症の継続的発生・接触者追跡が行われているためIHR基準に複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は首相による公式声明で、Tshopo州における第17次エボラアウトブレイクの対応状況（5例の輸入例、接触者追跡進行中）を報告。エボラは既知の高致死性・ヒトヒト感染症であり、国境地域での発生歴もあることから国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'engagement communautaire demeure la clé de la riposte (Professeur Steve Ahuka) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: community engagement remains the key to the response (Professor Steve Ahuka) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri (Bunia) with spillover to Beni; as of July 23, 2026, the response emphasizes community engagement as the primary strategy. New incident manager Steve Ahuka says success hinges on understanding and active participation of communities, involving community leaders, religious heads, local associations, and moto-taxi drivers to strengthen prevention and awareness. In areas reporting multiple community deaths, response teams are reinforcing local capacities to recognize suspected cases and to conduct dignified, safe burials, while bolstering health zones to improve interventions around cases. While no specific Ebola treatment is yet approved, over 300 people have recovered through symptomatic care. Trials ongoing for candidate therapeutics and vaccines; more than ten people have received experimental treatments after consent. The mission continues until the outbreak is fully controlled; trust and collaboration with authorities remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:地域社会の関与が対応の鍵であり続ける(ステーブ・アフカ教授) - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部(イトゥリ州ブニア、ベニへの波及)で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、複数のコミュニティ内死亡例が報告され、実験的治療・ワクチン投与が行われている高致死性疾患であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的拡大リスクを内包する疾患であり、コミュニティレベルでの死亡例報告や実験的治療薬・ワクチン投与が継続している点から、既知の進行中アウトブレイクとしてフルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : le transport des dépouilles désormais soumis à une autorisation sanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: the transport of remains is now subject to a health authorization.
article.articleSummary: Beni, North Kivu, Ebola’s 17th outbreak, with authorities tightening corpse transport controls: the mayor of Beni and senior commissioner Nyofondo Te-Kodale Jacob announced a strict prohibition on moving a body without prior health authorization. All corpses must be deposited at the morgue to complete administrative formalities and organize funerals under sanitary measures. Transport between locations requires an authorization signed by the chief physician of the relevant health zone. The measures, part of the May 27, 2026 provincial decree addressing the Ebola response in North Kivu, obligate checkpoint officers to enforce compliance, with heavy sanctions for violators. The move follows a resurgence of transmission; a July 22 epidemiological bulletin reports 18 new confirmed cases and six deaths within 24 hours.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ出血熱：遺体の搬送に衛生当局の許可が必要に
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで進行中のエボラ第17次流行における新規感染再燃（24時間で新規確定18例・死亡6例）が確認され、当局が遺体搬送規制を強化しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: エボラ第17次流行の再燃を示す新規症例・死亡者数の急増が報告されており、地方当局は遺体搬送に関する衛生許可制度を導入。国際支援の要否については記事内に明記なし。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Co-Pilot kollabiert auf British-Airways-Flug: Komplette Cockpit-Besatzung bekommt auf Flug aus Indien Magen-Darm-Probleme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Co-pilot collapses on a British Airways flight: The entire cockpit crew experiences gastrointestinal problems on a flight from India.
article.articleSummary: Three pilots on a British Airways flight BA276 from Hyderabad, India to London Heathrow suffered gastrointestinal illness during a ten-hour flight, with the co-pilot collapsing and requiring oxygen; the other two pilots continued in service though their condition worsened, and the aircraft landed safely in London. The cause is under investigation, with the crew reportedly sharing a hotel breakfast before departure, raising concerns about hotel hygiene. In Hyderabad, tap water is not potable and ice often uses untreated water, and during the monsoon season there are rising reports of cholera and typhus; incidences of E. coli and Salmonella food poisoning are noted as general risks in the region. The airline has launched a rapid probe and is considering alternative hotel options in Hyderabad.

triage.headline_ja: 副操縦士がブリティッシュ・エアウェイズ機内で倒れる：インド発便でコックピット乗員全員が胃腸障害を発症
triage.triage_reason: 航空機乗員3名の急性胃腸炎という孤立した事例であり、直接的な公衆衛生上の重大事案とは言えないが、記事内でハイデラバードにおけるモンスーン期のコレラ・チフス報告増加に言及されており、地域の水系感染症動向として要観察。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題は航空乗員の食中毒事案であり、ハイデラバードの水衛生問題・モンスーン期の感染症増加は背景情報として言及されているのみ。具体的な症例数・発生状況の続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Penajam Paser Utara Menurun, Dinkes Perketat Pengawasan di IKN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of dengue fever in North Penajam Paser Regency decline; Health Department tightens surveillance in IKN.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in North Penajam Paser Regency (PPU), Indonesia, declined to 113 as of July 2026, with an annual target of under 200. This follows 348 cases in 2025 and a 2024 peak of 1,484. Sepaku District reports the highest burden with 35 cases, including 27 hospitalized at RSUD Sepaku, of which 24 are workers in the Ibukota Nusantara (IKN) project. Other localities: Penajam 23, Babulu 10, Waru 2; RSUD Ratu Aji Putri Botung PPU has 40 inpatients. In response to high mobility around IKN, Dinkes PPU is training safety and medical teams across all IKN project segments, focusing on larval habitat recognition and larvicide distribution, in collaboration with the IKN Authority. Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN) remains the most effective dengue control; the dry season prompts open-water storage that fosters Aedes aegypti. Most cases are among working-age adults, with some children; residents are urged to keep water containers closed to prevent larvae.

triage.headline_ja: 北ペナジャン・パセール県のデング熱症例が減少、IKNでは保健局が監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例は減少傾向にあり、地域の風土病として例年通りの発生状況であるため、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: デング熱は当該地域で季節性・地域性の風土病であり、症例数は前年・前々年より減少傾向。IKN建設労働者の集団感染がやや懸念点だが、地元保健局が既に対応（幼虫対策、PSN活動）しており管理可能な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 522 Kelompok Usia Sekolah di Sidoarjo Terpapar HIV, Dinkes Buka Suara - merdeka.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 522 School-Age Groups in Sidoarjo Exposed to HIV, Health Office Speaks Out
article.articleSummary: HIV in Sidoarjo Regency, East Java, involves 522 school-age individuals living with HIV (ODHIV) as of 1 July 2026, out of 7,129 ODHIV registered in the district. The breakdown includes 13 in PAUD/TK, 44 in SD–SMP, and 465 in SMA–university. Transmission routes comprise mother-to-child, injection-drug use, and high-risk sexual activity. Health authorities stress that 522 is a cumulative age-based count, not the number of actively enrolled students currently living with HIV. Among ages 11–17, there are 60 cumulative cases since 2001 to June 2026, with 7 deaths and 53 living under care. Among ages 0–10, 117 cases, 35 deaths, 50 lost to follow-up, and 32 on antiretroviral therapy. Cumulatively, Sidoarjo has 7,230 HIV cases since 2001, with 1,708 deaths and 810 lost to follow-up. ARV adherence is vital to suppress viral load and reduce transmission; ongoing education and stigma reduction are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: スィドアルジョの学齢期522人がHIVに感染、保健局が説明
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の風土病であり、本記事は累積統計データの公表に過ぎず、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、累積症例の年齢別内訳を公表した地方保健局の通常業務報告。新規発生や異常事態ではないため対象国リストに該当しても除外扱いとした。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : un établissement public de santé favorable à la sensibilisation contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: a public health facility supportive of Ebola awareness campaigns - ACP
article.articleSummary: An establishment in Kisangani, Tshopo, DRC, that supports health mutuals endorses Ebola awareness campaigns. Prof. Franck Bokula, provincial director of the Public Interest Establishment for Technical Support to Health Mutuals (EUP-ATMS), said Ebola outbreaks cannot be ignored even as the unit also focuses on other health issues, and urged strict adherence to protective measures to limit transmission. The service has not halted its work and is currently prioritizing public education on sanitary precautions wherever people are, to curb the disease that has been active in Kisangani since early July. The agency’s mission includes surveillance of other diseases, and provincial authorities have supplied handwashing stations as institutional support for Ebola response. The report emphasizes ongoing awareness efforts and coordination with authorities in the RDC to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:ある公的医療機関がエボラ啓発活動を支援
triage.triage_reason: DRCキサンガニで7月初旬からエボラ出血熱の発生が継続しており、公衆衛生上重大な影響とヒト-ヒト感染の流行可能性がある感染症であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事自体は啓発活動に関する内容だが、キサンガニで7月初旬からエボラ発生が継続中であることを示唆しており、既存アウトブレイクの状況確認としてフルRRA対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: India's First Dengue Vaccine: A Milestone Against A Growing Threat
article.articleSummary: India’s drug regulator approved Takeda’s Qdenga (TAK-003), the country’s first dengue vaccine, for ages 4–60 in a two-dose schedule three months apart, without pre-vaccination testing. Dengue (DENV-1 to DENV-4) is rising in India, with outbreaks in Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru as thousands of cases are reported in early 2026; urbanisation, climate change and Aedes vectors drive transmission. In the Phase 3 TIDES trial across dengue-endemic Latin America and Asia, Qdenga showed 61.2% efficacy against virologically confirmed dengue and 84.1% against hospitalisations about 4.5 years after the second dose, with durability to seven years and protection across serotypes, including seronegative individuals. Local manufacturing via Hyderabad-based Biological E Limited underpins Make in India; rollout is planned for the first half of 2027. WHO endorses use in high-burden settings, and the vaccine is approved in >40 countries. Deployment will combine vaccination with vector control and surveillance, with post-marketing monitoring for real-world effectiveness and access challenges.

triage.headline_ja: インドで初のデング熱ワクチンが承認 ― 拡大する脅威への画期的対応
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドで流行が拡大しているが、記事の主眼はワクチン承認という前向きな公衆衛生施策であり、突発的・異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱ワクチン(Qdenga)のインドでの承認と2027年前半の展開計画に関する内容が中心。デリー・ムンバイ・ベンガルールでの症例増加が言及されているが、具体的な重症度や異常性を示す情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode aumentar os casos de dengue e chikungunya, alerta Ministério da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño could increase dengue and chikungunya cases, warns the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: El Niño could raise dengue and chikungunya transmission in Brazil, the Ministry of Health warns. Warmer temperatures and altered rainfall could boost Aedes aegypti breeding and increase standing water in containers. WMO/OMM and Inmet project moderate-to-strong El Niño from the second half of 2026. The Ministry advises strengthening epidemiological surveillance, blocking transmission at initial cases, reorganizing vector-control teams, employing recommended vector-control technologies, and expanding public-awareness campaigns; population participation to remove water-holding containers is essential. Projections by InfoDengue/Fiocruz estimate about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027 if the El Niño scenario materializes, though these are model-based estimates. In 2026, dengue and chikungunya cases are declining: by June 20, Brazil recorded 392,800 dengue cases (down 73% vs 2025) and a 46% drop in chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがデング熱とチクングニア熱の症例を増加させる可能性、保健省が警告
triage.triage_reason: 現時点ではデング熱・チクングニア熱の症例は前年比で大幅減少しており急性の公衆衛生上の脅威はないが、エルニーニョによる将来的な症例増加予測が示されており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は将来予測（2027年推計1.7万件超）に基づく注意喚起であり、2026年時点では症例数は減少傾向。気候要因によるベクター媒介感染症リスクの季節的注意喚起として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Nagpur Confirms First H1N1 Death Of 2026 As Swine Flu Cases Surge: When Should You Seek Medical Help For Flu Symptoms?
article.articleSummary: Nagpur reports first confirmed H1N1 death of 2026 as swine flu cases surge; July accounts for >60% of H1N1 cases this year. So far, 25 laboratory-confirmed H1N1 infections, with 15 in July and 13 within Nagpur Municipal Corporation limits. One July death confirmed due to Influenza A (H1N1); a second death was unrelated to the virus due to pre-existing illnesses. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body aches, fatigue and headache; severe breathlessness may occur. High-risk groups include adults ≥65, pregnant women, children under five, and people with diabetes, heart, lung or kidney disease, or weakened immunity. Public health actions: intensified surveillance and awareness campaigns with emphasis on early diagnosis and treatment. Preventive measures: hand hygiene, masks, avoiding close contact, staying home when fever or respiratory symptoms occur. Monsoon season favors spread; seek medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ナグプールで2026年初のH1N1死亡例を確認、豚インフルエンザ症例が急増：インフルエンザ症状で医療機関を受診すべきタイミングとは
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザによる局地的な症例増加・死亡例だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、既知の季節性疾患としてサーベイランス対応中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ナグプール（マハラシュトラ州）における季節性H1N1インフルエンザの局地的増加。25例確認、1死亡（もう1例は基礎疾患による死亡でH1N1関連ではない）。モンスーン季節による感染拡大の可能性があり、当局はサーベイランス強化と啓発活動を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 50 millions USD du gouvernement pour intensifier la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: US$50 million from the government to intensify the response.
article.articleSummary: On July 23, 2026, in Kisangani, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's government unveiled $50 million to intensify the nationwide Ebola response. Prime Minister Judith Suminwa announced the fund to support rapid, coordinated action across the country as the outbreak evolves. The money targets key response pillars: enhanced epidemiological surveillance, care for infected individuals, vaccination campaigns, logistics, and prevention and community awareness activities. Technical and financial partners have mobilized substantial resources to back government efforts. Authorities are coordinating disbursements to ensure efficient use of funds and aligned operational priorities. Priorities highlighted include strengthening surveillance capacities, vaccinating at-risk populations, and community sensitization, with the aim of accelerating containment and protecting affected regions, notably within Kisangani and the broader Greater Orientale region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：政府が対応強化のため5000万米ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の全国的な流行が継続しており、政府が大規模資金を投入して対応を強化していることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はキサンガニ及びグレーター・オリエンタル地域を中心とした全国的なエボラ対応強化を報じており、既存のアウトブレイクへの追加対応措置と考えられる。感染者数・死亡者数等の具体的疫学データは記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode aumentar casos de chikungunya e dengue no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño may increase Chikungunya and dengue cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: El Niño is expected to manifest moderately to strongly from the second half of 2026, promoting Aedes aegypti proliferation in Brazil and potentially increasing dengue and Chikungunya transmission. The Ministry of Health issued a technical note warning states and municipalities about rising arboviruses, with InfoDengue/Fiocruz projecting about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027. Warmer temperatures and more rainfall in certain areas raise standing-water habitats, boosting vector breeding. Recommendations include intensified surveillance and control by states and municipalities, rapid transmission blocking after the first cases, restructuring vector-control tasks, and deployment of vector-control technologies. Public vigilance for home breeding sites and awareness of symptoms are urged. Estimates are epidemiological and subject to update. As of June 20, 2026, Brazil reported 392,800 dengue cases (down 73% YoY) and a 46% reduction in Chikungunya cases.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがブラジルのチクングニア熱・デング熱症例を増加させる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 現時点ではデング熱・チクングニア熱の症例数は前年比で減少しているが、エルニーニョによる将来的な蚊媒介感染症増加の懸念から保健省が注意喚起を発出しており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は将来予測に基づく技術的注意喚起であり、現状データ（2026年6月時点）ではデング熱392,800例（前年比73%減）、チクングニア熱46%減と減少傾向。エルニーニョによる将来的な増加リスクへの備えを促す内容。

article.articleHeadline: जमशेदपुर के पोटका में ब्रेन मलेरिया पर लग रहा अंकुश, 24 शिविरों में 1503 लोगों की हुई जांच; 13 संक्रमित मिले - potka brain malaria control 13 cases found in 1503 tests
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cerebral malaria being curbed in Potka, Jamshedpur; 1,503 people tested in 24 camps; 13 infected.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, cerebral malaria is being curbed in Potka, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand. A district health drive screened 1,503 people across 24 camps, with 13 testing positive for malaria. All infections are being treated at the village level to prevent further transmission. Dr. Sukant Seat, Chief Medical Officer, said the pace of testing would be intensified in coming days. The health department is maintaining continuous screening, timely treatment, drug distribution, and public awareness campaigns in malaria-affected areas, with the aim of effective control and eventual eradication of cerebral malaria. Residents are urged to seek immediate testing for fever or malaria-like symptoms and to use mosquito nets regularly. The report highlights ongoing community-based surveillance and local treatment efforts to curb transmission and protect nearby communities.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプル・ポトカで脳マラリア対策強化、24キャンプで1503人検査し13人感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定的なマラリア発生で既存の保健当局による管理下にあり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: マラリアは同地域で地方病的に発生しており、地元保健当局が通常の対応（検査・治療・啓発）を実施中。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola à Butembo: trois ambulances remises à deux zones de santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response in Butembo: three ambulances handed over to two health zones - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Three ambulances were handed over to strengthen the Ebola response in the Katwa and Butembo health zones, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Supplied by the national Ebola response coordination, the vehicles are to be used exclusively for evacuating Ebola patients to prevent mixing with non-Ebola illnesses. Prisca Luanda, provincial health coordinator, highlighted the acute need and pledged ongoing advocacy at national and provincial levels to boost ambulance capacity. The handover was received by the incident manager and the provincial health division chief for onward distribution to the zones’ beneficiaries. Dr. Pablo Lwanzo and Dr. Les Mukoko Kambale, zone medical chiefs, promised proper use for patient referral and transport. Ebola cases caused by the Bundibugyo strain continue to rise in Butembo, with 131 cases in the Katwa health zone and 61 in Butembo.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボでのエボラ対応：2つの保健地域に救急車3台が引き渡される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でBundibugyo株によるエボラ感染が継続的に増加しており（Katwa131例、Butembo61例）、重篤な感染症の継続的発生であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）に関する対応強化の報告。症例数が具体的に示されており（計192例）、継続的な感染拡大が懸念される。救急車配備など国際支援の必要性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Judith Suminwa passe en première ligne dans la riposte de terrain !
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola - Judith Suminwa takes to the front line in the field response!
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak triggers a high-level mission led by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka to Kisangani (Tshopo) and to Bunia, Mungwalu, and Rwampara in Ituri, to reinforce the response. On 23 July 2026, Suminwa will head a joint high-level mission in Kisangani, then Bunia, Mungwalu and Rwampara, epicenter of the outbreak, accompanied by US representatives, UN system, and key partners. The aims are to reaffirm government leadership, strengthen coordination with technical and financial partners, and enable senior decision-makers to assess field realities to consolidate prevention, surveillance, and care for affected populations. The government seeks to remain close to affected communities and frontline health workers, praising their dedication and courage to contain the outbreak and save lives. This approach signals intensified efforts to master the outbreak, protect populations, and bolster long-term health security in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱 - ジュディス・スミンワ首相、現地対応の最前線に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中であり、首相自らが現地対応強化のため訪問するなど政府・国際機関の関与が高く、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクのある事象であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はKisangani(Tshopo)、Bunia・Mungwalu・Rwampara(Ituri)など、DRC国内のエボラ流行地における首相主導の対応強化に焦点を当てている。Kigali Province（ルワンダ）も発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及されておらず対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode aumentar casos de chikungunya e dengue no Brasil - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño could increase Chikungunya and dengue cases in Brazil - Tribuna do Norte.
article.articleSummary: El Niño could manifest as moderate to strong from the second half of this year, increasing Aedes aegypti breeding across Brazil, per INMET. In response, the Ministry of Health issued a technical note to alert states and municipalities about rising arboviruses, notably dengue and Chikungunya. Projections from InfoDengue/Fiocruz estimate about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027. Higher temperatures and more rainfall in parts of the country promote water accumulation and vector habitats. The ministry recommends intensified surveillance and control by states and municipalities, rapid transmission-blocking after initial cases, realignment of vector-control agent tasks, and use of Ministry-endorsed vector-control technologies. The public should monitor for home mosquito breeding sites and watch for symptoms. Projections are epidemiological and may be updated. As of 20 June 2026, Brazil had 392,800 dengue cases (−73% YoY) and chikungunya down 46%.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがブラジルのチクングニア熱・デング熱症例を増加させる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 現時点でのデング熱・チクングニア熱症例数は前年比で大幅減少しており緊急性は低いが、エルニーニョによる将来的な媒介蚊増加と症例急増の可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はエルニーニョによる将来的なアルボウイルス感染症増加への予防的注意喚起であり、現在の症例数（2026年6月時点でデング熱392,800件、前年比-73%、チクングニア-46%）は減少傾向にある。将来予測（2027年に約170万件のデング熱症例）に基づく保健省の技術通知が発出されている点は政府の関心の高さを示すが、現時点で緊急のシグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo y Uganda enfrentan un devastador brote de ébola que ya ha cobrado más de 1.000 vidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo and Uganda face a devastating Ebola outbreak that has already claimed more than 1,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: As of July 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by the Bundibugyo virus, has reached 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, with about 738 patients currently in isolation or hospital care. Declared May 15, the outbreak is centered in Ituri province, which accounts for roughly 90% of transmissions, with additional cases in Kisangani and five provinces, and spillover into neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization reports the global risk remains low, though Congo faces a 'very high' internal risk and Uganda a high risk. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; no vaccine or approved treatment exists, though clinical trials are ongoing and may take months. In Uganda, 20 cases (including 2 deaths) are linked to Congo; no new Ugandan cases since June 21. Community mistrust and regional conflict hinder response, complicating surveillance and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダ、既に1,000人以上の死者を出した壊滅的なエボラ出血熱の流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を複数満たす大規模エボラ流行（死者1,033人、感染2,536人）で国境を越えてウガンダにも拡大しており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、感染拡大先として重要な情報。地域紛争とコミュニティの不信感が対応を困難にしている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo-Ebola : 50 millions USD pour la riposte nationale mobilisés par le Gouvernement congolais - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo-Ebola: 50 million USD mobilized by the Congolese Government for the national response - ACP
article.articleSummary: US$50 million has been mobilized by the Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster the national response to Ebola virus disease, announced by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province in northeastern DRC, on July 23, 2026. The funding, complemented by substantial resources from technical and financial partners, targets a rapid, coordinated response as the outbreak evolves. Allocations will strengthen epidemiological surveillance, patient care, vaccination campaigns, logistics, and prevention and awareness activities across the country. The Prime Minister emphasised readiness to provide necessary support to response teams to improve intervention effectiveness in affected zones. The mission underscores government leadership, enhanced coordination with partners, and ensuring decision-makers can assess field realities to consolidate prevention, surveillance, and patient management efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ツショポ州エボラ:コンゴ政府が国内対応のため5000万米ドルを動員
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、政府が大規模な資金と体制を動員していることから社会的・政治的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国ツショポ州でのエボラ流行に対し、政府が国家レベルでの対応強化を発表。感染規模・症例数など詳細情報は本文に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: The nurse in DR Congo battling Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo's Ituri province, centered in Mongbwalu, is claiming healthcare workers' lives. Nurse Grace Kakure reports five colleagues contracting Ebola at work and dying, amid fear and months without pay. With roughly 20 medical workers dead in Ituri, staff are appealing for hazard pay and stronger government support while continuing to treat patients. Kakure recalls the outbreak was declared late, leaving facilities exposed and under-equipped and contributing to patients avoiding hospitals due to fear. The article portrays the ongoing outbreak and frontline perseverance, highlighting the human cost among health workers and the need for safer conditions and resources to sustain care in Mongbwalu and Ituri more broadly.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱と闘う看護師
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的流行で医療従事者に多数の死者が出ており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と管理体制の不備が確認されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はイトゥリ州モングバルワにおけるエボラ流行の継続を報じており、医療従事者約20名が死亡、感染対策・給与未払いなど医療体制の脆弱性が指摘されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限については言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño eleva risco de surto de dengue e chikungunya no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño raises the risk of dengue and chikungunya outbreaks in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and chikungunya outbreaks may intensify in Brazil as El Niño strengthens, with the Ministry of Health issuing guidance to bolster surveillance and control. Warmer temperatures and rainfall boost Aedes aegypti breeding, increasing transmission risk. Fiocruz’s InfoDengue projects about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027 if conditions favor vector expansion. The 81% probability of a very strong El Niño by late 2026 underscores the need for a coordinated government response to prevent a major health crisis. Key measures include rapid transmission blocking after first suspected cases, restructuring vector-control activities, deployment of validated tools, and public participation to eliminate breeding sites in yards, plant pots, and gutters. As of 20 June 2026, Brazil had 392,800 dengue cases (-73% YoY) and chikungunya declined 46%, with models continually updated and monitoring essential.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがブラジルにおけるデング熱・チクングニア熱流行のリスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: 現時点でデング熱・チクングニア熱の症例数は前年比大幅減少しているが、エルニーニョ現象による将来的な媒介蚊増加と流行拡大の可能性が指摘されており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性・気候要因（エルニーニョ）による将来予測に基づく注意喚起であり、現状のデータ（2026年6月時点で前年比-73%）は流行拡大を示していない。ブラジル保健省による監視体制強化の呼びかけが中心。

article.articleHeadline: Encontrou um morcego? Saiba o que fazer para evitar o risco de raiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Found a bat? Find out what to do to avoid the risk of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in bats confirmed in Sorocaba, Brazil, with an infected bat found in Vila Hortência and another incident where a bat fell into a residence, prompting collection by Zoonoses. Rabies is a viral disease that attacks the nervous system and can be transmitted to humans and animals via bat saliva, mainly through bites, scratches, or licking, requiring prompt care. Zoonoses advises against touching or capturing bats; isolate the area, keep people and pets away, and call the specialized service for removal. If contact occurs, wash the site with soap and water and seek medical attention immediately; if the contact involves a dog or cat, inform Zoonoses and seek veterinary guidance. Beyond Sorocaba, Jundiaí reported three bat rabies cases in 2026, underscoring vaccination of dogs and cats. Zoonoses: (15) 3229-7333 for bat collection or guidance. Follow on Instagram and WhatsApp for updates.

triage.headline_ja: コウモリを見つけたら？狂犬病のリスクを避けるための対処法
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおける狂犬病感染事例であり、人への感染例は報告されておらず、既知の啓発情報の域を出ないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 動物（コウモリ）における狂犬病確認と一般市民向け注意喚起の記事であり、ヒトへの感染事例の報告はない。地域の動物衛生当局（Zoonoses）による通常の対応範囲内の事案。

article.articleHeadline: Chuvas aumentam risco de leptospirose; Paraná registra 170 casos e 12 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rains increase the risk of leptospirosis; Paraná records 170 cases and 12 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreak risk rises with rains in Paraná, Brazil. From January through June 2026, Paraná reported 170 confirmed cases, 839 notifications, 47 investigations, and 12 deaths. The disease is caused by Leptospira bacteria, predominantly found in rat urine; in flooded areas the bacteria contaminate water and mud and infection occurs when exposed skin or mucous membranes contact contaminated material. The Secretaria de Estado da Saúde (Sesa) urges heightened precautions in flood zones: avoid direct contact with floodwater; wear boots and waterproof gloves; if protective gear is unavailable, use plastic bags to shield hands and feet. Typical symptoms appear 5–14 days after exposure (up to 30 days) and include high fever, headache, muscle pain (notably calves), nausea, vomiting, jaundice, and diarrhea. Preventive steps include securing household waste, keeping yards clean, storing food in closed containers, drinking treated water, keeping water tanks sealed, and washing promptly after floodwater contact.

triage.headline_ja: 雨によりレプトスピラ症のリスク上昇、パラナ州で170例・12人死亡
triage.triage_reason: パラナ州における季節性（雨季）のレプトスピラ症増加であり、例年見られる地方衛生当局の注意喚起の範囲内で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は雨季に毎年発生する風土病であり、動物由来（ネズミの尿）でヒト-ヒト感染はない。州保健局が予防策を呼びかけている段階で、外部支援の必要性や国際的懸念は現時点で確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 2 536 cas comptés, un bilan réel deux à quatre fois supérieur selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 2,536 cases counted, the real toll is two to four times higher according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Situation Report No. 068 (INSP) fixes the 17th outbreak at 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths (40.7% lethality) as of July 21. The WHO cautions this is a floor, with modelling placing true infections at two to four times higher (about 5,000–10,000). Most undetected deaths occur at home and transmissions arise outside standard contact lists. Ituri Province remains the epicenter, about 90% of cases, where care is hard to reach and funeral rites may fuel spread. Tracing covers roughly 82% of contacts, yet 80% of new cases come from unknown chains. WHO urges earlier detection, rapid treatment, and mapping routes into Haut-Uélé and Tshopo. There is no approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; several candidates are in clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：確認症例2,536例、WHOによれば実際の被害は2〜4倍に上る可能性
triage.triage_reason: 致死率40.7%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、WHOが実際の症例・死者数は報告の2〜4倍と警告しており、感染経路不明の新規症例が8割を占めるなど拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 感染源不明の新規症例が80%を占め、Ituri州が震源地（全体の約90%）。Haut-Uélé州・Tshopo州への拡大が懸念されており、承認された治療法がない点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo: une commission pour un plan d'urgence à Katwa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: a commission for an emergency plan in Katwa - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola responses focus on Butembo’s Katwa health zone, with a commission established to craft an emergency plan to curb rising confirmed cases. The provincial Ebola response coordination meeting decided to begin immediate actions, aiming to deploy measures as soon as possible. Prisca Luanda, chief coordinator for the provincial health governor, urged community engagement amid a surge in Ebola deaths, most occurring in communities. The government seeks to install a laboratory in Butembo to speed up rapid sample analysis. Across Nord-Kivu, about 255 Ebola cases have been confirmed with around 155 deaths, Katwa health zone in Butembo recording the highest fatality rate. The response emphasizes community outreach and faster laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボのエボラ：カトワで緊急対策委員会設立 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の症例・死亡者数が急増（255症例、155死亡）しており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（約60%）、コミュニティ内での死亡が多いことから感染連鎖の制御が困難な状況が示唆される。ラボ設置や緊急対応計画の必要性からも支援ニーズが高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Available Ebola Vaccine May Protect Against Bundibugyo Virus, Study Suggests
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, a filovirus, drives an Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda since May 2026, with 2,557 confirmed cases and 1,035 deaths as of late July 2026. There are no Bundibugyo-specific vaccines or therapeutics. In the PREVAC trial, 179 serum samples from African children and adults vaccinated against Zaire Ebola showed cross-reactive antibodies to Bundibugyo at 28 days and 3 months across vaccine regimens. For Merck’s rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP single-dose, Bundibugyo binding was 282 at 28 days and 130 at 3 months (vs 1,788 and 1,069 for Kikwit Ebola); the booster group showed similar patterns. After Ad26.ZEBOV/MVA-BN-Filo, Bundibugyo responses were 83 at 28 days and 433 at 3 months. The authors urge evaluating available Ebola vaccines during the outbreak; WHO’s stockpile of ~500k doses should be used only in trials; Ad26/MVA-Filo is not available. Nine vaccinated individuals who later contracted Bundibugyo survived; none of 242 deaths with known vaccination status had vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 既存のエボラワクチンがブンディブギョウイルスに対して防御効果を持つ可能性、研究で示唆
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで2026年5月以降ブンディブギョウウイルスによるエボラ様アウトブレイクが継続中で、感染者2,557名、死者1,035名と極めて深刻。特異的ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、国際的な支援・研究が必要な状況。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに該当しないため除外。ブンディブギョウウイルスは致死率約40%と高く、既存のザイールエボラワクチンの交差防御効果に関する研究データが報告されている。WHOの備蓄ワクチン（約50万回分）は臨床試験下でのみ使用すべきとされている点にも留意。
