article.articleHeadline: Експерт: Епидемията от ебола е най-тежката досега - Новини от Dnes.bg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert: The Ebola outbreak is the worst to date - News from Dnes.bg
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is described as the worst outbreak to date. The Congo Ministry of Health reports 2,473 cases and 999 deaths, including many health workers and three Congo Red Cross volunteers; the WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak likely began in January and was officially confirmed on May 15, with spread to Uganda, where the last confirmed patient was discharged Thursday after two negative tests. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine. Authorities warn that undetected transmission chains could drive a larger spread amid misinformation-fueled attacks on health facilities. A London-monitoring humanitarian worker shows possible exposure; Brazil and Italy initially reported possible cases but ruled them out. Veteran NHS doctor Simon Mardell and Dr. Matyu Lukvya emphasize gaps in case finding and infection control as the disease causes severe dehydration, vomiting, diarrhea, and multi-organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家:エボラ流行は過去最悪 - Dnes.bgニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行はWHOがPHEICを宣言するほど深刻で、感染者2,473人・死者999人に達し、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの伝播は確認されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル・イタリアは疑い例が否定されたため verified_locations に含めない。ロンドンの人道支援従事者の曝露疑いは監視段階であり確定事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: AP Explica: Los desafíos de combatir el brote de ébola que ha causado estragos en Congo y Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AP Explains: The Challenges of Combating the Ebola Outbreak That Has Wreaked Havoc in the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths, with 738 patients in isolation or hospital. Declared May 15, Bundibugyo strain lacks vaccines or approved treatments. It is centered in Ituri Province (about 90% of cases) with additional cases in five provinces, including Kisangani, and Uganda. Transmission remains ongoing, though officials say it may be easing; data delays complicate trend assessment. Only about 77% of contacts are being monitored, below the 95% target. CDC modeling warns worst-case scenarios could approach highs. Most cases arise from unknown transmission chains; WHO rates the outbreak high in Congo and high in Uganda and neighboring countries due to cross-border spread. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths; no new cases since June 21. France reports one imported case from Congo; recovered. US travel bans and Kenya quarantine facility plans face opposition; distrust and conflict hinder containment.

triage.headline_ja: AP解説：コンゴとウガンダで猛威を振るうエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクとの闘いの課題
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで確認例2,536件・死亡1,033件に達する大規模エボラ流行であり、国境を越えた拡大（フランスへの輸入例、米国の渡航制限、ケニアの検疫施設計画）も発生しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、フランス、米国、ケニアでの関連事象が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。感染連鎖不明例が多く、接触者追跡率も目標未達（77%対95%）であり、封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: US quarantined citizens at NY base after return from Congo, sources say
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-23, 14 U.S. citizens were quarantined at a New York military base after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo amid its third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. They were asymptomatic and deemed low-risk, though a Do Not Board order requires at least 21 days of quarantine before returning to the United States by commercial flight from Congo. The travelers entered via land from Canada, highlighting a gap in land-entry enforcement with no Do Not Board for land routes. Defense Department memos say they could not proceed directly to the United States from Congo as authorities try to keep Ebola out. The episode underscores federal coordination challenges and raises questions about the limits of public health authority when American citizens return home during an Ebola crisis in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 米当局、コンゴから帰国した市民をニューヨーク州の基地で隔離、関係者が明かす
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上3番目の規模とされるエボラ流行が発生しており、帰国者に対する検疫・渡航制限措置が取られていることから、IHR基準に複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行とその渡航者管理の課題。米国・カナダ・ニューヨークは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行状況（規模・死亡者数等）の詳細情報は本記事からは不明で、続報確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Pecuária brasileira vive marco histórico com novo Banco Nacional de Antígenos contra a febre aftosa - CompreRural
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian livestock industry marks historic milestone with new National Antigen Bank against foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Brazil inaugurates the National Antigen Bank for Foot-and-Mouth Disease, a strategic stockpile of major FMD antigens to enable rapid vaccine production across key serotypes in emergencies. The facility, delivered July 17 at Biogénesis Bagó in Garín, Argentina, is a collaboration between MAPA (Agriculture), Tecpar, and Biogénesis Bagó, aligning with the National Surveillance Program for Foot-and-Mouth Disease (PNEFA). Aimed at preserving Brazil’s status as a FMD-free country without vaccination and safeguarding beef exports, the bank reduces response times and economic/trade disruption if an outbreak occurs. It reinforces Brazil’s sanitary credibility and preparedness, supporting the world’s largest exporter of beef with enhanced prevention, surveillance, and rapid containment capabilities.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル畜産業、口蹄疫対策の新国家抗原バンク設立で歴史的節目を迎える
triage.triage_reason: 実際の口蹄疫発生ではなく、ブラジルが予防的措置として国家抗原バンクを設立したという内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の口蹄疫発生ではなく、ブラジルの予防的な抗原バンク設立に関する報道。抗原バンク自体はアルゼンチンのGarínに設置されているが、記事の主題はブラジルの家畜衛生政策であり、ブラジル・アルゼンチンともに対象国リストに含まれるが、実際の発生事例ではないため疾病発生国としての計上は該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Possível retorno do El Niño acende alerta para aumento dos casos de dengue no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible Return of El Niño Raises Alarm Over Increase in Dengue Cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Possible return of El Niño in the second half of 2026 raises Brazil's health alarm as higher temperatures and altered rainfall could boost Aedes aegypti breeding, increasing dengue, chikungunya, and Zika transmission. Projections from Fiocruz’s InfoDengue warn that Brazil could register about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027 if conditions materialize. El Niño warms equatorial Pacific waters and may produce hotter, wetter spells that accelerate mosquito development, but researchers caution that the phenomenon alone does not trigger epidemics; urbanization, inadequate sanitation, and gaps in vector control also shape outcomes. The Ministry of Health has issued a technical note urging states to strengthen epidemiological surveillance and vector control, including intensified door-to-door visits, expanded educational campaigns, and health-system readiness to detect outbreaks early. Prevention focuses on eliminating breeding sites and protective measures during the October–May transmission window.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ再来の可能性、ブラジルでデング熱症例増加への警戒感高まる
triage.triage_reason: 現時点では将来予測・注意喚起の段階であり、実際の症例急増は確認されていないが、デング等ベクター媒介感染症の拡大リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年後半のエルニーニョ再来予測に基づく将来的リスク警告であり、Fiocruz/InfoDengueによる2027年推計（約170万症例）に言及。保健省はサーベイランス強化を求める技術ノートを発出済みだが、実際の症例増加データは記事内に示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode aumentar casos de chikungunya e dengue no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño may increase Chikungunya and dengue cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: El Niño could moderately to strongly intensify from H2 2026 in Brazil, boosting Aedes aegypti breeding and arbovirus transmission, per INMET. The Health Ministry issued a technical note warning states and municipalities about rising dengue and chikungunya risk. InfoDengue/Fiocruz projects about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027. Warmer temperatures and more rainfall in parts of the country are expected to create more mosquito breeding sites. To mitigate risk, the Ministry urges intensified surveillance and vector control, including transmission-blocking measures after the first cases, reorganization of endemic-control duties, and use of vector-control technologies. Public guidance emphasizes eliminating household breeding sites and watching for dengue and chikungunya symptoms. Projections are model-based and may be updated. By 20 June 2026, Brazil had 392,800 dengue cases, with chikungunya down about 46% from the prior year.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがブラジルにおけるチクングニア熱・デング熱の症例数を増加させる可能性
triage.triage_reason: エルニーニョによる媒介蚊増加を背景とした将来予測に基づく保健省の注意喚起であり、現時点で異常な流行拡大や重症化の確証はないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事はエルニーニョによる将来的な感染症リスク増加を予測するモデルベースの報道であり、保健省は技術的注意喚起を発出したが、現状の症例数（デング392,800件、チクングニアは前年比46%減）は既存の季節的傾向の範囲内。異常な急増や重症化の証拠は確認されておらず、今後の実際の症例動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Veja por que El Niño pode aumentar casos de chikungunya e dengue - ACidade ON Ribeirão Preto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: See why El Niño could increase Chikungunya and Dengue cases - ACidade ON Ribeirão Preto.
article.articleSummary: El Niño could be moderate to strong from the second half of 2026, boosting Aedes aegypti populations in Brazil and raising the risk of dengue and chikungunya outbreaks. The Inmet forecast, cited by ACidade ON Ribeirão Preto, accompanies a Ministry of Health technical note warning states and municipalities about rising arboviruses. InfoDengue/Fiocruz projects about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027. Warmer temperatures and heavier rainfall promote standing water and mosquito breeding. To mitigate, health authorities urge intensified surveillance and transmission-blocking measures after first identified cases, restructuring vector-control tasks, and deploying recommended vector-control technologies; the public should eliminate domestic breeding sites and monitor for symptoms. Dengue cases in Brazil reached 392,800 as of 20 June 2026, down 73% from the same period in 2025; chikungunya cases declined 46%.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ現象がチクングニア熱とデング熱の症例増加を招く可能性がある理由
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱の将来的な増加予測に関する内容だが、現時点では症例数は前年比で減少しており、既知の季節性疾患の予測情報にとどまるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は将来予測（エルニーニョによる媒介蚊増加とそれに伴う症例増加予測）が主題で、現状の症例数は前年より大幅減少（デング-73%、チクングニア-46%）。既知の季節性・気候関連疾患のルーティン監視情報であり、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Crisis Hits 1,000 Dead as Strikes and Attacks Hamper Containment
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed more than 1,000 people; as of July 20, 2026, 2,473 confirmed cases and 999 deaths, with the true burden likely higher. The Bundibugyo strain drives this outbreak, for which no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. It is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976, and the WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern in May. The epicenter is Ituri province, but five provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; Ituri accounts for >90% of infections and ~80% of fatalities. Two confirmed cases reached Kampala, Uganda. By mid-July, cases >2,000 and deaths >750; 1,031 deaths reported by July 22. Community deaths exceed 60%. Strikes by health workers, attacks on burial teams, and insecurity hinder response; cross-border risk to Uganda persists, with scaling up by WHO, Africa CDC, MSF, though funding gaps remain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ危機、死者1,000人に到達 ストライキと攻撃が封じ込めを妨害
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行で、死者1,000人超・複数州に拡大、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Kampala）への越境症例が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行であり、資金不足・治安悪化が封じ込めを阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: Ξέσπασμα Έμπολα στο Κονγκό σκοτώνει πάνω από 1.000 ανθρώπους
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo kills more than 1,000 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed more than 1,000 people, with 1,031 confirmed deaths and 2,473 cases reported as of the latest health ministry update; about 737 patients are in isolation or hospital care. Declared on May 15, the outbreak is the fastest-spreading Ebola event on record and is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccines or therapies exist. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention says the true scope may be two to four times higher than official figures. The Ituri province remains the epicenter, with cases in four additional provinces. A Phase I clinical trial of a Bundibugyo vaccine has begun in Oxford, evaluating safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18–55. Officials warn that roughly 80% of new cases occur outside known transmission chains. Ebola can cause severe illness and is often fatal.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行、死者1,000人超え
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が1,000人超の死者を出し過去最速の拡大速度、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず伝播経路不明の症例が8割を占めるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: 英国オックスフォードはワクチン臨床試験の実施地であり、感染発生地ではないため対象国から除外。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる過去最速拡大の流行で、症例の80%が既知の感染連鎖外という点は特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемиолог Никифоров: вирус Эбола не передаётся воздушно-капельным путём
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiologist Nikiforov: the Ebola virus is not transmitted via the airborne route.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-23, Ebola virus is not transmitted via airborne routes and does not pose a global threat, according to Vladimir Nikiforov, head of Infectious Diseases and Epidemiology at the Russian National Research Medical University named after N.I. Pirogov. In a Zvezdanews interview, he states Ebola spreads between people only through very close contact, not through respiratory droplets, and has remained endemic to Congo and several neighboring countries since its recognition in the 1980s. He argues that fears of worldwide dissemination are exaggerated. Supporting this view, Anatoly Altstein, a virology professor at the Gamaleya Institute, notes that the greatest risk of spread persists in Central Africa, and the probability of an outbreak in Russia is absent.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学者ニキフォロフ氏:エボラウイルスは飛沫感染しない
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、専門家によるエボラの感染様式に関する解説記事であり、既知の風土病状況の説明に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの専門家によるエボラウイルスの感染経路に関する一般的な解説であり、新規の症例発生や具体的なアウトブレイク報告は含まれていない。コンゴは既知の風土病地域として言及されているのみで、新規イベントの主題ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les États-Unis ont confiné sur une base militaire quatorze de leurs citoyens revenus du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the United States confined fourteen of its citizens on a military base who had returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-23, 14 American citizens were quarantined for four days at Fort Drum, New York, after returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo where Ebola is ongoing. The group, including naturalized citizens, two teenagers, and a 70-year-old, showed no symptoms and posed no known transmission risk. Two families had briefly reached Canada by air before being blocked at the Vermont–New York border and were transported to Fort Drum for temporary isolation; they were released on Monday and resumed travel. The measure reflects the administration’s Ebola containment policy, including a 21-day pre-boarding requirement for air return from Congo, with land returns allowed but blocked in this instance. The legality of restricting citizens’ entry is contested, and Fort Drum is described as a temporary, isolated facility. Congo reports around 2,500 confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases, highlighting stigma concerns tied to nationality and travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国はコンゴから帰国した自国民14人を軍事基地で隔離した
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行が約2500症例に達しており重大な公衆衛生イベントであること、また米国が渡航制限措置（隔離・搭乗前待機要求）を実施していることからIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は米国内での帰国者隔離措置だが、背景にあるDRCでのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ型、約2500症例）自体が継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項であり、渡航制限を伴う国際的対応が発生している点でシグナルとして識別。米国・カナダ・バーモント・ニューヨークは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Expert Warns Of 'Unprecedented' Scenario As Outbreak Surges, 'Only A Matter Of Time' Before Deadly Virus Spreads Across Borders
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak across Africa surges to more than 2,550 cases and over 1,030 deaths, with the Democratic Republic of Congo reporting more than 1,000 infections. The Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine exists, drives the crisis. Ebola expert Dr. Simon Mardel warns the situation is 'unprecedented' and fears spread beyond Africa as tracing and infection control lag. Two Americans infected after trips to the DRC have recovered; possible cases have appeared in London, Brazil and Italy. Nigeria is highlighted as a high-risk area due to its population. Speed is critical: indicators suggest outcomes become clear within five days (some markers three days). Persistent gaps in prevention raise concerns that transmission chains remain unrecognized, threatening containment and increasing the risk of imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ専門家、感染拡大により『前例のない』事態を警告 ― 致死性ウイルスの国境越え拡散は『時間の問題』
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心にエボラ症例が2,550件、死者1,030人超と急増し、ワクチンのないBundibugyo株が原因。専門家が『前例のない』事態と警告し、複数国での疑い例も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ全体（主にDRC）でのエボラ拡大を主題としており、米国・ロンドン・ブラジル・イタリアでの症例は『疑い例』段階で確定情報が乏しいため対象国リストからは除外。ワクチン未整備のBundibugyo株による前例のない規模の流行として、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Indore Bhagirathpura Water Issue: NGT Seeks Reply After Sewage Entered Pipelines, Triggering Deadly Outbreak
article.articleSummary: 36 people died in Indore Bhagirathpura after sewage entered the municipal water supply, triggering a National Green Tribunal inquiry. A Health Department–PCB committee found E. coli in 50 of 52 drinking-water samples and linked outages to leaks and sewage ingress. Narmada-water samples were clean; however Kanh River and a borewell near Bhagirathpura showed heavy E. coli, indicating groundwater intrusion. The outbreak followed Dec 29–30, 2025 vomiting and diarrhoea; by Dec 31 eight deaths were reported, with officials suspended and a sub-engineer removed. A judicial inquiry and a High Court proceeding followed in early 2026; a March preliminary report found 109 of 110 overhead tanks normal, one severely contaminated. The NGT directed pipeline replacement, separation of sewage and water lines, leak prevention, reservoir cleaning, a 24x7 helpline/app, NABL testing, public reports, real-time monitoring, and third-party audits; parties to respond within three weeks; next hearing Sept 16.

triage.headline_ja: インドール・バギーラトプラの水問題:下水管への浸入が引き起こした致命的なアウトブレイクを受け、NGTが回答を要求
triage.triage_reason: 下水混入による飲料水汚染で36人が死亡し、大腸菌汚染が確認された重大な公衆衛生事案であり、司法審理・行政対応が続いている。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、被害規模と社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 汚水混入による水道汚染が原因の大腸菌集団感染で、感染症の人-人感染ではなくインフラ・環境衛生上の問題。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、死亡者数と司法・行政対応の規模から国内シグナルとして注視すべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Cifra de fallecidos por ébola en el Congo supera el millar - Correo del Orinoco | La Artillería del Pensamiento |Noticias de ...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in the Congo surpasses one thousand - Correo del Orinoco | La Artillería del Pensamiento | News of ....
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,536 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths as of July 21, according to the Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP). The outbreak, declared on May 15 in the eastern region, spans five provinces: Ituri (the most affected), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Lethality stands at 40.7%. About 738 people are in isolation or hospitalized; 506 have recovered. The surveillance system reports a 77.2% contact-tracing rate. Authorities warn that transmission remains ongoing with high viral circulation, but caution that recent data variations reflect reporting delays and gradual data consolidation from affected areas, underscoring the urgent need to strengthen contact tracing to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が1000人を超える - コレオ・デル・オリノコ紙
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率40.7%の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、複数州に拡大、死者1000人超と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 2,536例確認、死者1,033人、致死率40.7%。5州（イツリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートユエレ、ツショポ）に拡大し感染伝播が継続中。接触者追跡率は77.2%だが報告遅延・データ統合の課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : la Première ministre Judith Suminwa à Bunia pour évaluer la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Prime Minister Judith Suminwa in Bunia to assess the Ebola response - ACP
article.articleSummary: On July 23, 2026, in Bunia, Ituri Province, Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka arrived to evaluate the Ebola virus disease response. The Democratic Republic of Congo government, under President Félix Tshisekedi who chairs the Ebola Task Force, has released 50 million USD to bolster the outbreak response. Suminwa will assess field progress and encourage the response teams, visiting the Rwampara Ebola Treatment Center and the Mungbwalu site to observe patient care, surveillance systems, and interventions by authorities and partners. The visit underscores government efforts to contain transmission, strengthen response capacity, and escalate community awareness with the aim of ending the outbreak in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州:スミンワ首相、エボラ対応状況を評価するためブニアを訪問 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の政府対応として首相が現地視察し、5000万ドルの予算投入がなされていることから、深刻な公衆衛生イベントとして継続的なフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイトゥリ州でのエボラ対応の政府視察に関するもので、感染者数・死亡者数などの疫学的詳細は本文に含まれていないため、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : à Bunia, Judith Suminwa réaffirme l'engagement du gouvernement et annonce un suivi renforcé de la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: in Bunia, Judith Suminwa reaffirms the government's commitment and announces strengthened follow-up of the outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: On July 23, 2026, Bunia, epicenter of the Democratic Republic of Congo's 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak, hosts Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka who reaffirms government commitment to intensify the response to rapidly curb transmission. In Kisangani, where a few cases have been reported, she urges faster equipment delivery, stronger community awareness, and dignified, safe burials to limit spread. In Bunia, officials aim to reassure residents and assess urgent needs to bolster the health response in the province most affected. The government has mobilized significant resources, including $50 million for the Ebola response. Ituri province currently accounts for the majority of confirmed national cases, driving reinforced coordination with technical and financial partners to accelerate patient care, epidemiological surveillance, and community prevention.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:ブニアでジュディス・スミンワ首相が政府の関与を再確認し、対応強化のフォローアップを発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（第17次）に関する首相レベルの対応強化が報じられており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中アウトブレイク（第17次エボラ流行）の継続報道。首相の訪問と5000万ドルの対応資金投入、イトゥリ州での症例集中が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Более тысячи жертв: тяжелая ситуация с Эболой в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than a thousand victims: a dire Ebola situation in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Large Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths (per the National Institute of Biomedical Research). The eastern region remains volatile as armed groups operate and clinics are repeatedly attacked; hostility fueled by conspiracy theories and strict burial rules, along with a severe medicines shortage, worsen the crisis. The outbreak is caused by a Bundibugyo strain with about 40% mortality; there are no approved vaccines or effective treatments for this variant, though experimental drugs are being tested in animals. In neighboring Uganda, the epidemiological situation has been fully stabilized, with the last patient discharged on 16 July 2026 and officials awaiting an official declaration of no virus. Ebola symptoms include fever, muscle pain, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea and bleeding; transmission is via contact with blood or other infected body fluids; fatality ranges from 25% to 90% depending on strain.

triage.headline_ja: 犠牲者1000人超え：アフリカにおけるエボラ出血熱の深刻な状況
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（2,536症例、1,033死亡）が発生し、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく武力紛争地域で医療アクセスも困難なため、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダは症例が全て回復し公式終息宣言待ちのため、DRCのみを実発生国として扱う。Bundibugyo株は致死率約40%で承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、武装勢力による医療施設攻撃が対応を著しく困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: 30º Alerta dengue: 38 bairros com alto risco de transmissão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 30th Dengue Alert: 38 neighborhoods with a high risk of transmission.
article.articleSummary: On July 23, 2026, Campinas's Health Secretariat issued the 30th Dengue Alert, naming 38 neighborhoods at high risk of dengue transmission across the East, Northwest, North, Southwest, South, and Southeast regions. The alert targets intensified inspection of water-holding sites in homes and expanded efforts to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding grounds, with city-wide reach including areas cited in prior weeks. From January 1 to June 28, 2026, Campinas confirmed 3,531 dengue cases; health workers conducted 820,643 home visits for breeding-site control and education, and 53,382 fogging visits. Household-based control remains central, as 80% of breeding sites are inside residences. Prevention guidance urges eliminating standing water, changing plant-pot water every two days, cleaning saucers weekly, sealing water tanks, and keeping toilets closed when unused.

triage.headline_ja: 第30回デング熱警報：38地区が感染リスク高
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱は毎年季節的に発生する風土病であり、本記事は自治体レベルの定例的な予防啓発・対策活動の報告に過ぎず、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの風土病であり、本記事はカンピナス市の定例的な公衆衛生対策（第30回警報）に関する報告。症例数（3,531件、1月〜6月）は例年の規模と比較する情報がなく重症度は不明だが、地域限定的な蚊媒介対策の継続実施が中心であり、国際的な脅威とはみなされない。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus respiratórios se espalham por cidade de MS e autoridades fazem alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory viruses spread through a city in Mato Grosso do Sul, and authorities issue a warning.
article.articleSummary: Respiratory viruses surge in Corumbá, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. Municipal Health Secretariat issued an epidemiological alert after a spike in respiratory illness circulation, based on Epidemiological Week 27 of 2026. Of 369 samples tested, 227 (61.5%) were positive for respiratory viruses; 142 were negative. Rhinovirus led with 86 detections, followed by Influenza A (H3) with 70, Influenza B with 35, metapneumovirus with 20, and Respiratory Syncytial Virus also circulating. Highest incidence occurred in children aged 0–4 years, prompting emphasis on vaccination and preventive measures. Symptoms commonly reported include fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, nasal congestion, muscle pains, headache, fatigue, wheeze, and shortness of breath. Authorities urge medical care for persistent or worsening symptoms, particularly for children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities. Prevention: vaccination (influenza, COVID-19), pneumococcal 20-valent vaccine, RSV protection for pregnant women and premature infants; hygiene, masking, ventilation, and avoiding contact with the sick.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ・ド・スル州の都市で呼吸器系ウイルスが蔓延、当局が警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器ウイルス（ライノウイルス、インフルエンザ、RSV等）の通常範囲内の流行であり、対象国リストに該当せず、異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列。季節性呼吸器感染症の通常の増加であり、地域の公衆衛生当局による通常の予防啓発活動と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Лихорадка денге добралась до Швейцарии: зафиксирован первый случай
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever has reached Switzerland: the first case has been recorded.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever has reached Switzerland, with the first case recorded in the canton of Valais, in the municipality of Fully. The infection was identified in a resident who brought the virus from abroad. The tiger mosquito, Aedes albopictus, has inhabited the area since 2019, prompting preventive measures. Authorities emphasise the case is imported and local transmission risk remains low. As a precaution, officials plan insecticide treatments in Fully to kill adult mosquitoes and larval stages. Medical staff note that while human-to-mosquito and onward human transmission is possible, such a scenario is unlikely. In a related report, Russian doctors treated a woman who contracted dengue during a vacation in Vietnam; she arrived in a severe state with fever up to 40°C and joint pain, diagnosed with dengue, and recovered after intensive therapy. Travelers are urged to seek medical care if symptoms arise after travel to hot climates and report trip locations.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱がスイスに到達：初の症例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: スイスとロシアにおける輸入症例（海外渡航歴あり）の報告であり、対象国における発生事例ではなく、現地感染のリスクも低いとされているため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はスイス（初の輸入症例）とロシア（ベトナム渡航後の症例）であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナムは感染地として言及されているが、発生イベントの主体はロシア人患者の渡航歴に過ぎず、ベトナム国内での発生事例として扱うべきではない。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat Chandipura virus outbreak: 12 children dead in 22 days. Symptoms, spread and treatment - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: In Gujarat, 12 children have died over 22 days amid a Chandipura virus outbreak; from June 30 to July 22, 2026, the state logged 89 suspected cases, with 18 laboratory-confirmed positives. Twelve deaths include three children from neighbouring Rajasthan treated in Gujarat, prompting enhanced surveillance. Chandipura virus (CHPV), a member of the Rhabdoviridae family, can cause Acute Encephalitis Syndrome and has caused outbreaks in Maharashtra, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Bihar and West Bengal. Transmission is primarily via sandflies, with mosquitoes intermittently mentioned; vectors thrive in damp surroundings and mud-wall cracks, especially in rural areas. Monsoon season heightens activity. Symptoms include sudden fever, seizures or altered consciousness; rapid progression can occur. There is no specific antiviral or vaccine; care is supportive. Prevention focuses on reducing sandfly exposure and timely medical care; early diagnosis improves outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染流行:22日間で子ども12人死亡、症状・感染経路・治療法について
triage.triage_reason: 22日間で子ども12人が死亡し、疑い症例89例・検査確定18例を記録するなど深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、ワクチン・特異的治療法がないベクター媒介感染症でヒトへの重症化・拡大リスクが高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介のRhabdoviridae属ウイルスで、急性脳炎症候群を引き起こす。過去にもマハーラーシュトラ、グジャラート、アーンドラ・プラデーシュ等で流行歴があるが、今回は短期間での死亡例集中と近隣ラージャスターン州からの搬送例もあり、監視強化が行われている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode elevar casos de dengue no Brasil em 2027, alerta Ministério da Saúde - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño could increase dengue cases in Brazil in 2027, Health Ministry warns - Metro 1
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Health Ministry issued a July 22, 2026 alert to states and municipalities warning that El Niño-driven climate patterns could boost arbovirus transmission, with InfoDengue/Fiocruz projecting up to 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027. Warmer temperatures, heavy rains and drought periods are expected to increase stagnant water, creating ideal mosquito and tick breeding sites. Authorities urged enhanced surveillance and deployment of vector-control technologies approved by the ministry, while citizens were urged to eliminate standing water at home and seek prompt medical care if dengue, Zika or chikungunya symptoms appear. Dengue clinical signs include severe persistent headache, muscle and joint pain, retro-orbital pain, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, malaise and red skin rashes. Projections are epidemiological estimates based on climate scenarios and may be updated as models incorporate new information; ongoing monitoring will inform further alerts as needed.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがブラジルの2027年デング熱症例を増加させる可能性、保健省が警告
triage.triage_reason: 現時点での症例急増ではなく、2027年に向けた気候モデルに基づく将来予測・注意喚起であるため、続報や実際のデータを注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年7月時点で発出された、2027年のデング熱症例増加に関する気候モデルベースの予測・事前警告であり、実際の症例急増を報告するものではない。ブラジルは毎年デング熱が流行する既知のエンデミック地域であり、エルニーニョとの関連も既知のパターンであるため異常性は低いと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Waterlogged pond behind showpiece fighter jet in kid's park sparks health concerns
article.articleSummary: In Bhopal, a waterlogged patch behind a showpiece fighter jet in a children’s park near PHQ has become a mosquito breeding ground, prompting park closure and concerns about dengue, malaria and other vector-borne diseases. Stagnant monsoon water, foul odor, and garbage accumulation have left residents worried, with authorities not addressing drainage or cleaning. The park, redeveloped by the previous BMC council at about Rs 5 crore, exemplifies civic neglect and heightens disease risk, particularly for children. Dengue testing in Bhopal fell about 33% in 2026, while positives remained nearly unchanged: 44 dengue cases detected from 2,761 tests in 2026, compared with 47 positives from 4,121 tests in 2025. Health experts call for stronger surveillance, quicker detection, and improved mosquito-control measures to avert outbreak escalation.

triage.headline_ja: 子供公園の展示戦闘機の裏にある浸水池が健康懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 単一都市の公園における蚊発生源に関する地域的な衛生管理問題であり、症例数の急増や異常な流行拡大は報告されていない。
triage.notes: デング検査数は2026年に減少しているが陽性者数はほぼ横ばい（44例/2,761検査 vs 47例/4,121検査）。地方自治体の環境衛生管理不備が主題で、感染症の異常な急増ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Contagem confirma soltura de mosquitos com Wolbachia contra dengue a partir de novembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contagem confirms release of Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes to combat dengue starting in November.
article.articleSummary: Contagem's Municipal Health Secretariat announced a Wolbachia mosquito release plan to combat dengue, with community engagement from September to November and release of Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti slated for November. The program, run with the Ministry of Health, Fiocruz, and Wolbito do Brasil, uses Wolbachia to block dengue, Zika, and chikungunya viruses in mosquitoes. In Belo Horizonte, the metro area, the method has operated since 2020 (Venda Nova) and over 60% of released mosquitoes there carry Wolbachia. Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, reports an 88.8% reduction in dengue after implementation and is cited as the first city nationwide with urban coverage. National data show a 75% drop in probable dengue cases from January to April year-over-year. Contagem emphasizes the strategy as a complementary tool, not a substitute for traditional vector control, and calls for continued source reduction by residents and others.

triage.headline_ja: コンタジェン市、11月からデング熱対策としてウォルバキア感染蚊の放出を確認
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防対策（ウォルバキア法導入）に関する行政広報であり、感染拡大や異常な公衆衛生事象を示す内容ではない。国内のデング症例数はむしろ減少傾向にある。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症流行報告ではなく、公衆衛生対策（Wolbachia法によるベクター制御）の実施計画に関する広報記事。デング熱症例数は前年比75%減少と報告されており、リスク上昇を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde alerta para risco de alta da dengue com avanço do El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns of increased dengue risk as El Niño advances.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, Brazil's Ministry of Health issued a technical note urging states and municipalities to strengthen prevention of dengue, chikungunya, and other arboviruses as El Niño may intensify in H2 2026. Inmet forecasts higher temperatures and altered rainfall, boosting Aedes aegypti breeding—the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector—where standing water accumulates. The note calls for intensified epidemiological surveillance, rapid transmission blocking when initial cases are confirmed, reorganization of vector-control teams, and expanded use of approved vector-control technologies. InfoDengue (Fiocruz) projects about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027, contingent on climate evolution and new data. By 20 June 2026, Brazil had 392,800 probable dengue cases (73% below 2025’s pace) and chikungunya cases declined 46%. In Mato Grosso do Sul, 1,498 dengue cases were confirmed January–July.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル保健省、エルニーニョの進行に伴うデング熱リスク増大を警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱等の増加リスクに関する予防的な注意喚起であり、現時点では症例数は前年より減少傾向にあるため、季節性の警戒情報として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 現状の症例数は前年同期比で減少しているが、エルニーニョによる気候変動を背景とした将来的な流行拡大リスクへの予防的注意喚起。続報でのデータ推移を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo reforça prevenção e diagnóstico precoce de hepatites virais -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July reinforces prevention and early diagnosis of viral hepatitis -- District Politics is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: From 2021 to 2025, Distrito Federal reported 1,444 hepatitis cases and 206 deaths (B and C). Of these, hepatitis C accounted for 914 cases, hepatitis B 526, and hepatitis D 4. The WHO Yellow July campaign promotes prevention, diagnosis, and treatment. Vaccination is central: hepatitis B vaccine available at health units; infants receive doses at birth and 2, 4, 6 months, while those ≥7 years, adolescents, and adults receive three doses (second after 1 month, third after 6 months). Hepatitis A vaccination is included for children at 15 months and adults at risk (HIV, PrEP users, chronic liver disease). Other prevention includes condom use, hand/food hygiene, treated water, and not sharing personal items. Diagnosis is via rapid tests for hepatitis B and C at UBS with same-day results; pregnancy testing is mandatory in the first trimester. Early infections are asymptomatic; symptoms include fatigue, nausea, fever, abdominal pain, and jaundice.

triage.headline_ja: イエロージュライキャンペーンがウイルス性肝炎の予防と早期診断を強化
triage.triage_reason: 定例の公衆衛生啓発キャンペーンに関する内容であり、突発的な感染症アウトブレイクではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル連邦区（Distrito Federal）における過去5年間の肝炎統計と啓発キャンペーンに関するもので、急性のアウトブレイクではない。またDistrito FederalはBrazil国内の一地域であるが対象国リストのBrazil自体は含まれるものの、内容が定例啓発活動であるためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Takedas Qdenga Becomes First Dengue Vaccine Approved India
article.articleSummary: On 23 July 2026, India's drug regulator approved Takeda's dengue vaccine Qdenga, the first dengue vaccine cleared in the country. Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease; WHO data show a record 14.4 million cases and 11,201 deaths worldwide in 2024, including 232,425 cases and 233 deaths in India. In India, reported dengue cases rose about 11-fold over the past two decades. Qdenga targets all four dengue virus serotypes and is indicated for prevention in individuals aged 4 to 60 years. In late-stage trials, Qdenga demonstrated 80.2% efficacy against confirmed dengue one year after the second dose and 90.4% efficacy against dengue-related hospitalizations after 18 months. The vaccine has been approved in 43 countries to date.

triage.headline_ja: 武田薬品のデング熱ワクチン「Qdenga」、インドで初承認
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン承認に関する規制ニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の流行そのものではなく、ワクチン承認という公衆衛生上のポジティブな進展を報じるもの。既存の流行状況データ（過去20年で症例数約11倍増）は背景情報として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: First nursery for babies of Ebola victims opens in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola has resurfaced in the Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by the Bundibugyo virus strain, with Ituri province the epicentre, accounting for 90% of cases and 85% of deaths. The outbreak has orphaned about 135 children; children with confirmed Ebola represent about 15% of total cases and are nearly twice as likely to die as adults. The first UNICEF-supported emergency Ebola nursery opened in Ituri to care for infants and children separated from caregivers, offering safe space and psychosocial support. UNICEF and Save the Children report more than 4,000 children in Ituri have received mental-health and psychosocial services. The crisis unfolds amid insecurity and attacks on health facilities, with five provinces affected. The WHO has declared a public health emergency, underscoring the urgent need for vulnerable children's protection and scaled response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ被害児童のための初の託児所が開設
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が再流行し、WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。5州に拡大し高い致死率と多数の孤児が発生しており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、5州に拡大。子どもの死亡率が成人の約2倍と高く、治安悪化により医療施設への攻撃も発生している深刻な事例。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo: Saúde SP orienta sobre prevenção de hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July: São Paulo Health Department guides on the prevention of viral hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo State authorities emphasize vaccination, testing, and hygiene to prevent viral hepatitis A–D. In 2026, the state registered 1,953 hepatitis A, 651 hepatitis B, and 855 hepatitis C cases. Hepatitis A transmits fecal-oral and can be fulminant, sometimes requiring liver transplant; vaccination is available at Basic Health Units, with a dose at 15 months and two-dose options through CRIE. Hepatitis B vaccination is in the National Immunization Schedule: given at birth and at 2, 4, and 6 months (pentavalent); free via SUS for all ages lacking complete vaccination. There is no Hepatitis C vaccine currently; antiviral treatment is free via SUS and can cure most cases. Hepatitis D requires hepatitis B for replication; vaccination against B protects against D. Prenatal testing for B and C is recommended; adults should test for C at least once. Tests are available at UBSs and CTAs.

triage.headline_ja: イエロー・ジュライ：サンパウロ州保健局がウイルス性肝炎の予防について案内
triage.triage_reason: 定例の啓発キャンペーン記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni: les peuples autochtones sensibilisés aux risques de la maladie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Indigenous Peoples Made Aware of the Risks of the Disease - ACP
article.articleSummary: On July 23, 2026, in Beni, Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, indigenous pygmy communities in Ngadi were briefed on the risks of Ebola and the importance of barrier measures to prevent transmission. The awareness session was organized by PAP-RDC (Programme d'appui au développement des populations forestières en RDC) to include marginalized groups in the public health response. The Bapakombe Beni customary chief attended and thanked organizers for addressing a traditionally overlooked community. A participant, Jean Pierre Linga, expressed satisfaction, saying the session would help the pygmy community understand Ebola and educate others to save lives. Ngadi lies on the northern outskirts of Beni along the road to Beni Mavivi airport, where a pygmy camp is located, and the area faces multiple health challenges requiring broad outreach and rapid response to prevent outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ：先住民族がこの病気のリスクについて啓発を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ベニでのエボラに関する住民啓発活動を報じる記事であり、新規症例や具体的なアウトブレイク拡大の情報はないが、既知の高リスク地域における継続的な曝露の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規アウトブレイクの発生報告ではなく、既存のエボラリスクに対する先住民ピグミー・コミュニティ向け啓発活動を報じるもの。具体的な症例数や現行のアウトブレイク状況の記載がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Mpox en RDC : le Sud-Kivu approche les 4 000 cas, la riposte se poursuit | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Mpox in the DRC: South Kivu nears 4,000 cases, the response continues
article.articleSummary: Mpox remains circulating in South Kivu, DRC, despite the end of the national public health emergency. Since the start of 2026, provincial health authorities have recorded 3,945 confirmed mpox cases and 3 deaths, with 27 of 34 health zones affected. Nyangezi health zone is a major hotspot with over 1,000 confirmed cases. Authorities emphasize sustained surveillance and response activities even as the emergency status was lifted nationally, amid reports of waning support from some partners. The province also faces an Ebola outbreak, with three confirmed Ebola cases reported there. The simultaneous circulation of mpox and Ebola underscores the need for ongoing epidemiological surveillance, resource mobilization, and health-system strengthening to protect populations in South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox in the DRC: South Kivu nears 4,000 cases, the response continues
triage.triage_reason: 南キブ州でMpoxが約4,000症例・死亡3例に達し、さらにエボラも3例確認されるという複数病原体の同時流行が発生しており、公衆衛生上の緊急事態解除後もパートナー支援が減少する中で拡大継続のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: MpoxとEbolaがDRC南キブ州で同時流行しているとの報告。国家的な緊急事態は解除されたが、州レベルでは症例が継続的に増加しており、パートナーからの支援縮小が懸念材料。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : le transport des dépouilles désormais soumis à une autorisation sanitaire - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: the transport of corpses is now subject to a sanitary authorization - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 23 July 2026, in Beni, Nord-Kivu, DRC, transport of corpses now requires prior sanitary authorization signed by the health-zone chief doctor, under provincial decree 01/ES/047/CAB/GP-NK/2026 (27 May 2026) for the 17th Ebola outbreak, Bundibugyo strain. Bodies must be deposited in the morgue until administrative formalities and funeral arrangements are completed, with sanctions for violators. The provincial Ebola response bulletin for 23 July reports Nord-Kivu with 275 confirmed Ebola cases and 172 deaths (case fatality 62.5%), 41 recoveries, 55 active cases across 11 of 34 health zones; 18 new cases were recorded on 22 July, mainly in Katwa, Butembo, Musienene, and Beni. An emphasis on strengthening response measures accompanies these regulatory steps.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ出血熱：遺体の搬送に衛生当局の許可が必要に - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株）が継続中で、致死率62.5%、複数の保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ出血熱流行（ブンディブギョ株）は北キブ州複数保健地域に拡大中で、致死率62.5%と高い。既存のRRA対象イベントの継続報道である可能性が高いが、遺体搬送規制という新たな行政措置も含まれており、継続監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : " la ville de Kinshasa n'est pas menacée " (Dr jean Jacques Muyembe) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: "the city of Kinshasa is not threatened" (Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa is not currently threatened by Ebola virus disease (EVD), according to virologist Jean-Jacques Muyembe, at a conference in Simon Kimbangu University. The Bundibugyo variant is driving an active DRC outbreak, with mild infections and limited hemorrhage. As of July 23, 2026, the 17th EVD outbreak in the country has recorded more than 2,500 cases and over 1,000 deaths. Provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Upper Uele. The outbreak, declared May 15, 2026, prompted WHO to label it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Re-emergence factors include bushmeat consumption, diverse ecosystems hosting the virus reservoir, deforestation, contact with or handling dead animals, and climatic factors. Emphasis on hygiene and breaking transmission chains, with risk communication highlighted; data on Bundibugyo Ebola evolution from 1976 to date were presented by local experts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国「キンシャサ市に脅威はない」(ジャン=ジャック・ムイェンベ博士) - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ第17次アウトブレイクは2,500例超・死亡1,000例超に達し、WHOがPHEIC宣言済みであり、複数州に拡大していることから重大な公衆衛生上の脅威と判断される。
triage.notes: 既にWHOによりPHEICと宣言された進行中のアウトブレイクであり、既知のシグナルとしてフルRRAでの継続モニタリングが妥当。キンシャサ自体への直接的な脅威は専門家により否定されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Тревога объявлена в самом сердце Европы: смертельно опасная угроза вышла на новый уровень
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert Declared in the Heart of Europe: A Deadly Threat Has Reached a New Level.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever has been officially confirmed for the first time in Switzerland's Valais canton, in the commune of Fully, in a traveler infected abroad. The main risk is local transmission if the region's tiger mosquitoes bite the infected person. Authorities have launched large-scale preventive measures, targeting larvae and adult mosquitoes to suppress potential local vectors before the virus establishes in the area. The report highlights imported infections among travelers, such as a July 22 case in Ryazan, Russia, involving a woman who contracted dengue while traveling in Vietnam, illustrating import-linked risk. Symptoms include high fever up to 40°C and intense bone and muscle pains; incubation is 3–14 days. There is no universal dengue vaccine; protection relies on repellents and preparedness. No quarantine is mandated, but travelers are advised to monitor fever for two weeks and inform clinicians of travel history.

article.articleHeadline: Isabella Scherer revela diagnóstico de toxoplasmose na gravidez e acende alerta sobre doenças no pré-natal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Isabella Scherer reveals toxoplasmosis diagnosis during pregnancy and raises the alarm about prenatal diseases.
article.articleSummary: Toxoplasmosis diagnosed during Isabella Scherer's third pregnancy. The MasterChef winner was 10 weeks pregnant when routine prenatal tests detected infection, prompting immediate treatment. Amniocentesis at 18 weeks showed the fetus was not infected with Toxoplasma gondii. The infection's source remains unknown; the leading hypothesis is indirect exposure from sandbox areas in parks contaminated by feces of stray cats. Toxoplasmosis can be asymptomatic in adults but poses fetal transmission risk; early detection and treatment helped prevent fetal infection. Scherer is the daughter of Olympic swimmer Fernando Scherer, known as Xuxa.

article.articleHeadline: Dr. Sudhir Parikh, President Of Global Association Of Physicians Of Indian Origin Pledges To Help Maharashtra's Mission To Eliminate Tuberculosis - News India Times
article.articleSummary: TB elimination efforts in Maharashtra gain support as Dr. Sudhir Parikh of GAPIO pledges to assist the state’s National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP). The partnership with Commissioner of Health Services Sanjay Katkar aims to accelerate Maharashtra’s TB Mukt Bharat drive, with India reporting incidence down from 210 to 163 per lakh and a target of 42 per lakh. Under the 2030 goal, 12,000 of roughly 28,000 gram panchayats have been declared TB Mukt. The Ni-kshay Mitra Initiative and Ni-kshay digital portal enable patient tracking and telemedicine, including rural/tribal outreach with X-ray teams. GAPIO's network of about 1.4 million doctors across 60+ countries could contribute via education, CME webinars, prevention messaging, and technology, while stressing four-pronged focus: detect, treat, prevent, and build to reach the elimination target.

triage.headline_ja: インド系医師世界協会（GAPIO）会長スディール・パリク博士、マハラシュトラ州の結核撲滅ミッション支援を表明
triage.triage_reason: 既存の国家結核撲滅プログラム（NTEP）に関する支援表明・協力体制の紹介記事であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核（慢性感染症）撲滅に向けた既存プログラムの進捗と国際協力を報じるもので、新規発生や急性アウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: El Nino pode impulsionar casos de dengue em 2027
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño could boost dengue cases in 2027.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces a potential El Niño–driven surge in dengue and chikungunya as moderate-to-strong El Niño may develop from the second half of 2026, per Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia. Aedes aegypti proliferation could raise outbreak risk; the Ministry of Health issued a technical note urging states and municipalities to strengthen preventive surveillance and vector control. Projections by InfoDengue and Fiocruz estimate about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027. Warmer temperatures and increased rainfall raise standing water and breeding sites. Recommendations include prompt transmission-blocking measures after first suspected cases, reorganizing routine vector-control tasks, using approved vector-control technologies, and urging households to eliminate breeding sites and monitor symptoms. Projections may be revised as monitoring systems update. Through June 2026, Brazil reported 392,800 dengue cases (down 73% from 2025) and chikungunya down 46%.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョが2027年のデング熱症例を押し上げる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 2027年に向けたエルニーニョ由来のデング熱・チクングニア熱増加の将来予測記事であり、現時点（2026年6月まで）の症例数はむしろ前年比で大幅減少している。将来的なリスクとして継続的な監視が必要だが、現状で緊急のシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事は気象予測（エルニーニョ）に基づく2027年の将来的な症例数予測であり、実際の異常発生を報告するものではない。保健省は予防的な技術通達を発出済み。現状（2026年6月まで）のデング熱・チクングニア熱症例数は前年比で減少傾向にある。

article.articleHeadline: Sud-Kivu : le Mpox toujours actif avec plus de 3 900 cas notifiés depuis début 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Kivu: Mpox still active with more than 3,900 cases notified since the beginning of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Mpox remains active in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo. Since the start of 2026, the province has recorded 3,945 confirmed mpox cases, with 3 deaths reported this year and a low fatality rate. Twenty-seven of the province’s 34 health zones are affected, with Nyangezi health zone alone reporting over 1,000 confirmed cases. Although mpox has been declared no longer a current public health emergency in the DRC, transmission continues and some response partners have withdrawn, according to local civil society sources. The provincial health division says that some interventions are ongoing to counter the outbreak. South Kivu is also impacted by an Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with 3 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: 南キブ州:2026年初頭から3,900件以上のMpox症例が報告され、依然として活発な流行が継続
triage.triage_reason: DRC南キブ州で3,900件超のMpox症例が継続的に発生し34保健地区中27地区に拡大、加えてエボラ症例も確認されており、国際的関心と対応資源の必要性が高い状況。
triage.notes: MpoxはPHEIC指定解除後も感染が継続し、対応パートナーの一部撤退が報告されている。同地域でエボラ確定例3件も併発しており、複合的な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue despencam 72% em Londrina em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases drop 72% in Londrina in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Londrina, Brazil, totals 1,301 confirmations and two deaths in 2026, a 72% drop from the same period in 2025 when more than 4,700 cases were recorded. Fatalities fell 78%, from nine in 2025 to two in 2026. There have been 10,408 notifications, with 8,162 discarded and 945 under laboratory investigation. Despite improvement, authorities urge continued vector control and sanitation to prevent Aedes aegypti proliferation. The Municipal Health Secretariat conducts preventive inspections, drone-based aerial sweeps, urban cleaning, and weekly ovitrap monitoring; residents can request inspections by phone or online. Londrina advances the second phase of Wolbachia, releasing Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes to block dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, expanding from 60% to 100% of the urban area in H2 2026. Training with Wolbachia Brazil experts began July 23. A forecast from WMO/INMET cautions El Niño may boost mosquito spread from October, requiring heightened vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドリーナ市、2026年のデング熱症例が72%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例・死亡数は前年から大幅減少しており、公衆衛生上の異常な悪化ではなくむしろ改善傾向を示す通常のモニタリング記事である。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア・ジカ熱の予防としてWolbachia感染蚊放出プログラムが拡大中であり、季節性のベクター対策記事。エルニーニョによる今後の感染拡大リスクへの言及はあるが、現時点での異常な増加は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue segue com queda de 72% de casos em Londrina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue continues to see a 72% drop in cases in Londrina.
article.articleSummary: On July 23, 2026, Londrina, Brazil reports 1,301 confirmed dengue cases in 2026 to date, with nine new cases in the latest bulletin; this marks a 72% reduction from the same period in 2025, when over 4,700 cases were recorded. Dengue deaths stand at two so far in 2026, down from nine in the first 29 weeks of 2025. Notifications total 10,408 this year, with 8,162 discarded and 945 under analysis. Health authorities urge ongoing vector-control measures, including eliminating water-collecting containers, maintaining clean yards, and community participation to curb Aedes aegypti. Wolbachia-based control is underway: release of Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti; phase one completed in 2025 covering 60% of the municipality, with phase two expanding across the urban area in the second half of 2026. A Ministry note warns El Niño may boost arbovirus transmission from October onward, urging intensified surveillance and care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドリーナのデング熱、症例数72%減少が継続
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年比72%減少と改善傾向にあり、既存の対策（Wolbachia法など）が奏功している。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu/Ebola : le transport des dépouilles désormais soumis à une autorisation sanitaire à Beni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu/Ebola: the transport of corpses is now subject to sanitary authorization in Beni
article.articleSummary: In Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, mayor Nyofondo Te-Kodale Jacob announced new Ebola response measures on July 23, 2026. Transport of a corpse between locations now requires a signed authorization by the chief medical officer of the relevant health zone. Additionally, every deceased person must be deposited at the morgue while administrative formalities and funeral arrangements are completed. The measures implement the provincial decree of May 27, 2026, governing the response to the 17th Ebola outbreak in North Kivu. The article does not provide case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or explicit infection sources, but the rules tighten sanitary controls around burials to curb transmission amid the outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: They plan to vaccinate 90% of dogs and cats against rabies in Yaracuy
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Yaracuy, Venezuela, targets immunizing 90% of dogs and cats, domestic and stray, under the National Plan 2026 for the Elimination of Rabies. Launched this week by the state health authority, Marilyn Velásquez, the program combines fixed vaccination points in community spaces with house-to-house outreach to reach families unable to travel. Doses are provided free of charge and aim to curb the virus and prevent human transmission. Initial deployment covers San Felipe, Independencia, Peña, Bruzual, and Nirgua, with a first large rollout in Fundo El Carmen (Independencia) vaccinating over 100 animals. The operation will continue daily through the year, supported by a census conducted with students from the Hugo Chávez University of Health Sciences and Unes, coordinated with ASIC 15 and the Nevado Mission. An auditable record will track progress toward the 90% target.

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : la communauté estudiantine sensibilisée à la prévention contre la maladie à virus Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: the student community sensitized to the prevention of Ebola virus disease - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, July 23, 2026: The Simon Kimbangu University (USK) student community was sensitized to Ebola virus disease (EVD) prevention during a conference organized by USK’s Faculty of Public Health. The event aimed to mobilize and educate on protection against EVD, including understanding epidemiology, transmission, and clinical manifestations, and to promote prevention protocols and barrier measures in university, community, and family settings. Opening remarks on behalf of Rector Charles Kisolokele Kiangani were delivered by Evariste Manambumba, who stressed the university’s role as a knowledge hub and frontline in prevention. The conference also sought to foster scientific exchange with the invited expert. The discourse noted that the disease has re-emerged in recent months, causing victims in the DRC and neighboring countries, and remains a major public health challenge. Theme: Dynamics of the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC: Stakes and Perspectives.

article.articleHeadline: Gonorreia em mulheres: entenda os riscos, sintomas e a importância do diagnóstico precoce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gonorrhea in women: understand the risks, symptoms, and the importance of early diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Gonorrhea in women, caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae, is often a silent sexually transmitted infection. Many infections are asymptomatic, delaying care and increasing risk of complications. When symptoms occur, they include abnormal vaginal discharge, painful or burning urination, and postmenstrual bleeding; absence of pain does not exclude infection, underscoring the need for routine testing. If untreated, the bacteria can ascend to the uterus and fallopian tubes, causing pelvic inflammatory disease with infertility, ectopic pregnancy, and chronic pelvic pain; Bartholin gland involvement can cause swelling and severe vaginal pain requiring medical care. Transmission occurs via mucosal contact during vaginal, anal, or oral sex; ejaculation is not required. Vertical transmission during childbirth risks neonatal conjunctivitis. Diagnosis uses NAAT testing of urine or cervical, rectal, or pharyngeal swabs; culture may assess resistance. Treatment commonly includes ceftriaxone by injection, with partner treatment to prevent reinfection, guided by WHO guidelines. Context includes prevalence and Brazilian reporting.

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola en RDC : le gouvernement mobilise 50 millions de dollars pour la riposte | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in the DRC: The government mobilizes $50 million for the response
article.articleSummary: DR Congo mobilizes $50 million for Ebola response across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka announced the fund on July 23, 2026, in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo. The allocation targets epidemiological surveillance, patient care, vaccination campaigns, logistics, and prevention and awareness activities to ensure a rapid, coordinated response. Technical and financial partners have mobilized substantial resources to align priorities and disbursements. Authorities continue to collaborate with national and international partners to contain transmission. The Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,000 Ebola-related deaths nationwide.

article.articleHeadline: Ugandan scientists say ebola strain undergoes genetic changes
article.articleSummary: As of 23 July 2026, Ugandan researchers report that the Ebola Bundibugyo virus circulating in the Democratic Republic of Congo has undergone genetic changes that may affect diagnostic tests. The DRC outbreak persists, while Uganda has recorded two confirmed Ebola deaths in the May 2026 outbreak. Bundibugyo, first identified in Uganda’s Bundibugyo District in 2007 (149 confirmed cases, 42 deaths then), is now shown by comprehensive genomic analysis from Makerere University to be evolving in ways not observed in the more genetically stable Ebola Zaire or Sudan strains. Mutations could indicate an increased ability to infect animals, prompting questions about transmission and evolution. Efforts to develop vaccines and treatments specific to Bundibugyo are underway, but no approved vaccine or therapy exists. Diagnostics based on earlier viral sequences may be less accurate due to these changes, according to Dr. Henry Kyobe and colleagues.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの科学者、エボラ株が遺伝子変化を起こしていると報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行に加え、診断検査の精度に影響しうる遺伝子変異が確認され、ウガンダにも感染が拡大していることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの研究者による報告だが、当該遺伝子変異が確認されたエボラ株はDRCで流行中のもの。ウガンダも感染確認例があるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法が未承認である点、診断精度低下の懸念は国際的対応の必要性を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirose: 17 casos da doença são registrados no Paraná em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis: 17 cases of the disease have been recorded in Paraná in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in Paraná, Brazil, surged during the rainy season with roughly 170 cases and 12 deaths from January–June 2026. There were 839 notifications and 47 investigations ongoing. The disease, caused by Leptospira bacteria primarily shed in rat urine, poses greater risk in flooded areas where water and mud can contaminate skin wounds or mucous membranes (eyes, nose, mouth). Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with floodwater; when unavoidable, wear boots and impermeable gloves, or, if unavailable, plastic bags to cover hands and feet. Exposed individuals should watch for fever, headache, calf muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, jaundice, and diarrhea. Symptoms usually appear 5–14 days after exposure, but incubation can reach up to 30 days.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani: Judith Suminwa veut renforcer les capacités locales de diagnostic avec l'opérationnalisation imminente d'un nouveau laboratoire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: Judith Suminwa wants to strengthen local diagnostic capacities with the imminent operationalization of a new laboratory.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Kisangani, DRC: Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka led a high-level mission on July 23, 2026, to Kisangani, Tshopo, amid the resurgence of Ebola. After inspecting response facilities, she reported progress two months after the official declaration of DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak and weeks after first cases appeared in Tshopo. She noted five imported Ebola cases in Tshopo: two deceased at presentation, two arriving already dead, and one survivor; contact tracing teams have identified and are monitoring nearly all contacts. The government has released $50 million for the nationwide response, with partners mobilizing about $1 billion; ongoing work aims to align priorities with disbursements. She announced the imminent operationalization within a week of a new diagnostic laboratory in Kisangani, enabling local Ebola analyses rather than sending samples to Kinshasa (INRB). Emphasizing community engagement, she aims to boost early detection, currently around 10%.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ流行：ジュディス・スミンワ首相、新診断ラボの稼働開始を目前に地域の診断能力強化を目指す

article.articleHeadline: Minas confirma 42 casos de coqueluche, e especialista indica 'desconfiança' para evitar novos surtos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais confirms 42 cases of pertussis, and an expert suggests 'mistrust' to prevent new outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports 42 confirmed pertussis cases in 2026 through July 23, with 233 suspected and no deaths; 2025 had 1,745 notifications, 539 confirmations and one death. Experts warn against relaxing prevention; Bordetella pertussis spreads via droplets and early diagnosis and treatment can interrupt transmission; pertussis can be severe in infants under 1 year. In 2025, 125 cases were under 1 year and 135 were 1–4 years; in 2026, infants under 1 year account for 13 of 42. Vaccination coverage has fallen: dTpa 97.82% (2024), 96.81% (2025), 85.11% (Jan–May 2026); pentavalent 94.05%, 92.18%, 85.54%; DTP boosters 91.51%, 88.04%, 75.82%. Belo Horizonte led confirmations in 2025 (158); in 2026 Cruzília leads (16) with 9 in BH. Vaccination via SUS includes dTpa from 20 weeks gestation and pentavalent at 2,4,6 months with boosters at 15 months and 4 years.

article.articleHeadline: Saúde alerta para aumento da transmissão de dengue e chikungunya com El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities warn of increased transmission of dengue and chikungunya due to El Niño.
article.articleSummary: Brazil may face increased transmission of arboviruses, including dengue and chikungunya, from the second half of this year due to El Niño. Projections by InfoDengue/Fiocruz estimate about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027. The World Meteorological Organization and the Brazilian National Institute of Meteorology warn that El Niño could be moderate to strong, boosting conditions for Aedes aegypti spread. Higher temperatures and rainfall in some regions, and drought in others, may drive water storage and mosquito breeding. These projections are epidemiological estimates based on climate scenarios and may be updated as models evolve. The Ministry of Health will continue monitoring and may issue alerts. As of 20 June 2026, dengue cases totalled 392,800, a 73% drop versus the same period last year; chikungunya fell 46%. Authorities urge intensified surveillance and vector control to block early cases and eliminate breeding sites; the public should seek care for symptoms promptly.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョによりデング熱・チクングニア熱の感染拡大の恐れ、保健当局が警告
triage.triage_reason: エルニーニョに伴う将来的な感染拡大予測に関する記事であり、直近のデング熱・チクングニア熱症例数はむしろ前年比で大幅減少しているため、現時点で緊急のシグナルとは言えないが、季節的リスクとして経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月時点のデータで、症例数は前年同期比でデング熱73%減、チクングニア熱46%減と報告されており、将来（2027年）予測に基づく警告記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Limpurb intensifica limpeza em Paripe com ação contra a dengue | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Limpurb intensifies cleaning in Paripe with anti-dengue action
article.articleSummary: As of July 22–24, 2026, Limpurb intensified cleaning in Paripe, a neighborhood in Salvador’s Railway Suburb, to curb Aedes aegypti breeding and reduce dengue, Zika, and chikungunya risk. The event, part of Operation Bairro no Grau, mobilizes more than 70 agents and also covers Tubarão and Cocisa, focusing on street cleaning, lawn care, washing, and debris removal, with trucks and dumpsters aiding rapid waste removal. A new bulky-waste outreach service, Bota Fora, collects large items (furniture, mattresses, appliances) that can accumulate water and harbor mosquitoes. Residents are urged to separate objects before the visit to facilitate collection and deter illegal dumping. Limpurb plans weekly operations across Salvador to expand cleaning, cut irregular waste, and strengthen arbovirus prevention. Local residents praised the improvements in Paripe, noting cleaner streets and visible neighborhood benefits.

article.articleHeadline: Journal de l'Afrique - Ebola en RDC et en Ouganda : le bilan dépasse désormais les 1 000 morts, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa Journal - Ebola in the DRC and Uganda: the death toll has now surpassed 1,000, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-23, Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda have surpassed 1,000 deaths, according to the World Health Organization. Ituri province in the DRC remains the epicenter of the flare‑up. Two clinical trials have opened in Ituri, providing an encouraging path forward amid the response. Africa CDC (the African Union’s health agency) has urged the United States to lift travel restrictions, arguing they are ineffective at preventing the virus’s spread. The article centers on the epidemic’s gravity, the emergence of potential therapeutic approaches, and the need for sustained international coordination to contain transmission and improve patient outcomes. No other infectious disease events are described beyond Ebola in this report.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : 4 nouveaux guéris, dont une soignante, quittent le centre de traitement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: 4 new recoveries, including a nurse, leave the treatment center.
article.articleSummary: On July 23, 2026, four Ebola recoveries left Katwa Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) in Butembo, North Kivu. Three were laboratory-confirmed cases (two women and a man); the fourth was a suspected case ruled non-case after examination. The departures bring total recoveries at Katwa ETC to 28 since its rehabilitation by MEDAIR. One recovered patient is a nurse who contracted Ebola after caring for a patient; she reports proper care, urges adherence to barrier measures, and asks the public not to fear the ETC amid circulating rumors. She describes symptoms—headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, high fever—and notes treatment lasted about a week. The center has housed roughly forty confirmed cases since rehabilitation, with about twenty recovered and others still receiving care. Ongoing community resistance persists in some areas, including attacks on centers; officials say each recovery helps raise awareness and promotes timely care to maximize survival.
