article.articleHeadline: Rapid Review Quiz: 2026 Ebola Outbreak Update
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease drives the 2026 Ebola outbreak concentrated in Central and East Africa, notably eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring countries, with ongoing person-to-person transmission. By late June 2026, the outbreak was among the largest in the region in recent years. Laboratory analysis confirmed Bundibugyo virus (Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense) as the causative agent, with initial genomic sequencing suggesting a recently emerged strain and evidence of a zoonotic origin, though the reservoir remains unidentified. Bundibugyo virus has few prior outbreaks since its 2007 recognition. In contrast, separate outbreaks occurred for Zaire ebolavirus in the DRC (self-limited, ended Nov 2025) and Sudan ebolavirus in Uganda (2025). There is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo; treatment is supportive. CDC/WHO guidance stresses immediate isolation, PPE, and testing for patients with compatible symptoms and relevant travel history, especially among healthcare workers; early detection relies on travel/exposure history, with bleeding reported in some cases.

triage.headline_ja: 迅速レビュークイズ：2026年エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの最新情報
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyoウイルスによる稀少かつ大規模なエボラアウトブレイクがDRC東部を中心に発生し、人-人感染が継続していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyoウイルスによる2026年エボラアウトブレイクを中心に報告しており、主たる発生地はDRC東部。UgandaはSudan ebolavirusによる別の2025年アウトブレイク、MozambiqueとCentral Africaは地域概念のため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsとした。ワクチン・特効薬が未承認である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde em Campinas registra 38 bairros que apresentam maior risco de transmissão da dengue | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health in Campinas reports 38 neighborhoods with a higher risk of dengue transmission | Rápido no Ar
article.articleSummary: On July 23, 2026, Campinas, São Paulo, issued its 30th Arboviruses Alert, designating 38 neighborhoods as high-risk for dengue transmission. The affected areas span Leste (East), Noroeste (Northwest), Norte (North), Sudoeste (Southwest), Sul (South), and Sudeste (Southeast) regions, reflecting widespread transmission risk. From Jan 1 to Jun 28, 2026, there were 3,531 confirmed dengue cases in the city. Health teams conducted 820,643 in-home visits for vector-control and education and carried out 53,382 fogging operations. The alert aims to reinforce home inspections for Aedes aegypti breeding sites and to expand intensified actions in affected neighborhoods. It notes that about 80% of breeding sites are indoors. Preventive guidance includes eliminating standing water, disposing or cleaning containers, and regularly refreshing plant pot water every two days, cleaning saucers every seven days, and sealing water tanks, with unused toilets kept closed.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスの保健当局、デング熱伝播リスクが高い38地区を報告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はブラジルで季節的・地域的に流行しており、本記事は自治体レベルでの通常の警戒・対策活動を報告するもので、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年見られる風土病であり、本記事は自治体の定期的な警戒レベル発表と対策実施報告に過ぎない。死亡や重症例の具体的言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Jamshedpur News: मुसाबनी में चिकन पॉक्स के 20 मरीज मिले, छह के रक्त नमूने जांच के लिए सदर अस्पताल भेजे
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jamshedpur News: 20 chickenpox patients found in Musabani; blood samples of six sent to Sadar Hospital for testing.
article.articleSummary: On July 23, 2026, in the Jamshedpur area, about 20 people across children, women, and men in Tilabani Dhibar Basti, Baraghath village, Musabani reported chickenpox-like symptoms. Six patients' blood samples were sent to Sadar Hospital for laboratory testing while the rest were kept in home isolation. A district health team, including a CHC physician and auxiliary nurses, conducted examinations, provided medicines, and advised strict cleanliness and isolation. All patients are reported stable with no severe illness. Health workers distributed treatment and information on symptoms and prevention; families typically have 2-3 cases each. Vitamin A doses were administered. The health department instructed MPW and Sahiya (community health workers) to monitor households and report updates. Chickenpox is expected to resolve in 3-5 days, according to the department.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプールニュース:ムサバニで水痘患者20人発見、6人の血液サンプルを検査のためサダル病院へ送付
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は既知の感染症で局地的な小規模発生に留まり、患者は全員安定しており重症例もないため、国際的拡大や公衆衛生上の重大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局が既に対応し、患者は安定・軽症で在宅隔離中。水痘は一般的な感染症でありパンデミックポテンシャルは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura capacita Agentes Comunitários de Saúde para enfrentar hepatites virais em Mogi das Cruzes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall Trains Community Health Agents to Tackle Viral Hepatitis in Mogi das Cruzes.
article.articleSummary: City Hall of Mogi das Cruzes will train about 160 Community Health Agents on confronting viral hepatitis on July 28, as part of the Julho Amarelo campaign and World Hepatitis Day. The training, in Auditório do Prédio 2, Centro, aims to strengthen ACS work in education, early case identification, and referral for testing, vaccination, and treatment. It uses the Ministério da Saúde’s ABCDE das Hepatites Virais for ACSs, covering hepatitis A–E, transmission, symptoms, prevention, vaccination, rapid testing, and populations at higher vulnerability, and clarifying the ACSs’ roles in care and follow-up. Municipal Health Secretary Rebeca Barufi emphasizes permanent capacity-building to connect services with communities, expanding prevention, early diagnosis, and care to reduce viral hepatitis cases. Hepatitis infections target the liver and can be asymptomatic; information, vaccination (A and B for specific groups), and rapid tests are key to stopping transmission and enabling timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: モジ・ダス・クルーゼス市、地域保健エージェントにウイルス性肝炎対策研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界肝炎デーに合わせた啓発・研修活動の紹介であり、アウトブレイクや異常な症例増加を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は公衆衛生キャンペーン・研修に関する内容で、疾病発生の報告ではないため対象国リストに該当しても除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo surpasses 1,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 1,000 deaths among 2,536 confirmed cases as of Thursday; the outbreak, declared May 15, continues to accelerate. The epicenter is Ituri province, where three decades of conflict and displacement camps housing more than 900,000 people complicate response. The epidemic has spread to Tshopo and Haut-Uele provinces, with confirmed cases in Kisangani, a city of more than one million linked to Kinshasa. WHO and Africa CDC estimate a response budget of $518 million but face a shortfall exceeding $400 million. Healthcare workers protest inadequate pay and working conditions; treatment centers run at full capacity, forcing patients to wait at home and heightening transmission risk. Prime Minister Judith Suminwa planned to visit outbreak hotspots with U.S. and U.N. officials. Without increased funding, officials warn that controlling the outbreak will be unlikely.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ死者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRコンゴで急速に拡大し死者1,000人超・確認症例2,536人、複数州へ拡大し資金不足で対応が困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州を中心にツショポ州・オートウエレ州へ拡大、キサンガニ（人口100万超）での症例確認、資金不足4億ドル超、医療従事者のストライキも報告されており、対応能力に深刻な懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Why health officials do not have a good handle on the current Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has claimed over 1,000 lives and sickened more than 2,400 people over roughly two months, with daily case counts persisting. Contact tracing remains insufficient, with more than 80% of newly identified cases occurring outside known contact networks, signaling unseen transmission chains amid a mobile workforce and ongoing conflict. About two-thirds of deaths occur outside formal health systems as many seek traditional healers, stay home, or lack access to facilities, with stigma and distrust hindering surveillance. The World Health Organization plans to train about 21,000 community workers to boost tracing, though experts caution this may not fully close the detection gap. Trials of experimental treatments and preventive drugs are underway, offering a potential path to rebuild trust and increase clinic engagement, strengthening outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局が現在のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを十分に把握できていない理由
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,000人以上の死者、2,400人以上の感染者を出すエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続中で、接触追跡が不十分なため未検出の感染連鎖が疑われ、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: WHOが約21,000人のコミュニティワーカーを訓練予定であり、国際支援が既に動員されていることから管理可能性についても懸念（外部支援必要）に該当。実験的治療薬・予防薬の治験も進行中。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode fazer com que casos de dengue e chikungunya aumentem no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño Could Cause Dengue and Chikungunya Cases to Rise in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces an elevated risk of dengue and chikungunya as El Niño is projected to be moderate-to-strong from the second half of 2026, boosting Aedes aegypti breeding. The Health Ministry issued a technical note urging states and municipalities to intensify arbovirus surveillance and vector-control efforts, with transmission-blocking actions triggered after the first cases and a reorganization of vector-control tasks. Projections from InfoDengue/Fiocruz estimate dengue could reach about 1.7 million cases in 2027. In 2026, Brazil reported 392,800 dengue cases as of June 20, down 73% from the same period in 2025, and chikungunya cases decreased by 46%. Authorities emphasize checking home breeding sites and recognizing virus signs, while noting projections may be revised as models incorporate new data.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがブラジルのデング熱・チクングニア熱症例を増加させる可能性
triage.triage_reason: El Niñoによる将来予測に基づく季節性サーベイランス記事であり、現時点でのデング・チクングニア症例数は前年比で減少しており異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は将来予測（2027年推計1.7万件）に基づく注意喚起であり、2026年時点の実績値は前年比で大幅減少（デング-73%、チクングニア-46%）。保健省は通常の技術的対応（サーベイランス強化・ベクター対策）を実施中であり、緊急性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: जांच में 65 मिले मलेरिया पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 65 tested positive for malaria
article.articleSummary: 65 malaria-positive cases detected in Chakradharpur block's rural areas during the Mission Uday malaria control program, conducted from July 6 to August 15. Of about 12,000 individuals suspected of malaria, health teams confirmed positives and provided treatment at the rural level, distributing medicines alongside follow-up care. Pregnant women who tested positive were prioritized for preventive measures, including distribution of mosquito nets and comprehensive guidance on proper usage to reduce exposure. The Sub-Divisional Hospital's in-charge Medical Officer, Dr. Anshuman Sharma, stated the campaign ensures timely diagnosis and treatment within rural communities, potentially curbing transmission during the ongoing malaria-control drive.

triage.headline_ja: 検査で65人がマラリア陽性
triage.triage_reason: 既存の季節性マラリア対策プログラム（Mission Uday）の一環としての通常の症例検出・治療活動であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの当該地域で地域流行しており、本記事は既存の対策プログラムによる定期的な検出・治療活動を報告するものであり、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Programa itinerante leva prevenção à esquistossomose ao Guamá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itinerant program brings schistosomiasis prevention to Guamá.
article.articleSummary: First edition of the Municipal Itinerant Schistosomiasis Control Program (PMCE) was held at ESF Riacho Doce in Guamá, Belém, Pará, on July 23, 2026, emphasizing education, prevention, and guidance for schistosomiasis and other parasitic diseases. Residents received transmission and prevention information, viewed an educational mollusk exhibit, and obtained materials while PMCE staff answered questions. The session underscored ongoing, permanent surveillance by the Belém program; from 2024 through July 2026, 9,359 coproparasitological exams identified 191 Schistosoma mansoni positives. Annual positives: 44 in 2024, 74 in 2025, and 73 in 2026 so far. Preventive advice emphasized avoiding contact with risk areas, hygiene, and protective measures in flooded or transmission-prone sites. Free diagnostics are offered at the PMCE headquarters (Avenida Romulo Maiorana, 552, Marco neighborhood); reports of Biomphalaria snails should be sent to pcebelem@sesma.pmb.pa.gov.br.

triage.headline_ja: 巡回プログラムがグアマ地区に住血吸虫症予防を届ける
triage.triage_reason: 既存の公衆衛生教育・啓発活動に関する定例的な報道であり、異常な流行や新たな公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の地方公衆衛生プログラムによる住血吸虫症の予防啓発・監視活動を伝えるもので、症例数は年次的に安定しており急増や異常事態を示唆する内容はない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: South Kivu reports more than 3,900 mpox cases this year
article.articleSummary: DRC's South Kivu province reports mpox (Monkeypox) activity with 3,945 confirmed cases since January 1, 2026, and 3 deaths; the fatality rate is described as low. Justin Bengehya, head of health information and epidemiological surveillance for the Provincial Health Division, notes 27 of 34 health zones are affected, with Nyangezi health zone containing more than 1,000 cases, the most affected. Mpox was declared no longer a current public health emergency in the DRC, yet transmission persists and some health partners are reportedly no longer working, per local civil society sources. The Provincial Health Division says some interventions are underway to combat the disease. South Kivu is also affected by the Ebola epidemic in the DRC, with 3 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:南キブ州で今年3,900人超のMpox症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 南キブ州で27/34保健地区に拡大する大規模なMpox流行が継続しており、公衆衛生上の緊急事態解除後も対応が縮小している点、加えて同地域でエボラ出血熱の確認例も併発している点から、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 同地域でエボラ出血熱の確認例（3例）も報告されており、複合的な感染症危機の可能性がある。Mpoxの緊急事態宣言解除後も保健パートナーの撤退により対応能力が低下している点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisadores da USP criam teste que identifica superbactérias em apenas seis horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers from the University of São Paulo create a test that identifies superbugs in just six hours.
article.articleSummary: Carbapenem-resistant bacteria detected in six hours with a rapid test developed by researchers at the University of São Paulo (USP) in Brazil. The assay, described as akin to a pregnancy or COVID-19 test, uses a rectal swab placed in culture and incubated about six hours, then identifies resistance mechanisms with specific antibodies. Designed to replace traditional culture methods that can take up to three days, the test targets carbapenem-resistant bacteria, among the most worrisome hospital pathogens. In hospital pilots, adoption could shorten isolation times and cut costs, with estimated savings of around US$4,000 per week, while also reducing patient discomfort and anxiety. The work from USP’s Medical School underscores potential to speed identification of carriers in ICUs. Published July 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ大学(USP)の研究者、わずか6時間でスーパーバグを検出する検査法を開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規診断技術の開発に関する内容であり、感染症の発生・流行報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19の発生報告ではなく、カルバペネム耐性菌検出のための新規迅速検査技術の開発を報じるもの。感染症イベントのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: За две недели смертность от Эболы в ДР Конго выросла на 67% -- Reuters
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over two weeks, the Ebola mortality rate in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rose by 67% — Reuters.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, attributed to the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccines or specific treatments, has reached 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths as of July 23, 2026, a rise of about 67% from two weeks earlier. The outbreak’s toll rises amid ongoing fighting in eastern DRC, supply shortages, and attacks on health facilities, with misinformation fueling distrust of clinicians. Over the latest 24 hours, authorities reported 63 new confirmed cases and 34 deaths. The virus has also spread to Uganda, which has 20 reported cases; no new infections since June 22, and a last patient discharged on July 16, initiating a 42-day countdown for potential regional elimination. WHO has begun early clinical trials for Bundibugyo-focused interventions, while funding needs were estimated at $580 million in June.

triage.headline_ja: 2週間でDRコンゴのエボラ死亡率が67%上昇 ― ロイター
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常な急拡大、国際的拡大）し、WPRO基準も全て該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ウガンダでは42日間のカウントダウンが開始され地域的排除の可能性あり、続報の確認が必要。WHOによる臨床試験開始、資金需要5.8億ドルも重要な動向。

article.articleHeadline: За два тижні смертність від Еболи в ДР Конго зросла на 67% -- Reuters
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over two weeks, Ebola mortality in DR Congo rose by 67% — Reuters.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s ongoing Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has reached 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths as of July 23, 2026, about a 67% rise over two weeks. Declared in mid-May, transmission is believed to have begun weeks earlier. Bundibugyo’s mortality can reach ~40%, and there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for this strain. Ongoing conflict in eastern DRC, attacks on health facilities, and distrust of clinicians hamper containment, with reports of people fleeing quarantine. In the last 24 hours, 63 new confirmed cases and 34 deaths were reported. The outbreak has spilled into Uganda, which reports 20 cases; Uganda has had no new cases since June 22, and a 42-day countdown begins after the last patient’s discharge on July 16. WHO has begun early trials for Bundibugyo therapies; no licensed vaccines exist. A June appeal sought $580 million to bolster international response and curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 2週間でDRコンゴのエボラ死亡率が67%増加 — ロイター
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が拡大し死者1,033人・症例2,536人、ウガンダにも波及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、紛争による対応困難、国際支援要請（5.8億ドル）などリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola fuori controllo in Rdc oltre 2.300 casi confermati
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola out of control in the DRC with more than 2,300 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the northwestern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control two months after it began, with more than 2,300 confirmed cases and 930 deaths. About 80% of cases are concentrated in Ituri province, with infections also reported across four other provinces. World Health Organization estimates the true case count could be two to four times higher due to overwhelmed hospitals and under-detection. In response, health workers isolate the sick, trace and monitor contacts, and impose strict transmission-control measures to curb spread. The article highlights the ongoing epidemic in the DRC’s northwestern region, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, symptoms, or on imported/exported cases. The report is dated 2026-07-23, marking two months since the outbreak started.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が制御不能、確定症例2,300例超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで制御不能な状況にあり、2,300例超の確定症例と930人の死亡が報告されており、複数州に拡大していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率は約40%（930/2300）と非常に高い。WHOは実際の症例数が2〜4倍多い可能性を指摘しており、検出率の低さと医療体制の逼迫が懸念される。複数州への拡大が確認されており、フルRRAでの評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: The Discipline of Waiting: Uganda's 42-Day Ebola Countdown | Infection Control Today
article.articleSummary: Uganda ended its Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) outbreak with a 42-day countdown starting July 16, 2026, after the last confirmed patient tested negative and was discharged. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, there were 20 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2 deaths; 15 were imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and 5 locally acquired; no new confirmed case has been reported since June 21. Uganda’s success hinged on three pillars: exhaustive contact tracing, complete patient follow-up, and proactive community engagement. By July 16, all 836 identified contacts had completed follow-up, with monitoring extended to 36 high-risk districts and 38 border crossing points, about 70 WHO experts deployed, and ongoing cross-border collaboration with the DRC. A Kampala community-engagement effort helped restore trust when a suspected Ebola case was later confirmed not to be Ebola but a bacterial infection.

triage.headline_ja: 忍耐の規律：ウガンダのエボラ出血熱42日間カウントダウン
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は常に重大な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、DRCからウガンダへの越境感染（輸入症例15例）が確認されているためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 本記事はウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの終息（42日間カウントダウン完了）を報じるもの。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし20症例中15例がDRCからの輸入例であり、DRC国内での感染拡大が背景にあることから、DRCをverified_locationsに含めた。既に終息宣言済みであり新規性は低いが、越境感染の実績があるため経過観察・記録として妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Fenômeno El Niño pode aumentar casos de chikungunya e dengue no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño phenomenon could increase chikungunya and dengue cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Ministry of Health issued an alert to states and municipalities about a potential rise in dengue and chikungunya linked to the El Niño phenomenon, which could intensify from the second half of 2026 through 2027. Projections by InfoDengue/Fiocruz estimate about 1.7 million dengue cases in 2027. Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia (Inmet) notes higher temperatures and rainfall would boost Aedes aegypti breeding, sustaining transmission of arboviruses. In response, the Health Ministry urges strengthened surveillance, vector control, and mosquito source reduction, and advises the public to eliminate standing-water containers and monitor for symptoms. Despite concerns, 2026 numbers show a downturn: as of June 20, 2026, Brazil recorded 392,800 dengue cases, a 73% decline from the same period in 2025, and chikungunya cases fell by about 46%.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ現象がブラジルのチクングニア熱・デング熱症例数を増加させる可能性
triage.triage_reason: エルニーニョによる将来的なデング熱・チクングニア熱増加への警戒を促す予防的な内容であり、実際の2026年症例数はむしろ前年比で大幅減少しているため、異常事態や緊急のシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルの風土病であり季節性の予防喚起記事。2026年の実数値（デング熱392,800例、前年比73%減、チクングニア熱46%減）は増加傾向を示しておらず、将来予測に基づく注意喚起にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: SP alerta para prevenção e diagnóstico precoce da febre amarela
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: São Paulo warns about the prevention and early diagnosis of yellow fever.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state, Brazil, recorded 19 cases of spotted fever (febre maculosa) and 18 deaths in 2026, caused by Rickettsia bacteria and transmitted by bites from infected ticks found on animals such as capybaras, horses, and dogs. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat (SES-SP) issued an alert emphasizing prevention and the importance of early diagnosis and treatment. Early symptoms typically appear about seven days post-infection and include fever, severe headache, myalgia/arthralgia, and fatigue. Between days three and five, a red macular rash may develop, starting at the wrists and ankles and possibly spreading to the arms, palms, and soles. Public health guidance focuses on reducing tick exposure and prompt medical evaluation for suspected cases to improve outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: JJ:サンパウロ州、黄熱病の予防と早期診断を呼びかけ（紅斑熱にも言及）
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で紅斑熱（Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever）19例中18例が死亡という極めて高い致死率が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 致死率(18/19=約95%)が異常に高く、ダニ媒介性のためヒト-ヒト感染はないが、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があるためRRAへの移行を推奨。カピバラ・馬・犬に付着するダニが媒介するリケッチア感染症であり、動物由来の曝露が継続する可能性がある点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de raiva bovina é confirmado em Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bovine rabies case confirmed in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Bovine rabies confirmed in Itapiranga, western Santa Catarina, Brazil. The state veterinary agency Cidasc diagnosed rabies in a dairy cow that died on July 12; another cow on the same farm with compatible symptoms is under monitoring. This year, Santa Catarina has recorded 26 bovine rabies cases, with the highest deaths in Pescaria Brava (6), Chapecó (4), Orleans (3), and several other municipalities (1–2). Rabies is a viral, incurable disease of the central nervous system transmitted to cattle and other mammals, including humans, by the saliva of hematophagous bats Desmodus rotundus during bites. Incubation ranges 30–90 days; symptoms include behavioral changes, loss of appetite, hypersalivation, ataxia, weakness, and inability to rise; death typically occurs within 4–8 days due to respiratory paralysis. Prevention relies on herd vaccination; farmers should monitor for vampire bat roosts and report suspicions to authorities.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州で牛の狂犬病感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州における牛（家畜）の狂犬病流行に関する獣医学的報告であり、人への感染例はなく、コウモリ媒介の地域風土病として毎年発生している状況で、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事案は牛（家畜）の狂犬病で、吸血コウモリ（Desmodus rotundus）媒介によるもの。人への感染事例は記事中に言及なし。同州では年間26件の牛狂犬病例が既に報告されており、地域の風土病的状況とみられ、家畜衛生当局（Cidasc）がワクチン接種で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Primera ministra de RDC realizó chequeo a respuesta de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prime Minister of the DRC conducted an assessment of the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: July 23, 2026 — In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka assessed the Ebola response in Tshopo and Ituri provinces. In Kisangani, capital of Tshopo, she visited the provincial public health laboratory and discussed strengthening training of community linkages for rapid detection of suspected cases. She outlined plans for a new provincial reference laboratory and urged closer coordination with Africa CDC, the U.S. CDC, and UN partners. She called for expanded surveillance at entry/exit points and along the Congo River to curb transmission, noting that recoveries provide hope and that alarm should not rise solely from case counts. The government has released $50 million for the response, with partners mobilising about $1 billion. After Tshopo, she visited Bunia in Ituri, the Ebola epicenter, to reaffirm continued containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国首相、エボラ対応の視察を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的アウトブレイクに対し首相自ら視察し、国際的パートナー（Africa CDC、米国CDC、国連）との連携強化や約10億ドルの資金動員が言及されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数該当およびシグナルとして重要度が高い。
triage.notes: 既知の継続的エボラアウトブレイクへの対応状況の報告。TshopoおよびIturi州（Bunia：エピセンター）が対象。コンゴ川沿いの越境拡大リスクへの言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola : Judith Suminwa appelle à renforcer le
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Response to Ebola: Judith Suminwa calls for strengthening the
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola virus disease (EVD) response received a political push from Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka during a July 23 high-level Kisangani meeting in Tshopo. The government has released $50 million to bolster the national response, with roughly $1 billion mobilized by partners. For Kisangani, a new provincial laboratory is to be operational within a week, enabling all Ebola analyses locally rather than at INRB Kinshasa. Strengthened community engagement will deploy local relay volunteers to rapidly identify suspected cases. Scientific work on a vaccine for the new variant is progressing under Professor Jean-Jacques Muyembe. The PM urged calm, arguing that rising case numbers reflect improved awareness and faster hospital arrival, which should reduce fatalities with early screening after any exposure. She also visited the provincial public health lab handling Ebola, Mpox, and Covid-19 analyses, signaling intensified coordination near affected communities and care teams.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応:ジュディス・スミンワ首相がスクリーニング強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラウイルス病の新変異株が出現し、政府が5000万ドルを投入、国際パートナーが約10億ドルを動員するなど大規模な対応が進行中であり、複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応の政治的動員に焦点を当てており、新変異株に対するワクチン開発も進行中。Mpox・COVID-19は同じ検査室で扱われているという言及のみで、それ自体のアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: 蜱虫进入活跃期！专家提醒：游玩做好防护，防止蜱虫叮咬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ticks Have Entered Their Active Season! Experts Remind: Take Protective Measures During Outdoor Activities to Prevent Tick Bites.
article.articleSummary: Summer tick activity increases risk of tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS). Li Ting, deputy director of Heilongjiang Institute of Infectious Disease Prevention and Control, told a July 23 briefing that both diseases are tick-transmitted acute infections; TBE can cause high fever and altered consciousness, while SFTS features fever with low platelets and white blood cells, petechiae, gastrointestinal bleeding, and potential multi-organ dysfunction in severe cases. Most cases in China occur in mountainous or hilly tick-endemic areas; outdoor workers such as farmers and tea-pickers face higher exposure. Heilongjiang Province has not reported locally transmitted cases. Protective measures for outdoor activities include avoiding prolonged sitting/lying in grass or woods; wearing light-colored long sleeves and trousers, tucking pant legs into socks, and avoiding sandals; applying repellents containing DEET and other active ingredients; thoroughly checking for ticks after activities and on pets; showering and changing clothes after returning home; inspecting skin folds. If bitten, remove the tick with fine tweezers, disinfect, and seek medical care if fever, fatigue, or rash develops within about two weeks.

triage.headline_ja: ダニが活動期に!専門家が注意喚起:アウトドア活動時は防護を徹底し、ダニ刺咬を防止しよう
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のダニ媒介感染症に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、黒竜江省では現地感染例の報告もなく、異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の注意喚起・予防啓発を目的とした内容で、黒竜江省での局地的な感染例報告はない。TBEとSFTSは中国では既知の風土病であり、新規性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Duale Clarifies Reports 7 Americans Are Quarantined at Laikipia Ebola Facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale said reports that seven American humanitarian workers were quarantined at the Laikipia Ebola facility at Laikipia Air Base are inaccurate. He noted that, after a court directive, construction of the quarantine centre was halted and only the remaining 22 Ebola response sites are being built. Duale argued that disclosing quarantine-centre locations could deter Kenyans from seeking care. The seven Americans, members of Samaritan's Purse Disaster Assistance Response Team, were reported to have voluntarily relocated to the facility as a precaution during the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC); none showed Ebola symptoms. U.S. officials confirmed precautionary relocation and monitoring by the U.S. Public Health Service; the Kenyan government authorized admission, and the quarantine was 21 days. Duale also noted other quarantines, including staff of the President, during Ebola prevention.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ氏、7人の米国人がライキピアのエボラ施設で隔離されているとの報道を訂正
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行への対応活動に関するケニア国内の政治的論争が主題であり、新規の感染拡大シグナルではないが、既知のDRCエボラ流行に関連するため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア国内の検疫施設に関する政治的論争であり、ケニア・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。背景にあるDRCのエボラ流行のみverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Mỹ thu hồi gần 19 triệu quả trứng do nguy cơ nhiễm khuẩn Salmonella
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States recalls nearly 19 million eggs due to risk of Salmonella contamination.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 19 million eggs recalled in the United States due to Salmonella risk. Indiana-based producer voluntarily pulled eggs produced in Texas and distributed to multiple states, sold in major supermarkets and other retailers. Salmonella can cause fever, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and vomiting in healthy people; in young children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals it can lead to serious complications or death. FDA advises consumers to check packaging and avoid recalled products; those who bought affected eggs should return or discard them for safety. In Vietnam, a 55-year-old man in Ha Tinh province is in critical condition with a suspected Streptococcus suis infection after 10 days from eating goat blood pudding (tiết canh dê) at a restaurant, highlighting ongoing risk of bacterial infections and the need for prompt medical attention.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、サルモネラ菌汚染の恐れで卵約1900万個をリコール（ベトナム記事内でハティン省の連鎖球菌感染疑い症例にも言及）
triage.triage_reason: 米国での卵リコールは対象国外の事象であり、ベトナム・ハティン省での豚レンサ球菌（Streptococcus suis）感染疑いは単発の重症例で、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報は確認できない。
triage.notes: 米国の卵サルモネラリコールは対象国リスト外（United States）のため除外。ベトナムの症例は単発の食品由来感染（生の血のプディング喫食後）であり、豚レンサ球菌感染は同国では散発的に報告される既知の疾患であるため、現時点ではアウトブレイクの兆候は乏しい。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo: Prefeitura de Caruaru promove ação gratuita de prevenção e combate às hepatites virais no Marco Zero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July: Caruaru City Hall promotes a free initiative for the prevention and control of viral hepatitis at Marco Zero.
article.articleSummary: Caruaru City Hall, through the Municipal Health Secretariat, will host a free event on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, at 8:00 a.m., at Praça do Marco Zero in downtown Caruaru, as part of Julho Amarelo — Brazil's national campaign to raise awareness and fight viral hepatitis. The open event offers prevention, early diagnosis, and vaccination services, with health education, integrative therapies such as auriculotherapy and massage, rapid hepatitis tests, and vaccination against viral hepatitis. Viral hepatitis often presents with no symptoms in early stages; when they occur, common signs include fatigue, low-grade fever, nausea and vomiting, loss of appetite, right upper abdominal pain, dark urine, pale stools, jaundice, and itching. The initiative aims to improve screening and vaccination coverage among residents.

triage.headline_ja: イエロー・ジュライ:カルアル市役所がマルコ・ゼロ広場でウイルス性肝炎の予防・対策無料イベントを実施
triage.triage_reason: これは疫病発生に関する報告ではなく、ブラジル国内の啓発キャンペーンによる予防・検査・ワクチン接種の広報イベントに関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例の啓発・予防キャンペーン（Julho Amarelo）に関する市の広報であり、アウトブレイクや症例急増の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: レプトスピラ症の市場規模、2030年に7億9000万米ドル到達見込み
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis market size expected to reach $790 million by 2030.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis, caused by Leptospira bacteria, is projected to reach a market of $790 million by 2030, up from $540 million in 2025 and $590 million in 2026, with a 2025–2026 CAGR of 7.6% and a 2030 CAGR of 7.8%. Transmission occurs when humans contact water, soil, or food contaminated with urine from infected animals, especially rodents; entry is via skin wounds or mucous membranes. The disease ranges from mild fever, headache, and myalgias to severe hepatic and renal failure. Diagnostics include CBC, creatine kinase, liver enzymes, urinalysis, and blood cultures; treatment comprises antibiotics and supportive care, delivered in hospitals, clinics, or at home. Tariffs on diagnostic kits, reagents, antibiotics, and equipment raise costs in import-dependent regions such as Asia-Pacific and Latin America, though they may spur domestic production and stronger supply chains. Growth drivers include surveillance investments, rapid diagnostics, climate-related flood risks, public-health campaigns, and AI-based outbreak forecasting; trends feature genome-based detection and cloud-based epidemiology platforms.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症の市場規模、2030年に7億9000万米ドル到達見込み
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は市場調査レポートであり、実際の感染症発生や症例報告ではないため、シグナルとして扱う対象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は市場規模予測に関する業界レポートであり、特定の国での実際の発生事例を報じるものではない。発生地域として中国が付与されているが、記事内容に地域特異的な発生情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 1001 حالة وفاة بـ "إيبولا" في إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1001 Ebola deaths in Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola deaths in Africa surpassed 1,000 as of July 20, 2026, with 1,001 fatalities in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The DRC reported 2,473 confirmed Ebola cases, including 999 deaths, while Uganda recorded 20 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths, bringing the total to 2,493 cases since May 15. Ongoing treatment or isolation accounts for 737 patients, and 482 have recovered. The World Health Organization has initiated clinical trials of two treatments against the latest Ebola strain, signaling active therapeutic research amid the outbreak in DRC and Uganda. The data reflect a cross-border Ebola outbreak centered in these countries, with laboratory-confirmed counts and outcomes evolving as investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラによる死者1001人
triage.triage_reason: DRCとウガンダで国境を越えたエボラ流行が拡大し、死者1000人超・症例2493件と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生国だが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOによる治験開始など国際的関与が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Pneus abandonados que virariam foco de dengue, incêndio e poluição são triturados e usados como combustível alternativo em fornos de cimento, e só no Brasil o coprocessamento destinou 321,9 mil toneladas em 2024 para substituir parte do carvão e do coque de petróleo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discarded tires that would become a hotspot for dengue fever, fires and pollution are shredded and used as an alternative fuel in cement kilns, and in Brazil alone co-processing allocated 321,900 tonnes in 2024 to substitute part of coal and petroleum coke.
article.articleSummary: Brazil directed 321,953.51 tonnes of unusable tires to coprocessing in 2024, out of 784,111.58 tonnes of tire waste managed domestically, with coprocessing representing 41.06% of destinations. In cement kilns, shredded tires supply high-calorific energy at about 2,000°C, substituting part of coal and petroleum coke and allowing inorganic materials to be incorporated into clinker. The tire-derived fuel is valued for energy content, reportedly up to 25–50% higher than coal and far above wood. Beyond coprocessing, tires are also granulated, laminated, or pyrolyzed. The widespread disposal of tires in yards or vacant lots increases dengue risk by creating mosquito breeding sites and raises fire and pollution hazards. Brazil’s CONAMA Resolution 416 (2009) requires post-consumer tire collection and proper end-use by manufacturers/importers, addressing environmental liabilities while reducing fossil fuel use in cement production.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・火災・汚染の温床となりうる廃タイヤが粉砕され、セメント窯の代替燃料として利用される――ブラジルでは2024年に32万1900トンが石炭・石油コークスの代替として共処理された
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は廃タイヤ処理の環境・リサイクル文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の感染事例や流行状況に関する情報がなく、公衆衛生上のシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はタイヤ廃棄物のセメント産業での再利用に関するもので、デング熱は蚊の発生源リスクとして間接的に触れられているのみ。感染症イベントとしての実体的情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴのエボラ死者1000人突破、封じ込め難航　治安悪化と物資不足で
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo surpasses 1,000; containment proving difficult due to worsening security and shortages of supplies.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 1,000 people, with 2,536 confirmed cases and 1,033 deaths as of the night of July 22, 2026. This is the 17th outbreak in the country, declared in mid-May though transmission likely began weeks earlier. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with a case-fatality around 40% and for which there is no approved vaccine. Containment is hindered by deteriorating security in eastern Congo, where dozens of armed groups operate, and widespread shortages of basic supplies. Attacks on clinics and disruptions impede response, and burial restrictions have angered relatives. Conspiracy theories that the outbreak is fabricated have circulated. The combination of insecurity and resource gaps continues to challenge public health efforts and vaccination strategies for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者1000人突破、封じ込め難航　治安悪化と物資不足で
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約40%のエボラ流行で死者1000人超、治安悪化・ワクチン未承認により国際的拡大・支援必要性が高くIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による第17次流行で、致死率約40%、治安悪化により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Gov't rolls out smart mosquito traps to combat rising breeding rates
article.articleSummary: Macau's Health Bureau (SSM) is testing 30 intelligent mosquito traps imported from mainland China after two consecutive yellow-alert ovitrap readings in May and June, with the Aedes albopictus breeding index at 57.3% and 58.4%. Highest activity was recorded around Seac Pai Van (Coloane), Ocean Gardens and Lake Building (Taipa), and on the Macau Peninsula (Praya Grande, Fai Chi Kei, Tap Seac, Praia do Manduco). Traps are being trialed at Conde S. Januário Hospital, health centers, and health stations; SSM director Alvis Lo said expansion will depend on results. The device mimics human respiration by releasing carbon dioxide and uses a light spectrum to attract mosquitoes, which are dehydrated and killed. Imported dengue and chikungunya cases raise local transmission risk during the peak summer tourist season. Since January–June, 7,751 breeding-site inspections and 1,524 fogging rounds at about 130 spots; from July, fogging intensified to 3–4 times monthly, with dynamic risk assessments. Locally made traps will also be tested for wider deployment.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、蚊の繁殖率上昇に対処するためスマート蚊トラップを導入
triage.triage_reason: マカオでのデング熱・チクングニア熱の蚊媒介リスク上昇と予防対策の記事だが、実際の症例急増や地域流行の報告はなく、現時点では予防的措置の段階であるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事はマカオ（中国特別行政区として China に分類）における蚊媒介感染症（デング・チクングニア）予防のための対策強化に関するもの。輸入症例による地域内伝播リスクの上昇が言及されているが、具体的な症例数や流行状況は記載されていない。ニュージーランドは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Updates on Ebola Outbreak in DRC and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC is the 17th there, with the Bundibugyo strain spreading across five provinces, affecting more than 2,400 people and causing over 930 deaths since May. Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths, linked to travel from the DRC. More than 80% of new infections occur outside known contact lists, signaling untraced transmission; the outbreak is the third largest, with a fatality rate around 25–40%. WHO has declared a PHEIC. No approved vaccines or targeted treatments exist for Bundibugyo; NV-387 is under study. Response is hampered by conflict, limited health infrastructure, and funding cuts; Africa CDC estimates $1.4 billion is needed, with only about $110 million pledged. The U.S. imposes 21-day travel restrictions on people from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and CDC has deployed over 120 personnel. Public health measures: early detection, contact tracing, safe burials, and supportive care remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: CDC、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行に関する最新情報を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラ流行（感染2400人超、死亡930人超）が発生し、ウガンダへの国際的拡大とWHOのPHEIC宣言、米国の渡航制限が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・米国・南スーダンは記事に登場するが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）はWHOによりPHEIC宣言済みで、資金不足と紛争により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Shanghai Ark Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd.: ArkBio Completes all Cohort Dosing in Australian Phase I Trial with Influenza AFC Drug AK0406
article.articleSummary: As of July 24, 2026, Shanghai Ark Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (ArkBio) reports all cohorts of healthy volunteers have been dosed in an Australian Phase I trial of AK0406, a novel long-acting antiviral-Fc conjugate (AFC) for influenza prophylaxis, with the study now in the follow-up phase. AK0406 is designed to provide sustained pre- and post-exposure prophylaxis and potential therapeutic benefits by linking potent antiviral drugs to an antibody Fc fragment. Preclinical data indicate broad-spectrum, high-potency activity against influenza A and B and retention of Fc-mediated effector functions, with an optimized pharmacological profile for prophylaxis and treatment. Influenza remains a global public health challenge due to antigenic drift, strain-prediction uncertainty, and reduced vaccine protection in elderly/immunocompromised populations. AK0406 may offer a safer, more convenient preventive option to complement existing influenza vaccination strategies.

triage.headline_ja: 上海アークバイオファーマシューティカル社：インフルエンザAFC薬AK0406のオーストラリア第I相試験で全コホートの投与が完了
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新薬開発（治験）に関する企業発表であり、感染症の発生・流行に関するイベントではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザ治療薬の臨床試験進捗に関する企業ニュースであり、実際の感染症発生事例を報告するものではない。上海・中国・オーストラリアの記載は企業所在地・治験実施地に関するものであり、疾病発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: شیوع ابولا در آفریقا جان ۱۰۰۰ نفر را گرفت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Africa has claimed 1,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Africa has claimed more than 1,000 lives. In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), as of July 20, there are 2,473 laboratory-confirmed cases, including 999 deaths and 482 recoveries. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths, bringing total deaths across the two countries to 1,001. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and remains in a sustained transmission phase with high viral circulation. Frontline responders have been infected in 121 cases, with 36 deaths. WHO cautions that official figures may underestimate the true scale; modeling suggests the real burden could be 2–4 times higher. The spread has reached Haut-Uele and Shopo provinces, raising concerns of wider spread within the DRC or into neighboring countries, notably Uganda and South Sudan. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kasia warned that failure to stop now could make this one of the worst Ebola outbreaks on record.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ流行、死者1,000人に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC・ウガンダで持続的に拡大し、死者1,000人超・症例2,400以上、医療従事者感染も多数発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの拡大懸念があるが、対象国リストにウガンダ・スーダンは含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Africa CDCは過去最悪クラスの流行になり得ると警告。

article.articleHeadline: Masih Endemik Malaria, Biak Numfor Kembangkan Strategi Lintas Sektor Bebas Penyakit 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria Still Endemic, Biak Numfor Develops an Intersectoral Strategy to Achieve a Disease-Free Status by 2030
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains highly endemic in Biak Numfor Regency, Papua, with 4,425 cases in 2025. To achieve disease-free status by 2030, the Biak Numfor Health Office is implementing an intersectoral prevention and control (P2P) strategy targeting malaria, tuberculosis (TB), HIV, and leprosy, aligned with national health service standards (SPM). The plan emphasizes cross‑sector collaboration, advocacy, and social engagement to strengthen preventive, promotional, and responsive measures, and to accelerate early detection at village and district levels while reducing stigma around TB, HIV, and leprosy. Actions include mobilizing CSR funding and coordinating with TNI/Polri, district authorities, and local leaders to solidify partnerships. Twenty-one Puskesmas will optimize early detection and treatment initiation. The initiative seeks to translate coordination-evaluation activities into concrete recommendations and actionable plans to speed up elimination targets by 2030 and improve overall health outcomes in Biak Numfor and Papua.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアは依然として風土病、ビアック・ヌンフォールは2030年疾病フリーに向け部門横断戦略を展開
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・パプア州における既知の風土病（マラリア、結核、HIV、ハンセン病）対策の行政的取り組みに関する記事であり、異常な流行や新規性はなく、通常の保健政策報道である。
triage.notes: 既知の風土病（マラリア等）に対する地方自治体の2030年までの排除目標に向けた継続的施策の報道であり、新規シグナルとしての緊急性はない。Papua New Guineaは発生地域に含まれるが記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DRC passes the 1,000-death mark for Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 1,000 deaths, with 1,033 fatalities among 2,535 confirmed cases as of 23 July 2026. Of the confirmed cases, 738 are in isolation and 506 have recovered; the overall case-fatality rate is 40.7%. The national contact-tracing rate stands at 77.2%, below targets. The outbreak affects 42 health zones across five provinces: Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Ituri, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele. Ituri remains the hotspot, accounting for 88.6% of cumulative cases and 73% of new infections recorded on the day. Nord-Kivu has the highest case-fatality rate at 58.7%. The Emergency Operations Centre for Patient Care notes ongoing transmission, with the outbreak having begun on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱による死者数が1,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者数が1,000人を超え、致死率40.7%、5州42保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡率が目標(77.2%)を下回り、Ituri州が症例の88.6%を占めるなど感染拡大が続いている。フルリスク評価が必要。
